snga 'gyur byang gter chos skor phyogs bsgrigs/5 mtha'i65595720331090505 5 601955035 55 33135 tsā
tshosagu/rṇe/ zhunyi dzrakegi jiXri9dzi/9phyo
༄༅/ /snga 'gyur byang gter chos skor phyogs sgrig pod nyi shu pa bzhugs so//
༄tshi/ /rgya zhang khrom rdo rje 'od 'bar ni/ gtsang rong ram pa'i chu tshan khar spyi le'i dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i nang sku 'khrungs/ khyim tshang dbul bas chung dus mu to ba dang ra rdzi mdzad/ nya mo lha khang du rnal 'byor pa zhig dang mjal nas phung po ri bo cher bla ma de dang mnyam du phebs/ bla mas dngul gyi bum pa tshe chus gang ba zhig gnang ba de btsongs nas yi ge bslab/ de nas rim bzhin gsan bsam rgya cher mdzad/ gter gyi kha byang zhig phyag tu son/ de bsnams nas gtsang gi phung po ri bo che dang g.yung phu rdza lugs/ gnyug gi rdo rje phug sogs gter gnas rnams su byon nas 'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i lcags sdig dang lcags 'dra/ thog 'dra/ gshin rje khro bcu dug sdong nag po sogs rgyud dang sgrub thabs dpag tu med pa spyan drangs skal ldan gyi bu slob mang po smin grol gyi lam la bkod par mdzad do/ sku tshe ji tsam bzhugs pa ma shes/
༄tshi/ /rgyal ba nyid las lhag pa'i lung mnga' zhing / /'phrin las mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i rtsa lag mchog gyur pa'i/ /o rgyan rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /snga 'gyur byang gter chos skor phyogs bsgrigs las glegs bam nye shu pa'i nang bzhugs/ rgya zhung khrom rdo rje 'od 'bar gyis gter byon 'jam dpal gshin rje skor las/ pod gsum pa phung po ri bo che nas spyan drangs ba'i tshe bdag lcags 'dra'i skor la/ sdig pa snying 'dzings 'khrul 'khor gsang rgyud/16 (1) tshe bdag snying po don gyi rgyud/5 (33) sdig pa snying 'dzings kyi man ngag rtsa ba slob dpon padmas mdzad pa/8 (43) sgron ma drug gsal bar byed pa'i man ngag rin po che 'od 'phro zhes bya ba phag ston gyis mdzad pa/3 (59) gshin rje tshe bdag gi las thams cad pa'i 'khor lo'i 'grel pa/6 (65) mchod rten gsal bar byed pa'i sgron ma se ston gyis mdzad pa/14(77) tshe bdag gi las tshogs tsakra kiti'i rgyud/3 (105) zil gnon mngon rtogs rgyun khyer se ston rin po ches mdzad pa drag sngags cog brdungs su grags pa/3 (111) 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed phyag rgya zil gnon tshe bdag nag po'i thugs dam rgyun khyer gtor 'bul dang bcas pa/5 (117) dpal tshe bdag nag po'i las bzhi'i sbyin sreg4 (127) pad lugs kyi sbyin sreg6 (135) 'jam dpal tshe bdag gter brgyud
las bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/3 (147) zil gnon las byang sngon 'gro'i kha skong gi so sdebs dang bcas pa/6 (153) bcom ldan 'das phyag rgya zil gnon gyi las byang /9 (165) go cha'i lha bskyed pa dang rwa zor bcas/3 (183) bsam gtan stong srog 'khor lo bri rgyud/10 (189) sbyor ba bzhi pa/5 (209) pad lugs kyi las tshogs/4 (219) rgya zhang khrom gyi gter byung gi lo rgyus/2 (227) mchod rten lag tu blang ba'i spra khrid sgron ma gu ru khrag 'thung nag po'i man ngag9 (231) phung po ri bo che'i gter byang /4 (249) mchod bstod gsal bar byed pa'i sgron ma/13 (257) bsam gtan stong srog gi 'khor lo'i bri yig6(283) bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon gyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga28 295) nad gdon sdig sgrib dag par byed pa bum pa khrus kyi las rim/4 (351) rin po che phyag rgya gsal ba'i sgron ma zil gnon gyi man ngag9 (359) 'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i sbyin sreg gi las byang /6 (377) pad lugs snying 'dzings gter ma'i skor/2 (389) zla gsang nag po'i man ngag byad ma rang gshed rang la dbab pa'i las drug3 (393) khrag 'thung nag po'i zhal gdams sdig pa snying 'dzings yang gsang snying po'i don gyi sgrub pa/5 (399) mchod rten yongs rdzogs 'khor lo nag po gsang ba'i sgrub thabs/3 (409) drag sngags
༄tsho/ /mtshon cha nag po'i rgyud/8 (415) drag sngags nag po snying 'dzings las sgrub khog chen mo'i dbab pa/9 (431) 'khor lo gsang ba'i spra khrid/3 (449) mnan pa'i zhal gdams shig yod/2 (455) sngags kyi 'khrul 'khor sdig pa snying 'dzings drag po dbang sdud/4 (459) lha srin ming srog 'phrog pa'i ting 'dzin yig chung /3 (467) bsrung ba bsam gtan stong srog gi 'khor le'i bri rgyud/6 (473) 'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i mchod rten gyi bstod pa gsal ba'i sgron ma/11 (485) dpal gshin rdze gshed tshe bdag nag po'i mchod rten gyi rnam par nges pa gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes kyis mdzad pa/4 (507) spyi gcod 'phrul gyi lde mig sgron ma gsal ba'i spra khrid/17 (515) phyi mchod rten la brten pa'i sgrub thabs/8 (549) 'jam dpal dril sgrub gsang ba/6 (565) sdig pa snying 'dzings dril sgrub man ngag3 (577) dpal gshin rje zla gsang 'khor 'o1 nag po'i drag sngags/3 (583) 'jam dpal zhi ba'i sgrub thabs bdud rtsi thig pa/3 (589) gnam lcags ur mo las drug g.yu spyang gi skor/11 (595) sdig pa nag po'i lus kyi spra khrid 2 (617) rus sbal khra bo'i pra khrid/2 (621) snying 'dzings snying po'i bcud phyung ba srung ba'i man ngag3 (625) bcom ldan 'das phyag rgya zil gnon gyi phrin las kyi rim pa gsal bar byed pa'i sgron me/12
(631) sngags kyi 'bru bshad thems yig6 (655) 'jam dpal sku'i bsnyen yig yid bzhin nor bu/4 (667) tshe bdag brgyud pa'i phyag 'tshal byin rlabs rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs/5 (675) sngags kyi 'khrul 'khor sdig pa snying 'dzings drag po 'bru 'grel/3 (685) mchod rten lag tu blang ba'i man ngag dang spra khrid dbabs/9 (691) kha thun gyi dril sgrub man ngag ces bya ba ur mo las drug zer ba/9 (709) sngags spra khrid zhal gdams 2 (727) tshe bdag sgom khog zhal gdams/2 (731) tshe bdag sdig pa snying 'dzings kyi man ngag sgron ma drug pa/29 (735) padma 'gyur med rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i 'jam dpal tshe bdag lcags 'dra'i stobs chen mchod rten gtso gyur gyi man ngag gnad kyi sgron ma bdun pa/35 (793) man ngag sgron ma bdun pa las phag mo gsang ba'i 'khor 'o'i dpe'u ris/2 (863) mchod rten gyi nang gi lha gnas dpe'u ris/2(867) rme 'thab nang tshan sbrul nag lte 'thab dang rdo rje rme 'thab kyi 'khor lo'i dpe'u ris/2 (871) rme 'thab spu gri'i nang tshan rgyal po dgrar langs dang btsad po bsad pa'i 'khor lo'i dpe'u ris/2 (875) rme 'thab spu gri'i nang tshan stag mo mche 'thab dang glang chen mche 'thab kyi 'khor lo'i dpe'u ris/2 (879) 'jam dpal tshe bdag lcags 'dra'i stobs chen mchod rten gyi lag len sgron ma bdun pa'i dpe'u ris rnams las mun
༄tsho/ /smag bsdu ba'i 'khor lo'i dpe'u ris/2 (883) 'chi bdag yab yum gyi thod 'khor dpe'u ris/2 (887) gshed po las kyi 'khor le'i yab yum gyi dpe'u ris/2 (891) 'og 'degs rlung steng gcod nam mkha' bshig pa bya khyung so brdar gyi tsakra rnams kyi dpe'u ris/2 (895) rme 'thab spu gri'i nang tshan rma bya mjing bsnol sngags rus sbal lto sdebs kyi 'khor lo dpe'u ris/2 (899) lcags sdig nas bshad pa'i gnam lcags so brdar gyi 'khor lo'i dpe'u ris/2 (903) lcags sdig nas 'byung po'i gtad zlog 'khor le'i dpe'u ris/3 (907)lcags sdig gi byas pa bshig pa'i dpe'u ris/2 (913) rme 'thab spu gri'i nang tshan shwa na lce 'thab dang khyung mo gshog 'thab kyi 'khor lo'i dpe'u ris/3 (917) man ngag sgron ma bdun pa las gshed po las rdal gyi 'khor lo'i dpe'u ris/3 (923) sgrub gtor mchod gtor gter srung ba'i bam skong rnams kyi gtor ma'i dpe'u ris/2 (929) gtad bzlog dgra mnan gyi 'khor le'i dpe'u ris/2 (933) stong srog spyang mo drug gi 'khor lo dang sgron drug rlang ga'i dpe'u ris/2 (939) rus sbal mchog gi 'khor lo'i dpe'u ris / 3 (945) gnam lcags thog 'khor dang pho nya rkang mgyogs zlog pa'i 'khor le'i dpe'u ris/2 (951) liṅga sdig 'khor sogs la skyon pa'i dpe'u ris/1 (955) par byang smon tshig1 (957—958)bcas
༄//sdig pa snying 'dzings sprul khor gzhi rgyud btsos so//
༄༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ mañdza shrī ya ma tsakra kā la hri tsitta dzu ghu hya tan tra/ bod skad du/ 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed 'khrul 'khor nag po'i sdig pa snying 'dzings gsang ba'i rgyud/ bcom ldan 'das 'jigs byed kyi rgyal po ya man ta ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gi thos pa'i dus gcig na/ chos gnas phun sum tshogs pa kyi dbyings rnam par dag pa'i klong mtha' dbus med pa'i pho brang rgya yongs su ma chad pa lhun gyis grub pa'i gzhal yas na/ bcom storbe pa phun sum tshogs pa ldan 'das sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i bdag nyid/ sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin chos nyid : yang ma yin pa zhes bya ba mnyam pa chen po'i ngang la snyoms par bzhugs so/ /de nyid 'bosgyur phun sum tshogs pa na ma sgrib chos kyi dbyings gnas pa'i ye shes dang / /sa dang byang chub sems dpa' lam la gnas pa rnams dang / /lha dang mkha' 'gro rig pa 'dzin pa rnams dang / /'jig rten dregs pa'i gtso
༄tshi/ /bo rnams dang/ thabs gcig tu 'khril cing bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe de'i dus na 'khor de dag gi nang nas/ rdo rje snying po zhes bya ba stan las langs te/ bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa/ kye ho/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin rdo rje 'chang / /chos kun thugs rje chen pos kun khyab pa/ /ma rtogs sems can thugs rjes bsgral ba'i phyir/ /mi rtog dbyings las rdzogs pa'i skur bzhengs la/ /mnyam pa'i ngang la 'gro ba'i don mdzod cig /ces gsol pas/ de nas bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis mi rtog pa'i dbyings las rol pa'i skur/ thugs rje'i chags pas bzhengs te/ dregs pa can dbang du bsdu zhing / gdug pa can 'dul ba'i phyir/ phyag rgya chen po zil gyis gnon pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par bzhugs so/ /gsang sngags 'di dag ched du gsungs/ ayo ayo drag po'i dbang sdud ayo a kro sku'i te ka ya man ta ka ya ma ye gsung gi ka la ru pa ka pa ye/ hri ti a pa thugs kyi ye a 'jig rten dregs pa'i
dbang du sdud cing gzir ba a ni a ni/ lha srinon srobs gzhom pa'i yang snying ngo u u nai u nai/ du du ne du ne/ a i u e o aX/ ra ri/ la li/ du ru ye/ bya tsa ye/ sing nga ye/ hri da ye/ bi dha ye/ tsitta ye/ ha la ye/ mu kha ye/ u u ne u u ne/ byi tri ta/ a a na na/ ya ma rā sras mchog tsa/ ya ma myos byed 'bar ba rag sha/ ya ma arya ma ru rag a/ ya ma ral pa ṇā dgu rakṣa/ se ta sbyor yum li/ kro ti shwa ri/ ma ma e ka dza sgrol yum ti/ de ma kha la/ bam ril/ ru lu ru lu/ shrī badzra kro ta ya ma garma/ ro ṣa ṇa kri ta tsan dha rag sha mon mon pa bzhi ta/ a mu mingasrol 'dir gzhug ka myags thums ril trig gzer ba nan/ sbur ya ston pa nan/ e hur thums dza/ kham shag rgyun bcad pa ro myags mugs ti sbad ya/ ces gsungs pas/ nam mkha' nyid mthing nag gru gsum du gyur to rlung rdo rje rgya gram phyogs bcur 'thor ro/ rakta'i rgya mtsho 'khrug go 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad 'ur 'ur/ chem chem dang / rab tu 'gul / ldeg go de'i tshe de'i dus na/ lnga'or thams cad rgyas te/ lus sa la sdeb cing / dran pa'i dbang po nyams so/ de nas yang rdo rje snying pos gsol pa/ kye ma 'jigs byed chen po lags/ mnyam pa'i ngang las 'jigs pa'i skur khros te/ /gsang sngags gsung gi nga ro ched du gsungs/ /'jig rten khams rnams rab tu cher g.yos te/ /'khor du 'dus pa srog dang bral du nye/ /thugs rje nyi ma lta bus dbugs phyung la/ /dkyil 'khor chen po bsrung bar phrin las bskos/ /ces gsol te/ de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis dbugs dbyung ba'i ting nge 'dzin la
༄tshi/ /snyoms par zhugs pas/ 'khor thams cad rgyal ba las langs te/ bcom ldan 'das la 'dun pa skyes te/ skad cig mas lhags nas/ rang gi srog gi snying po mthu rtsal 'gran nas phul te sku la 'khril to/ dpal sdig pa snying 'dzings 'brul 'khor nag po'i gsang rgyud las/ gleng gzhi'i le'u ste dang pa'o/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das rdo rje snying pos gsol pa/ kye ho/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo rdo rje nyid/ /lnga brgya tha ma snyigs ma dus kyi nye/ /'chi bdag bdud kyi gshin rje khong nas 'khrug /mtshams med lnga'i las ngan kun spyod tshe/ /dga' rab nyi ma shar phyogs nas bdud dga' rab dbang phyug gis bstan pa 'jig par byed pas sangs rgyas gyi chul bcos nas/ de mu stegs spyod pa ngan pa/ sngags dang dug dbal gyis buddha rang yang nang 'khrug dbang phyug bdud kyi sprul pa 'gyed/ /rang dang 'dra ba'i tshul 'dzin ban dgra yis/ /phyi rol la sogs sngags dang dug rlangs 'tshol/ /de dus gzer spyir drag sngags thugs drag po'i smod pa zhal gyi mchog /sdig pa nag po'i snying la ban dgra'i ru 'dzings pa'i las kyi zhabrul 'khor nag po bshad par mdzod/ ces gsol pas/ de nas phyag rgya chen po bcom ldan 'das kyi khro bo thams cad dbyung zhing las kyi gzer thun nag po rgyas par bshad pa'i phyir/ btsun mo chos kyi dbyings kyi bha ga la snyoms par zhugs te/ye shes bzhi dang sku gsung thugs las ya ma ra tsa me long badzra dang myos byed mag nyid ratna 'bar ba/ arya kun rdzogs padma dmar po/ ral pa tshar dgu bya ba nan tan rkarma bzhi sngon du phyung ste/ de nyid yang dregs pa 'dul zhing zil gyis gnon pa'i phyir/ ya ma
ra me longe tsa dang / phyag na mnyam nyid rdo rje dang / rus sbal mi bya grub zan dang / ye shes kyi bya khung so 9so /kun dang / bzhir gyur te/ 'byung ba'i dngos po rsāchu me rlung 'dzin pa nyid dag phung po 9bzhi nas/ dwangs ma ye shes bzhi chen po nyid du rang grol te/ phyag zil gnon rgya sku'i la rjesags par gyur to/ sprul pa rnam pa gsum ni/ sku'i sprul nag po rtsomago rtsodagu pa sa 'og la dbang byed pa 'chi bdag gsung gi sprul phyome byed dmar po 9bar snangal dbang byed pa pa 31ga bdag thugs kyi sprul tshe bdag nag po rtsomago rtsodagu pa ni mkha' la dbang byed pa pa tshe bdag ste/ gdug pa can 'dul bar gyur to/ gshed po bzhi las kyi mon pa bzhi dungagi morna pa lcags kyi bso'i gser gyi sprul te/ pho gshed sprul pa nyid yin gyis nyid kyi gshin rje gzugs kyi phung po rtsol soges pa sum brgya drug cu phung po la dbang bsgyur/ mo gshed sa chu me rlung las kyi bdud mo bzhis/ mo gshed sum brgya drug cu 'byung ba la dbang bsgyur/ de ltar gshin rje lo /rsāg la rdzoges par 'gyur ro 9bdun brgya nyi shu la sogs pas/ 'jig rten pa'i dregs lha dgu la soges pa pa can gyi/ dpal phyag rgya chen po zil gyis gnon pa'i ya man ta ka la yongs su bskor te/ rol pa chen po las kyi dkyil 'khor du 'khod par bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe lha dang sngags dang 'byung ba bzhis bstan te de'i dus na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor rnams la 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /snang stong gnyis bde ba nyid do /med ye shes sku/ /thig le ngo rtsobo 9nyid yang dag pa nyag gcig spros dang bral/ /skye med rnam chas kyai sku dag bde chen sku/ /'gag med bde chen longes sku gdal ba'i/ /bdag dang bral ba'i chos nyid la/ /chags sdang lhun gyis grub
༄7/ /pa'o / / zhen de nyid ye shes rang snang chags bzung 'dzin rtog spyod 'das/ /gnyis med don dam chos kyi sku/ /rgyu dang rkyen ma nor bar bskyed pa ma bskyed pa las grub pa med/ /kun gyi rang bzhin dngos cir yang ma grub pa med pa las med pas/ /yon tan kun gyi 'byungaganas ma lus kun 'byung ba'o/ /de nyid rtogs med brjod dang bral/ /dug lnga nyid ye shes tshog 'byung rang grol ba lnga'i sku/ /phyag rgya zil gnon chen po ye shes nyid/ /stong pa ryā nyid skye ba med pa chen po'i ngang nyid las/ /rang snang rol rol pa 'gag pa med pa ya man ta ka pa'i phyag rgyar gsal/ /las dang sbyor ba du ma kun/ /sgyu ma lhun grub rol par shar/ /'di dge bde phyis ma 'dir don smin byed pa'i/ /rol pa chen po'i 'khrul 'khor yin/ sdig pa snying 'dzings 'khrul 'khor nag po'i rgyud las/lta ba bstan pa'i le'u gnyis pa'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang chen pos/ rang gshed rang la dbab pa'i phyir/ sdig pa drag sngags nag po dgra tsho'i snying la ru 'dzings pa'i lasakyi 'khrul 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor mchod rten bca' chen po bca' ba'i thabs/ 'di gsungs so/ /stobs chen nag po'i rdzas bzlog dag /phung shul mi phungapa'i sde phrul hrul g.yul du bsad pa'i mi bsad g.yul bkye pa'i sa dang / /dur khrod kyi sa la dngosaro yi sa dag la/ /ro dngosabasreg dngosardo dang sol ba chen po dang dang / /gri lcags mi bsad pa'i lcags brdal dpa' bo g.yul bsad khrag /ra dug re'u lcags a phreg ba spu gnad/ /11ga lha srin chags mkhar sa spyin gro kha ba'i lpags pa 11ga shun nag /lhagag dngos 'dag tshe chus dngos sbyar te brtsig /nag kha dogs po khru gang dpang tshad bang
rim bzhi/ /yongs stobes chen yonges rdzoges nus pa khyad par can rdzogs stobs chen mi 'gyur gnad/ /stan gyi steng nas la rus sbal glang po chen 'degs/ /bad la shar rgyal rigs des 'gre rigs bzhi sbrul gyi 'degs/ /bang rim bzhi la stag dang zur bzhi gzig /gsum pa seṅge chu srin zur bzhir no/ /'oshesar 'o1 'brug gi phru'i 'degs pa la/ /char khab mkha' lding ro nye sbrul nag za/ /rang sems can rang kha dog ldan pa ste/ /mkhas pas bkod pa stobs chen sems can sto bas chen gnad/ /bang rim phyogs kun drag po'i sgo/ /yongs su rdzogs pa'i lho ru bdag gi bca'/ /gri mda' snyug rgod khrag chen ldan/ /srog shing zil phyag rgya zil gnone lha brgyad bcas pa'i gnon sku ru gsal/ /bang rim dang po zur bzhi la/ /srin po shar smug nag ya ma ra tsa dang/ /gzhin rje lho /ser myos byed 'bar ba dang/ /bdud po arya nub dmar ma ru rtse/ /gnod sbyin ral byang ljang pa tshar dgu dgod/ /bang rim gnyis pa srog gi gshed/ /dung lcags seṅge stag dred khyung mgo can bse dang gser gyi mon/ /gsum pa phyi'i he le so /'dar ral pa nag po rtsogashed po bzhi/ /mtha' zur bzhi ma 'chi bdag bcu gnyis loge la brgyad dgod/ /dkar po shar sgo /snying 'byin mgon po lho nag /yab rje nub nag po sku mchog byang dmar/ /drag po sgo bzhi dag la dgod/ /lha gsal ba'am mis ma tshor bar bko da pas stong gsum zil gnon sgrol/ /sangs rgyas thugs rje bka'i byin rlabs cig 31bas dpag med/ /bka'i ye nas gnas pas 'phel 'grib med byin rlabs yun du gnas/ /bam rim dang po rtsonas tha ma rgyu dag gi bar bar du/ /phas dam nyams kyi lha dang gnod byed mnan/ /gang de'i byin
༄7/ /rlabs kyi bsgrub las rnams grub par 'gyur/ /stobs dang ldan pa'i sngags drag po nang 'gras pa'i pa'am/ /rdo rje nang dme drag po yi/ /gnam lcags ur drag po dang 'gras pa'i mo nang 'gras na/ /rgya mtsho'i steng du na klu bdud gag bzlog nag po ga'i bdud/mun pa'i dmag bsdud 'khrul 'khor bcas/ /ri rab rtse la gnam lcags dag/ /ur mo so gdar 'khrul 'khor bca' gsang pa/ /ri thang mtshams su zhe sdang can/ /khros pa'i bzlog pa'i gzhu cag 'khrul 'khor bca'/ /nam mkha' bsrung zhing bzlog pa mthing gi phya ra dgram/ /sbyor ba bshig pa'i mtshon cha dbab/ /ya bag sha'i las 'di dag yin pas/ /med dngadam tshog mi bsrun gang zag gis/ /spyad kyang las med 'bras bu dmyal bar lhungarang la gnod par 'gyur/ /sdig pa nag po snying 'dzings 'khrul 'khor nag po gsang rgyud las/ stobs chen gyad non mchod rten yongs rdzogs kyi le'u ste gsum pa'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rang gshed rang la dbab pa las/ las kyi 'khrul 'khor snying la skor ba 'di gsungs so/ /sku yongs su mchod rten 'og tu rdzogs pa'i lto ba sa/ /maṇḍal mthing nag gru gsum gsang ba'i 'brub khung dag /phung pa gsum mi bsad g.yud gyes phungashul dang dug khrag sbru/ /bang rim tri la kha khyer gsum brtseg rtsangs/ /dug ro sreg pa'i sol ba khrag sol bas nag por byug /dpal brtul can gyi lta ba spyod pa sngags pa yis/ /zhing lpags 'bor lo'i rgyud dag gam ro gos la/ /rno myur sdug sku 'byams par byed byed phag mo'i ltor/ /srid pa'i khyam khang rus sbal gyi srog snying bsdud/ /khyams nga lto mingarus ru gnag pa gzhug /snying kha mtshon
cha'i 'khor 'ordzo sdig pa rang gshed bca'/ /rgya gram dag la rtsa ba'i e myags sngags/ /yang 'ordzog dgra bo'i srog la snra hur thums bcu bzhi spu gri'i so/ /rtsa ba spu gri lto sdeb bar na khyams/ /brten pa bdud du 'bebs kho gang sgrub bya pa'i 'bru/ /ming rus gsang sngags dgra bo ma ra ya ces dang khams bcas za kha dbab/ /rus sbal 3( yi spungags mtshams la/ /bcu gnyis nang bstan phag mo'i 'bru/ /'khrul mig khyams khang mi rus bri/ /kha sbyar dug dang khrag gis byug /rme ba'i rdzas byug ja hril bsdo/gas/ /rgyu liṅga rkyen drug la ling ga bri/ /rang rgyud rtsa ba'i dgra bo'i srog rtsa 'bar lo nag po 'khor lo dag /dmar nag ya'i dbus na ma/ /ma mo'i khong nas srog mig na gnas yig bri/ /me chu las kho rang gi kyi 'khrug cing skyom/ /snying gi rtsa rang chas ye nas yinabazhi dngas ma ni/ /zhe sdang sdig pa nag chul du por gnas/ /lus la sdig pa'i dmar len e dun ka yam yig 'bru gnas/ /ru 'dzings sdig pa'i 'bru brgyad bsnol 'bru brgyad mar gnas/ /rtsa mdud bdun gsum rang gshed 'bru drug gnyis yis 'joms/ /dngas ma bzhi'i rtsa chen bzhi bcad na si ra la/ /chos nyid bad dzin rtsa la ayo dang myags/ sa'i dwangs ma me la bsdud/ /yon tan mkhris pa rtsa la ya dang 〈cobs/ /me'i dwangs ma chu la bsdu/ /ye shes khrag rtsa la mugs dang shags/ /chu'i dwangs ma rlung la bsdud/ /rang rgyud rtsa la ka dang dun dwangs ma sdud cing nad bzhi bzhi rim pas rgyas/ /rlung gi rnam shes stobs kyis dwangs ma 'degs/ /de bskul de 'od rang rgyud rtsa de mtshon pas/ /de bcad rang rgyud rtsa de nyid sreg cing 'joms/ /bdud po a yi bcad pas bzhi la mtshon pa'i 'bru/ /
༄tshi/ /bdun gnyis drug gnyis spu gri bsnol mar rtsi ba yang log gnas/ /las kyi me ga chu 'khrug cing bsreg /rang rgyud rang la 'dod zhingarang sa la sgyur rang gi rgyud la ldang / /mtshon khrum po ri ka lta chas rang srog rang gi gcod/ /snying la gnas pa'i tshe bdag sems can kun gyi gis/ /rtsa rnams bzhi brgyad gcod cing srog brtan 'joms/ de nas gsang ba'i bcom ldan 'das kyis rang gshed kyi 'khrul bzlas pa'i thabs bstan 'khor gsang ba'i yang snying 'di gsungs so/ /e myags ya bsnol mar bstegs rngubs mug pa shag ka dun/ dgra bo'i srog la snra khur thums dza/ rtsakhag snying thums/ ril ram shag rbad/ dgra bo'i tsitta brengashag dgra bo dza/ srog la hur thums rbad/ dun ka shag mugs bzlog par bstegs rngubs ya myags e/ shag ram ril thums snying khrag rtsa dun thums snra la dgra bo dza/ thums hur la srog rbad/ shag breng ta tsi dgra bo dza/ e yag lto ba dkrug pa shag myags dun rngubs ka mugs/ srog thums ril hur snra dza/ thums khrag snying rtsa la thun shag rbad/ dgra bo'i srog la breng thums tsitta shag khur dza la rbad/ /snal dang po ma bzlog dang ma grub na lto ba dkrug /sgrub dang tingange 'dzin masgo rten pa drug la spog dang shi sa yis/ /yid chad rang dbang med par 'ong / /'khor lo mkhas sa ba'i pa pas gdug par gtad/ /nam gsum pa mkha' bar snang sa gzhi la brgyad pa/ /gnod (mnan )pa'i las kun rdzogs par bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ / sdig pa nag po snying 'dzings 'khrul 'khor gsang ba'i rgyud las/ rang gshed 'khor lo snying la bskor ba'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o/ /de nas bcom ldan
'das 'jigs byed chen po des/ rang gshed rang la dbab pa labar lo thun dang sbrel drag po thun gyi las 'di gsungs so/ /gnad kyi gsang thun las 'di grub par byed do kyi mtshon/ /bskyed pa kha gso las kyi gtso/ /gri rgod thod pa mon (men )nam snol khyi dang spyang kai wa'i khrag /thal chen mnol khrag dug mda' gsum/ /zangs phye lcags phye rdo phye sbyar/ /gri rgod khrag dang dug rgod dang / /tsha ba gsum dang yugs sa'i khrag/ /gri lcags phur pa dung chen gzar/ /bcas la 'khor 'ordzo thun dang po nas 'khor lo thun dang sbrel dang sbrel / /'khosar 'o( gtad la 21ra kha garbersha thun bcas/ /nya stong skabs skabs su mgo bcingadabral dus su yul lha brab/ /mon yang na thun cig phu thod nang du gnas pa gzhug /lha gsal bdag nyid kyi zhal nas thun sngags brab zhal nas dug rlangs 'phyo/ /nad dang dgra'i yul mtshon cha char du dbab/ /dug dgra'i gi na bun khong du skyes/ /nad khrag dgra'i rgyas nas rtsa mdud gcod/ /'gyur ba med pa'i las su gsungs/ /dgra bo'i srog la thum ril shar sgo nas rbad rgyu'oX /khram lho shig tsitta phyogs rbad rgyu'oX /rtsa la nub rmugs thun rbad rgyu'oX /khrag byang la rmugs ti thun rbad rgyu'oX /dug rlangs 'chol pa las kyi thun/ /snying la dug rlangs 'bebs par byed/ /skyed pa kha gso rgyun mi bcad/ sdig pa snying 'dzings 'khrul 'khor gsang ba'i rgyud las/ rang gshed thun nag gsang ba'i le'u ste lnga pa'o/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das 'jigs byed chen po des/ rdo rje nang khyad par gyi las drug po 'di rme las kyi rmod pa gsang ba las kyi spu gri 'di gsungs so/ /dmar gsang ba yang gsang sdeb
༄༅/ /len yang gsang snying po mchog /gdug rtsub gnas mchog gsum bde gnas su/ /rang nyams bstan pa'i mtshams bcad la/ /ye shes rig pa'i bde klong nas/ /mkha' lnga khyab pa'i don sdud la/ /bzung 'dzin chos nyid dbyings su bsgral stobs can gzhan phyogs phas kyi lha gzan la dbab/ /rgyu rkyen tsakra'i tshogs pa'i 'khor 'ordzo la/ /mchog rus sbal dang phag mo'i 〈sna sdebs gong dang 'dra la/ /dbus kyi gru gsum la pho brang rgyal chen la/ /mtha' 'gyur gang yin bsad pa'i las drug gang byed liṅga bri/ /gu ru dam tshog rnam pas las mi tshib seṅge'i khog mi bshig /las kyi rgyal po rtsad po la/ /'khor lo rus sbal thod par brub/ /dkyil 'khor byin can 'og tu mnan/ /slob bu dang 'khru ma dam med dgrar lang na/ /cog pu liṅga'i snying nang du/ /zhe sdang lcags kyi sdig pa mgo dgu pa gzhug /thod pa stag gi 'dzum la mnan/ /dam rus gcig pa dam 'dres yi dam gcig pas na/ /gcer bu rid pa'i klad dkyil du/ /phrag dog bse'i sbal pa dmar po khrag gi bri gzhug /rme khrag nad khrag rkyen sterdzong bskul thod pa lu ma 'khyil par gtad/ /dam tshig gcig pa spyi'i spun/ /ling ga spyi tshar snying kha rtswa /bse'i sbal pa dmar po snyingal bri/ /dug rgod dza mdze la'i khrag gis brab/ /thod pa mun pa'i gling du mnan/ /lha gsas chags pa'i pon po la snying khar dug gi phag pa gzhug /nad khrag khyi lud thun brabs la/ /srin mo'i sgroms su nye bar gtad/ /drag sngags ur mo nang 'gras na/ /drag sngags snal dkru/ga bsnel mar steg /mnan pa 'breng gi thod par mnan/ /dril
dang rkyang pa las kyi sdebs/ /rtsab e myags 'bru brgyad drug pa la spu grir 'khor lo'i bcas/ /'khor 'ordzo thod thod pa lhas pa sre pa bcas par brub/ /ma grub sbyor ba stobs zhan na/ /dril ba'i gsang ba yang gsang du sdeb mtha' ru spu gri bsgyur/ /drag sngags snal bzlog dkrug pa brdeg /de nas bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las gsang sngags 'di dag gsungs so/ /ra tsa las kyi rtsang po la ni dza thums ril ma ra ya rbad/ /srog la slob la hur thums ma ra ya tsa la rbad/ /srog dam bcas pa la la hur ya thun rmugs ma ra ya rbad/ srog la drag sngags spyi la mugs dza hri shag ma ra ya rbad/ /srog la bon po la snra dza thun mugs ma ra ya rbad/ /tsitta kha shag dza 37ga la thun drag sngags nang la rbad/ /'dod dgra bo'i pa'i ming dang a mu ka/ /las kyi skabs su shes par bya/ /sngags dus kyi 'ang kyi 'khor lo nang gcod dang / /kha thams 'jigs seng ge rus sbal bsnol rtsal 'gram sngags/ /dam tshig rme 'khrug 'byung ba la/ /dpa' bo chen po'i las 'di gsungs/ /spyang ki brtsad po slob ma mon gyi thod pa dang / /mu sngags spyi zi nag po bon po mdze can snel/ /khrims dam tshig gcig pa 'chal mgo'am gos dag la/ /rab chad nag po'i ur mo'i nang thod par mnan/ /'di dag las kun yang rab ste/ /rang gshed nag po'i las mthar phyin/ /ces gsungs so/ sdig pa snying 'dzings 'khrul 'khor gsang ba'i rgyud las/ gsang ba yang snying gi le'u ste drug pa'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis/ ban dgra nag po'i stobs dang bral ba'i 'khrul 'khor ngag mnan pa'i labar lo 'di gsung so/ /dbang can stobs dang bral
༄tshi/ /ba dag /dur khrod gdug pa gnas pa'i bde gnas su/ /sna lhutogs rdzas gomedang 'dre ba'o /drag po'i sa dag la/ /mchod rten nag po rim pa bang rim gsum/ /dug khrag nag po rtsodag gis rab tu byug /dri mingarus dza kha sbyore gcig par rgod ras sam rgya thegag du ni bcas pa bri la/ /ban dgra nag po'i liṅga bri/ /rkang sa bshad rjes sa stug pa dang sa nang dri chu chu/ /bag phye khrag dang kham sa ra khrag dang sa spyin sbru/ /mdzub che chungagang dbang po lngasad pa la/ /snying khar ming rus gang ma kun gzhug par bya/ /ñtsa steng du nan ga mnan ṇā 'bore 'o lnga yis mtshan/ /rgya rdo /rje gram thugs hri tri nyid lang gis mdzes/ /srog ya ma rag mo /lus lha srin snying pos mnan/ /steng du mchod bang rim gsum pa rten ri rab bzhag /gnas kho'i gnas kyi lha yang gdug pa che bas kho rtsogang sgrub yang rtags med khang steng ma shar du mnan sgrub bcol phrin las ci byas kyang / /ngag gi nus dregs pas 'chi'o 9pa stobs kyis 'ching/ /dam yang dam tshig gcig pa tshig ldan yang sngags rus gcig pa gcig pa'i/ /rgyud gsum yang bslobe gsum bzloge nus pa gag bzloge nus pa'i stobs dang bral/ /ha la nag po stam pa'i ri/ /nus pa 'joms pa'i 'khor lo yin/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis stobs chen gnan pa'i gsang sngags 'di gsungs so/ e e drag po e hri ti a thug gnad pa pa ye/ byi tri ta na na/ hūṃX stam pa ya laX laX laX mnan pa laX laX /nan rakṣe gnode sbyin na/ ya ma gshon rje raka srin mo rtsomo rag gza' srin sha she ma badzra zhi khro /kro ta dun ti kī la phur pa ma ma re ma lta rag ma/ nyid du rngubs mkha' drug/ he sha rag ye shes rje mo rtsotrag so rtsonag mo rtso / du brag dung ting gdug pa can 'bi la mu stegs ni/ ya dun btsan

༄/ /na dur khrod ras la sa mo'i zhabs ma la/ /sa dkar cong zhis mdog phyung la/ /'khor mu khyud me'u (me bur )bya lo rim pa lnga ru bskor/ /gru gsum kho'i gzugs nag po spyi tshar bri/ /zla kham lha kha'i lha dang ming rus bri/ /mu khyud gdug pa can sbrul gyis rab tu bskor 'khrul yang gsang mig bcu gnyis e ka rtsa ba'i sngags/ /phyi rim 'og ma rgya gram spu gris bstams/ /yang 'o(ga bcu drug garbershad dang ma ra ya dang mnan/ /kha sbyar mu su'i thod par brub lkugs pa'i/ /zhag gsum sngags pa thang gcad sngags pa'i rang 'og mnan stobs kyi pho rmis ltas su nya khrod gtong che/ /tshe srog bsdu ba bdag drag po sngon byon las kyi 'khrul thugs kyi sprul pa tshe bdag 'khor yin/ /e bcu ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya/ /dgra bo gyi sda rus a mu ka srog la thun spu gri gdags pa mugs bya/ /srog la kham shag lus srog dbye ba bhyo:༷༷ srog la srog dgrog pa breng shag bhyo:༷༷ sro la yam gsad cingagasad pa shag bhyo:༷༷ dgra bo'i srog la ma ra ya gsang ba rbad/ dgra bo'i srog la stam mnan pa pa ya nan/ /las 'di yang snying gsang ba bcud/ pho nya bzlog pa'i las su gsungs/ zhes gsungs so/ /sdig pa snying 'dzings 'khrul 'khor gsang ba'i rgyud las/ gzhan gyi rkang mgyogs bzlog pa'i le'u ste brgyad pa'o/ /de nas yang de'i tshe de'i dus na bcom ldan 'das kyis sdig pa snying 'dzings lha srin tsitta dkrug pa 'di gsungs so/ /dur khrod ras la rna la che bar bshad dug khrag gis/ /snying gi 'chi bdag gi snyingal 'khor lo bskor bas dmigs pa sgrol 'khosar 'o( bri ba bya/ /rtsa chen bzhi la dmar lan 'bru bzhi/ /'bru brgyad e myags rang gnas bsnol mar gnas/ /rtsa
phran brgyad de sul brgyad du/ /tsitta dkrug pa'i spu gri bri/ /phyi rim rtsibs chen bcu drug bris/ /phyi rol mu khyud gdug par ldan/ /'chi bdag bshan pa'i lto bar bri/ /de 'dra 'khor lo kha sbyar bar/ /dmigs pa'i rlang bri ma drug la bya ga bris te bzhugs zhag mtshams bcad la bdun bar du ma yeng par/ /tsitta dkrugs pa'i 'khor 'o1 drag po rang gnad bskerdzor/ /yang gsang thugs kyi las mchog yin/ /phyag rgya zil gnon gsal bar bsgom/ /las kyi 'khrul las kyi gshon rje lto ba dkrugs ba 'khor 〈sna dkrugs pas/ srog de grogs kyi ming bsdebs dgra po'i srog gcod par 'gyur ro shing/ /gzas pa'i tsitta 'khrug par byed srog gcod par 'gyur ro/ rtsa phran brgya dang rtsa chen bzhi/ /las kyi smod pa mtshon chas gcod/ /rtsasrog bcad nas rnam shes 'phrog /'chi rang rgyud kyi bdag bdud kyi las su rig /'jig rten las dang las 'byung ngo lha srin thams cad kun/ /gshed bdag rang la yod na grub nag po'i lto na 'chang / /ru tra de'i rgyud sngags de dang rang chas la gnas/ /de'i rang srog rang lasaḍaḍaḍaḍaḍaḍaḍaḍaḍa 'byungazhing rang gis ga〈snad/ /de nas ba〈snam ldan 'das kyis/ /sdig pa snying 'dzings tsitta dkrug pa 'di gsungs rbersha/ /ayo dun ka 'bru bzhi yam/ /ayo myags ya rngubs mugs 'bru brgyad shag mtshon ka dun/ /ya ma gzhin rje ya tsitta srog dkrugs/ /dgra po lha srin mingagazhug snra ma ra ya rbad/ /ma ma ma mo ru lu ma srog tsa ti dkrugs/ dgra bo snru ma ra ya rbad/ ma ma ru lu mirta mu stegs ti ka srog du ru bdud tra srog dha/ de ba lha a/ rag sha srin po ra/ rag mo srin mo ra/ yag gnod sbyin kṣa sha/ yag mo gnod sbyin mo sha / mun dmu mun pa/ shu
༄tshi la btsan dza ra tsa tsa rgyal po badzra sa dgra bla du tri/ ham sham yam shud tri/ na ga klu phu/ tsitta yu ri dkrugs/ dgra bo snra ma ra ya rbad/ de'i las de ma grub na/ drag sngags 'di dag rab tu 'bad/ /tsitta dkrugs rtsa bran brgyad la 'god pa dgra bo'i srog la breng shag ni ma ra ya rbad/ /mthar thug mnan pa'i sngags kyis bsdu/ /sdig pa'i lus rgya mtsho'i gting dkrugs ltar tshad btag la gtad/ /thod pa dur ma cig las yin/ /sngags kyi grerdzong khyer dkrug pa ste/ /gnad la dbab cing gsad pa gces/ /lha srin 'khrug nas nang 'thab cing / /stobs chen gril ba'i las su bshad/ sdig pa snying 'dzings 'khrul 'khor gsang ba'i rgyud las/ tsitta dkrug pa'i le'u ste dgu pa'o/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis phyag rgya chen po bsrung ba'i rim pa 'di gsungs so/ /e nyid skye ba med pa'i ngang las stong pa'i chos 'byung ste/ /ma skyes 'gag pa med pa las/ /rgyu rkyen gtso bo la bskyed pa sngags las ma bskyed par/ /rol pa chen po'i sku ru rig pa lhag gi gsal/ /dbu gsum sku gsung thugs phyag drug pharol phyin drug zhabs bzhi 3med bzhi bsgrad/ /g.yas 'gyur med dkar g.yon dmar gas med dbus mthing skye med brngams/ /rdo rje tha ma 'khor 'ordzo dang po ral gri bar pa dang / /be con dang po gaston bar pashing sdigs tha ma mdzub bsnams/ /rig rang sna tshogs lnga khro bos dbu la brgyan rang rig phyag rgya chen thabs kyi rol pa por brjod/ /sbrul dpal gyi mmu brgyad dang rin chen 'bar ba dang / /dregs tshas pa la sogs pa pa'i mgo bcad phreng bas brgyan/ /klu rigs rgyal rigs la sogs pa du ma sku la spras/ /yum ni yum shes rab kyi ngang
dmigs med chos kyi dbyings/ /mthing nag sku mi 'gyur tsitta g.yas tsitta bhan dmar g.yon stobs/ /thugs gar sku mdog smug nag ya ma ra tsa gnas/ /me 'osnong don chos nyid ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /'khor lo g.yas don snying g.yon phyag na bsnams/ /ya ma'i ra yam̐ thugs khar dregs pa phyag na rdo rje che/ /mnyam nyid ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /ljang sku mdog nag rdo rje g.yas snying g.yon phreng 'dzin/ /dregs pa'i thugs khar khyam khang ru sbal ste/ /bya ba nan tan bya ba ye shes nyid/ /'jigs byed chen po thur du lta/ /dbu gtsug zil garnon gyi mkha' lding gdug pa 'dul/ /so sor kun rtog ye shes nyid/ /dkar po zil gnon ro nye za/ /phrag gong sprul pa brgyad pa rnon smug nag 'jigs pa'i khyung gnyis/ /dpung khar stag chen ro la brngams gnyis/ /nu 'jigs seng ge ral pa sprug gnyis / sta zur dug sbrul nag po khyug gnyis/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid/ /rdo rje 'chang rgyal spyi gzugs can/ /ma skyes ngang las rang bzhin 'char/ /gdod nas rnam dag ye shes sku/ /bskyed dang spyan drangs mchod mi dgos/ /rgyu dang rkyen ma nor bar bskyed la rag ma lus khrus ma byas/ /skye 'gag med pa ye shes gsal/ /phyag lha rgya kun gyi zil gnon lha sku yin/ /rol pa chen po'i 'phrin las kyi/ /gsang sngags ayo ayo ayo phreng ba de nyid la/ /bod pa ya ma la sogs pa ming dang brda' ru sbyar/ /rnam par shes a mu ka pa'i 'bru re ya sogs dpog /dregs pa 'dul byed gsang sngags sredag /zil gnon gsung yi ge gi ngo bo nyid/ /'di nyid mchog gsangab kho na gi las yin pas/ /'di med las kun phug pa kyang / /khrod gtong 'khrug gam thun
༄tshi/ /mong du/ /rdzas dang sngags kyi nus pa yis/ dregs pa'i sgrol ba ngan pa 'joms/ sdig pa snying 'dzings 'khrul 'khor gsang ba'i rgyud las/ phyag rgya chen po bsrung ba'i le'u ste bcu pa'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'jigs byed chen po des klu bdud 'chi bdag gdug pa chu srin mgo can dbang du bsdus te/ las kyi 'khrul 'khor gtad log nag po zhes bya ba 'di gsungs so/ /rus sbal nag po 'jing bsnol gyis/ /las kyi 'khrul 'khor 'di gtad mkhan nang 'gras la bya'o 'di lta ste ta la 'bor lo'i rgyu lo ma'i ka ri ka/ /yang na rgya shog dag la yang/ /klu rigs sprul bzhi dang sa bdag sbal pa dang / /srid pa'i rus sbal lto bar bri/ /klu'i yang sprul nag snying ta ru ta log dang/ /rtsaba'i snying e myags po 'bru brgyad e dun kā yaX bzhi/ /'dod pa'i dgrabo ming dang a mu brda ru sbyar ka/ /nag po mgo dgu'i bsad bo ci sngags sbrel/ /yang gsang dpa' brtul gsang ba nas yang gsang brdeg can gyis spyad/ /na ga klu bdud nag po ru tra ka la che ge mo ni la dgra bo'i snying la bhyo/ /nag po bam tsitta mon pa dgu rgyob trag thur snying mgul myags myags rtsa bzhi skums shan shan 〈snag la shan/ /thur thur dgra po'i tsitta la rbad/ /na ga sa bdag klu gnyan gyi dug rlangs kho rang gi snyingal bzlog pa'o ha la tsa ma ra dgra po'i snying la thums bhyo/ /zhag gsum mtshon rtsa ba rang gshed bzhi cha bsnol mas klu gshed bcad/ /mtha' ru dpa' brtul can gyis sa gzhi'o gcad/ /klu'i nad rlangs dug gi ngar/ /kho bdag de la gtad mkhan de la rang gshod dbab/ /'di ni las kyi man tra hol/ /stobs can 'joms gang nus pa che ba la myur pa drag po'i
mtshon sbyor ba kha gag ngan sngags gso'i sngags pa 'joms/ /las rdzogs rus sbal dngos su khog par gzhug /bang rim mchod rten lnga pa'i 'og ru mnan/ /ri gsum yang na 'brang gi brag la gtad/ /yang na sa bdag gnas klu gnas sar sar gtad/ /las 'di gnag gag nag po gsod pa kun gyi mchog /ces gsungs so/ /'khrul 'khor nag po'i gsang rgyud sdig pa snying 'dzings las/ gtad bzlog nag po ze sbal nag po'i 'jing bsnol gyi le'u ste bcu gcig pa'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'jigs byed chen po des/ 'khrul 'khor rdzas 'di dag ni rdzas kyi nus pa'o bzlog dus kyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba 'di gsungs so/ /stobs can 'khor lo'i gnad dag gi /las dang sbyor ba nus pa'i mthu/ /dum pa ri dper na kha 'khor ba ltar/ /rang gi nus pa 'joms shing gsod/ de'i sbyor ba 'di lta ste/ ri rab 'og mchod rten 'og gam rgya mtsho'i steng / /gdug rgya mtsho'i gting du mun pa'i dmag bsdu ba pa can gyi stobs gzhom phyir/ /kham sa nag po sa'i ga'u phyi ru sbal pa rus sbal nang du gsum gyi/ /lto sbyar bar du 'khrul 'khosar bca' 'khor lo/ /rgya phregag srid pa gsum dag la mu khyud gsum/ /gru gsum se'i sdig pa dug sdig pa lcags kyi sdig pa sdig pa ru 'dzings pa'i/ /steng sdig pa 'og liṅga lto zla gam la phas kyi lha sbyar bya/ /bar ma'i mu khyud zla gam la phas kyi lha dregs pa can/ /'dul bdud kyi sngags ba'i yang snying 'khor bar bri/ /phyi rim eyo 'byung ba'i 'khrul 'khor gyi/ /skyong zhing bsdud pa'i yang snying bri/ /e mkha' bam sa ramame bam rlungakham chu shig tsitta rngubs drag sngags kyi rgyal po pas brdib mes tshig chus khrus rlung yon kha ri ba
༄sto/ /ldag sna ri rtse ri kha spen dgra bo ma ra ya/ e ka ya ma khresag la khung thums gzir nan las kyi tshe bdag nag po rtsomago rtsodagu shan pa dgra bo'i snying la shag rbad/ ra tri ra khrag 3rdzog la yam las kyi sroge bdag nag po /gri thoges pa yam tri ling dgra bo'i snying la shag rbad nag po na ga bhe las kyai tsha bdag nag po /khro /thoges pa ta srog la dza la snra thums shag dgra bo'i snying la rbad/ tsitta sdig pa la breng shag snra lingag la ma ra ya/ /'khor 'o1 gnyis kha sbyor ga'ur gzhug /nam nam mkha' la dbang che ba tshe bdag bar snang la dbang che ba sroge bdag/sa 'oge la dbang che ba 'chi bdag/ 'di gsum las dbang che med mkha' bar snang sa 'og gi /dbang chen stobs can 'dul ba yin/ /'og gi 'khrul 'khor gsang bar bshad/ /'bar ba'i 'khor lo 'di lta ste/ /gshed po ri thang goms su 'brose pa'i gzhu bcag las rgyas lto ba rtswa /mu khyud rim pa lnga ru bskor/ /dbus su 'dod pa'i ming gzugs bri/ /g.yas g.yon 'doms su dam sri byi du ra dang/ /klu na ga mo /ti srin sa sa ga khyi du srin snying po bri/ /snying la sdig pa bzhi bsgrad pa/ /dmar len e myags drag sngags 'bru brgyad bri/ phyi rim yang snying 'khrul mig dag /brgyad bzhi dregs ya ma rag mo 9pa'i yang snying bri/ /tha ma 'khor lo bcu gnyis rtsibs/ byas pa 'jig pa'i 'khrul 'khor bri/ bar cha dag ni tsakra yin/ sarba g.yone nas loge pa sha trum stam pa ya nan 'drid rbad sarba g.yas nas loge rtsa sbur srog nan snying gzer breng shag rbad ri rab kyi rtse ma ri rab gnam lcags kyi so berdar ba bang rim gsum gyi khar/ /gru gsum nag po dug khrag byug /rabs chad ski mo rtsolto 9sdebs thod par 'khrul 'khor bca'/ /sgo bzhi drag po'i
rdzogs pa'i mchod rten dag /rus sbal zur bzhi na gdan la glang chen 'degs/ /sgo bzhi drag po'i lingaga'i snyingakhar gsang lam dbye gri lcags smyug ma 〈sdo /drag po sngags thun yungs gar mtshon chas bdar/ /bsad pa khyad par can las kyi mtshon du bshad/ /nam mkha' masang gi bya ra ba bzhag phyag rgyar gsal ba yis/ /stobs ayo ayo ayo chen snying po rdzogs pa dang / /las rab kun gyi mchog khyad par can du bshad/ /sdig pa snying 'dzings 'khrul 'khor gsang ba'i rgyud las/ gsang ba 'khrul 'khor gyi le'u ste bcu gnyis pa'o/ /de nas 'jigs byed chen po des/ gsang sngags kyi 'khor 'osno 'brase pa'i ri lta ba choso nyid 'broso pa'i ri khra ba nyid 'di gsungs so/ /gdod ye gdode ma nas yin pas nas rnam dag ye shes sku/ /lhun dang po rtsonas yin par shes pas gzung 'dzin gtingathoni gyis grub pa yin pa la/ /:(la grub re dogs 'dzin pa bral/ /rnam dbyings las rtog bag chags rang byungarang zhi sprin lta bu/ /nam rnam rtoge nyid las ye shes ste mkha' lta bur 'dzin med na/ /bsrung ba kun gyis dregs pa can gyi zhes gam phyoge go rtsomachog tu bshad/ /3steng bsten pa'i khar gong la pa'i dbyings las rjerdzogs pa yi/ /phyag zil gnorna du gsal bas rgya'i rol pa skurdzongs rjesags pa/ /bsam dbyings rnam dag role pa'i cho 'phrul gnas pa lta bu'i sku gtan sems kyi 'a9rdzor 'o1 bshad/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu smin pa 31ga dang gnas pa las/ /dregs pa can rang gi rnam par de nyid shes pa na/ /dregs rnam rtoge yin par shes pa des pa'i rang gshed rang gis gcod/ /bsam gtan 'oge ma rnams tsakra byed pas na/ /sngags ayo ayo ayo dang rdzas dang 'bore bco 9brgyad dang ting 'dzin gyis/ /ming bode pa de nyid dang rnam rtog dbyings su
༄ga/ /sgral / sngags athi+-i ayo kyi grong khyer rab bgrang zhing / /ming mi 'ong pa'i dbang med nas bos shing rab tu gzir/ /rnam 'bru shes dbrog cing gcad ma ra ya bya ba/ /sngags athi+-i athi+-i ayo ri bsrungaba'i ting nge 'dzin kyi phreng bas gdug pa 'dul/ dregs pa rdzas dang sngags kyi dkrug cing dbang bsdu athi+-i athi+-i rnyu la ming ya ma log pa trig nan myog nas bos la thog ltar gzir/ /rnam 'bru'o shes phrog ga thum ste mtshon chas kham shag rbad gcod/ /bsrung zhing bzlog pa'i las su las 'di bya'o rigs/ de nyid rang gshed bsad pa'i ting 'dzin 'bebs pas na/ /rno phag sdig myur srid pa'i khyam khang na/ /rang gshed gdug pa'i yi ge e ka gnas/ /drag sngags bdag gi bzlas dbugs kyi rta la zhon/ /dug rlangs 'od zer rang shugs 'phro/ /sha za gsod byed sngags kyi pho nya bskul/ /rang gnad gdug pa'i yi ge blangs snying la yod pa rang dgra bgegs kyi rlang ga la bu ga dgur gshed grerdzogs kyi 'khor 'ordzo 'phro/ /kun 'dus rtsa bzhi gcod tsittar 'dus/ /hur thums des 'bru re dzaXyis snra phog nas/ /srid pa'i 'khyams spu gri kham shag lhun khang mtshon chas gcod 'di dag gsad dgra bgegs gang la yang pa'i las su rigs/ /skyod pa zor kha gso dug dbal gyis/ /rtsakhang pa'i bang ri rnams kheng pas nad rgyas nas/ /rtsa'i mdud chod srog 'bral 'gyur/ /〈sgrogs sam sgo khang pa'i bzhi las kyi thun/ /kha gso zor gyi las su shes/ /'khor 'ordzo thun bsdebs las rab mchog /rkyang pa sbag ma las kyi sdebs/ /mbhi 'gril 'khrul 'khor bsad pa'i bcud/ /yang gsang thugs kyi 'khor lo bshad/ /las bsad pa'i las drug po la brtsad pa'o kyi rgyal po'i snying nang
du rtsabazhi ral gri ru gyur na mtshon gyi gcod par byed/ /dam slob ma med bu'i sems dpa' ni/ /lcags rang gyur par bsam kyi sdig pa rtsa brgyad za/ /dam 'dres 〈spun mched grogs bse'i sbal pa las/ /nad khrag 'dus shing ldang bar 'gyur/ /sngags spyi'i spun pa nag po spyi'i spun/ /rang gshed bse'i sbal pa yis/ /rnam shes me chu dug khrag bskol/ /bon mu stegs po rigs gnyis phyi rol pa/ /phag rgod nad dang mtshon gyis rgyal/ gnam drag sngags lcags 'thab na rtogs med lasacaX phya rgya rdzogs dang rol pa'i sku'oX gnyis su med pa'i ye shes bsgomacaX gzhan gyi rgya med stobs kyis gziracaX las drug smyi yi dgongs par bshadacaX nag po stobs dang bral ba dgacaX rgya gram dregs pa'i sngags bris tecaX lce steng ri rab dag gis gnanacaX zhi khro gshin rje phur pa nasacaX sa bdag klu srin yan chad kyicaX sngags kyi bzlas brjod ci byas pa'oX ri rab rgya gram chen po yisacaX ngag gi nus pa gnon par byedacaX nus pa non cig ces kyang brjodacaX drag po ngag mnan 'khor lo bshadacaX 'byung ba'i khram zlog chen po stecaX gsang sngags 'khor lo bskor ba yisacaX 'jig rten lha 'dre khams dkrugs shing caX mtshon cha'i 'khor lo bzlog pa ltaracaX kho rang rgyud la bzlog pa nicaX pho nya bzlog pa zhes su bshadacaX 'chi bdag bshan pa'i lto ba ༄caX gsal ba'i sngags kyis grong dkrugs pasacaX lha srin tsitta 'khrugs pa yisacaX gzas pa'i rtsa srog 'bral ba nicaX tsitta dkrugs pa'i las su bshadacaX srid pa rus sbal lto ba 〈tshoX klu dang sa bdag sde bzhi lacaX stobs kyi sngags kyi 'od zer gyisacaX gdug pa'i
༄༅/ /klu gnyan dug rlangs tecaX gzas pa'i snying la 'dus par bsamacaX gtad 'o(ga nag po'i las su bshadacaX phyag rgya mtshon cha dmigs pa'i yulacaX gsal ba gsum gyis las kun 'grubacaX ces gsungs socaX sdig pa snyig 'dzings 'khrul 'khor gsang ba'i rgyud lasacaX drag po ngan sngags kyi le'u ste bcu gsum pa'o/ /de nas 'jigs byed chen po des/ mtshan ma rgyu rtsal ngan gsang ba dmar mi 'dod sngags reng phung nag po zhes bya ba 'di gsungs so/ /lnga brgya snyigs ma dus nyid du/sangs rgyas bstan pa nyams pa dang / bka'i byin rlabs kun bdugs shing / dam pa'i bstan pa mi gnas na/ reg phung nag po'i las 'di brtsam/ gsang sngags drod tshad shes pa yis/ rigs ldan rnal 'byor chen pos spyad/ bya thar nu mar khu nu'i bcu dang sta sta dngos dmar dang / zar ma'i dngos mar khu dngos zo sha dang / sbrul dngos po dang nya'i tshil bu dang / cha snyam 'khar ba'i snod du bsdu/ sum cha skam pa tshad ldan pas/ sbrang cha gcig rgod dug chagacig rgod kha da sbyi mo ra/ dza la dar mdzes po'i thod paṇā cha tshog ma'i tshil bu dang / rus chagacig pa skam pa zhib btags cha mag par sbyar te/ sa cha tshog tshur phabs bsregs zhag gsum du/ spu nag 'ordzo ma'am thar nu ba'i lo ma ma'i gseb tu mnan/ de nas de rnams langs pa dang / bse zho yod na mchog tu 'gyur cha snyam sgo'am gos la byug yang na thar nu'i tshobazhi dang sbyar/ lus la reg pas skam rtags su par 'gyur/ lus rnams za zhing rtse bar 'ong / lo'i dus na dza lar mdze na smin/ ha la nag po'i las kyis gcong / reg phung nag po zhes
bya'o mdze nag las kyi 'khor 'ordzo bshad/ sbyor ba bskul byed yang gsang ba'i las/ gri rgod nag po'i thod pa sa ngan sngags 'du yang gsang ngo ba'i las bshad pa/ ston zla gsum la dbugs bral ba'i/ pra ba gzhung nag nang cha bru/ sngo nag sna sngon po mjug nag khog pa de nang du/ khrag yu can bsdom nag po gzhungs pa'i sdig /skang sta la ba mang 'degs pa'i sha rus mnyam/ drod kyi rgyal 'di gsum gongalas 'dab ru bya po btsan dug dang / mu zi nag po tsitta gang ma'i stags su bzhags nag po dang / grib gong ma log skyes gnyis par pa'i thar nu sbyar/ skar ma'i rgyal po smin drug la/ drod kyi rgyal po kha da sbyi mogs ras/ zhag grangs gsum du byibs te bzhag zhags gsum nang par kha phye ste/ a mu dri rdzas la sogs pa ga'i rdzas lnga dang / rgya tsha dngos phab dngos dang chang du sbyar dmigs pa 'grim pa'i lam du sba/ sa la rlangs pa byung ba dang / 'goms la lus sbrid ka 'o( yis/ zhag grangs gsum du bro 'tshal te/ zla ba gcig na 'gum par 'gyur/ nag po gdug pa'i ngan sngags te/ sbyor ba 'du ba yang gsang mchog grod tshad brtan pa'am mi shes dmyal ba'i rgyu/ go cha med na bsrungaba'i yan lag bsrungaba'i dug rang la 'du/ ya bag sha'i las su gsungs/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ngan sngags 'di gsungs so/ /ayo sngags kyi byin gyis brlab 'du 'du sa 'du ha la tsa ma ri 'du/ myos myos dgra bo che ge mo la hal yaX thun gzir kham bhyoX dug gi mon pa nag po yis/ byin gyis brlabs kyi sngags su bshad/ gsang pa yang gsang las 'di dag sbyor ba'i nang nas khyad par can/ bstan pa bsrung phyir ngan
༄tshi/ /sngags bshad/ sdig pa snying 'dzings 'khrul 'khor gsang ba'i rgyud las drag po ngan sngags kyi le'u ste bcu bzhi pa'o/ /de na bcom ldan 'das kyis yongs su bskor ba'i 'khor rnams la 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /e ma ho/ rnam rb+ya nyid ngo bo rtog mtshan ma rang grol ba'i/ /rdo rje bde ba chen po'i bka'/ /gsang tshig lam du khyer ba smod pa'i las mchog ye shes 'di/ /rigs byed rdo rje snying po gzungs/ /skye med chos nyid ngo bo nyid rnam dag chos dbyings pho brang ye nas nas/ /thugs rje rol gzugs snang ba pa'i bye brag sgra grags stong cir bstan sems dran rtogs kyang / /gnyis med 'bras bu phyag rgya dbyings nyid sku gsungathugs su rdzogs chen por rjerdzogs/ /snang stong gnyis med ye shes sgyu ma'i sku/ /rtag yab yum chad mtha' bral grol ba'i ye shes nyid/ /kho dpal gshin rje rtsa ba byang chub sems kyi na nyid do gnyug ma rdo rje'i sku/ /phyag rgya chen po sangs rgyas kun gyi spyi gzugs can zil gyis gnon par gnas/ /sku ni sgyur ma'i sna tshogs nges pa med pa phyag rgya cir yang snang / /gsung ha he hūX bhyoXhrū ni khro bo'i rngams sgra lnga dang ldan thugs gos rngams drag po'i ni sna tshogs cho 'phrul mtshon cha bzhin/ /las kyi sbyor ba a skabs kyi phye ba de lta bu/ /ngo bo nyid ni chos sku skye 'gag med/ /skye ba'i cho 'phrul snang la rang bzhin med/ /yon tan ye shes brtags kyi mtshan ma mtshan dang dpe byad ldan/ snying dper na rin po che'i snyingapo lta bu phyag rgya sna tshogs de ltar bstan pa gshogs nas de lta bur bstan shes na po 'gyur med chos nyid ngang la 'char/ thams cad chos sku bde ba chen po'i dbang / ba11da pa rnam gsum bum pa'i dbang / gsang ba'i dbang / shes rab ye shes kyi
dbang thob pa'i rtsal gyis longs/ e ma ho/ rno dbal mtshon cha'i gsang sngags kyi rgyud gag pa mchog sdig pa snying sngags pa dam nyams pal ru 'dzings pa'i/ snying po dug dbal smod pa'i mchog khyad par gsang ba'i mchoge dang phag mo'i sbyor ba 'di/ dpa' brtul drag gsang ba yang gsang po'i stobs kyis spyad/ sdeb dril ba dang rkyang pa so 9so /stobs che chung dang sbyar/ stobs ldan 'byor na sbyor ba sdeb/ rgya mdud mchode rten nag po 9brtseg pa'i lto ba'am/ nam mkha' bsrungab bar bzloge pa snang sa gzhi gsad pa 'og mnan pa/'khor lo rdzogs dang rdzas kyi gnad bcas pas 'grub/ ri rab mchod bang rim gsum gdan dang 'khore lo /gru gsum rten bar dag tu/ stobs kyi 'khosar lo mchoge dang phag mo /thod par gzhugs/ phyag lha bdag rgya gsal bar rngam phye phye ayo tshig bzlas/ dregs pa dkrug cing gnod byed gzir/ rang sto 'byore gshed 'khor lo dkrug thun gyis sgo 9bzhi nas brab/ bla rang gshed kyi liṅga drug la gnas gzugs la gnad la dbab/ tha rtsad pa la soges pa 'gyur spu gri rno dbal sbyar/ masmyo1gas kyi pho nya ba~Xgag cing gsad skabs su gzhan gyi pho 9nya ste las thore phu/ drug pa klu'i gtad khram 'byung ba'i khram bzloge gtad bzloge bya sdeb dang sbyar ba:rdzog sdebs drag tu pa'i las rim skabs su sbyar/ gsad pa sdeb la dril sgrub rno rtsol tshan che ba bzhad pa las su shis par bshad/ rgyun du ayo ayo ayo lha srin stobs gzhom zhing / ngag mnan 'khor lo bcas la mnan le'u sho / stobs can nus pa 'joms par bshad/ tsitta dkrug cing rang gshed dbab/ sdig pa'i lus rgya mtsho gtingadu tshad btags la gtad/ dregs pa 'khrugs na shis par bshad/ e ma zla gsanganag po /yang gsang rnal
༄tshi/ /'byor rgyud/ thabs le'u nyi shu dang shes rab snying po'i nyi shu rtsa gcig don/ rtsab bshad pa 'phrul gyi snying po spyod 'phrul gyi bka'/ yang las 'di zab bo snying nag po gsang ba'i mtshon sdig pa snying la ru 'dzings 'di/ gsang bdag rdo rdze snying po dang /longs spyod rdzogs dang sprul par bcas/ lha dang mkha' 'grerdzo rig pa 'dzin/ rdzu'aphrul stobs can dregs pa 'khor/ byang sems dga' dang lung bor men/ slob dpon mi spang spun mi brnyas/ sangs rgyas bka' rgyud la mos par bya la nges par bskur bla ma dang dkon mchog yi dam lha la mchod/ bdag gzhan byang chub sems mi gsad/ don gyi lam lta spyod zab mo mi bstan no stor 'og ma la/ gsang sngags brda' dang dbang mi smra/ yongs su ma sbyangs tshad mas sbyar/ theg pa dman snod med la la chos mi bshad/ bka' la tshad ma'i sgra mi gzhal/ dad ldan mi skal ldan la gdams ngag bstan bzlog phyag rgya bstan/ rin po che'i rtsar mi chos dbyings gzhunga'akhrug mi bya dkrug rnal 'byor lha gcig mi btang gsang sngags bzlas/ drod rtags rmi lam mi bzung dbang po rang nyams rtag sems kyi me long rtag lta ba/ e ma 'khor du 'dus pa'i tshogs/ lha klu dregs pa rdzu 'phrul can/ nga'i bka' rgyud snying po 'di/ ma 'ong dam can sgrub byed 'brul 'khor nag po 'di na/ nga'i dam la mi 'da' bsrungs/ 'khor gyi dregs pa pho mo yis/ rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i grogs gyis shig ces kyang gsungs so/ /de nas rdo rje snying po la gnas pa'i 'khor rnams/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la dga' mgu yi rangs te/ mngon par bstod do/ /dpal gshin rje gshed
zhabrul 'khor nag po/ /sdig pa snying 'dzings gsang ba'i rgyud las/ rgyud gtad cing rjes su yi rangs pa'i le'u ste bco lnga pa'o/ /'jam dpal gshin rje dngos grub nye bar bsgrub pa/ zla gsang nag po'i snying po/ las kyi 'khrul 'khor nag po/sdig pa snying 'dzings kyi rgyud ces bya ba lha yul du grags pa rdzogs so/ /bal yul gyi slob dpon chen po rgyal po bha su dha ra dang bod kyi lo tsa ba spu ngan gnubs ban budha dzña na ratnas bsgyur ba'o/ /tshe bdag dbang gi rgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang sdud pa po phyag na rdo rje/ dga' rab rdo rje/ 'jam dpal gzhin rje/ gtsug lag dpal dge shintaX garba/ da na bha la/ khrag 'thung nag po/ ba su dha ra/ jo bo sangs rgyas/ yon tan rgya mtsho/ ye shesargya mtsho/ sdo ston lcags po/ mi ston dran chung / dran ston mtha' bral/ me ston dkon rin/ slob dpon bkra shisargyal mtshan / slob dpon lha bsgom bla ma gang pas/ desargyal ba g.yung ston/ 'brom ston tshe'i rgyal mtshan/ desa.a yu pa shang ra dza la/ desabadag dar ban kun dga' bkralhasal gnang ba lags/ yang rgyud lugs gcig la/ rdo rje 'chang nas dbu bzung ste/ g.yu pa shang ra dza thugs gong dang 'dra/ desrgyal sras rdo rje la/ desabla ma legs pa dpal la/ desas gsum gas bdag dar ban kun dga' bkra lhasal gnang ba lags so/ bkra lhas//
༄tsho/ /tshe bdag snying po don gyi rgyud bzhugs so//
༄tshi/ /rgya gar skad du/ e man tra bi tsu tsi ta na ma tan tra/ bod skad du/ drag po sngags rgod sdig pa snying 'dzings kyi rgyud ces bya ba/ dpal 'jigs byed kyi rgyal po ya man ta ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas rdo rje snying po yis/ /rdo rje khro po 'jigs tshogs la/ /kun kyang gus pa phyag 'tshal te/ /bde mchog yab la 'di skad gsol/ e ma ho/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin te/ /rdo rje 'chang gi ngo po nyid/ /snyigs ma lnga yi dus nyid du / / 'gal ba cham la dbab pa'i phyir/ /rang gshed drag po bshad par mdzod/ /de nas phyag rgya chen po yis/ /rdo rje snying po khro tshogs la/ /gsang tshig drag po'i smod pa yis/ /'gal ba cham la dbab pa'i mchog/ /'khor la nye bar bka' stsal te/ /snyigs ma lnga yi dus nyid du/ /mtshams med las ngan kun spyod pas/ /ban dgra dam nyams bsgral ba'i phyir/ /ri thang mtshams su zhe sdang can/ /'bros pa'i gzhu bcag sbyor ba brtsam/ /de yang phyir
༄tshi/ /la bzlog pa dang / /byas pa bshig dang zug pa dbyung / /gsang lam 'gag dang gzir mnan te/ /spyang mo drug gi sbyor ba yis/ /dang po 'chi med dus sbyor bzlog /bar du mkha' 'gro gzan la dbab/ /tha ma dug mda' khong du skyal/ zhes gsungs so/ /drag po sngags rgod sdig pa snying 'dzings kyi rgyud las zhus pa dang gnang ba'i le'u ste dang po'o/ /de nas 'jigs byed chen po yis/ /dang po stong pa lha'i 'khor lo yis/ /'chi med dus kyi sbyor ba bzlog pa 'di gsungs so/ /e nyid stong pa chos 'byung zhes/ ma skyes skye 'gag med pa la/ /rgyu rkyen sngags las ma skyed par/ /rol pa chen po'i sku ru gsal/ /dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad/ /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing rngam/ /rdo rje 'khor lo ral gri g.yas/ /be con gtun shing sdigs mdzub g.yon/ /rigs lnga'i khro bos dbu la brgyan/ /rang rig phyag rgya zil gnon brjid/ /sbrul dang rin chen 'bar bas brgyan/ /
dregs pa'i mgo bcad phreng bas brgyan/ /klu rigs du mas sku la brgyan/ /yul ni dmigs med chos kyi dbyings/ /mthing nag tsitta ban dmar stobs/ /thugs dkar smug nag ya ma gnas/ /me long ye shes ngo po nyid/ /zhabor lo tsitta phyag na bsnams/ /ya ma'i thugs gar dregs pa che/ /mnyam nyid ye shes ngo kro nyid/ /ljang nag rdo rje snying phreng 'dzin/ /dregs pa'i thugs gar khyams khang steng / /bya ba nan tan ye shes nyid/ /'jigs byed chen po thur du blta/ /smyi gtsug mkha' lding gdug pa 'dul/ /sor rtog ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /dkar po zil gnon ro nye za/ /phrag gong smug nag 'jigs pa'i khyung / /dpung khar stag chen ro la rngam/ /nu khar seṅge ral pa sprug /sta zur dug sbrul nag po 'khyug sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid/ /rdo rje 'chang chen spyi gzugs can/ ma skyes rang gi rang bzhin 'char/ phyag rgya kun gyi zil gnon sbyin/ de 'dra'i sku ru gsal bsgoms la/ stong srog 'khor lo 'di dag bzlas/ ayo ayo ayo/ a kro te ka ya man ta ka ya ma ye ka la rū pa ka pa ye hri sti a pa ye a ā ne ā nai u u ne u ne du du ne du ne a i u e o aX ra rwi la lam̐ du ru ye bya tsa ye seng he ye hri ta ye bi da ye ha la ye mu ka ye u u ne u ne bhi kri ta/ a ne a ne ya ma ra tsa ya ma rag sha ya ma rag a ya ma rakṣa pe ta liṃ kro ti shwa ri ma ma e ka dza ti de ma kha la bam ril ru lu ru lu shrī badzra kro ta ya ma garma ya ma rag sha kri ta tsan ta rag sha mon ta a mu ka myag thums ril trig nan sbur nan e
༄khu/ /hur thuX dza kham shag ro myags smugs ti rbad ya gsang sngags phreng ba 'di nyid la/ spyang mo drug gi so 'di gsungs/ bar du ming dang brda' ru sbyar/ zhes gsungs so/ drag po sngags rgod sdig pa snying 'dzings kyi rgyud las/ stong srog lha'i 'khor los 'chi med dus kyi sbyor bas bsrung ba'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o/ de nas 'jigs byed chen po des/ mkha' 'gro'i zas kha dgra la spo ba yi/ spyang mo drug gi so 'di gsungs so/ che ge mo a mu ka trig nan/ e hur thums dza/kham shag ro myags mugs ti rbad/ che ge mo a mu ka rtsa sbur srog nan/ snying gzer breng shag yam rbad/ e hur thum dza/ kham shag ro myags mugs ti rbad ya/ che ge mo a mu ka man tra/ dum ma sta ra dum thum ril rbad/ e hur thums dza khaX shag ro myags rmugs ti rbad ya/ che ge mo a mu ka du ram tri/ yaX 'drid phyung / srog gzer nan phyung / e hur thums dza/ khaX shag ro myags mugs ti rbad ya/ che ge mo a mu ka tsi ta stam bha ya nan/ ye nan yam bzlog /'drid bzlog bhyo/ e hur thums dza/ kham shag ro myags smugs ti rbad ya/ che ge mo a mu ka bi tam stam pa ya nan/ e hur thums dza/ kham shag ro myags smugs ti rbad ya/ de dag gong gi sngags rings las/ skabs kyi bsgyur ba shes par bya/ bgyings gzir byad bzlog gsang lam dgab/ byas pa bshig cing zug pa dbyung / stobs dang nus pa mnan pa'o/ /ting 'dzin spyang mo 'phrod 'du ni/ g.yu'i spyang mo drug tu 'gyur/ spyang mo re re'i phrin las re/ /myur du byed pas gsal bar bsgoms/ zhes
gsungs so/ /drag po sngags rgod sdig pa snying 'dzings kyi rgyud las/ spyang mo drug gi mkha' 'gro'i zas kha dgra la spo ba'i le'u ste gsum pa'o/ /de nas yang sngags kyi dug mda' khong du skyal ba rang gshed dbab pa 'di gsungs so/ /dpa' po grir shi ba'am/ khyi nag po'am/ ra rog po'i snying nang du/ gdug byed rang gshed dbab pa'i 'khor lo gnyis/ zhe sdang lcags kyi sdig pa nag po dang / phrag dog bse'i sbal pa dmar po gnyis lto bar bcas la/ tsitta'i nang du tsakra gzhug de nas rabs chad thod pa bzhag thod pa'i nang du tsitta gzhug ag tshe ba yar bstan la/ de nas lan nas rdzas dang thun gyis bsdeg go /bdag nyid phyag rgya zil gnon du bsgoms la/ ngan sngags 'di bzlas so/ /e myags ya rngubs mugs shag ka dun/ a mu ka srog la rbad/ thums ril rbad/ rtsakhag tsitta phyung / nd+ri srog hur thums dza/ zhes bzlas so/ ngan sngags 'di skye ba rgyun gcod yin no/ /nag po rag sha snying la sbur nan rbad/ nag po rag sha srog la hur thums rbad/nag po rag sha snying khrag breng shag rbad/ nag po rag sha rtsa la breng shag rbad/ nag po raka snying khrag tshal pa sham long rbad/ nag po raka gar pa snra dza/ bhan tra bee tam stam bha ya nan/ ces bzlas so/ /nyin mtshan phye la bzlas te/ mtshan mo nag po'i las bya/ nyin par dmar po'i las bya'o/ /des tsitta yang 'gas 'gyur ro/ /dus thams cad du thun gyi las nyi tshe bya ba gces so/ /gsang ba tsitta rang gshed dbab pa/ zhe sdang sdig pa nag po dang / phra dog bse'i sbal pa dmar po
༄tshi/ /gnyis / rang gshed phab la mnan par bya/ zhes gsungs so/ drag po sngags rgod sdig pa snying 'dzings kyi rgyud las/ sngags kyi dug mda' khong du skyal ba/ rang gshed dbab pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o/ /de nas drag po thun la dbab pa'i las 'di gsungs so/ /gri rgod kyi thod pa'i nang du/ gri rgod kyi snying ngam ra rog po'i snying du/ dgra bo'i liṅga bcug pas/ de yang liṅga dza dgu dang / gar pa snra dzas brgyan pa ni/ sngo dmar srad bus brgyan la bzhag /bdag nyid phyag rgya zil gnon sgom/ thun rdzas dug dang skye tshe dang / nyungs nag dang ni zi ra til/ shang tshe mi khrag khyi khrag dang / ra khrag dang ni phag pa'i khrag /lcags phye zangs phye thun du sbyar/ ngan sngags 'di dag drag tu bzlas/ ayo ayo ayo/ a kro ti ka/ ya man ta ka/ kā la rū pa/ hri sti byi kri ta/ ka ya kro ta/ a ne u ne/ du nai bya tsa ye/ du ru ye/ tsitta ye/ ha la ye/ ya ma kri ta/ mon ta ya ma rag ta/ ma ma byi sha/ tsi du ste/ mon ta kri ta ya/ a mu ka/ tsitta breng / shag mugs thun bhyo/ /thums ril srog la myog bhyo/ /dun ting srog ma ra ya rbad/ ni sha ku ru ni rbad/ hā hur long breng dun hur thums dza/ tsitta rbad/ ces bzlas la sum yar du brdeg go /sgom pa ni phyag rgya zil gnon du bsgom mo/ skabs su bskul ba yang btang ngo / /liṅga thun gyi skug pa de/ lam rgya gram du/ gza' rgyu ba dang bdud kyi nyi ma la srod la mnan/ gru gsum nang du mchod rten bang rim gsum pas mnan/ kha bal nag dang tsher ma dgab/ phyis kha gsos la dum re 'phang ngo / /zhes gsungs so/ /drag
po sngags rgod sdig pa snying 'dzings kyi rgyud las/ rang gshed gsang ba snying thun gyi las kyi le'u ste lnga pa'o/ /de nas 'jig rten gyi lha 'dre spyi'i rbod gtong mkhan gyis/ ngag mnan pa 'di gsungs so/ phag thod dam dom thod du kho'i bsrungs ma rnams shog bu la bris la ngo ma shes na/ rmi lam du gang byung ba bris la/ rang dang gnyis kyi so 'tshams su/ dong khru gang pa brus la/ kho rang gi ming rus/ der dug sna tshogs dang / khrag dang nyungs nag dang / tsha ba gsum dang / gu gul dang /gri rgod khrag dang thal chen sbyar ba'i thun la ngan sngags bzlas te/ gzugs kyi khar mnan na/ rbod gtong mkhan gyi bsrung ma rnams nus pa'i mthu nyams par 'gyur ro/ sngags 'di'o/ /e myags ya rngubs mugs shag ka dun srog la thums ril rbad bhyo/ rtsa la thun smugs rbad bhyo/ khrag la rmug ti rbad bhyo/ snying thur nag po khas yen yen/ gar pa ni hūm̐X dza dza bi dang stam pa nan/ ces bzlas na/ pho nya rkang mgyogs kho rang la/ gnod cing bzlog par 'gyur ro/ /de nas yang sngags pa nus pa can gyis/ stobs dang nus pa mnan pa 'di gsungs so/ /kho'i zag pa'i rdzas blangs la/ kho rang gi 'dra 'bag byas la/ ming dang rus bgod do/ /de'i lte snying khar drangs la/ lte la sngags bgod do/ /lte steng du phur pa sor bzhi pa gcig gdab kro/ /de gti mug nag po snying du bcug la/ mchod rten bang rim gsum pas mnan no/ /de yang zla ba nag po kho dur du zhugs pa la bya'o/ /gza' phur pa'am/ skar ma lag sor la bya'o/ /ting nge 'dzin kho'i sngags bzlas pa
༄༅/ /thams cad/ gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs drug pa gnyis su gyur nas/ lte la lcags kyi gzer gyi btab nas ri rab khong seng rgyud nas 'gyur dbang med par bsam mo/ /ngan sngags ni/ e myags ya rngubs mugs shag ka dun/ a mu ka snying du nan/ sri du nan/ tsi ta nan/ snying gzer sbur nan/ ka ya wa ka tsitta badzra ti sta/ bhan dha bi dang bi da stam pa ya nan/ ces bzlas so/ /rtag tu kha dang lte la 'brum pa 'ong ba dang bsrangs par 'gyur ro/ /sngags de khri phrag gcig gam gsum rdzogs nas mnan par bya'o/ /skabs su e rings dang ting nge 'dzin bsdebs la bya'o/ /drag po'i sngags rgod sdig pa snying 'dzings kyi rgyud las/ sngags pa stobs can ngag mnan pa'i le'u ste drug pa'o/ /de nas gtad mkhan nang 'gras na gtad bzlog nag po sbrul nag 'bying bsnol gyi 'khor lo 'di gsungs so/ /ta la'i lo ma'am rgya shog la/ klu mgo dgu pa'i lto bar 'khor lo bcas pas/ bdag 'chi bdag nag por bsgoms te/ ngan sngags 'di zhag gsum bzlas la/'bor lo ru sbal gyi lto bar bcug la rang gi gnas su mchod rten nag po'i 'og tu mnan te/ skabs su sngags brgya tsam bzlas na/ gtad mkhan de myur du brlag par 'gyur ro/ /ngan sngags ni/ e dun ka yam/ dgra bo tsitta breng shag dza srog la breng shag hur thums rbad/ e myags ya rngubs/ mugs shag ka dun/ nag po bam tsi ta la rgyab bo/ /khrag thur snying rgul/ myags myags rtsa bzhi skums/ shan shan dgra bo'i srog la shan/ thur thur dgra bo'i snying la thur rbad pa na ga ha la tsa
