༄༅/ /sgron ma drug gsal bar byed pa'i man ngag rin po che 'od 'phro zhesabya ba phag ston gyisamadzad pa bzhugs so/
༄༅/ /man ngag gi rgyal po sgron ma drug gi zhal gdams la/ dang po rdo rje'i mkhar du mi shog pa'i sku bskyed pa ni/ rang gi rig pa spros bral las phyag rgya zil gnon gsal bar bskyed la mchod bstod bya'o gnyis pa nam mkha'i mthongs su mthing nag gi phyar ba bkram pa ste/ e ring 'bum phrag gcig bzlas so/ /yang na zhag nyer gcig gam bcu bzhi'am bdun du bzlas so/ /de nas stong srog gi 'khor lo bcas la/ dgra bgegs kyi ming srog yi ge phreng ba'i bar du stem mo/ /liṅga kun gu gul gyi dud pas bdugs la/ zhag lnga'am bdun du gzir cing / nyungs gar brab bo/ /de nas mchod rten byin can gyi 'og tu mnan no/ de nas yang 'khor lo bcas la dgra'i liṅga bcas te/ spyang mo drug gang dgos re sbyor/ gzhan yang ur mo ngar gcod dang / lha srin yid 'phrog pa'i che bdud kyang shes par bya'o/ /
༄tshi/ /gsum pa ri rab kyi mkha' la gnam lcags kyai so brdar ba ni/ bsad pa'i las kho na ste/ 'di la phyi mchod rten la brten te gsad pa'i skabs su/ mchod rten dril ba dang / rkyang pa gnyis las/dril ba ni yongs rdzogs chen po kho na'o/ /rkyang pa ni/ mchod rten bcas la/ phyi nang gi stobs can lha sngags sems can dang bcas pa'i 'og tu 'brub khung bcas la sgrub thabs so so rnams kyis/ 'khor lo gang 'dod pa re bskor te rkyang bar bskor ba yin no/ /'khor lo la brten pa dang / tsitta la brten pa gnyis ni so so rang rkyang yin la/ mchod rten rkyang pa dang sbrel yang rung ngo / /de yang dang po kho nar/mchog phag gi 'khor 'o/ bcas la/ sngags dang dmigs pa bstun la gzhung bzhin bya/ rang gshed drug dang sbyor na gang yin pa'i ling ga re/ sngags kyi mde'u re/ /thun rdzas de rnams man ngag ltar bsdeb la
ling ga la phur pa gdab/ thun dus bzhir brab dbugs kyi rta la zhon nas/ drag sngags 'khor lo mtshon char 'phros te/ rtsa chen bzhi dang / rtsa bran brgyad po bcad par bsams/ thun gzhug la mon pa bzhi bskul lo/ /de ltar zhag bdun drag tu byas la gzhung ltar las la sbyar/ rtags med na spogs nas gdab bo/ /de nas gsang ba tsitta la brten pa'i gsad las bya/ zhag bdun thun brab/ thun rnams 'du ba rnam bzhi'i nad du gyur nas dgra bo'i khong du nad rgyas par bsams/ rtags rab 'bring tha ma la/ tsitta 'gas/ 'tsheg cing me stag 'phro ba 'ong / rtsi shing bcad pa dang / ra g.yag ri dwags bsad pa yong zhag bdun la rtags med na/ da dung zhag bdun bsring / des nges par 'chi'o/ /de rdzogs pa dang / drag po thun gyi bca' gzhi byas la/ thun sgrub lha lnga'i rang gshed kyi thun gyi brab bo/ /de zhag bdun rdzogs nas gnan no/ /mjug tu thun lhag ma kha gso/ /zhag gsum sgrub la 'phang ngo / /de'ang dgra'i khang pa la phog na legs/ min na phyogs su 'phang ngo / /de ltar bsad pa'i las gsum po de ma rdzogs bar du/ bar ma chad bar sgrub bo/ /dgra bo nus pa che zhing tshan che yang zhag nyer gcig po 'di la nges par 'chi'o/ /tshan dang nus pa chung na bsad thabs re res kyang 'grub bo/ /lar gsum ka rdzogs par byed pa gnad yin no/ /nyer gcig po de la ma grub na/ lto dkrugs te zhag gsum
༄tshi/ /sbogs so/ /de la mi 'grub mi srid do/ /thun gyi kha gso ni/ gza' rgyu ba'i thebs gang yod la 'phang zhing bskul lo/ /ri thang gi 'tshams su/ zhe sdang drag po'i gzhu bcag pa ni/ rang bsrung zhing / gzhan gyi sbyor ba phyir bzlog pa kho na yin pas spyang mo drug dang / stong srog gi dgongs pa dang / lha srin yid 'phrog gi ting nge 'dzin dang / ur mo ngar gcod dang / de rnams man ngag ltar gang dgos bya'o/ /mun pa'i dmag bsdu ba ni gtad bzlog khraX bzlog ngag mnan rnams la gzhung ltar ro/ /srid pa'i ri bsgyel ba ni/ las kyi mtha' rgyas te/ smos pa tsam las lag tu blang bya ma yin no/ gong gi las de rnams la nan tan du skyar la bya'o/ /gal te tsitta dkrug pa'i las byed na/ lta ba dang ting nge 'dzin ldan pas bya'o/ /sgron ma drug gsal bar byed pa'i man ngag rin po che 'od 'phro zhes bya ba rdzogs so/ /phag shākya nā thā ston nag po'i go mtshon yin/ rbod gtong bzlog pa'i mthar thug he he/
༄tshi/ /gshin rje tshe bdag gi las thams cad pa'i 'khor lo'i 'grel pa zhesabya ba bzhugs so/
༄༅caX caXrgya gar skad du/ garma sarba a ti tsakra ni nā ma/ bod skad du/ las thams cad pa'i 'khor lo'i 'grel pa zhes bya pa/ dpal tshe bdag nag po bde ba chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi bcud bsdus pa/ snang srid kyi lha ma srin thams cad kyi srog gi snying po sgril ba/ drag sngags thams cad kyi rtsa ba srog 'phrog pa kun gyi mchog /snying po don gyi man ngag 'di la khyad par bzhi ste/ grub pa po rten gyi khyad par dang / sbyor ba las rdzas zer ba'am khrug kyi khyad par dang bsnyen sgrub drag sngags kyi khyad par dang / mjug sdud las kyi khyad par ro/ /dang po la bzhi ste/ sgrol byed gang zag gi khyad par ni/ chos gsum dang ldan pa ste/ dbang thob pa/ lta ba rtogs pa man ngag gi gdengs yod pa'o/ /rgyud las kyang / gdengs gsum ldan pa gsal gsum bya'oX zhes so/ /yang thabs ldan bde ba snying po'i mchogacaX byin rlabs kun 'dus drag po'i mda'/ zhes pa'o/ /gzhan yang chos gsum
༄༅caX caXste/ bdag don dril ba/ bag dang ldan pa/ don gnyis grub par 'dod pa'o/ /de yang rgyud las/ brda don grol dang smin pa'i lam/ ta la nag po'i sbrul 'dzin ltar/ sbyor ba gang zag bdag dang ldan/ don gnyis 'grub par 'dod pa yis/ zhes so/ /bsgral bya'i zhing la khyad par ni/ bdag don ma yin pa/ bstan pa la phan pa'i blo dang ldan pas bya ste/ rgyud las kyang / bdag don ma yin bstan pa'i don/ dkon mchog bla ma'i don ched du/bstan pa'i bar chod byed pa dag/ bsgral na bla med byang chub myur/ de min na ni mnar med de/ las kyi ru tra la sogs skye/ zhes so/ /sgrol ba dus kyi khyad par la/ dus ni dgra bgegs byung ba'i dus sam/ lnga brgya'i tha ma'am/yang na zla ba nag po'am/ kho'i skeg gam de lta bu bya'o/ /rgyud las kyang / dam chos dge bcu smod pa dang / dgon pa'i gnas su 'phrog pa dang / rgyal ba'i bka' las bzlog pa dang / mtshams med lnga la spyod pa dang/ bden pa'i
bar log lta ba spyod/ de tshe sngags kyi dmod pa bor/ zhes so/ /yang de nyid las/ tshes dang gza' dang skar ma dang / nag po smes pa gcig la gtad/ ces so/ /sgrol ba gnas kyi khyad par ni dur khrod dam/ brag sngon po'am/ gnyan pa'am/dben pa'am/ nyams bde ba dang / gang rung du bsgrub ste/ rgyud las kyang/ dur khrod gnas sam brag ri'i ngos/ dben par 'dug la bsam gtan bya/ zhes so/ /yang dur khrod la sogs bde gnas su/ rang sems dben par gnas bcas te / zhes so/ /khyad par dang po'o/ tshos/ sbyor ba rdzas kyi khyad par la gnyis te/ bzas po 'gugs pa'i dmigs rten dang / sbyor ba 'dzoms pa drag po'i rdzas so/ /dang po la gnyis/ 'khor lo bri ba dang / liṅga bca' ba'o/ /'khor lo la gsum / bri ba'i rgyu dang / bri ba'i rten dang / bri ba'i thabs so/ /de la yang bdun te/ bri ba'i dus dang / phyi'i 'khor lo bskor ba dang / nang gi sngags 'god thabs dang gsang ba bla byang gzhug pa dang / de'i dus kyi spyod lam dang / de'i dus dgos pa'o/ /liṅga la gsum/ rgyu dang / tshad dang / chas su gsal ba'o/ /sbyor ba 'dzoms pa drag po'i rdzas ni/ brub khung dang / rtsong phur dang / skam sher gyi thun dang / thod pa dang / sngo dmar dang / dam rdzas dang / gtor ma dang / yo byad do / / sbyor ba gnyis pa'o/ tshos/ sgrub pa sngags kyi khyad par la brgyad de rgyud las shes so/ /dang po bdag nyid lha'i khyad par ni/ gsum ste/ phyi mtshon pa rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du bsgom shes pa/ nang phung po rtsa mig tu 'debs shes pa/
༄tshi/ /gsang ba rtog pa'i tshogs lha ru ngo sprod shes pa'o/ /dang po ni/ tshe bdag rtsa ba'i lha drug rgyan gyi lha brgyad phy-i nang gi gshed dang 'khor rnams skad cig gis rang gsal bar bskyed do/ /mngon rtogs las shes shing / rgyud las kyang /rigs lnga'i sku ni zil gnon sku/ rigs bzhi sprul pa gyad non brgyad/ phyi nang srog gshed khro chung bcas/ ma bskyed dbyings nas rdzogs par bya/ zhes so/ /nang phung po rtsa mig la dgod pa ni/ gabor lo bzhi las/ khyad par du snying la rdu ti dang la la na dang / dngas ma rtsa bzhi dang / rtsa bran brgyad dang / bcu gnyis dang / bcu drug rnams gshin rje gshed kyi lha tshogs su dgod pa ste/ rgyud las kyang / snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo la/ dwangs ma bzhi dang seng hā brgyad/ drug gnyis bcu drug ya ma'i klong / zhes so/ /gsang ba rtog tshogs ni/ phung po lnga dang 'byung ba dang / rnam shes tshogs brgyad dang / yul brgyad skye mched bcu gnyis dang / khams bco brgyad rnams lha'i rang bzhin du dag nas/ mthar mi rtog pa sgom pa'o rgyud las kyang / phung po lnga ni gtso bo gshod/ gsang bdag ya ma ru sbal khyung / 'byung ba yum lnga shes rab gsal/ rnam shes phyi nang gshed brgyad 'grub/ yul brgyad de bzhin gshod po brgyad/ skye mched bcu gnyis 'chi bdag tshogs khams la ging chen bco brgyad rdzogs/ yan lag bzhi la bdud kyi pho nya bzhi/ sha dang sgal tshig sha za'i tshogs/ 'dzin pa rang grol lan cig grub/ rang byung ye shes ye sangs rgyas/ zhes so/ /drag po sngags kyi khyad par ni/ rgyu dang
rkyen las ma bskyed pa/ bsnyen sgrub la rag ma lus/ yig 'bru dang ting 'dzin 'phro 'du ma byed pa mchod pa dang / rdzas dang gtor ma mi zhen pa/ 'o na ji ltar sgrub ces na/ chos sku stong pa las gzugs sku sprul nas/ 'gro ba'i don mdzad tshul du skabs kyi gdug pa 'dul ba dang / phrin las bzhi'i las thogs med mdzad pa'i don te/ rgyud las kyang / rgyud dang rkyen la rag ma lus/ bsnyen sgrub mi byed mthar ma ltung / re dogs bsgrod pa'i g.yang sa med/ rdzas dang sbyor ba'i 'phro 'du bral/ mchod dang rdzas la brten mi bya go' zer ba'am snang / chags sdang rgyu rkyen dbyer med 'dzom/ sa dang lam la bsgrod pa med/ ces gsungs so/ /rang gshed gnad kyi khyad par ni/ gnyis te/ rang lus lha dang lha mo'i rang bzhin du shes nas phung po rang rgyud du mi 'dzin pa/ 'khrul par snang ba'i gshed kho na la dgod shes/ 'khrul pa'i gshed bzhi ni/ ye shes kho rang la gnas te/ a wa dhu ti rnam snang na e dang ka dun gnas la la na la e gnas/ ra sa na myags gnas/chos nyid kyi rtsa la ya gnas/ yon tan gyi rtsa la 〈cobs gnas/ ye shes kyi rtsa la shag gnas/ rang rgyud kyi rtsa la mugs gnas/ rtsabran brgyad la dun dun re re gnas/ mdud pa bzhi la sngags kyi spu gri gnas/ rtsa bran bcu gnyis dang bcu drug la sha za gnas/ rtsa sgo rnams su bhyo rbad nan ces kha bcad/ de ni gshed bzhi rgod pa'o/ /rgyud las kyang / rang gshed rang sdud gnyis la ldang / gzugs can 'khor lo'i mi de yis/ gang yin snying gi 'khor lo la/ dwangs ma bzhi la
༄tshi/ /gsang gshed bzhi/ maphran brgyad la phyi nang gshed/ mdud pa bzhi la mtshon cha med/ 'dus pa gsum la yum re re/ rtsa bran yang logs 'chi bdag bdun/ masgo bzhin tshogs bhyo rbad nan/ dkar nag chags pa'i rten bzhi 'grub/ces gsungs so/ /bsrung bsad 'khor lo'i khyad par ni/ bsrung ba ni glang po lta bu ste/ rgyud las kyang / glang po che'i lta stangs kyis/ thabs chen bde ba'i mchog la dmigs/ zhes so/ /bsad pa ni bzhi ste/ rkyen bskul ni bdag nyid lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ drag sngags dmod pa rang rgyud du bzlas pas/ thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas/ bzas pa so'i bu ga dgu nas thim pas/ rtsa 'dab kyi yig 'bru la phog pa'o/ /gshed bslang ba ni/ gong gi yig 'bru las 'od zer 'phros pas la la na la yab/ ra sa na la yum/ srog rtsa la sprul pa'i tshe bdag dwangs ma bzhi la gsang gshod bzhi/ rtsa bran brgyad la ༄rdzog gshed bcu drug rtsa bran bcu gnyis la bee wa sa twa/ bye ba dgu khri/ rakta la sogs pa bcu gnyis/ bcu drug la bdud dang zhing gang la sogs te sha za rnams so/ /ba spu rnams la sprul pa bye ba dgu khri'o/ sbyor ba nang nas bcad pa ni/ bdag gi sngags drag tu bzlas pas/ gshed kyi khro tshogs kyis rang rang gi rtsa 'dab gcod par bsam/ dwangs snyigs dbye ba ni/ khro bo de rnams kyis bcad gtubs nas bdag gi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas/ dwangs ma bzhi'i brten pa gcig bsdus nas/ rtsa bcad khrag skam srog dwangs snyigs dbye ba ni/ dwangs ma'i sems snying dkyil nas/ khrag sbal
gyis snyim pa na/ ya dmar nag gnyis kyi bar na/ hūṃX dmar la dkar ba gcig che chung ni rtsa na ga'i 'bras bu tsam gnas so/ /snyigs ma'i srog snying dkar nag gi mtshams na bag chags nyer len gyi srog gi mṛ ljang gu gnas so/ /de yang rgyud las kyang / tsitta khrag sbal tsa na'i 'bru/ zhes pa dang / srog dang mṛ yi rang bzhin te/ ces so/ /dgu skor thun gyi khyad par ni/ thun sngags sam gang rung gcig brjod pas/ sngags kyi 'od zer sha za dang / gshed du gyur par bsam/ gnyis brjod pas phyung ngor 'phros par bsam/ gsum brjod pas gung bkug par bsam/ bzhi brjod pas liṅga la thim par bsam/ lnga brjod pas thun de dkrug cing sngags bzlas pas nad dang dug dang mtshon char gyur par bsam/ drug brjod pas rlangs pa phyogs bcur 'phros par bsam/ bdun brjod pas sgrub bya'i khog pa kha dbye bar bsam/ brgyad brjod pas bsrung ba'i lha dang de'i rgyab brten byed 'bros par bsam/ dgu brjod nas thun rgyab pas khog par me 'bar bas rtsa gcad khrag skam dwangs snyigs phye nas las byas pa'o/ /rgyud las kyang / dgu bskor drag pos bskor ba bya/ zhes so/ /'pho rgod ye shes kyi khyad par ni/ gsum ste/ chos sku la 'pho na/ bdag gi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ kho la thim/ dwangs ma'i yig 'bru la/ de yar thon nas tshangs pa'i bu gar bton la/ snang la rang bzhin med par bsam/ longs sku la 'pho na gong bzhin ston la bdag gi thugs gar e la stims/ sprul sku la 'pho na yig 'bru de e'am hūṃX las rdo rje sems
༄tshi/ /dpa' tshon gang par sprul nas/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ yam̐ las rlung gi mings stegs nas 'og min du 'phangs te/ rigs lnga yab yum sbyor ba mdzad pa'i yab kyi thugs gar bstims srog dag pa'i lam du zhugs nas/ yum gyi mkha' la babs/ yum gyi sbyor mtshams su rigs nges pa'i sras su gyur bar bsam mo/ /rgyud las kyang / 'pho ba gsum gyi brda dang sbyar/ dmar nag srid pa'i khrag dkyil nas/ sdud pa'i yi ge gsum gyis phrog tsa na'i snying po rten la thim zhes pa dang / yam yig byin can rten du stag phyag rgya sprul sku sprul bsam yas/ thob cing bsgrod pa sngags kyi stobs/ zhes so/ /dbrog sdud la las kyi khyad par ni/ snyigs ma phrogs na gsod pa ste/ bdag gis sngags rno la myur bas/snyigs ma'i srog gi dwangs ma la bzhi lus kyi rten/ mṛ ljang gu de rang dbang med par phrogs nas/ gabor lo'am/ liṅga'am/ thod pa'am gang rung gcig la stim/ de la phur pa ya ma rā dza mnga' gsol la/ snying gar bstim la mṛ bsad do/ /de yang rgyud las kyang / khrag sbal dang bcas dkar nag las/ rno myur 'bru gsum mthu yi 'phrog/ kun gyis rnam shes rten la bsdu/ zhes gsungs so/ /yang rten med na bdag gi thugs kyi e la bstims/ 'jig rten dregs pa'i mthu bsdus nas bdag rang bde ba'i 'bru la rol/ zhes so/ /rang grol chos nyid kyi khyad par ni/ gnod pa rjes med du shes pa/ rtag chad kyi mtha' chod pa/ gzhi lam 'bras bu'i don khong du chud pa/ de yang rgyud las kyang snang stong dbyer med du shes pa
chos sku la rnam par shes pa/ rtag chad kyi mtha' chod pa/ gnas dang rkyen dang glong dang gcod/ 'pho dang bgrod dang dbrog phud rnams/ las de chos nyid rang grol yin/ ces so/ /khyad par brgyad pa rdzogs so/ mjug sdud las kyi khyad par la lnga ste/ bsregs pa las bzhi'i khyad par ni/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi sbyin sreg bya lugs so/ /las gnyer gtad kyi khyad par ni/ zhakhor lo dang / thun dang drag sngags kyi mjug sdud do/ /mnan lugs la gsum las/ nam mkha' la mnan pa dang / bar snang la mnan pa dang / sa gzhi la mnan pa'o/ /de la yang gsum ste/ skam gtad dang / gsher gtad gnyis so/ /log gnon zer gyi khyad par ni/ gong gi log pa dang / sbyor bas gnod na/ zor bya ste/ gang gis 'phang ba/gang 'phang ba gang du 'phang ba dang / tshul lam thabs ji ltar 'phang ba dang / de'i dgos pa'o/ /mjug sdud gnag pa'i khyad par la gang gi zor log na bya/ yang na skam gtad kyi lag len dang bstun/ zor thebs gcig log na gnyis su bya/gnyis log na gsum du bskyar/ gsum log na 'bum par mnan pa bya'o/ /kha gso thun gyi khyad par ni/ phyis thun sngags kyis thun sgrub ste/ zhag gsum maX/ lnga'am/ bdun nam gang rung bya'o/ /las sbyor gyi khyad par ro/ /de yang rgyud las kyang / nam mkha' bar snang sa gzhi la/ bsreg mnan byas pa'i 'khor lo bya/ las la gnyer gtad mthar zor rbod/ dus bzhi las kyi kha gso bya/ zhes so/ /las ga'i khyad par lnga yi gsal byed rdzogs so/ /kun 'byung kun rdzogs kun tu
༄༅/ /bzang / / rdo rje 'chang gi snying po'i mchog /'jam dpal rdo rje mchog bsdus pa/ /rdzu 'phrul bdag po'am don bshad pa/ /rigs dang ldan pa'i snod la gdams/ /rigs min g.yengs ba'i bu la min/ /skal ba can la me long 'dra/ /skal med rang gcod sdud dang gshed/ /smon lam dag pa'i las 'phro can/ /'phrad na don ni brtsams pas 'grub/ /re dogs med pa'i kho thag chod/ athi+-i/ sarba maṅga laX/
༄༅/ /mchod rten gsal bar byed pa'i sgron ma se ston gyisamadzad pa bzhugs so//
༄7/ /dpal 'jigs byed chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khro rgyal tshe bdag nag po zil gnon brngams pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jam dpal gshin rje gshod kyis tran tra 'bum sde bkod pa nas/ gsang ba'i rgyud sde bco lnga la sogs pa'i snying por gyur pa/ gsang ba'i gsang chen yang gsang dam pa rang gshed sdig pa nag po snying la ru 'dzings pa 'khrul 'khor nag po'i gsang rgyud kyi dgongs pa/ man ngag tu gsal bar byed pa'i sgron ma drug yod pa las/ phyi mchod rten la brten nas gsad pa dang / mchod rten yongs rdzogs nyams su len pa'i spra khrid do/ /rnal 'byor pa dbang thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pas/ sngon du bsnyen pa rdzogs par byas te/ de nas dril sgrub dam pa/ rgya mdud chen mo bsnol mar brtsegs pa'i las/ mchod rten nag po la sku rnams yongs su rdzogs par bca' zhing / bsrung bzlog gsad mnan gyi las rnams/ lhun grub tu grub par bya ba ni/ rgyud las/ stobs chen
༄tshi/ /nag po rdzas bzlog dag /phung shul mi bsad g.yul bkye'i sa/ dur khrod ro'i sa dag la/ ro bsregs rdo dang sol ba dang / gri lcags dpa' bo g.yul bsad khrag ra dug re lcags a therdzo dzin/ grog mkhar sa spyin khro zhun dag shogs mdag mtshe chu sbyar te brtsigs/ nag po khru gang bang rim bzhi/ phyi nang sems can stobs chen 'degs/ ces pas/ sgrub pa po bsnyen pa rdzogs shing lta ba'i gdengs dang ldan pas phyag rgya chen po zil gnon du gsal zhing brten pas rnal 'byor pas/ gzhung dang mthun pa'am/ dben zhing nyams dga'i gnas nyid du/ sngon 'gro'i cho ga dge ba'i dpung bskyed pa dang / ma nyes pa'i dpang gzugs shing bden pa'i dam brdar ro/ gzhi bdag dang lha 'dre spyi la bka' bsgos la/ de nas drag po'i las la 'jug ste/ de yang rdzas dang sngags dang / lha dang gsum gyi bsrungs bzlog dang / rang gshed dang gzir mnan gyi las bya'o/ /rdzas la gsum ste/ rdzas bzlog
nag pos bdag srungs shing bgegs kyis mi tshugs pa'i phyir/ rang la btang zhing byug bdug bya ba/ gshed kyi thun drag pos pha rol gzer zhing myos pa dang / bskrad cing 'joms pa'i brab rdzas dang / 'phang rdzas dang / sku yongs rdzogs bca' ba'i/ mchod rten brtsigs pa'i rgyu rkyen/ rten 'brel nus pa can gyi rdzas dang gsum mo/ /dang po ni cu gang / mu zi btsan dug gla rtsi/ shu dag lngas rang gi lus la byug /pu shud sgro dang / gla ba'i mche ba dang / gong gi sman lnga po dang /bdun po de lus la btags pas/ bgegs rnams bsrungs bar byed do/ /gnyis pa thun rdzas ni/ gu gul rgya tshil mu zi bong tshil/ mi tshil rta khrag mngal khrag mdze khrag nyungs dkar nag skye tshe/ mtshon cha brdar ba'i phye ma rnams thun snod du bsags la sngags des dgra phyogs su 'phang ngo / /liṅga la brab pa dang bdug pa yang bya'o/ /rang nyid zil gnon du bsgom la/ e myags ya rngubs mugs shag ka dunacaX byad stem pho mo'i snying la ram/ rtsa la rbad/ srog la brengs/ sha la phyogs khrag la thun bhyo/ /ces 'phang pas/ sde brgyad thams cad brgyal rengs/ myos shing khrag tu skyug go /phyogs su nye bar mi nus so/ /gsum pa mchod rten nag po'i rdzas ni/ lha khang dang mchod rten byin rlabs can gyis sa rten 'brel 'grub pa'i rgyu'o/ /phung shul dang mi bsad pa'i sa/ g.yul bkye ba'i sa/ ro bsregs pa'i sa rdo/ sol ba/ dur khrod gnyan pa'i sa rdo dang lnga ni dgra'i lha lnga zil gyis gnon pa'i rdzas so/ /gri khrag dang / dug sna dang / mkhar gyi sa dang gsum
༄7/ /ni ngag mnan pa'i rdzas so/ /khro zhun rtse dang gri lcags dang / mtshon cha brdar ba'i phye ma dang / ra dug re lcag ka sho ka dha'i phye ma dang dug khrag rnams ni rang gshed dbab pa'i rdzas so/ /shog mdag mtshe chu sbyar ba ni/ rgyu rkyen rten 'brel 'grub cing sra bar byed pa'i rdzas so/ /de nas gza' skar dang / tshes grangs bzang zhing dar ba la 'grub pas/ zla ba yar ngo'i dus su bya ste/ de yang mig dmar dang phur bu dar ba la/ ra hu la dang bstun ste brtsig go /tha skar ram bra nye lag sor la sogs pa la bya'o/ /de yang dang por tshes gcig gi nyin/ gser skyems btang la/ dpang gzug bden pa brdar/ srid pa mnyam mo/ de nas dal gyi 'og tu/ gru gsum khru gang brus la/ 'og rgya mtsho'i steng du/ mun pa'i dmag bsdu ba ni/ rgyud las/ ri rab 'og tu rgya mtsho'i gting / gdug pa can gyi stobs gzhom phyir/ kham pa'i ga'ur rus sbal gyi/ lto sbyor bar du 'khrul 'khor bca'/ rgya shog dag la mu khyud gsum/ gru gsum sdig pa ru 'dzings pa'i/ steng 'og ling ga kha sbyar bya/ zhes pas gru gsum nang du/ rdza'i ga'ur rus sbal gnyis lto sbyar ba'i nang du 'khor lo bca' ba ni/ rgya shog la 'bor lo rim pa gsum bris la/ dbus su gru gsum la sdig pa rwa bsgrad pa gsum bri de la dug gsum rang gnad kyi rdzas ni/ gcig la zhe sdang rang gnad kyi rdzas lcags kyi byug go /gcig la gti mug rang gnad kyi rdzas dug gis byug go /gcig la 'dod chags rang gnad kyi rdzas khrag gis byug go /zla gam gsum la/ kho'i bsrung ma dang rbod
'dre bri'o/ /ra tri ra khrag srog la yam yam sre rlang dgra bo'i snying la shag e ka ya ma srog la hur thums gzir nan/ dgra bo'i snying la shag rbad/ nag po na ga rbe ta srog la dza dzacaX nd+ri hur thum shag dgra bo'i snying la rbad/ ces bri'o/ /de yi phyi rol 'khor lo rtsibs so gnyis la 'byung ba lha dang dbye ba'i sngags 'di 'bri'o/ /e baX raX yaX khaX shigs/ tsitta gtub pas stibs/ mes tshig chus khyer/ rlung gis g.yengs/ kha ri ltag rna ri rtse ri khas yan/ dgra bo ma ra ya rbad/ ces pas bskor de'i mtha' ma sbrul dang me ris bskor/ de 'dra'i tsakra gnyis bris la/ kha sbyor steng ma'i dkyil gru gsum gyi sdig pa gsum gyi lus la/ breng shag rbad/ ces pa re bri/ 'og ma'i lte ba gru gsum la/ ling ga'i khog par ming rus bris/ling ga la thun rdzas gong mas brab cing gdug ngan sngags 'di khri'am brgya stong bzlas so/ e myags ya rngubs mug shag ka dun/ ra tri ra khrag 〈snag la yam yam/ tri ling dgra bo'i snying la shag rbad/ e ka ya ma snying la hum thum gzir nan/dgra bo'i snying la shag rbad/ nag po na ga bho ta srog la dza dza/ nd+ri hur thums dgra bo'i snying la rbad/ ces steng du brab bo/ 'bor lo kha sbyar ste/ steng ma'i sdig pa/ 'og ma'i liṅga la sprad la tshigs 'dis bskul lo/ /hūṃX/ nyon mongs las kyi ru tra 'di/ ma rig mun pa'i smag rum du/ dug gsum stobs kyi mnon mdzad pa/ 'chi ba'i bdag po tshe dang srog gsang ba gshed kyi lha khyod kyis/ rang gshed nag po'i las mdzod cig ces bskul la sngags 'di brjod do/ /e baX raX yaX khaX
༄7/ /shig tsitta gtubs/ che ge mo 'di sa yis gtib/ me yis tshig chu yis khyer/ rlung gis g.yengs/ kha re ltag sna ri rtse ri rtog khas khas/ yan yan/ dgra bo/ ma ra ya nan/ ces brjod la/ dang po kha g.yam pa la rdo rje rgya gram bris la kha bcad do/ /sas brtibs rdzi bcag bya/ las bzhi'i bro brdung ngo / 'di ni ma bskor bar 'khor ba'i 'khor lo ste/ rgyud las/ rgya mtsho'i gting du na ga bsdus/ mun pa'i dmag bsdud 'khor lo mnan/ ces so/ /de yang dang po ga'u zlum por bcas pa ni khams gsum 'khyud mo bzhin du 'khor ba'o/ de'i nang du tsakra dang 'byung ba'i sngags bkod pa ni/ dgra bo'i lha phral ba'o/ /nang gi mu khyud la dregs pa'i sngags bkod pa ni/ dgra srog rang dbang med par 'gugs pa'o/ /zla gam gsum ni/ kho'i lha srung rang dbang med par bkug nas/ kho rang la bdud du 'beb pa'o/ /gru gsum gyis sdig pa gsum ni/ kho rang gi dug gsum dgra ru lang nas/ kho rang gi snying 'byin pa'o/ sa yis bkab ste/ steng du lam zhes bris pas ni/ 'chi bdag klu'i byad kha bzlog par 'gyur ro/ de'i steng du ri rab rmang la 'brub khung gcig bcas la gtad bzlog nag po/ mun pa'i dmag bsdu ba'i 'khor lo dbyer 'dod na/ de'i man ngag ltar bca' zhing bsgrub la mnan no/ /de yang rgyud las/ rgya mtsho'i steng du na ga klu'i/ mun pa'i dmag bsdu 'khor lo mnan/ zhes so/ /de'i steng du/ bar pa ri thang mtshangs kyi tsakra ni/ zhe sdang drag pos khros pa'i gzhu bcag pa'i 'khor lo ste/ rgyud las/ gshed po las rgyal lto ba
ru / / mu khyud rim pa lnga ru bskor/ dbus su 'dod pa'i ming gzugs bri/ /ces pas/ tshes gnyis kyi nyin/ ri thang gi mtshams su/ ri rab bang rim gnyis kha sbyar la 'brub khung nag po rtse mo lhor bstan pa/ rgya mdud bsnol mar brus la/ ro ras sam/ ka ri ga'am/ shog bu la gshed po las kyis rgyal po 'joms byed kyi lto bar mu khyud rim pa lnga ru bskor/ dbus su gzas pa'i ling ga bri/ de'i lto bar ming rus bri/ de'i snying la sdig pa nag po rwa bsgrad pa bzhi bri/ ra la e myags 'bru brgyad bri/ liṅga'i g.yas g.yon 'dom gsum du/ gshed kyi sngags gsum po 'di bri/ byi du ra na ga byi di ra/ rag mo ti/ de'i phyi rim du 'khrul mig bcu drug rim pa gnyis la dregs pa'i srog snying 'di bri/ ya ma rasmo / rakta kṣe ma/ shrī badzra kro ta/ dun ting kī lā pa/ ma ma rag mo/ nyid du rtubs he sha/ rag trag du phrag dun ting bhi la ni/ a dun tri/ tri sha na/ ra sti ha sti/ ces 'khrul mig phyi ma la/ sngags mgo phyir bstan ma bri de'i nang gis 'phrul mig bcu drug la/ ra tsa/ mu trag sha truX ti sta/ ra ni ru tra/ a tri pa du/ tsa tri ra tsa/ ra tsa na ga dhe tsa na ga dhe ba ru tri/ kha rag kṣe ma tri/ tun tri/ dun tri/ dun ti tri srog ma ra ya/ gha na pa ti/ bhi na ka ro/ ka la du phrag byi du ra/ na ga mo ti/sa ga byi du/ ces pa yig mgo phyir bstan du bri'o/ /de'i phyi rim rtsib nyer gnyis la/ byas pa bshog pa'i drag sngags 'di bri'o/ sarba sha truX staX bha ya nan/ 'drid rbad sarba rtsa sbur/ srog la nan/ snying gzer/ breng shag raX yaX rbad/ ces pa'i
༄7/ /yig mgo phyir bstan du bri/ de'i phyi ru gshed po'i gzugs bris la/ de lta bu gnyis kha sbyar ro/ /dregs pa'i sngags rnams bzlas la/ srid gsum gshed po'i lto ru dbang du bsdud/ 'di skad bskul lo/ hūṃX / lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la/sngags pa nang rgyas byed pa'i tshe/ gshed po las kyi rgyal po khyod/ skye ba snga ma'i las dbang gis/ sgrub byed skyes bu chen po la/ sde dpon dregs pa'i srog khang nas/ srog snying sngags kyi rnam par byung / sems ni sngags kyi rgyud du phyung / 'jig rten dregs pa'i srog sngags kyis/ dam nyams las kyi ru tra la/ rang gshod dbab pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ dregs pa'i srog sngags ming spel bcug la/ rgya mdud bsnol ma'i nang / ri rab chen po'i 'og tu mnan no/ de ltar gshed po las rgyal gyi 'khor lo bcas pa ni/ rnal 'byor 'khor bcas kyi bar chad bsrung ba'i dam pa yin no/ de ri rab kyi 'og tu mnan pa ni/ rbod gtong gis so 'tshams gcod pa yin no/ /de yang gshed po'i gzugs sbrul gyi ral pa can bris pa ni/srid pa gsum lto ru sdud pa yin no/ /'khor lo nyi shu sngags dang bcas pa ni/ kho'i byin rlabs bshig pa yin no/ /'khrul 'khor phyi nang la srog sngags bkod pa ni/ lha srin rnams rang gnas 'gug shing / bstim pa yin no/ /ling ga'i g.yas g.yon sgrom dang gsum du sngags bkod pas/ phung sri bdud du dbab cing 'dre srin la gtad pa'o/ snying khar sdig pa bzhi bkod pas ni/ bdud bzhi rang las longs nas bdud du dbab pa'o/ 'di ni ri thang gi mtshams su zhe sdang drag po'i
gzhu bcag pa ste/ 'di yang ma bskor bar 'khor ba'i 'khor lo'o/ de nas tshes gsum gyi nyin/ ri rab kyi kha la gnam lcags kyi so brdar ba'i tsakra bcas la/ dgra bsad pa'i las bya ste/ rgyud las/ ri rab rtse la gnam lcags dag ur mo so brdar 'khor lo bca'/ ces pa dang sku mchog yongs rdzogs lto ba sa maṇḍal mthing nag gru gsum dag phung pa gsum dang dug khrag sbru/ bang rim gsum la kha khyer gtsang / dug khrag sol bas nag por byug ces pa dang / mchog dang phag mo'i lto sdebs la/ dbus kyi pho brang rgya che bar/ mtha' bsgyur gang yod liṅga bri/ zhes pas/ ri rab bang rim gsum pa de/ gzhi che bar byas la/ bang rim steng du 'brub khung gru gsum pa bang rim gsum brtsegs/ kha khyer la thod pa dang me ri bris la rtsang gis bskor/ nang du dug khrag dang ro sol gyis byug go thod pa mtshan ngan gyi nang du shog bu mdzub re pa gnyis la/ mchog dang phag mo lto sdebs pa'i tsakra/ dpe chung ltar bris la gnyis kha sbyar te/ gcig rtsang la dgram /cig thod par dgram/ bar du liṅga zag rdzas dang ldan pa sen gang pa gcig brtsal lo/ liṅga ni rang gshed drug po gang yin dang sbyar te/ gsang ba yang gsang du bsdebs pa'i gnad do/ /zag pa'i rdzas med na don med ces bshad / 'bor lo thod nang du brtsal te/ steng ma'i lte ba'i thun lam nas/ 'og ma'i rlarsha la thun 'bab par bya ba la sogs kun zhib par 'khor lo la bsten te/ gsad pa'i sgrub pa'i skabs na gsal bar yod pa bzhin bya'o/ /thod pa ni ja
༄༅/ /hril yin na/ 'chi bdag zhal phye la mnga' gsol lo/ skya yol yin na/ thod pa'i kha zhabs su/ 'bor lo steng ma bkram la/ lte ba nas thun lam gsal lo/ /de nas zil gnon bskul/ sprul pa gsum bskul/ 'khor gyis gshed po bzhi dang / bla 'gugs pa'i mon pa bzhi dang / srog gshed kyi bdud bzhi dang / las kyi 'chi bdag bcu gnyis/ sgrol ba'i ging chen bco brgyad rnams drag tu bskul lo/ bla 'gugs la liṅgar bcug la/ las kyi gshin rje la gtad par bya'o/ ayo myags ya rngubs mugs shag ka dun/ e hur ka tsa/ khrag tu ya hril/ ru ti baX hla/ ragyu kha raX/ mu ti dza/ bha ti da ra ya/ bhi sha tsakra/ dam nyams ma ra ya rbad/ ces thun brdeg /gzer zhing byed du gzhug go /de yang dang po rus sbal gyi ltor tsakra bris pa ni/ srid pa'i tshe srog dbang du bsdus pa'o/ /phag pa'i lto bar bcug pa ni/ gti mug gi rang gnad kyis dbang du bsdu ba'o/ /rdo rje rgya gram bris pa ni/ rdo rje'i rwa brgyad la drag sngags 'bru brgyad bcas pas / tshogs brgyad rang gshed 'bebs pa'o/ /dbus su gru gsum ni/ phrin las drag po'i nd+ri tri gnyis la thams cad sdud pa'o/ /tsakra'i phyi nang rtse mo sprad pa ni shes rab thabs kyi rang bzhin no/ /bsad pa'i las drug dang sdebs pa ni/rang gshed gnad gcod yang gsang ba'i man ngag go /las 'dis ni/ zhag bdun la bsgrol nges so/ /'di ni bskor bas 'khor ba'i 'khor lo ste/ bzlas shing bskor la/ gsad cing gzir bar bya'o/ /ri rab kyi kha la gnam lcags kyi so
brdar ba'i 'khor lo bca' ba'i rim pa'o/ /de nas tshes bzhi la/ sku yongs su rdzogs pa'i mchod rten gyi bang rim bzhi la thugs par brtsig go /sgo bzhi'i thun ni 'brub khung nang gi liṅga la 'phogs par bya'o/ /de yang gong du bsham pa'i rdzas rnams la rgya mdud brtsegs pa'i mchod rten nag po gru gang pa bang rim bzhi dang ldan par brtsigs la/ phyi nang du stobs chen gsum dang ldan par bya ste/ mchod rten de'i phyi nang du 'degs par byed pa'i stobs chen/ gdug pa rnams zel gyis gnon pa'i mthu stobs dang ldan pa'i stobs can gyis sems can phyi'i phyogs su 'degs byed du dgod pa ni/ de'ang gdan khri nas rim par bsham ste/ 'og phyogs phyi yi rgya mtsho la nub pa ni/ dbyings nus pa'i gting dang ldan pa'i rtags so/ /phyogs bzhi nas ngo mtshar gyi chu bo bzhi 'bab pa ni 'phrin las bzhi la rgyun chad med pa'i brda'/ chu la gnas pa'i klu rigs mi bsgrung pa bzhi zil gyis mnan pa'i phyir/ gdan khri la rus sbal bzhi'i gdan dgod do/ /de'i steng du bdud bzhi zil gyis mnan pa'i phyir/ glang chen bzhi yis 'degs par bya'o/ /de nas rmang la phyogs bzhi nas/ drag po sgo bzhi byas nas/ de nas drag po'i thun brab par bya'o/ /de'i steng du bar la 'degs byed ni/ pho gdon zil gyis gnon pa'i sbrul dang / chu bdag zil gyis gnon pa'i padmas 'degs par bya'o/ /sbrul ni rigs bzhi'i kha dog dang mthun par bya ste/ phyogs mdog go de'ang phyogs rer gnyis kyis 'degs par bya ste/ shar du dkar po dkar khra/ lhor ser
༄༅/ /po dang ser khra/ nub tu dmar po dang dmar khra/ byang du ljang khu ljang khra'o/ /de'i steng du sna tshogs mdzes pa'i padmas bkab la/ bad kyi dgab po/ /de dag gis dus thams cad sha khrag gi gtor ma btang zhing / 'phrin las drag tu bskul lo/ /ting nge 'dzin gsal zhing bzlas pa drag po bar ma chad par bya'o/ /de nas tshes lnga'i nyin mor/ bang rim bzhi po brtsigs te/ de yang mas yar bsgrangs pa'i/ bang rim dang po'i steng du/ klu srin zil gyis gnon pa'i phyir du/ bya bzhi yis 'degs par bya ba ste/ kha dog phyogs mtshon no/ de'i steng gi bang rim la/ phyug bdag zil gyis mnon pa'i phyir du/ zur bzhir stag bzhi dang dregs pa thams cad zil gyis mnan pa'i phyir du/ phyogs bzhir gzig bzhis 'degs pa'o/ /de'i steng ma la rig 'dzin zil gyis mnan pa'i phyir/ zur bzhir seng ge bzhi/ gdug pa gsum zil gyis mnan pa'i phyir/ phyogs bzhir chu srin bzhis 'degs pa'o/ /de nas tshes drug gi nyin/ bum pa bre dang bcas pa bzhengs la/ tshogs dang gtor ma rgya chen po 'bul lo/ /de nas tshes bdun la 'khor lo bcu gsum gdugs dang bcas pa bzhengs la tog dang bya ru la sogs pa rnams brtsigs te/ 'khor lo bcu gsum po 'brug gis 'degs par bya'o/ /phrin las thams cad 'grub cing thams cad zil gyis mnon pa'i phyir/ char kheb bya khyung ro nye za bas 'degs pa'o/ /de dag gi srog shing du/ gri mda' la khrag chen byug la/ e myags 'bru brgyad bris la/ rab gnas dang ldan par byas la
gzugs so/ /de nyid zil gnon gyis sku ru byin gyis brlabs so/ /de nas drag sngags stobs chen dgod pa ni/ drag sngags tshar gsum du bang rim la dgod do/ de yang yas mar drang pa'i bang rim dang por/ gsad pa'i sngags 'di dgod do / / srod la thun myags tsitta la rbad/ shar du'o/ /khas rtsa la breng sha rbad/ lho ru'o/ tsitta la bre shag dzaX nub tu'o/ /srog la hur thum rbad/ byang du'o/ /bang rim gnyis pa'i phyogs bzhir/ sngags 'bru bzhi po 'di bri/ srog stam bha ya nan/bang rim tha ma la/ sngags tshan bzhi po 'di shar nas rim pa bzhin bri'o/ /srog la ram shag rbad/ thun yaX bzlog kha thun ri li liṃ bhyo/ de nas tshes brgyad kyi nyin mo/ mchod rten nang du lha tshogs stobs chen rnams 'god pa ni/ bya ru'i nang du/na mo bhuddha ya/ bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'khor lo la na mo dharma ya/ bdag cag 'khor dang cas pa rnams chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ /bre logs la/ na mo saṅga ya/ bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dge 'dun la skyab su mchi'o/ /zhes bris la gzhug go ྅༷caX rnal 'byor chos la dgra byung gis/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rams mda' bzlog gzu dang dpang du dkon mchog bzhugs/ dkon mchog gsum gyis byin gyis rlobs ces brjod do/ de nas bum pa rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang du/ e myags 'bru brgyad bris pa'i srog shing la/ phyag rgya zil gnon rtsa ba'i lha drug gyad gnon gyi lha brgyad dang bcas pa bskyed la/ spyan drangs te/ hūm̐XcaX klu 'bum
༄tshi/ /gnyen khri phyogs skyongs ma he'i stong / thabs dang shes rab nyi zla'i gdan steng du/ nag po dug chen sgril dgra'i sku/ dgyes shing bstan par bzhugs su gsol/ thugs khar sngags kyis phreng ba la dmigs la bzlas par bya/ de nas bskul lo/ hūm̐X / chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas/ drag po e yi gzhal yas nas/ srog bdud gshin rje nag po ni/ nag po dug chen 'khyil 'dra'i sku/ dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgrad/ phyag drug mtshon chas dgra bgegs bsgrol/ sku la dur khrod brgyan dang ldan/ khro rgyal thams cad zil gyis gnon/ dregs pa'i lha srin rdul du brlog dam nyams dgra bo'i gshed ma mdzod/ e myags ya rngub mugs shag ka dun/ dgra bo'i tsitta la hur thum dza/ srog la dun smugs breng shag rbad/ ces brjod do/ srog shing zil gnon du bsam mo/ bum pa lha'i pho brang du/ dpal chen zil gnon yab yum gsal bar bsgom/ de nas rang gi rtsa chen bzhi bsrung zhing bdud bzhi'i gnyen por/ bang rim dang po'i phyogs bzhir/ gshed po bzhi dgod do/ liṅga'i bzhi'i tha mar/ gshed sngags ming dang spel la bri/ phur pa bzhi'i dbal la yang / sngags bzhi bris la yang / dgra po'i srog la mā ra ya/ zhes ming dang spel te bris la/ liṅga'i snying khar gdabs bskul ba'i tshig 'di brjod do/ hūṃX/ srin po ya ma ra dza'i sku/ smugs nag be con 'khor lo bsnams/ dam nyams dgra bo'i gshed ma mdzod/ gzhin rje myos byed 'bar ba'i sku/ ser nagaza 'gre'o/ /dam nyams: bdud po ārya mo ru tse/
dmar nagazo dam nyams: gnod sbyin ral pa tshar dgu'i sku/ ljang nagazo dam nyams: ya ma ra tsa sa twa me ya/ che ge mo'i srog la dun smugs rbad/ ya me do 91 )ru na yo da ya/ che ge mo'i srog la kham shag rbad/ ya ta yo ni ra la kṣe ya/ che ge mo'i srog la breng shag rbad/ ya kṣe ya tsa ni ma ra ya/ che ge mo'i srog la yam shag rbad/ ces bzlas shing / phur pa liṅga la btabs la phyogs bzhir dgod do/ /phur pa la bri ba'i sngags bzhi ni/ ya ma ra tsa sa twa me ya/ che ge mo ma ra ya nan/srog la hur thun myags/ ya me twa ru na yo ta ya/ che ge mo ma ra ya nan/ khas rtsa la breng shag rbad/ ya ta (ta la )yo ni ra ya kṣe ya/ che ge mo ma ra ya nan/ tsitta breng shag dzaX ya kṣe ya dza ni rā ma ya/ che ge mo ma ra ya nan/ srog la hur thum rbad/ces bris la gdab kro/ /kho rang gis srung ma gshed du dbab bo/ de nas bang rim gnyis la ni/ bla 'gugs pa'i srog shed/ mon pa bzhi'i phur pa la/ mon pa'i sngags bris la/ dgra bo'i srog la ma ra ya dza dzaX ces pa bris la/ liṅga bzhi la gdab bo/ /mon pa bzhi dang / bdud po bzhi dang / phyi nang gi srog gshod brgyad po 'di/ rnal 'byor pa'i rnam shes tshogs brgyad srung zhing skyobs pa'i lha'o/ /liṅga ming rus can bzhi'i steng du/ phur pa sngags bris pa bzhi gdab ste/ hūm̐XcaX shar du dung gis mon pa seng ge'i mgo lho ru lcags kyi mon pa stag gi mgo nub tu bse'i mon pa dred kyi mgo byang du gser gyi mon pa khyung gi mgo /sprul pa las kyi srog shed bzhis/ dam nyams dgra bo'i gshed ma mdzod/ ka ling dun ting tsitta
༄༅/ /srog ro myags rbad/ a mu ga'i srog stam bha ya nan/ ha la ha la dun ting tsitta ro myags rbad/ a mu ga'i: rakṣa hur ti dun ting tsitta ro myags rbad/ a mu ga'i srog: karmā bha ti dun ting tsitta ro myags rbad/ a mu ga'i srog stam pa ya nan ces bris la/ bzlas shing gdab bo/ de nas bang rim gsum par/ bdud bzhi dgod do/ liṅga sngags kyi bskor ba bzhi'i/ phyogs bzhir bzhag la/ he le khyab pas dgra bo ma ra ya nan la sogs pas liṅga bskor la/ phur pa la/ he le khyab pas/ dgra bo ma ra ya nan/ a mu ka ram bzlog nag po 'dzum med kyi dgra bo ma ra yā nan/ kha thun so 'dar 'khrig pas dgra bo ma ra ya nan/ yaX bzlog ral pa spyir bcings kyi dgra bo ma ra ya nan/ ri laṃ laṃ bhyo bzlog ces pa bris la dgod do/ he le khyab pa dkar skya 'khor lo thogs/ so 'dar 'khrigs pa dmar ljang ral gri thogs/ nag po 'dzum med tshe srog 'dzin pa par bu thogs/ ral pa smyi bcings ljang nag khram zhags can no/ /he le khyab pa shar gyi bdud/ so 'dar 'khrigs pa lho'i bdud/ nag po 'dzum med nub kyi bdud/ ral pa spyi bcings byang gi bdud/ las kyi bdud po chen po bzhis/ dam nyams dgra bo'i gshed ma mdzod/ dun ru tra ru thum/ bha ti da ra srog la thur thu/ dgra bo ma ra ya ces dgod do/ de nas bang rim bzhi pa ste/ tha ma la ni rang gis skye mched bcu gnyis bsrungs ba'i phyir du/ 'chi bdag bcu gnyis dgod de/ liṅga bcu gnyis kyi mtha' sngags kyi bskor te/ bhe ba sa twa dgra bo ma ra ya nan/ ces pa nas gzhan
rnams des 'gre bar bskor la bhe pa sa ta dang / nor bu dge 'phel shar du/ ser nag 'joms byed shar lto/ bye ba dgu khri dang yakṣa glog phreng ba lto/ yakṣa za byed lho nub/ gtum po dud ka dang / gang ba kun 'joms nub kha 'bar ral gcig nub byang / sbrul mgo kun 'dzin dang ngad pa stobs ldan byang du/ hong ban srog 'dzin byang shar ro/ /de dag thams cad g.yas pa: g.yon pa thams cad thod khrag thogs par bsgom la dgod do/ hūm̐XcaX lcags mkhar 'bar ba bcu gnyis nas 'chi bdag bdud kyi bdud chen po/ /'jigs byed chen po 'jigs pa'i bdag /gdug pa dug gis kha rlang can/ 'bar ba gtum po tshogs kyi bdag spyan gsum bzlog nas sdang mig bsgyur/ zhal bsgrad 'bar ba'i mche ba gtsigs/lce rkyang (spyangs )mchu ni khrag gis rlan/ so rno lag pa dmar po yis/ zangs gri zhags pa nag po thogs/ gdug pa'i tshon cha sna tshogs bsnams/ snying rje med par gsod par byed/ rngam zhing gdug pa'i tshogs bcas kyis/ dam nyams dgra bo'i gshed ma mdzod/ kriṣa rna dza ma ri/ dgra srog la hur thum rbad/ hūm̐XcaX 'chi bdag bdud kyi bdud chen po/ bhe ba sa ti'i dus la babs/ dam nyams dgra bo'i gshed ma mdzod/ ser nag 'joms byed las mkhan mo/ be ba sa twa khrag 'thung po nor bu dge 'phel gtum bag can/ kha 'bar ral cig chu 'jib po/ sbrul mgo kun 'dzings ma rungs pa/ rakṣa glog phreng gtum bag can/ yakṣa za byed khrag gi myos/ gtum po dud kha khro gtum 'bar/ gang ba kun 'joms bsod la
༄tshi/ /dga' / hong 'phan 'thom pa snying rje med/ ngad pa stobs ldan mi bzad pa/ lag na mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs/ kha nas drag sngags dmod pas gzir/ dam nyams dgra bo'i gshed ma mdzod/ shag dzaXsrog la rbad/ zhes bskul lo/ /de nas sgo bzhir phur pa bzhi la/ dkar po snying 'byin gyis dgra bo ma ra ya nan/ de bzhin du mgon po nag po yab rje/ sku mchog dmar po dang bzhi/ g.yas 'khor lo dang gri gug g.yon lcags kyu dang zhags pa lcags sgrog dang dril bu can bsgom mo/ liṅga'i mtha' mar ming dang dmod sngags bris la/ sgo bzhi la dgod/ hūm̐X/ drag po las kyi sgo bzhi nas/ srog bdag dkar po snying 'byin dang / ma hā ka la 'jigs pa'i sku/ bdud po yab rje nag po dang / gnod sbyin sku mchog dmar (dkar )po bzhi/ drag po las kyis sgo ba bzhis/ dam nyams dgra bo'i gshod ma mdzod/ ces dgod do/ de ltar lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i phur pa rnams/ bang rim rnams la bkod cing lhar bskyed la dgugs stim bya rab gnas byas la lha ru mnga' gsol lo/ liṅga la byug bdug dgug gzhug byas la gdab ste/ dgra bgegs dang rang dbang med par gzir ro/ lha rnams kyi sku mdog phyag 'tshal rnams bskyed rim kyi skabs su bstan pa bzhin sgom zhing / thugs gar rang rang gis sa bon gyis srog rnams bsam mo/ sha khrag gis mchod gtor phul la/ las la drag tu bskul zhing / phrin las gzhol lo/ sngags bzlas la rang rang gis gnas su dgod pa rnams mi 'gyur zhing brtan par bzhugs nas/ drag po'i
las mdzad par bsgom/ de ni byin rlabs dang mthu stobs chen po rnams yongs su rdzogs/ rdzas bzlog nag po'o/ dus 'tshams bsrung ba'i mchod rten nag po la sku yongs su rdzogs pas las rnams lhun gyis grub pa/ rgya mdud brtsegs pa zhes bya ba yin te/ pha rol gyis dmod pa bzlog cing / dregs pa thams cad tshar gcod zil gyis gnon pa lha'i pho brang du sgom la/ de las sprul pa dang yang sprul gyi tshogs 'phro 'du byed cing / gang la dmigs pa'i ting nge 'dzin rnams thogs pa med par 'grub pa'i ting nge 'dzin bsgom par bya'o/ /de las rab gnas dang mnga' gsol bya ste/ e myags la rten 'brel snying po btags la/ mang du bzlas zhing me tog gtor la/ mchod bstod gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /phyag 'tshal smon lam gdab/ de nas lha'i stobs kyi rang gshed dbab pa'i phyir/ bskyed rim gsal bar bsgom zhing / spyan drangs la mchod bstod bya'o/ /lha srin gyis stobs gzhom pa'i phyir du/ rang nyid mi 'jigs pa'i go bgo ba ni/ rang lhar gsal ba'i lus la khro bcur rdzogs par bsgom zhing / snying gar gtsug tor 'khor lo bsgyur ba ser po/ phyag na 'khor lo dang padma bsnams par bsgom mo/ gnas gsum byin gyis rlabs/ sprul pa bdag po gsum dang / phyi nang gi srog shed la sogs 'khor 'das kun gsal btab la/ mchod bskul bya zhing las bcol lo/ /rang 'khor bsrung zhing pha rol gyis byas pa bshigs/ rang gshed phab nas bsgral bar bsam/ sngags ni e rings la khro bcu uṣṭi ngar gcod btags la rang
༄khu/ /bsrung ngo / /gzir ba g.yu spyang gi rgyun du lha srin gyis stobs gzhoms/ stong srog 'khor lo bcas la/ spyang mo drug gis so bsgyur zhing / dug mda'i ngar bcad do/ /skabs su lha srin yid 'phrog gis/ tshe bsdu zhing srog dbrog go /rgyun du stong srog gnad kyis dgongs pas gzir zhing srog dbrog go de ltar zhag nyer gcig tsam byas la/ mchod rten lha'i pho brang la byin rlabs kyis dpung dbab po/ pho nya dregs pa dngasprul pa'i rten bcas lha srin dregs pa'i stobs gshom mo/ /mchod rten tshogs mchod kyi dge ba'i dpung bskyed la rang srog bsrungs zhing skyobs/ bar chad sel bas dus bzhir dbul lo/ gdung sha ri rab bum par gzhugs pas byin rlabs yun du gnas shing rten 'brel 'grub po/ /sngags rings rgyun du bzlas pas bsrung bzlog gzir mnan bshig pa gang yang 'grub pas/ spyi srog dang dgos srog bsdebs/ spyang mo so ste/ dgongs pa byas la las gang 'dod pa 'grub bo/ /dril ba rkyang pa'i gnad kyi/ 'phrin las gang dgos skabs dang sbyar ro/ de nas las sbyor drag po bsad pas mchog gi las kyi 'khor lo bskor ba ni/ mchod rten 'og ri rab kyi bum pa'i nang du/ mchog dang phag mo'i tsakra bcas pa'i nang du/ bar du rang gshed drug gi liṅga gang dgos pa re bcug la/ 'bor lo bskor/ de yang thog mar liṅga dbye dgug bya ste/ ya bdud gsod byed rgyal po dang / rgyal po shel ging btsan yam shud dang / ging rdo rje legs pa dang bzhi'i ming bris la/ khra'i gshog pa g.yas pa la sbyar la/ mda'
stong nag po gcig la gdags so/ de'i 'og tu dgra'i lha srung dang / lha lnga'i ming shog bu la bris la/ de dang dgra'i ming gzugs yang shog bu la bris la/ de rnams 'thab sar bya/ srid pa'i lha 'dre la gtor ma byin la/ dbye dgug las gzhol lo/ /lha dang dbye ba'i rdzas kyi/ liṅga la bdug de nas liṅga 'khor lor bcug la/ sgo bzhi nas thun 'phog par bya'o/ /de nas 'khor lo bskor ba dngos ni/ sngon du zhag bdun la sogs par sngags ring bzlas te/ las drag po'i dpang btsugs la/ lha srin gyi stobs gzhom mo/ de nas lha'i ting nge 'dzin gsal zhing brtan pas/ zhag bdun nam/ bcu bzhir nyungs dkar nag dang dug dang / skye tshe khrag skam la sngags la sgo bzhi nas liṅga la brab kro/ e myags ya rngubs mugs shag ka dun/ dgra bo'i srog la rnikhur thum dza/ rtsakhag tsitta thum ril raX shag rbad/ dgra rba'i tsitta bring shag dzaX srog la khur thum dza rbad/ ces brdeg go /dmigs pa ni/ rang lhar gsal ba'i/ sngags bzlas pas/ sngags kyi 'od zer/ dbugs kyi rta la zhon nas mtshon cha'i 'khor lo 'phros pas/ gzas pa'i bu ga dgu ru thim/ rtsaskrubs khengs nas srog rtsar 'dus/ srog gi gzhi ma'i sbal pa bsregs/ yi ge snra ljang khu de thod pa'i nang du 'khrul 'khor du 'chang bar bsgom mo/ kho'i ye shes sems dpa' gshed po chen po lcags kyi sdig pa nag por gyur nas/ kho rang gi srog rtsa za ba bsgom mo/ kho rang gi nyon mongs pa las dug lnga'i khro bo brgyad khri bzhi stong du gyur nas/ khong rang gis rgyud las
༄༅/ /longs te/ kho rang gis srog gcod cing / sha rul 'bus g.yengs ltar bsam mo/ dus drug tu thun dbabs pa ni/ shar nas dkar po snying 'byin gyis/ lcags kyus snying nas bzung bar bsam zhing / smyo ru bcug par bsam e mu ka e/ dgra bo'i srog la thum ril rbad bhyo zhes brab kro/ /lto nas mgon po nag pos zhags pa bcing nas rgyal du bcug par bsam/ a mu ka thun khrag shing / tsitta myogs rbad bhyo/ ces brab bo/ /nub nas yab rje nag po lcags sgrog dang khram shing thogs nas/ khram la btab par bsam mo/ a mu ka rtsa la dun mugs rbad bhyo zhes brab bo/ /byang du sku mchog dmar pos/ rgyu zhags dang dril bu thogs nas/ dgra bo'i rtsa rgyus bcad par bsam/ a mu kaX yaX/ khrag la mug ti thun bhyo/zhes brab bo/ /tho rang sgo bzhi'i thun sngags dril la/ de'i gshams bur 'di btags thun brdeg go /sngags pa snying du sod/ tsitta rbad longs/ srog tsitta myags myags ma ra ya ma ra ya tsitta la thun bhyo/ ces brab bo/ /zor 'phang ba yang /sngags des 'phang ngo / skabs su thugs dam drag tu bskul lo/ /rmi rtags kyang kho rang bsad pa dang / ra g.yag gsad pa 'byung ngo / gzhan yang las drag po'i dus su rtags ni/ rang yang rngams zhing 'tshigs pa dang / khong shugs che ba dang /sems dga' zhing lus yang ba ni rtags yang dag pa'o/ de nas gsang ba mchog phag dang / yang gsang rang gshed drug dang sbyar nas las byed na/ bsad thabs drug gi las sbyor dang bsdebs pa ni/ mchog dang phag mo lto sbyor gyi tsakra la
dbus kyi pho brang gru gsum pa de/ rgya che bar byas la gang gsod par 'dod pa de'i liṅga bris te/ de yang ghu ru seṅge'i khog mi bshig ces pas/ bla ma la byar mi rung ngo / las kyi rgyal po sdig can bsad pa ni/ snying khar ral gri bris la/ rtsa bzhi mtshon chas gcod par bsam/ rtsa ba e myags 'bru brgyad dang / spu gri ur mo mchog gis drag sngags la/ so ru rang gshed drug po re gang dgos pa re btags la bya ste/ btsad so la byed na/ e myags ya rngubs/ mugs shag ka dun dgra bo'i srog la zahur thum dzaX rtsakhag tsitta thum ril ram shag rbad/ dgra bo'i tsitta breng shag dza/ srog la hur thum rbad/ ra dza nd+ra dza/ thum ril ma ra ya rbad/ ces bzlas/ gri lcags dang dug gis brab la las ka rdzogs pa dang / tsakra dril la spyang zhi'i thod par bcug la/ las mtha' mnan pa bya ba ni/ seṅge'i khog par mnan zhes bya ste/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'og tu'o/ /yang na mchod rten rang la mnan no/ slob ma dam nyams bsad pa ni/ ling ga'i khog par sdig pa bzhi gzhug go/kho'i ye shes sems dpa' snying la bcug ste lcags kyi sdig pa nag por gyur nas/ srog rtsa za bar bsam mo/ /spu gri la sogs gdags pa ni/ srog la hur thum rtsa la ma ra ya rbad/ ces sngags la/ thun rdzas la gu gul dang / mngal khrag bsres la thun brab kro/ /rdzogs nas tsakra de/ mon thod du bcug la/ thod pa stag gi'adzum la mnan/ chu mig 'babs chu yod par mnan no/ /dam 'dres pa yi dam gcig pa'i mched po'am/ khrims 'chal pa la/ liṅga snying gar bse'i sbal
༄༅/ /pa bcug la/ nad khrag 'dus shing bsad par bsam/ srog la hur thum yam thum rmugs/ ma ra ya rbad/ ces bsdebs la/ rme khrag dang / nad khrag dang / sdig pa'i khrag dang / thun rdzas kyis brab/ thod pa gzig gi thig le ste/ chu mig lu ma 'khyil bar mnan no/ /dam tshig mi gcigapa'i sngags pa spyi la/ liṅga'i snying gar bse'i sbal pas bri/ dug khrag snying la rgyas na me chus rnam shes bsad par bsam/ srog la mugs/ hri shags ma ra ya rbad/ ces pa so ru bsdebs la dur khrod kyi sa dang / khrims 'chal gyi khrag dang / glang gi khrag gis thun rdzas brab pas thon pa dang / thod pa mun pa'i gling ste/ ro khung du mnan no/ bon po mu stegs mkhan gyis rigs de nyid la liṅga'i snying gar dug gis phag pa bcug la/phag rgod smug nag de las/ nad dang mtshon 'phros nas brgyal zhing bsad par bsam/ srog la hur thum nd+ri ma ra ya rbad/ bong khrag mdze khrag mnol khrag gu gul thun rdzas brab la/ liṅga srin mo'i sgrom (sgram )gces pa/ brag dmar po chu mig sha re 'babs pa'i sar mnan no/ /ur mo drag sngags mkhan dang / ngan sngags mkhan dang / phyir bzlog mkhan gsum po de dang 'gras na/ ur mo'i drag sngags 'di dang / kho rang gis drag sngags la/ bsnal bzlog dkrug pa dang bsdebs la/ bsnol mar brdeg go /thod pa ni 'brong gi rwa zhes pa/ brag nag thug pa can la mnan no/ /tsitta kham shag dza/ srog la yam thun rbad/ ces thun brab bo/ /rtsab 'bru brgyad pa/ spu gri dang bcas pa'i so rtswa /rang gshed drug po
btags la brab bo/ /de la rtags dang mtshan ma yid ches par byung nas/ thod pa drug po gang yin par re bas phur la sngo dmar skud pas rgya gram du bcings la/ nag po bdud kyi nyi ma shar ba la gnas drug po gang yin du gtad par bya'o/ /nam gyi gung ngam/ nyi ma'i zer la/ thod pa tshes legs par byas la/ dong khru gang brus pa'i gting du las kyi gshin rje la gtad do/ /hūṃX 'byung ba gdan bzhi'i rngam 'og nas/ las kyi tshe bdag nag po ni/ ya mtshan che la rmad du byung / mun nag 'thib pa'i 'og na bzhugs/ g.yas pa'i phyag na ri rab bsnams/ g.yon pa'i phyag na rgya mtsho bsnams/ zhabs kyis rlung gi 'khor lo bsnams/ dam nyams dgra bo las ngan 'di/ mnan pa las kyis dus la babs/ sgo med lcags mkhar nang du bcug gshin rje rnams kyi zas su byin/ 'bor lo 'bar ba'i rtsibs la bskyon/ rgya mtsho chen po'i gting du chug ri bo chen po'i rmang du non/ nam yang ldang bar ma bya zhig che ge mo ma ra ya staX bha ya nan/ zhes mnan no/ de nas thun gyis bsad las byas la thun bsgrub ste/ nya stong la thun kha gsos zhing 'phang ngo / pho nya rkang mgyogs bzlog pa'i thun yang 'phang pas rbod gtong bzlog pa'o/ /thugs dam drag tu bskul lo/ /gtor ma gtang ba'i dus su yang / pho nya rkang mgyog bzlog pa'i sngags kyis gtor zor 'phangs pas/ pho nya bzlog par nges so/ /gal te bsgrubs pas rtags ma byung na bskyar la bya'o/ /des kyang 'gor na/ bzlog pa zhag bdun du 'khor lo bskor te spog go /des kyang las 'gor na
༄༅/ /dkrug la zhag gsum bskor te/ ar la gtad do/ dang po bsnal ma la nan tan bskyed do/ /spogs mi dgos shing bkra shos pa'i gnad do/ de ltar bsnal ma dang / bzlog pa dang dkrug pa gsum ni/ sgrub dang spogs dang sho ba yin no/ de la bsnal bzlog dkrug pa'i sngags ni 'di ltar ro/ /e myags ya rngubs mugs shag ka dun/ dgra bo'i srog la nd+ri hur thums dzaX rtsa khrag snying thums ril ram shag rbad/ dgra bo'i tsitta breng shag dzaX srog la hur thum dza rbad/ de la gshed drug gi sngags sdebs pa ni/ btsad po la ra dza snra dza/ thum ril ma ra ya rbad/ slob ma la/ srog la hum thums rtsa la ma ra ya rbad/ sngags pa dam 'dres la/ srog la hur yang thun rmugs ma ra yā rbad/ sngags pa spyi la/ mugs dza hri shags ma ra ya rbad/ bon po la/ srog la ni dza/ thun rmugs ma ra ya rbad/ drag sngags mkhan la/ tsitta khaX thun dzaX srog la yaX thun rbad/ ces pa snal ma'o/ /bzlog pa ni/ dun ka shags mugs rngubs ya myags e/ rbad shags raX ril thum snying khrag rtsa rbad thums/ hur ni srog la dgra bo dza thums hur la srog rbad/ shag breng ta tsitta dgra bo dzaX gshed drug gis so btags pa ni/ ya ma ril thums dza nd+ri tsa ra rbad/ rtsal ma ra ma ma thums hur la srog rbad/ ya ra ma rmugs thun dzaX yang hur la srog rbad/ ya ra ma shag hri dza mugs la srog rbad/ ya ra ma rmugs thun dza/ nd+ri la srog rbad/ thun yam srog dza/ shag kham tsirta rbad/ ces pa bzlog pa'o/ /dkrug pa ni/ snal dkrugs la sogs pa'o/ /e ya
shag myags dun/ rngubs ka mug srog thum ril ril rnihum thum dzaX thums khrag snying rtsa raX shags rbad/ dgra bo'i srog la breng thums/ ta tsi sha shag breng dza rbad/ gshed drug po rnams dkrug pa ni/ ra dza rni dza/ ma ra ya/ rtsa la hur thums rbad srog la mugs ma ra ya rne dza rbad/ ces pa la sogs gshed sngags drug dkar lto dkrug la/ zhag gsum du drag po spog go /de nas mnan pa ni/ las kyi gnas drug po'am/ ka ni rang la mnan par bshad do/ /bla ma'i gsung gis/bka' rten byin rlabs can gyi 'og gam/ gdug pa can la gtad na legs/ sdig pa nag po snying la ru 'dzings pa/ yang gsang rang gshed nag po sgron ma drug po las/ ri rab kyi rtse la gnam lcags kyi so brdar ba/ bsad pa las kyi mtshon cha bzhi las/ mthar thug mchod rten nag po'i dril sgrubs/ gsang ba yang gsang / rno dang ngar du sdebs pa mchod rten gsal bar byed pa'i sgron ma rdzogs so/ /chen por rlom nas bla ma mi 'tshol bar/ rang gzhan bslu ba'i rnam thar rings spangs te/ mkhas grub mang po bsten pa'i bka' drin las/ zab mo'i gnad la za hor bande mkhas/ shu bhaX/
༄7/ /tshe bdag gi las tshogs tsakra gisti'i rgyud cesabya ba bzhugs so/ /
༄༅/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de nas sroge dmar len dgra la bya/ zhe sdang thams cad kyi bcud phyung ba'i khyad par gyi sbyor ba 'di gsungs so/ /tshe bdag smod pa yang snying 'di/ gang mthun rgyu la 'khor lo bca'/ dpa' brtul zhugs drag po'i stobs de gang gi kyi spyadacaX khyams gang bu nang du khang srid pa'i 〈sna rus sbal ser po'i ba zas zhe sdang sdig bse'i pa'i 〈sna ba bca'/ sdig pa de yi 〈sna ba 〈su phrag sngone po 9lcags kyi dog phag pa'i gzugs brnyan bca'acaX phag mo de yi 〈sna dbus gru gsum du ba ru/ gnag pa pho mo'i liṅga bca'/ brnag pa pho mo'i snying liṅga de'i kha snya dmar len sngags kyi mtshon 'bare lo 9cha bca'/ mu khyud du bskore bzhi dbus ming la khyams la mingabyang bri byang bri/ phyi rim rgya gram rtsa e myags ba'i sngags/yang logs rwa bzhi la rmi bri bcu gcig spu gri'i mtshan/ mu khyud bar du ming rus lto sbyor 'bare lo 9kha sbyar bsad/ rtse mo sngags nang bstan spu gri bzlog go 9bzloge/ mtha' yi dgra'i sroge staX bha ya nan gong nas mnan pa'i sngags/ 'bru dgra bo'i bzhi srog dang
ra༅༅/ /a mu kaX/ bskyod pa'i sngags yan lag bdag gi dbugs kyi ra la zhon/ don dgra bgegs gnyis gnyis bsdus pa sbyar ba bya/ kha thode pa sbyar du mar gnag pa'i gzugs/ liṅga'i rgyu rten drug bcas lhunag phur ma phungab dgra'i phyis pags pa bzhagsnying khar mchog phur ya ma sngags khri gdab/ bsgom bskul lha gsum yar du drag spu gri sngags bsnol mar brdeg rab kyi rkang sngags re la thun re thon bsnol mar brdeg /'bring gi sngags bcu bcu la bcu bar bsnol mar brdeg dman tha ma pas brgya brgya la re re bsnol mar brdeg /gsang mal sgo dgu rtsa sngags kyi 'od zer nan las 'jug /bde ba ye shes rang la shar/ dmar yang nag gdol pa'i khrag la skyil/ bsdu ba'i yi mmu ge gsum gyis dbrog /rtsa dṛ na'i 'bras bu len cing sdud/thod par snying po 'bru bcu rbad bya/ klu la btsud yangs 'gran zlar gtad byed na ca'i yig wī brgyad po 9ngag tu 'don/ g.yin du btsan dang gnode sbyin bcud yang spu gtore na 'gran zla gri sbyar/ yi oX ge byin can steng du bdag /phyag rgya chos skur sprul yang na ngag
gtsang bsam pas/ thob cing bgrod pa drag sngags kyi stobs/ gdug pa'i klu snying dang kha ru gtad/ e myags rtsa sngags 'bru brgyad paya rngubs rmugs shag ka dun/ che ge mo srog yin pa dang la rtsa khrag snying khrag thuX ril rtsa la srog rbad nd+ri hur thuX dzaX dza bzlog pathums khur rṇi shag raX raX thuX snying khrag rtsa la srog rbad/ 'khor lo stenga'og kha sbyar byas la thod pa'i nang du liṅga dang bcas la gzhug thod pa de dong gru skyer tshar steng du gsum rtsangs kyis bskor ba'i nang du gzhug dong khar dar nag gis bcad/ zhag gsum du gsal nub dang po lha gsal ba gnyis pa la sngags pa rang gi snying khar rtsa sngags kyi mtha' ma e myags kyi bskor ba la 'od 'phros bzlas pa mtshon gyi tsakra la phog nas bsad cibarngubs par bsam la lhag ma las kyi gshin rje gsol bar bsam gsum bsgoms la/ sngags ñtsu nus tshad du bzlas/ bskul ba yang gsum yar du gtong ngo / /thod pa bca' ba'i bar ni mnan sngags khri bzlas e myags kyi mjug tu bags la/ dgra bo'i srog staX bha ya nan/ zhes bzlas la/ de nas nyi ma dmar thag chad pa nas/ sa 〈snas kyi bar du 'am/ tho rangs mnan pa'i las bya'o/ /klu gzir ba'i sngags ni/ sa na ga e myags la bags tsitta ro myags srog gzer sbur nan khaX shag rbad/ ces bzlas chu mig gi phyogs gnyis su yab g.yas su lcags phur/ g.yon yum du seng ldeng gi phur pa gdab bo/ /de nas kha gso ba'i las/ stong dang / tshes brgyad dang / nyi shu bzhi la bya/ khrag skam thod pa gang gi gseb tu liṅga dang ming 〈cos bcug la/ bsad sngags nyid zhag gsum bzlas/ bskul ba gsum yar du gtang / tshes yar gcig gam bcu drug gi mar skya
༄7/ /rengs shar nas liṅga gri yis gtubs la/ khrag dang dug gi chus sbyangs la zor du 'phang ba'i sngags ni/ dgra bo'i e myags kyi mjug gdags srog la thuX ri li ri liṃ bhyo/ sngags brgya'am stong bzlas la zor du 'phang ngo / /yid gnyis dang the tshom ma byed cig srog tshe bdag gi gdamasapa mthar thug go dmar len dgra la bya ba rdzogs so/ /'khor lo bskor kho gdams ba'i dus su/ bdag tshe bdag tu gsal ba'i thugs gar hūm̐X mthing nag bsam/ de las 'od 'phros pas dgra bgegs bkug la bstim/ 'khor lo dang liṅga la bdag gi sngags kyi 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'khor lo la phog pas 'khor lo rang rtags ka tsug tu 'khor bar bsam/ pho g.yas mo g.yon du 'khor bar bsam/ dgra bgegs gang yin pa dmar nyal gyis song bar bsam/ hūṃX gi tha ma rtsa sngags kyis bskor bar bsam/ sngags drag la 'dril bar bzlas/ bskul gsum yar du gtang ngo / /e kun gyi rtsa ba myags ya rngubs/ rmugs shag ka dun trig dmar len nan/ dgra bo'i srog bsad sngags la hur thuX dza tsitta breng shag mā ra ya rbad/ athi+-icaX sarba maṅga laX//

༄༅/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ skad cig chu la nya ldang du gsal btab pa ni/ hūṃX rgya chen e yi pho brang dbus/ klu 'bum gnyan khri sa bdag stong / phyogs skyongs ma he brdzis pa'i khri/ padma nyi zla'i gdan steng du/ ayo ma skyes skye 'gags med pa las/ rgyu rkyen sngags las ma bskyed par/ rol pa chen po'i sku ru gsal/ mthing nag dug chen ha la'i mdog /dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgrad/ g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing brngams/ 'bor lo ral dri rdo rje g.yas/ be con gtun shing sdigs mdzub g.yon/ rigs lnga'i khro bos dbu la brgyan/ rang rig phyag rgya chen por brjid/ sbrul dang rin chen 'bar ba dang / dregs pa'i mgo bcad phreng bas brgyan/ klu rigs du mas sku la spras/ yum ni myos byed chos kyi dbyings/ mthing nag tsitta bhan dmar stobs/ thugs gar smug nag ya ma gnas/ 'khor lo don snying phyag na bsnams/ ya ma'i thugs khar dregs pa che/
༄༅/ /mnyam nyid ye shes ngo bo nyid/ ljang nag rdo rje snying 'phreng 'dzin/ dregs pa'i thugs khar khyams khang gnas/ bya ba nan tan ye shes nyid/ 'jigs byed chen po thur du blta/ dbu gtsug mkha' lding gdug pa 'dul/ so sor kun rtog ye shes nyid/ dkar po zil gnon ro gnye za/ phrag gong smug nag 'jigs pa'i khung / dpung khar stag chen ro la rngams/ nu khar seng ge ral pa sprug /sta zur dug sbrul nag po 'khyug /sangs rgyas kun gyis ngo po nyid rdo rje 'chang rgyal spyi gzugs can/ ma skyes ngang las rang bzhin 'char/ gdod nas rnam dag ye shes sku/ lhun gyis grub pa yin pa la/ bskyed dang spyan 'dren mchod mi dgos/ rgyu dang rkyen la rag ma las/ skye 'gags med pa'i ye shes gsal/ sangs rgyas kun gyi zil gnon yin/ zil gnon gyis thugs gar nyi ma'i steng du hūṃX mthing nag ya ma ra dza'i thugs gar ya smug nag phyag na rdo rje'i thugs gar hūṃX mthing nag ru sbal gyis thugs
gar srog dang las kyi dwangs ma e dang ka mthing kha/ bya khyung gi thugs gar khro/ de rnams kyi mtha' skor du/ e myags ya rngubs mug shag ka dun/ e ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya/ e dun ka yaX ayo rings kyi bskor ba las 'od 'phros/snod bcud kyi dri ma sbyangs/ gzhal yas khang zil gnon gyis lha tshogs su gyur pa/ sngags kyi rang sgra sgrogs par bsam/ 'jam dpal gshin rje lha rgyud bye ba dang bcas pa'i yang snying sku gsung thugs phu sprugs su dril ba 'di bzlas so/ ayo ayo ayo/ a kro te ka ya manta ga ces bzlas shing / sku gsung thugs kyi snying po yang ci 'grub bzlas so/ thun mtshams su gtor ma 'bul na/ gtor ma raX yaX khaX gyis bsregs sbyangs bkrus/ āoX gyis snang srid 'dod yon bkang / āXyi ye shes bdud rtsir spel/ hūṃX gis phyi nang mchod par gyur/ ces byin gyis brlabs nas mgron spyan drangs pa ni/ ayau chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas/ drag po e yi gzhal yas nas/ bcom ldan zil gnon yum dang bcas/ rtsa ba'i lha drug rgyan lha brgyad sprul pa rnam gsum gshed bzhi dang / mon bdud 'chi bdag sgo bsrungs bcas/ sgrol ging las gshin pho mo rnams/ 'dir gshogs gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ ces mdun du spyan drangs zhing gsol bar bsam la/ i bsgral ba'i zhing bcu sha rus rnams/ khrag chen dag dang sbyar ba yis/ dmar gyis gtor ma'i mchod pa 'di/ zil gnon 'khor bcas rnams la 'bul/ e ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya/ ma hā ba rlang ta khā
༄༅/ /hrī / ma hā pañtsa khā hi/ ma hā rakta khā hi/ zhes 'bul/ yang gnas skabs thun mtshams su mchod bstod bsdus pa tsam byed na/ bcom ldan phyag rgya zil gnon 'khor bcas la/ bdud rtsi sman dang rakta dang / bha rlang gtor ma'i mchod pa 'bul/ mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ bstod pa ni/ chos dbyings ngang las khro bo'i skur ston pa/ lha'i lhar gyur bcom ldan gshin rje'i gshed/ bdud kyi bdud chen ma rung 'dul ba'i lha/ khro rgyal kun gyis gtso la gus pas btud ces 'dod don la gsol ba gdab/ dge rtsa byang chub tu bsngo/ dus thams cad du lha'i nga rgyal dang ma bral bar spyod lam rnam bzhir spyad pas don thams cad 'grub cing / gshin rje gshod kyi go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la mngon du byad par 'gyur ro/ /rgyu dam rdzas gtor ma mi dgrerdzos drag sngags cog brdungs su grags pa rdzogs so/ /sa ma yā/ rgya rgya rgya// //
