༄༅/ /dpal tshe bdag nag po'i las bzhi'i sbyin sreg cesabya ba bzhugs so/ /las bzhi bsgrub pa'i man ngag za hor ban de'i zab chos he/
༄tsho/ /'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i dgongs rgyud chen mo las/ las bzhi'i sbyin sreg 'di gsungs so/ /zhi ba'i sbyin bsreg ni/ dang por yid mthun bde ba yis/ /gnas dang yo byad rdzogs bshams la/ /maṇḍal sa dkar spos dang ldan/ /dbus su me thab zlum po rtsig pa/ /khru gang kha khyer mdzub gang la/ /sor bzhi zheng du rnam par brtag /nang du chag gang thur du brko/ /dkar ba'i nang du padma brgyad/ /gser dang dung gi dbyibs can te/ /mtha' ma 'khor yug dkar po bya/ /hom shing lcang ma glang ma dang / /'phang ma dag la khru gang bya/ /de nyid yam shong sor brgyad la/ /dbyibs dang kha dog dkar la zlum/ /'bras dang nas chan rtsi mar dang / /me tog sna tshogs gu gu dkar/ /'o ma dang bcas mchod par 'bul/ /tshogs bdag sri'u so ba sbyar/ /lha bskul sngags bcus mchod
༄tshi/ /par bsregs/ /zhi bar gyur ces brjod la bsngags/ /thal 'jim nya phyis ras gtsang mar/ /bstums la zhi ba'i sa ru sba/ /zhi ba'i sngags 'di thon te/ /e ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya hur kha tsha re (ru )che ge mo shintaX a yu dzña na sarba haXcaX dgra dang gnod byed log 'dren dang / /phas pham sa dang zhi bar bshad/ ces gsungs so/ /rgyas pa'i sbyin bsreg ni/ /dur khrod ljon shing nags tshal du/ /rin po che'i maṇḍal la/ /me thab gru bzhi khru gang por/ /kha khyer mtho gang chag gang mthur/ /sor bzhi zhing la 'khor los mdzes/ /nang du gser dang ldong ros bku/ /tha ma 'khor lo rtsibs bcu por/ /hom shing ser po rin chen dril/ /gser gyi ga'u ka pā la/ /rgyas par 'dod pa'i ming bcas gzhug /bu ram sbrang rtsi bdud rtsi bcu/ /tshil sna me tog shing thog dri/ /rtsi mar zho dang
bcas pa dbul/ bdun nam lnga ru gsum bar bsreg /bskul tshig dang bcas sngags bcu sbyar/ ga'u kha sbyar mtshams kyis dril/ rigs brgyud nor ldan gos kyi bstums/ gser la sogs pas ser po bku/skyed mos tshal lam lu mar sba/ sngags sarba che ke mo u pa ta ya bug bug ta siddhi ho/ /thams cad ma lus rgyas pa yis/ sbyor ba dam pa 'di gzung ngo / /ces gsungs so/ /dbang gi sbyin bsreg ni/ dur khrod dbang bsgyur zil gnon du/ maṇḍal khru gang rgyar gsum la/ khrag gis byugs la me thab bca'/ dbus su zla gam dmar po la/ mtshan ldan khrag dang rgya skyegs bku/ nang du lcags kyu dmar po bca'/ dzaXdang hrīXyi gang bar bya/ kha khyer a gar sha yis skor/ mtha' mar zhags rdogs lcags kyus 'khyil4༷༷ dbang drag yi ge hrīnaX ga bris/ 'om bu smang shad rgya shing la/ mngal khrag rgya skyegs tsan dan chu/ hom shing khru gang yam shing bkugiX chag pa'i rgya yis lan gsum brtag /sngags kyang bar ma chad par bzlas/ 'khor lo tsandan rgya skyegs dri/ mu khyud rim pa gsum du bskor/ nang dang zla gam gang 'dod ming / mu khyud gnyis par rtsa ba'i sngags/ mtha' mar lcags kyu zhags sdogs bcu/ dbang du bya ba'i spu gri gang / kha sbyar bar snang dag la bca'/ pho nya bskul la dbang du bya/ zhag bdun bar du las rmis brtag mtha' ru srin po'i sgrom
༄༅/ /la gtad/ sbyor ba kun ldan ba bag ta/ sngags 'di'o/ /che ge mo sarba akar ṣa ya hri pa sham breng breng dun dun dzaX dgug pa kun gyi mchog tu bshad/ ces gsungs so/ /drag po'i sbyin bsreg ni/dur khrod gnyan sa gdug pa sa phung gsum pa la maṇḍal bya/ khrag dang dug gi chag chag gdab/ dbus su me thab gru gsum la/ kha khyer gsum dang ldan par rtsig /mtho gang mdzub gang chag gang du/ nang la sogs pa rim pa bzhin/ nang du rgya ser kha khyer dmar/ rtsangs dang thod pa me ri bya/ brgyud bsten liṅgar dbus dang mthar/ hom shing khru gang drag po'i gzugs/ zla gam gnod pa'i gzugs ming bzhag /thod pa liṅga'i 'og tu mnan/ mtha' ma rgya gram phur pa khrag bcu gnyis rtsibs la me ri ldan/ sha sna khrag sna de bzhin tshil/ dug lnga sngo lnga 'o ma chang/ khrag dang mar khu rdzas kyis bskor/ mthun rdzas dug rdzas rgya gram pa/bar snang gcod pa'i 'bor lo bca'/ dur khrod ras dang ro yis rdzas/ shog bu dag la bzhi ru bskor/ dbus su gru gsum zla gam gsum/ ming rus khams dang bsrung ba bris/ phyi rim lcags mkhar bcu gnyis la / rtsa ba'i drag sngags kun gyi lus/ yang logs rtsibs mchan bcu gnyis la/ gcod cing bsreg pa'i spu gris mdzes/ mtha' ma sbrul gyi ra bas bskor/ mu ran khyams la gnod pa'i ming / bris la ru sbal lto
bar bcad/ bar snang me thab steng du bca'/ thod pa kha sbyar stengs ma la/ nang du rgya gram sbrul gyis bskor/ thod par snying po'i bcud bsdus bris/ ra la mnan sngags ming bcas 'god/ 'og ma mo yis thod pa la / gru gsum sbrul dang me ri bris/ gza' dang snying po'i ming rus khams/ bris la liṅga'i bar du gzhug/zhag bdun gsal gsum drag sngags bzlas/ nyi ma'i gung la bskul zhing gdab/ rdzas dang liṅga ming byang bsregs / drag sngags bcu gsum rdzas re 'bul/ bdag med me thab bum pa la'o/ /lha yi nga rgyal zil gnon du/ sngags dang bcas la gsal bar btags/ gshin rje bdud dang yang 'bor kun/ me thab 'phrin las bzhi ka la/ gsal bar byas la las la bsngags/ mtha' ru gdug pa'i klu la gtad/ thal ba gnag pa'i phyogs dag tu/ zor du 'phangs pa thun brab pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi sku gsung thugs las drag sngags 'di bton/ dgra bo'i srog la hur ya shag /mā ra ya rbad raX khaX raX dzā la raX zhes kha bskang ba'o/ /nye bar gyur pa'i sbyor ba 'dis/ 'khor lo hom sbrel drag por bshad/ ces so/ /bsreg rdzas ni/ 'bras dang 'o ma me tog chan/ zhi ba'i thab khung lha la dbul/ mngal khrag skyer kha stag sha chen/ dbang gi lha la: mngar dang sbrang rtsi'i bdud rtsi'i bcud/ me tog 'bras bu rtsi mar tshil/ rgyas pa'i lha la
༄༅/ /de bzhin 'bul/ mi sha rta sha phag sha sbrul/ drag po bsad pa'i skabs su 'bul/ khyi phag bya sha tshil dang khrag gdug pa gsum gyi sbyor ba brtag /sha sna khrag sna 'o ma dug /sbyor ba drag po'i rdzas bzlog pa'o tshil dang glang ru yugs sa'i khrag the'u rang la sogs byad sgrol ba'o/ /til dang nyungs nag spra tshil brun/ gzhan gyi bsrungs ma bzlog cing gzir/ dug gi ril bu ming rus bcas/ rgya dang 'o ma sngo sna chang khrag dang mar khu kun la sbyar/ drag po'i 'brub khung dag tu'o/ /rang yang zil gnon gsal bar bya/ thab khung gnyis la zin gnon gsal/ gshon rje ma mo nyid kyis bskor/ sha khrag drag po'i rdzas la rol / bskul dang thun 'dzab ling ga gsum/ de bzhin lha la mchod cing bstod/ gang brtsams thogs med 'grub par bshad/ ces tshe bdag dgongs brgyud nas bshad do/ /las bzhi'i sbyin bsreg bskol te bris pa'o/ /phyag rgya zil gnon go 'phang thob par shog/ maṅga laX/
do༅/ /pad lugs kyi sbyin sreg cesabya ba bzhugs so/ /
༄༅caX caXdapal ya man ta ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ de nas bsnyen pa rdzogs shing bskyed rim bstan pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ gdug pa can thugs phrad du 'dul ba dang drag po las kyi mtha' rgya/ bsreg pa me yi las sbyor/ gdug rtsub drag po'i sbyin bsreg gi sbyor ba brtsam pa ni/ 'og gdon gdug pa can gyi nad rnams zhi bar bya ba dang / zhing bcu'i dgra dang bar chad kyi bgegs bsgral ba dang / nad pa sri'u la sogs la gnod byed dang snreX byed la sogs pa dgra bgegs gdug pa can rnams zhesadape gcig tu yod mchan/ 'dul phyir/ drag po'i sbyin sreg gi las 'di bya'o/ gang du bya ba'i gnas ni/ dur khrod sgrub khang rnying pa la sogs pa gnyan zhing dben pa'i gnas de nyid du/ gang gi bya ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ bsnyen bsgrub rdzogs shing lta ba'i gdengs dang ldan pa yis/ mi bsad pa'i sa dang / g.yul bkye ba'i sa
dang ro bsregs pa'i sa gsum gyi sa sna dang / mkhar gong srin can rnams la/ maṇḍal mda' gang gru bzhi bya/ de'i dbus su thab khung khru gang gru gsum pa brtsigs te/ nang nas phyir bskyed pas kha khyer bang rim gsum dang ldan par byas la/ rtsang dang me ri thod pas brgyan/ dbus su rdo rje rgya gram bris la dkyil du raX yaX e gsum dgod/ zur gsum la dza gsum bris/ de'i phyi ru rdo rje rgya gram bris la/ rgya gram brgyad kyi rwa brgyad la e myags 'bru brgyad bri bar bya/ de'i phyi ru 'khor lo rtsibs bcu gnyis la/ bsregs byed drag po bri bar bya/ thab khung de'i steng du/ gdug pa can gyi dug shing dang drag po tsher ma can gyi shing gtubs la/ hom thab gru gsum brtsig go /de'i mthar rdzas bsham pa ni/ phyi'i mchod pa lnga dang / nang gi gtor ma bdud rtsi rakta dang / me'i srog 'dzin pa'i mar
nag til dang / bsad pa'i rdzas dgra bgegs gang yin pa'i liṅga dang drag po'i rdzas dug dang khrag dang bag phye'i ril bu dang / gnad kyi rdzas nya sbal sbrul/ khyi phag bya la sogs pa'i sha sna du ma dang / ra dug la sogs pa'i dug sna dgu dang / tsha ba'i rdzas til nag nyungs nag dang tsha ba gsum dang bsod pa'i rdzas/ lcags phye zangs phye dang myos byed kyi rdzas la/ mar nag dang / rme khrag dang / gnol khrag dang la sogs rnams thod pa'am/ lcags la sogs pa'i snod nang du rim pa bzhin bsham mo/ /thab kyi steng gi bar snang la me lce yi mi slob pa'i sar/ steng gcod bsrung ba nam mkha'i 'khor lo bris la dgram mo/ /de nas rnal 'byor pas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du 'gro ba rnams byas te/ las drag po kho na yin pas/ mtshams gcod bshags pa ma byas kyang btub/ mchod pa rnams brlab la/ las rim bsrang / 'dzab dang tshogs mchod 'bul/ de nas rnal 'byor pa kha lhor bltas la/ rakta'i phreng ba se ral du byas/ chas gos nag po gon zhing lpags kyi gdan la 'dug ste/ rgyu byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pa sems bskyed kyi ngang nas/rol pa chen po yongs su rdzogs pa'i sku phyag rgya chen po zil gnon du gsal bar bsgom/ lha tshogs bskul la las khung gi liṅga rnams la bkug bstim bya/ gzir cing drag po'i thun brdeg bsad pa'i las drag po
༄༅/ /bya'o / / pho nyas drag du dgug pa ni/ dpag tshad brgyad khri bzhi stong 'das pa'i gzhal yas na/ lcags mkhar sgo med bcu drug 'bar ba'i dbus phyogs nas/ 'obs chen bcu gnyis 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ thod mkhar 'bar ba'i pho brang nas/ pho brang lcags mkhar spu gris gtams pa nas/ klu 'bum gnyan khri sa bdag stong gi gdan/ lto 'phye phyogs skyong ma he brdzis pa'i khri/ thabs dang shes rab nyi zla'i gdan steng na/ ye shes rngam pa'i rgyal po zil gnon sku/ bka'i las mdzad 'chi bdag bdud kyi sku/ srog bdud tshe bdag nag po 'khor bcas bzhengs/ rngams pa'i tshul gyis bla kun las la bkye/ las kyi sprul pa mngon byung ba/ shar gyi phyogs nas bla 'gug pa/ dung gi mon pa seṅge'i man /ces pa'i wo nya dkyus bzhin drag tu btang / bkug stim khug par nges na thun dang phur pa gdab/ de nas thab la dri rtsis bsangs sbyangs bya/ thab khung dbus su nyi ma'i gdan steng du/ me lha sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ ra skyes kham yu la chibs pa/ rwa la 'ja' dang glog gis brgyan pa/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa gcig bskyed / rgyan dang phyag mtshan/ bstod pa ltar bsgom/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs la dbang bskur ya man ta gas dbu la brgyan/ me sbar ba ni rdo nag dang / ur mo las byung pa'i drag shul me ni rab tu
bsngags / yang na shan pa'am/ yugs sa'am rme khyim nang nas me blangs la/ oX asne ye/ abya ka bya dza/ dgra bo che ge mo mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces drag po'i sngags dang rlung g.yab nag po'i spar ro/ /de nas ye shes kyi me lha bkug la stim te me lha spyan drang ba ni/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gi /tshur gshegs tshur gshegs 'byung po che/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog/ bsregs blug zhal zas bzhes slad du/ 'di nyid du ni gshegs shing bzhugs/ asne ye dhe wa ri lkaṃ sa ma ya dza dza/ sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan/ cesabazhugs su gsol/ hūṃX ting 'dzin dbang bsgyur zhal zas bdud rtsi lnga/ /drang srong chen po sngon chad ma bstar ba'i/ /dag cing gtsang mar sbyar la dbul lags kyis/ thugs rje chen pos dgongs te bzhes su gsol/ asne dhe wa ri shi ha bye ka bya de wa ri sho ma hā ma ra na phaṭa/ kha'i mchod sngags ni phyi nang sbyar te mchod pa 'bul lo/ dgra bgegs gnod byed mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces sham bur gdags/ bstod pa ni/ tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /'byung po yongs la skyabs bya'i phyir/ /thugs rje'i dbang gi sku sprul pa/ /rig pa grub pa drang srong tshul/ /nyon mongs bsregs pa'i shes rab 'od/ /bskal pa'i me bzhin gzi brjid 'bar/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi rgyan dang ldan/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul zhabs dang ldan/ /thabs kyi theg
༄tsho/ /pa rwa la chibs/ /phyag na rtse gsum me hom bsnams/ /bgrang 'phreng bgrang zhing rig sngags gsung / /bdud rtsi bcud ldan ghandhe bsnams/ /chos kyi bdud rtsi yang la bsil/ /'jig rten 'das kyang mya ngan 'das/ /nyes pa'i skyon bral tshangs par spyod/ /drag po'i mnyes shing thugs rje che/ /de la phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul/ sngags la phyi nang mchod sngags sbyar la 'bul lo/ /hoX me lha drang srong rgyal po la/ye shes klong yangs 'khyil ba'i hom khung du/ bsreg rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba'i sbyin sreg gi pu tsa phul bas/ sku gsung thugs la phog pas gnyes par gyur cig de nas me lha'i thugs khar zil gnon gyi dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par gsal bar bskyed la gsal gdab/ spyan drangs bzhugs su gsol bar bya'o/ /de nas zhal dbye ba ni/ hūṃX/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad gshin rje gshed srog bdag tshe bdag nag po ni/ /sku yang che la dregs shing brngams/ /sku ni nam mkha'i khams dang mnyam/ /thugs ni stong khams 'chad par blta/ gsung ni rngams pa'i nga ro 'brug /zhal gdangs hom khung gdangs ba 'dra/ /ljags ni hom gzar rkyang ba 'dra/ /mche ba rtsang phur gtam pa 'dra/ khyod ni srog dbugs bdag po ste/ /zhal kha gru gsum yar gdongs shig /sdang dgra gnod bgegs khā ram khā hi/
nad bdag rgyal mo zhal gdongs shog /smug nag brjid pa zhal gdangs shog /stobs chen drag po zhal: tshe srog bdag po zhal: klu 'dul mkha' lding: sgrol byed tshe bdag mgo dgu pa/ sprul pa chen po zhal:bdud mo khrag gi ral pa can nad gtong rgyal mo zhal: sum cu rtsa gsum yar steng nas/ 'chi bdag rgyal po: rgya mtsho chen po'i gting rum nas/ gzhin rje bye ba dgu khri bzhugs/ las kyi mtha' bsdus zhal:drag po 'khor bcas zhal phye zhig /ces pas zhal dbye/ de nas phyi nang mchod pa rnams/ rang rang tshig dang sngags kyis dbul lo/ /de nas drag po'i bsregs rdzas dang mchod pa kun/ thugs dam gnad nas bskul byas la/ rdzas tshan re la sngags tshan bcu bcu rdzogs par byas la me la dbul/ hūm̐X/ chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas/ /phyag rgya zil gnon bskul ba'i rjes/ /chig rgyu 'di dag btag la 'bul/ /gdug rtsub dmar nag 'khyil ba'i hom khung du/ /gshegs shing bzhugs la drag po'i phrin las mdzod/ rakta dmar gyi arghaX dang / /'chi med bdud rtsi'i dpal bshos dang / /lcags phye zangs phye rdo phye tsha ba'i rdzas/ /dug dang drag po'i gnad rdzas 'di bsregs pas/ /dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs myur du brlag gyur cig zhe sdang dregs pa'i sbyor ba chom/ lus srog dbang po'i dwangs snyigs phye/ /rtsa rgyud khrag dang bla mtsho skems/ /
༄༅/ /gdug rtsub me lha'i zhal du stobs/ /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/ zhal du bstab kro khā raX khā hi/ ces pas yum dang / sras mchog dregs pa dang / rus sbal khyung dang khyad non sprul pa dang /bdud dang dregs pa kun la sbyar/ bcu bcus liṅga rdzas bcas dbul/ e myags ya rngubs/ mugs shag ka dun/ che ge mo'i srog la hur thuX dza/ dza la rom shag rbad/ dzwa la raX/ sa na ga du du raX/ sa na ga u nan gzir chung srog la du raX/ tsitta breng shag du raX/ e raX pa na ga breng gzer du raX/ e nan 'drid phyung / pa na ga tsitta thum ril rbad/ dzwa la raX ma ra ya phaṭaX ces gdug pa can gyi ming srog sbyar te bsregs pa'i sbyor ba'o/ /gzhan yang gang gnod ming srog brdab sbyar la/ gang dmigs bsregs pa'i sbyor ba bya/ lha rnams zhal du lhag ma med par gsol bar bsam/ phung po rdul cha tsam yang med par gsol bar bsam de bzhin las gzhol drag po'i smon lam gdab/ bsgral bya shes pa lha dang gnyis med bde ba'i sa ru gyur par bsam/ de nas mchod pa rnams kyi mchod la/ gtang rag btang / ma dag pa rnams bshags pa dbul te gshegs su gsol/ bro brdung / mnan pa'i cho ga bya/ de nas drag po'i thal ba de/ bsrung ba nam mkha'i 'khor los bstums la/ phag rgod dam thod chen gyi nang du bcug la/ dregs pa
can gnas pa'i gnyan sa'am yang na mchod rten byin rlabs can gyi 'og tu mnan cing gnyer du gtad do/ /rjes la las bzhi'i bros gzir la/ steng du lha'i pho brang sgom zhing gzir mnan bya'o/ bskal pa mar 'grib dus ngan lnga brgya'i tha ma la nye ba'i tshe/ 'chi bdag bdud ni rang gi gzung 'dzin drag po brtas pas rang khong nas 'khrugs/ gzhung bzhin mi sgrub bka' ltar ma spyad pa yis/ lha dang rig 'dzin gyi dngos grub yal ba'i tshe/ de dus 'jam dpal thugs rje drag po khros pas/ khro rgyal gshin rje gshed po nga yi bstan pa 'byung zhing / bdud dang bar chad 'dul ba'i phyir du/ e ma ho/ mthu dang rdzu 'phrul ldan pa 'khor du gtogs pa'i mkha' 'a3rdzo srung ma dregs pa'i tshogs rnams kyis bka' ltar spyod pa'i rnal 'byor bsgrub pa po'i las dang grogs rnams gyis shig /'jam dpal nga yi bka' gsang rgyud sdig pa snying la ru 'dzings/ man ngag gi snying gnad dril du dril ba 'dis/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrungs nas yun du gnas shing / dar zhing rgyas par shog /'khor gyi dregs pa can gyi ma gshin pho mo thams cad kyi man ngag 'di bzhin bsgrub pa'i rnal 'byor ba rnams kyi bcol ba'i las gyis shig /drag po sngags rgod sdig pa nag po snying la ru 'dzings pa rang gshed dbab pa'i mthar thug pa'i 'khrul 'khor nag po'i gsang rgyud nas bsdus te/ rtsa ba'i don rnams
༄༅/ /bsdus nas/ lag len gyi man ngag tu bsdebs/ gu ru rin po che padma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /sgrags kyi gnubs sangs rgya ye shes rin po che'i khyad chos/ pha wong g.yu sga mo la sbas pa/rgya ston rdo rje 'bar gyis thon pa'o/ yongs rdzogs sgron ma spra khrigs che chung la sogs 'khor lo dang mchod rten gyi lag len spra khrigs thams cad 'di la tshang bas/ gzhan g.yab dgos dang / kha bskang dgos mi bdog cing / lag len thams cad tshang ba lags so/ /rgya rgya rgya/ kha thaX/
༄༅/ /'jam dpal tshe bdag gter brgyud las/ bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debasabazhugs/'jam dpal tshe bdag gter brgyud la gsol 'debs kyi rim pa kun khyab ma bzhugs/ zhersā'imachanayang 'dug
༄༅/ /gu ru padma sirnyi hūm̐X hrīX kun khyab ye shes lnga dngos 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /gshin rje'i gshed po khros pa dus kyi dgra/ /phyag rgya chen po zil gnon tshe yi bdag /thog ma'i mgon po nyid la gsol ba 'debs/ lha bu tshangs dang nyi ma bde mchog ldan/ zla ba'i 'od zer gyis gdams gsang chen bka'/ sgo 'byed siṅga'i yul gyi parnyi ta/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen nyid la: gsang sngags bdag po'i lung bstan ma la yar/ 'jam dpal chos kyi rgyal bdag por mngon dbang bskur/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi mthu stobs bdag /padma 'byung gnas nyid la: 'bum sde'i mnga' dbang bal yul yam bu'i khab/ rgyal rigs lnga rig mchog gi grub pa brnyes/ 'khor 'das yongs kyi srog la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ ba su dha ra nyid la: mchog grub yang le shod kyi phug pa sa bam chen dbang
༄༅/ /thob ka dag spyan drangs nas/ bod yul log sde cham phab lung bzhin gdams/ sangs rgyas ye shes nyid la: ri bo che dang rdza lhud la sogs gter/ lung bstan ji bzhin ngo mtshar mtshan ldan pa / zab gter spyan drangs rgya ston zhang khrom zhes/ rdo rje 'od 'bar nyid laca dam pas rjes bzung mthu stobs nus par ldan/ zab yangs yul gyi bral te sasto ṭa/ gangs can bkra shis dar zhes mtshan ldan pa'i/ gsang gsang bdag nusaldan zung la cesasnang sngags snod ldan zung la: stobs gsum rtsal 'chang gangs pa ri dkar ba/ mthu chen yongs grags gangs pa shākya 'bum/ gangs can mig bu g.yung ston rdo rje dpal/ 'gran zla bral ba gsum la: 'phrul gyi rgya mdud gsal mdzad shākya mgon/ mkhas grub spug (bu )zhes mkhyen rab dpal ldan mgon/ chos kyi rgyal dang bde legs rgyal ba'i mtshan/
dgongs pa dbyer med bzhi la: dgongs pa'i don ston se ston rin chen rgyal/ mtshan ldan spyan tshab mgon po zla ba dang / bka' drin mnyam med byams pa chos rgyal mtshan/ sku gsum ngo po bla mar: padmas byin rlabs chos rgyal 'gro kun don/ bsam shing skye mtha'i byang sems chos dbang gis/ rnam 'phrul bka' gter mnga' bdag maṅga'i mtshan/ rig 'dzin dbang po'i sde la: sngon tshe 'jam dpal khro rgyal nyid grub pa/rnam bzhi'i phrin las mchog gi thugs rjer ldan/ rig 'dzin mchog sprul ngag gi dbang po yis/ mkhyen brtse nus pa'i byin rlabs nyer stsol cig /bdag ni srid dang zhi la snang bde la mi zhen par/ ma gyur 'gro ba sems can kun don du/ bla med rdo rje theg pa'i lam zhugs nas/ sgrub la rtag tu brtson par byin gyis rlobs/ bde chen ye shes sku dang mchog gi bam/ mtshan ldan gzung ma lus kyi dkyil 'khor du/ rab 'byams bgrod pa rnam gsum la brten nas/ bdag rgyud smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ stong nyid lta ba zab mo rtogs pa yi/ rang bzhin lhun grub khang par lkog bzhengs lha/ gdol pa thug 'phrad sngags kyi mthu 'grub nas/ mngon spyod phrin las mthar phyin byin gyis rlobs/ rigs bzang shes rab thabs kyi phyag rgya las/ zung 'jug rnyed pa'i ye shes dga' ba bzhis/ bcu drug phyed phyed cha yis rdzogs pa yi/ bde
༄tshi/ /stong nyams su myong bar byin: mi lhags lus kyi rtsa gsum 'bor lo bzhi/ 'gyur med sku bzhi'i gar stabs bde ba che/ lhan cig skyes sku mi 'gyur kun tu bzang / tshe 'di nyid la grol bar byin: gal te tshe 'dir 'grub bar ma gyur na/ 'chi khar gnad gcod spyod duXkha mi 'byung zhing / 'gro ba'i mar me rang byung ye shes sgron/ 'khrul med ngo yis zin par byin: bar do'i gnas der 'chi bdag dran gyur nas/ las nyon dbang gis rnam par g.yeng ba na/ cir snang thams cad 'khrul par thag chod nas/ stong pa nyid don dran par byin: mi sdug keng rus mche ba gtsigs la sogs/ gshin rje'i snang ba sna tshogs shar ba'i tshe/rab 'bar ye shes khro bo bgegs kyi rgyal/ rang byung ye shes rang ngo shes par rtsodag /de tshe bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ bdag la brtse bas lung bstan dbugs dbyung ste/ nyer 'tshe las grol mchog gi go 'phang nyid/ skad cig gcig gis mngon par 'grub par 31ga /sangs rgyas ye shes sku lnga'i bdag nyid can/ khyab bdag 'jam dpal dpa' bo'i sku thob nas/ 'gro kun 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po las/ rtag tu sgrol ba'i ded dpon byed par thekhog /gzhan yang gnas skabs kun tu lam bgrod pa'i/ 'gal rkyen kun zhi bsam don phun tshogs kun/ 'bad rtsol med par lhun gyis grub pa yi/ rnam pa kun tu bkra shis bde
legs shog /ces tshe bdag gter brgyud rim pa la gsol 'debs tshigs su bcad pa 'di yang / rig sngags 'chang ba dbang po'i sdes pho brang lhun grub stag rtser sbyar ba maṅga laX/
༄༅/ /zil gnon lasabyang sngon 'gro'i kha skong gi so sdebasadang bcas pa bzhugs so/padma'i lugs/
༄༅/ /gu ru dhe wa ḍā kki nīX zil gnon gyi phrin las skyabs su 'gro ba'i rim pa la/ mchod gtor mchod rdzas bsham/ shin tu gtsang ba'i gnas su stan bde ba la 'dug la/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun gsum la skyabs su mchi'oX ye shes lha dang dam tshig lha la skyabs su mchi'oX bla ma yi dam mkha' 'a〈sna gsum la: bdag dang drin can pha mas gtso byas sems can rnamasacaX ye nas sangs rgyas yin pa nyid la bde gshegs kyisacaX byang chub mchog tu rgya chen sems ni bskyed par bya'oX 'jam dpal brgyud 'debasani/ chos sku 'dus pa kun tu bzang po dang / /longs sku 'dus pa 'jam dpal rigs lnga dang sprul sku 'dus pa shākya thub pa sogs/ /sku gsum bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro rin chen mkha' 'gro dang / /padma mkha' 'gro las kyi mkha' 'gro dang / /de bzhin
༄༅/ /mkha' 'gro o rgyan mkha' 'gro sogs/ /ma lus mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la: /'jam dpal dbyangs dngos rdo rje 'chang chen po/ /'jam dpal bshes gnyen shrī sedha dang / /rang byung chen po padma 'byung gnas zhabs/ /rig 'dzin brgyud pa rnams la: /khri srong lde'u btsan 'jam mgon sprul pa'i sku/ /she sa sgron gcig mtshan ldan gsang ba'i yum/ /gter ston chen po sar ban phyogs med sogs sprul pa'i sku mchog rnams la: /lung zin sar ban nyi ma'i snying po dang / /sngags 'chang dbang dar mgar ston rin chen 'bum/ /rig pa sangs rgyas byams pa dpal la sogs/ /brgyud 'dzin bla ma rnams la: /rgya ban bla ma sba ston dpal ba dang / /rig 'dzin chen po rgod kyi ldem 'phru can/ /rdo rje mgon po ngag dbang grags pa sogs/ /bka' babs bla ma rnams la: /sangs rgyas
dpal bzang thugs sras nam mkha'i mtshan/ /dpal ldan slob dpon dran mchog chos kyi rje/ /yongs 'dzin dam pas rjes bzung dbang po'i rje/ /rtsa brgyu bla ma rnams la: /stag tshang bkra shis dpal phug g.yu phra'i gnas bdud rtsi'i tshul du rgyas btab gsang ba'i gter/ /rdo rje gra skyes skyi mthing shwa na ma/ /gnas chos srung mar bcas la: /'jam dpal rigs lnga zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor du/ /rmad byung rdzas kyi rten 'brel la bsten nas/ /rigs gsal dbang bzhi'i ye shes thob pa dang / /ngo sprod don gyi snying po rtogs par shog /bde gshegs kun 'dus rang byung ye shes sku/ /gsal stong dbyer med bskyed pa'i rim pa yis mtha' mal lus kyi snang zhen yongs grol nas/ /gzhi lus 'od phung chen por mngon gyur shog /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i bcud phyungs glur blangs rgyud/ /brjod tshul bzhi dang yang snying snying po'i don/ /skye med a yi rang sgra yongs bsgrags nas/ /mthar thug 'bras bu sku bzhi thob par shog /rdo rje thugs kyi bzlas pas lam sbyangs nas/ /rtsa la ngo sprod rlung la bde ba sbyar/ /thig le chos kyi sku ru la zla ba'i/ /zag med dga' bzhi'i don rnams rtogs par shog /mtha' gnyis las grol rang rig chen po'i don/ /sgom med sgom sogs dbang po'i rim pa yis/ /khregs chod thod rgal ye shes zang thal sogs/ /tshul bzhin lam du longs par byin gyis
༄༅/ /rlobs / / sngon dus rgyal ba'i smon lam rnam dag mthus/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rdul snyed rab 'byams kyis/ /'gro kun srid pa'i 'ching ba las grol nas/ /kun bzang gdod ma'i go 'phang myur thob shog / bar 'dir mtshan brjod rgyas 'bring brjod do/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang rgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /yi dam rgyal ba dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la: sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la: /dam pa'i chos rnams la: /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la: /'gro rnams bsgral 'dod bsam pa yis/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /shes rab snying rje dang ldan pas/ /brtson pas byang chub sems bskyed do/ /sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde: ces tshar gsum brjod/ tram̐ ratna maṇḍa la/ paX padma maṇḍal/ ma hā surya maṇḍal/ a tsaṇḍa maṇḍal/ badzra sa ma ya hūṃX dza4༷༷ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su/ rin po che'i khri padma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i steng du/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed kyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyi por bla ma rdo rje slob dpon bzhugs pa/ oX badzra sa ma ya hūm̐X dzaX rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/ /dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchog gsum bsten pa'i zhing gyur la/ /gnyis med yid
kyis skyabs su mchi/ /dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i/ /dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /dngos grub chu bo gcod pa'i bgegs/ /nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyis/ /phyogs bcu dus dang dam pa'i chos/ /ma chags chos la rjes yi rang / /dag pa'i mtha' bzhi dri ma med/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do/ /bdag dang mtha' yas sems can rnams/ /dus gsum bzhugs la lus 'bul 'o1/ /tshe rabs bgrangs pa'i las rnams kun/ /bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo/ /gtsug tor 'khor losabasgyur ba'i srung 'khor ni/ rang nyid zil gnon du gsal ba'i spyi bor/ gtsug tor 'drar los sgyur ba khro zhal ser po/ de'i thugs gar bhūX las bsrung ba'i 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa/ rtsibs bcu la ma hā sarya maṇḍa la nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bcu'i steng du hūṃX bcu las khro bo bcu sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ be con dang zhags pa bsnams pa/ dbus su rang nyid gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba/ zhi ba'i cha byad can/ phyag gnyis na 'khor lo bsnams pa/ dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan pa/ thugs gar ye shes kyi 'khor lo 'khor ba/'khor lo'i rtsibs kyi bar du nad dang gdon dang dgra bgegs sdig sgrib bar du gcod pa thams cad nyal nyal gcod par bsam la/ oX ā5༷ |ñdzi ṣa badzra tsakra wanti sarba lo ki ta ra na/ yant+ra mant+ra tant+ra ha na ha na da ha da ha
༄༅/ /pa tsa pa tsa/ ku ru ku sa smu ru smu sa a bhi ṣiñtsa a āX gtad mnan sbyor ba la sogs pa ngag mnan byed pa'i ban bon thams cad mā ra ya sod sod dzaXl bzlog phaṭa swā hā/ byin 'bebasani/ hūm̐X bde gshegs rgyal ba kun gyi bdag nyid che/ /drag po las kyi lha tshogs dgongs su gsol/ /chos dbyings drag po e yi gzhal yas nas/ /bcom ldan phyag rgya zil gnon yum dang bcas/ /rtsa ba'i lha drug rgyan lha bdag po gsum/ /gshed bzhi mon bdud 'chi bdag sgo srung bcas/ /drag po'i las mdzad pho nya dam can tshogs/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi byin phob cig /bdag cag sems can las kyis mnar ba la re zhing dpung gnyen gzhan na ma mchis pas/ /thugs rje chen pos 'gro la brtser dgongs la/ /byin chen myur du dbab pa'i dus la babs/ /'jam dpal khros pa'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas/ /sngags tshigs bshugs pa brda yis spyan 'dren na/ /mi dmigs chos kyi dbyings nas sku bzhengs la/ /drag po'i dkyil 'khor 'di la byin phob cig /sgrub mchog rnal 'byor bdag la dbang bskur stsol/ /sgrub rdzas dam pa 'di la mthu stsol cig /drag po'i phrin las mdzad pa'i dus la bab/ /bdag cag re ba'i 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ go cha'i lha ni/ e dpe gcig na mi snang hūm̐X/ steng dang phyogs bzhi'i khro bo ni/ /spyi gtsug mgrin pa ltag
pa dang / /dpung pa g.yas dang g.yon la bsgom/ /mtshams bzhi 'og gi khro bo ni/ /brla g.yas g.yon dang lte ba dang / /spyi mtshams gsang ba'i gnas su bsgom/ /mgul nas zhabs kyi bar dag la/ /khro chung mtshon cha thogs pas gtams/ /ba spu rdo rje'i tshwa tshwa 'phro/ /bu ga dgu nas rdo rje yi/ /thog dang me yi 'tshub ma 'phro/ /sprul pa'i khro tshogs dpag med 'gyed/ /zhi khro ma gshin phur pa dang / /sa bdag 'gong po pe gar dang / dam sri skye 'gro thams cad kun/ /klu dang klu bdud mdze yi nad/ /zil gyis gnod cing stobs rnams 'phrog /zla gam gsum la sprul pa gsum/ /sku sprul 'chi bdag bye ba dang / /gsung sprul srog bdag dmar po dang / /thugs sprul tshe bdag dbu dgu pa/ /phyi rol thod pa'i mkhar bzhi la/ /gshed po ya ma rā dza dang / /srin po myos byed 'bar ba dang / /klu bdud ārya dmar po dang / /gnod sbyin ral pa tshar dgu'o/ /de yi phyi rim rtsibs brgyad la/ /phyogs bzhi la ni mon pa bzhi/ /mtshams bzhi la ni bdud bzhi ste/ /de dag yum dang bcas pa'o/ /phyi rim lcags mkhar bcu gnyis la/ /las kyi 'chi bdag bcu gnyis gnas/ /de yi tpū rim bar khyams la/ /pho gshed mo gshed la sogs pa/ /sha za zhing kaX ma mo tshogs/ /sgo bzhi ru ni rgyal po dang / /'gong po bdud dang gnod sbyin bzhi/ phyi rol 'obs chen bcu drug
༄༅/ /la / / 'obs srung chen po bcu drug nas/ /de ltar de dag thams cad kun/ /sems nyid stong pa'i cho 'phrul te/ /chos nyid stong la shar ba la/ /bar snang khams kyi 'ja' tshon dang / /me long nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /snang la rang bzhin med pa ltar/ bla ma brgyud pa'i bdud rtsi sman mchod ni/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal 'jam dpal bshes gnyen dang / /o rgyan padma gtsug lag dpal dge la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/ /bzhes nas mthu dbang dngos grub stsole/ oX na maXsarba ta thā ga ta ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raX khā hi/ bal po'i rgyal po gnubs chen sangs rgyas dang / /yon tan rgya mtsho ye shes mtsho rgyal la / / dam rdzas: bzhes nas: na maXsarbacu padma dbang rgyal blang chen 'jam dpal dang/ /rgya gar rdo rje chos kyi ye shes la/ /dam rdzas: bzhes nas: oX na maXsarba ta: khro bo 'bar ba dar ma rgyal mtshan dang / /yang dag rdo rje phug pa shes rgyal la/ /dam rdzas: bzhes nas: oX na maXsarbazo rdog ston 'bum dang 'gro don bsod nams 'bum/ /bla chen bla rgyal 'phags ston shāka mgon la/ /dam rdzas: bzhes nas: oX na maXsadra: sprug ston chen po mkhas grub chen po dang/ /slob dpon chen po se ston chen po la/ /dam rdzasaza bzhes nas: oX na maXsarbacu kun bzang gnyis pa mgon po'i mtshan can dang / /'jam dbyangs chen po
chos kyi rgyal mtshan la/ /dam rdzas: bzhes nas: oX za 'jam mgon bla ma chos rgyal dbang po'i sde/ /bka' gter brgyud pa'i bla ma tshogs bcas la/ dam rdzas: bzhes nas: oX na maXsarbazo de dag la sogs pa rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oX āXhūṃX/ bstod pa ni: eXphung po 'byung ba rnam dag ye shes ngang / /snang ba'i phyag rgya bde chen sgyu ma'i lha/ /'gro la chags pa'i dbang gis mdzad pa'i gar/ /spyir yang bsgyur ba'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de bzhin rigs mchog chos dbyings ye shes dang / /yan lag drug ldan gtum chen ha la'i mdog /rab 'bar mtshon cha hūṃX dang phaṭa kyi sgras/ /bdud tshogs skrag par mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /shes rab rang bzhin mi g.yo phyag rgya che/ /zung 'jug bde chen ye shes skyed pa'i yum/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas rdo rje khros/ /lha mo gsod byed ma la phyag 'tshal bstod / / rdo rje'i rigs mchog me long ye shes ngang / /srid pa bar ma'i gshin rje'i gshed mdzad lha/ /spyir yang bsgyur ba'i mdog can 'khor lo 'dzin/ /dgra bgegs don snying 'dzin la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rin chen rigs mchog mnyam nyid ye shes ngang / /rgyal ba kun gyi gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin pa/ /rnam bzhi'i las mdzad thogs med sku mdog ljang / /rdo rje rtse dgu snying phreng 'dzin la bstod/ /las kyi rigs mchog
༄tshi/ /bya grub ye shes ngang / /'bor 'das tshe srog 'chang ba'i khyams khang ste/ /'jigs byed 'bar ba'i zhal spyan thur du bsgrad/ /gser mdog rme ba'i thig le can la 'dud/ /padma'i rigs mchog sor rtog ye shes ngang / /khams gsum zil gnon gnam lcags mchu sder can/ /dung mdog mtshon cha'i 'dab ldan ro nye za/ /mkha' lding nor bu'i gdengs can la phyag 'tshal/ /dbyings dang ye shes rol pa'i byin rlabs te rna ba'i khyung stag seṅge ro nye zung/ /mnyam med mthu mnga' gtum byed dregs pa'i gshed/ /zil gnon rgyan gyi lha brgyad la phyag 'tshal/ /lhun grub phyag rgya'i ngang du ro gcig pas/ /gdul bya'i dbang gis 'khor ba'i tshul 'dzin cing / /bdag po rnam gsum gshed bzhi mon bdud bcas/ /'chi bdag bcu gnyis sgo srung bcas la bstod/ /khyon yangs rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bka' 'khor nas/ /sgrol ging las gzhin bye ba sa ya dang/ /'thun 'bebs ma mo stong rtsa brgyad la sogs/ /dam can rgya mtsho bstan dang bstan 'dzin skyongs/ /rnal 'byor bdag dang 'gro ba 'di kun gyi/ /rtog pa las byung 'khor ba'i dgra gdon rnams zung 'jug sna tshogs thabs kyis tshar bcad nas/ /'jam dpal gzhon nu mnyam nyid mngon gyur mdzod/ /cesago rim rnams rim pasazhal lasashes/ shu bham mastu sarba dza gartaX// //
༄7/ /bcom ldan 'das phyag rgya zil gnon gyi las byang zhesabya ba bzhugs so/ /pad lugs/ se ston gyisamadzad pa/

༄tshi/ /bcom ldan 'das phyag rgya zil gnon tshe bdag chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ rtsa ba zur 'debs go rim bzhin/ /bsgom don ngag tu blang bde'i phyir/ /rnam nges rin chen sgron ma'i bcud/ /'khrul med gsung rgyun 'di lta ste/ / hūṃX mdzad rta mgrin rnam rgyal gshin rje gshed/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil rnams mthing nag zhal nang gzigs/ /'khor lo sdigs pa'i mdzub can bsrung ba'i phyir/ /dbyug sngon g.yin gyis mi thub mi g.yo mgon/ /khams gsum rnam rgyal stobs chen rnam ljang nag /'khor lo sdigs mdzub phyir gzigs byas pa bshig /shar lho gsung sprul srog bdag sku mdog dmar/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi be con rgyu zhags g.yas/ /g.yon pa gnyis na lcags kyu bse mdung 'dzin/ /rus sbal g.yang gzhi dur khrod chas kyis brgyan/ /srin mo ro langs spu gri thod 'dzin 'khyud/ /bse
༄༅/ /yi gyi rlang dmar mo srab med 'chibs/ /lho nub sku sprul bye ba gu rings ni/ /'chi bdag zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi pa/ /g.yas ser g.yon dmar dbus dang sku yi mdog /sngo nag thod dbyug dgra stu ral gri g.yas/ /thod pa mdung thung lcags kyi ri rab dang/ /me phur g.yon 'dzin lcags khrab dur khrod chas/ /rin chen sbrul sogs sku dang lhu tshigs brgyan/ /srin mo gsod byed tri shul thod 'dzin 'khyud/ /ma he sngo nag sbrul rigs can la chibs/ /byang du thugs sprul tshe bdag sku mdog mthing / /dbu dgu phyag ni bco brgyad zhabs brgyad bsgrad/ /dang po rma bya gang ka khyung gi mgo /bar pa dkar dmar dbus mthing khro bo'i zhal/ /rtsa zhal g.yas stag g.yon dang dbus ma he/ /phyag mtshan g.yas dgu rim bzhin 'khor lo dang/ /ral gri rdo rdze kha ṭwāṃ mdung mda' chen/ /zhing dbyug
sna tshogs rdo rje lcags phur bsnams/ /g.yon pa be con gtun shing rgyu zhags sbrul/ /sdigs mdzub tri shul dgra stu gzhu tsitta/ /zhing stag lpags rlon thon sbrul la sogs brgyan/ /bdud mo gsod byed tsitta bhan dmar thogs/ /mi lpags gos gsol yab 'khyud ma he chibs/ /smug nag ral gri zhags 'dzin dred mo zhon/ /ser nag gri dang dgra stu 'dzin dom zhon/ /dmar nag lcags kyu zhags 'dzin drel rta zhon/ /ljang nag dbyug to zhags 'dzin rnga mong zhon/ /bzhi ga'ang sbrul dang thod pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan/ /srin mo nag mo e ka dza ṭī dang / /bdud mo nag mo gnod sbyin nag mo rnams/ rim bzhin yab la 'khyud cing thod khrag stobs dung gi mon pa dregs chen seng ge'i mgo /mon mo bla rkun rngams pa'i gdong can 'khyud/ /lcags kyi mon pa gsod byed stag gi mgo /mon mo nag mo g.yu yi ral can 'khyud/ /bse yi mon pa gtum chen dred kyi mgo /mon mo tshe srog khrag gi ral can 'khyud/ gser gyi mon pa srog gshed khyung gi mgo /mon mo bla rkun snying la gzer 'debs 'khyud/ /yab bzhi'i g.yas g.yon 'khor lo zhags pa bsnams/ /yum bzhi tsitta thod khrag 'dzin 'khyud stob/ /he le khyab pa sngo nag 'khor lo can/ /bdud mo mi zan snying rkun ma yis 'khyud/ /nag po 'dzum med ser nag ral gri 'dzin/ /bdud mo me tog snying 'byin ma yis
༄༅/ /'khyud / / so 'dar khrag pa dmar nag spar bu can/ /bdud mo khrag skyug snying gzer 'debs mas 'khyud/ /ral pa spyi bcings ljang nag khram shing can/ /nag mo myos byed dbugs sdud ma yis 'khyud/ /bdud po bzhi yi g.yon kun khram shing bsnams/ /yum bzhi tsitta thod khrag 'dzin 'khyud stob/ /mon bdud yab yum kun kyang shin tu rngam/ /me lce glog dang skar mdas brgyan pa'o/ /bhe wa sa twa mthing nag be con brdeg nor bu dge 'phel ser nag 'khor lo bskor/ /ser nag 'joms byed khros pa lcags kyu 'dzin/ /bye ba dgu khri ljang nag dbyug to bsnams/ rakta glog phreng dmar nag rgyu zhags 'phen/ /yakṣa za byed sngo nag spu gri thogs/ /gtum po dud kha bdud kyi khram nag 'phyur/ /gang ba kun 'joms dkar po mda' gzhu 'gengs/ /kha 'bar ral gcig dmar nag rgyu zhags 'phen/ /sbrul mgo kun 'dzings sngo skya lcags mdung 'phen/ /ngad pa stobs ldan ser po dgra stus gtubs/ /hong san srog 'dzin nag po bdud zhags brdeg /kun kyang shin tu khros pa'i cha lugs can/ /'jigs pa'i tshul la dur khrod chas kyis brgyan/ /dkar po snying 'byin ru mtshon 'khor lo 'dzin/ /mgon po nag po g.yas g.yon bang thod khrag /yab rje nag po khram shing bdud zhags bsnams/ /sku mchog dmar po g.yas g.yon dbyug tho mdung / /rang 'dra'i
