༄tsho/ /pad lugs kyi lasatshogs bzhugs so/ /
༄༅/ /dpal tshe bdag nag po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lo zla zhag dang za ma la/ /lam du bzhugs pa'i skeg dar na/ /bzlog pa'i sbyor ba 'di ltar ste/ /lo gzugs bcu gnyis rang lo dbus/ /bris pa rang rang khrag gis byug /khyu mchog rwa yi nang du gzhug/ mthing nag sngo dmar mtshon gyis dril/ /mtha' ru rgya gram gzhi la mnan/ /drag sngags khri tsho bzhi ru bzlas/ e ka ya ma he dun pad ka ra dzwa la ram sha truX rbad bhyo/ ki gang bzlog pa'i sbyor bar gsungs so/ mi longs spyod dbral ba 'di lta ste/ /khyi dang phag dang spre'u gzugs bris la/ /phyogs bzhir bskor la ming gzugs dbus/ /khyi thod bcug la dar nag dril/ /mkhar gyis longs spyod 'gram dbus dang / /phyugs srol dbus su bzhugs par bya/ /gshed bzhi gsang ba'i sngags dkrug la/ /drag sngags khri tsho brgyad du drag por
༄༅/ /bzlas / / snying khrag ma ra khrag rtsa la snying la khrag snying rtsa khrag snying la du li has pho bhyo/ nyung dkar brabs la longs spyod dbral/ /longs spyod dbral ba'i sbyor bar bshad/ sgri gzhan yang dmag dpung stobs gzhom na/ ri rtse phung shul mi sha stag seng glang po sprug bskyon la drag sngags stong du bzlas/ lha rten yul dang yul rngun dang / la khu dag gis mkhar la gzhug/ drag sngags sbyor ba dril la bzlas/ e dun bhyo sarba sha truX yaX/ pad ka ra dzwa la raX 'gri ma dri ya bhyo/ dmag dpung gzhom pa'i sbyor ba gsungasalgi dgra bo mkhar dang dbral ba ni/ /khang sa zhing sa dur sa la/ /rje la grogs mkhar sa bsres la/ /mi gzugs nag po mche ba gtsigs/ /sma ra ag tshom ser la leng / /lus dang gdong pa rid la gnyer/ /mig bzlog lag na khram shing thog /dug chus bkus la mthing
nag dril/ dgra bo'i mkhar gyis 'gram du gzhug drag sngags 'bum tsho lnga ru bzlas/ o du raX yaX shag yaX pra ma rakta ma ra g.yengs 'khor ba phung byed mkhar la yaX yaX bhyo/ phung sri 'bum sde khaX khaX tshig tshig bhyo/ nag po bha ti kha na kha na bhyo/ e ka ya ma he sa pra ma ram dun hab btang (tang )hab btang (tang )phyo/ brgya brgyas bskul la stong gis rbad/ khri tsho gcig gis lam du bzhugs/ /mkhar dang dbral ba'i sbyor ba gsungs/athi+-iX gzhan yang nyi zla rlung rgud na/ /gso ba'i sbyor ba 'di lta ste/ /lo yi rgyal po 'brug stag rta/ /gzugs byas mkhar gzhong nang du gzhug /nyi zla bzhi'i gzugs de bzhin/ /shing bu ma gsum gzugs la gzugs rin chen sman dang 'o ma chang / /byang chub sems kyi de bzhin dgong / /tshe bdag gsal byas khri bdun bzlas/ /yar ngo mkhar gyi zur bzhi dang / /rang gi mal du gzugs dang gzhug /drag sngags sbyor ba khri bdun dbye/ e ka ya ma sarba ti ka bur ba he ka ho/ /rlung rta gso ba'i sbyor ba gsungs/ athi+-i/ gzhan yang gsang keg gshed dar na/ /gnag pa'i dgra la rlung dar na/ /'pho ba'i sbyor ba 'di lta ste/ /shog bu dag la ling gzugs bri/ /spyi kro mgrin pa snying lte gsang ba rtswa /rtsa rbad khaX raX yaX bris la/ /re bas dril la glang rur gzhug /bdag nyid lha yi skur bsgom la/ /spyi bo mgrin pa snying lte gsang ba rtswa /āoX
༄༅/ /dang e dang ma dang ho/ /lus la drag po bkod nas su/ /gzugs de dgra'i lam srang du/ /stong bzlas mtha' ru brgya yi gzhug /drag sngags sbyor ba gnyis su sdebs/ /e ka ya ma ghas ma ka laṃ hūṃX dza/e ka ya ma dun mun rtsa myags bhyo rbad/ dar rgud 'pho ba'i sbyor ba bshad/ sgrigiX gzhan yang ltas ngan dbab pa'i las/ /chu mig dgu yi chu blangs la/ /sbrul gyi sha dang mi yi phung pa bsre/ /zhe sdang gzugs byas mkhar la gzhug /sbrul gyi mngon du gang bar 'gyur/ srin bya 'ug pa dur bya'i sha khrag bsres la bya yi gzugs byas te/ mkhar la bskyal na bya skad 'byin zhing 'thab/ byi la sro dang bsres la gzugs bzhi bya/ /khong du sngags bcug mkhar la bskyal/ /ltas ngan de nyid 'bab par 'gyur/ /thod pa du mar kha mig bri/ /dgra bo'i sa gsum ming rus gzhug /mkhar la bskyal na 'phar zhing 'thab/ /drag sngags 'bum tsho dgu ru bzlas/ /khri tsho gcig gis gnas nas bskrad/ e ka he ma ya du pra ma rakta du li has phob/ ltas ngan dbab pa'i sbyor bar gsungs/ /gzhan yang yul khams 'khrug pa'i las/ /lha klu the'u rangs btsan rgyu'i gnas blangs la skyes pa'i gzugs byas te/ /lag tu mtshon cha sna tshogs bskur/ /de raX yaX dun sho khram bhyo/ /bris la sngags re shog bus dril/ /khyi spyang mi thod glang rur gzhug /thod pa kham pa'i ga'ur
bcas chu mig lha rten rgya gram lam/ /gong gsum dgra yi mkhar du sbas/ /drag sngags khri tsho bdun du bzlas/ /mtha' ru mnan pa brgya yi sba/ /e ka ya ma di raX yaX dun sho khram bhyo/ yul khams phung ba'i sbyor bar bshadalgi/ rta bsad pa'i gdams ngag la 'jag ma la rta yi gzugs byas la/ phad tshe rog po gcig gis khar bzhag la/ der rgya tshil skam po sla nga gang bzhag /sngags 'di nyungs dkar la bzlas shing rta'i gzugs la brdeg /āoX rta shi/ rta shi/ ku sha rta sh-i/ ku shi rta shi/ u ma rta sh-i/ kye ma rta shi/ ku sha rta shi/ sna shi rta shi rta sh-i/ byi dza rta shi/ tre ma rta shi/ myags rta shi phya rta he shi/ hūX phaṭaX zhes gang nas btab la / nya yi nub mo rgya tshil gyis me btang la/ rta gzugs gris gtubs pa sngags bzlas la me la bsregs/ thal ba rwa rur blug la rgya srang du sbas so/ /zhag bdun nas rta 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /slob dpon ra ti dpal bzang gis mdzad pa rta gsod palgi/ nang 'gras sa la 'di bya'o/ /tri pa dang / sa dmar dang / rgyal po'i khab sa dang / mi sme ba can gyis rdzas dang ba yi lci ba dang / sa spyin 'jam po la liṅga sor bcu gnyis la/ lag pa snying khar bkab pa byas la tsha ba gsum dang khrag gis phyi bskus/ de la kho bsrung ba'i lha dang / bsgrub pa'i srung ma gang yin pa bkug la bstim/ /dud pa brgyad kyis bdug cing / sngags dang
༄tshi/ /nyung dkar gyis brabs la/ nya gsum la chas gos dang go cha gyon la/ gnyid ma logs par nyin gcig ma las bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed kyi lha tshogs tshe bdag gi lha tshogs thams cad tshangasabar bayo 'khor dang bcas pa bskyed rtsa sngagasakyisal/ dbul ba'i gtor ma sngags ni/ e ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya / i dan bha ling ta ghri ha na du kha kha khā hi kha hrī/ ces pas 'khor dang bcas pa la 'bul lo/ /rgyun du gtong na gzhan gyis bsham du btags pas chog /'di tshe bdag gcig pu rang sgrub pa byad na bsnyen gtor bca'/ /thun mtshams su gtor ma yang yang btang ngo / /tshe bdag gi gtor ma'i man sngagasatshonicaX caXrtag zhus / /
༄༅/ /rgya zhang khrom gyi gter byung gi lo rgyusabazhugs lho/ /
༄tsho/ /rgya zhang khrom ni/ rus pa rgya/ mtshan zhang khrom/ yul rong ram pa chu tshan kha pa/ gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes kyi sprul pa'o/ /sprang du byon pas nya mo lha khang du rnal 'byor pa gcig dang mjal/dris pas gong ltar bshad/ da 'o cag gnyis kyis don chen po gcig 'grub pa yod pas yar la 'dong gsungs nas phyin pas/ phung po ri bo cher sleb/ blangs pa'i rtsam gang byung la gnyis gas skam lto gcig byas/ dge 'phel 'og mar bsdad/ da 'di ru sdod cig ngas phyin nas mar la phyir yong gi zer nas yud tsam cig ma byung / rdo ste'u chung 'dra ba gcig khyer byung nas brag logs la mtshal gyi g.yung drung ris bris pa gcig 'dug pa de la 'di rgyob cig zer nas/ zhang khrom gyis lan lnga brgyab pas/ tshur sbag gi byung ba rnal 'byor pas bton pas/ mi 'dzul bas thar ba gcig byung / der
༄༅/ /rnal 'byor pa zul le song / shul la zhang khrom gyis yang phyin pas/ dkyil 'khor mda' gang gi steng na/ dngul bum gcig 'dug pa tshe chus gang ba de 'phral 'thungs so/ /nga la skal ba nga la skal ba byas bzung bas/ bum stong de lag tu gtad pas/ khyod kyi skal ba bzhag nas yod do zer nas/ spyi bo'i brag gi ser khar 'od du yal te song / der dngul bum am brag tu bcug ci 'dug g.yengs bas/ dkyil 'khor 'og na shog dril 'ga' byung ba khyer/ sgo rtsigs thon yongs/ dngul bum btsongs/ rin la yi ge dang klog bslabs/ da gzod yi ge bltas pas/ tshe bdag khro 'dus/kha thun gyi 37ga dril dang / g.yu drung dang / smu'i gter gyi kha byang byung / da gzod de kha phyes pas gter kha gsum ka tshang ngo / /de lta bu'i zhang khrom gyis/ bral te sam bho ra bya ba/ bsam yas pa la
gnang des gang ban shes rab dar la gnang / des gangs pa shag 'bum mo/ smu ni rong smu yi phu na yod/ g.yung kyang rong na yod/ dang po zhwa phrug legs po yong ba de yin gsungs/ zhang khrom gyi gter byung lo rgyusosmi
༄7/ /mchod rten lag tu blang ba'i spra khrid sgron ma gu ru khrag 'thung nag po'i man ngag bzhugs so/ /
༄tshi/ /dpal 'jigs byed kyi rgyal po tshe bdag nag po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jam dpal gshin rje'i rgyal po tan tra 'bum sde bkod pa nas/ gsang ba'i rgyud sde bco lnga la sogs pa nas/ snying po gsang ba'i rgyud/ sdig pa nag po snying la ru 'dzings pa/ gsang ba gshed bskor nag po las/ nyams su blang ba'i man ngag lag tu blang ba'i spra khrid do/ /dang po rnal 'byor pa dam tshig dang ldan pa/dbang thob pas/ ye shes lha'i bsnyen pa sngon du song ba'am/ lta ba de kho na nyid dang ldan pas/ brtul zhugs kyis bsgrub pa la 'jug ste/ gnas dben par sngon du 'gro ba'i rim pa bya/ 'jig rten pa'i dregs pa can la phud gtang / bden pa bsnyo ma nyes pa'i dpang gzug gho /de nas gsang ba gshed nag gi las la 'jug ste/ rdzas dang lha dang sngags gsum mo/ /dang po rdzas kyi rang gshed
ra༅༅/ /rdzas ba:rdzog nag po'i rdzasadang / 'brul 'khor gyi rang gshed dbab pa dang / lha'i rang gshed ting nge 'dzin sngags bzlog nag po lha'i stobasakyisazil gyisamanan pa dang / sngags kyi rang gshed sngags bzlog nag po'i drag sngags kyisasgrol ba'o/shā dpe la lar med mchan / shā lha'i sku yongs su rdzogs pa'i mchod rten nag po'i rdzas rnams 'tshogs pas tshad dang ldan par brtsigs le'u gsum pa nas te bzhugs/ rdzas rnams 'tshogs par byas te/ 'phrul 'khor rnams kyang bri/liṅga'i bca' gzhi rdzogs par byas la/ stegs bu'i steng du bzhag la/ tshogs phud la sogs pas mchod/ sha khrag gi gtor ma yang gtang ngo / /de nas gsang ba gshed bskor nag po'i las la 'jug ste 'khor lo rnam pa bzhi'i dang po rgya mtsho'i gting du mun pa'i dmag bsdus rusasbal gyisal mnan pa dang / ri thang mtshams su zhe sdang phyag na rdo rje khros pa'i gzhu bcag la bsnyal ba dang / ri rab kyi rtse la
gnam lcags ya ma ra tsa kyi so brdar la bcad pa dang / nam mkha'i mthongs su mthing gi phya ra bkram la bya khyung gisabazhig pa'o/ /rgya mtsho'i gting du mun pa'i dmag bsdu ba ni/ rnal 'byor pa'i lho phyogs su/ dang po gru gsum khru gang brus te/ der khams pa'i ga4 srid pa'i rus sbal 'dra ba'i lto rtswa 'khor lo gzhung bzhin bcas la/ 'khor lo 'og ma'i ling ga la/ khrag dug yungs gar gyis brab cing / drag sngags 'dis bzlas shing brdeg go /e rtsa'i sngags myags ya rngubs mugs shag ka dun/ ra tri ra srog sngags khrag srog la yaX yaX/ tri ling dgra bo'i srog snying la shag rbad/ a ka ya ma srog la hur thibs gzir nan dgra bo'i srog snying la shag rbad/ e ka ya tshe bdag ma srog la hur thibs gzir nan dgra bo'i snying la shag rbad/ nag po na ga kṣu bdag be ra srog la dza la dza ni thums dgra bo'i snying la rbad/ ces brgya'am/ stong rtsa bzlas so/ /'di brjod do/ /hūm̐X/ nyon mongs las kyis ru tra 'di/ /ma rig mun pa'i smag rum du/ /dug gsum stobs kyis gnon mdzad pa/ /'chi bdag ba'i bdag po tshe bdag dang srog bdag /gsang ba gshed kyi lha khyod kyis/ /rang gshed nag (gnon )pa'i las mdzod cig /ces 'khor lo steng mas bkab la/ 'di skad brjod do/ /e baX raX khaX lhag tsitta rmugs/ che ge mo pas stibs mes tshig chus skyur/ rlung yon/ kha ri ba ltag rna dri tsa
༄khu/ /rdib / khas yen dgra bo ma ra ya nan/ ces brjod la/ g.yam pas kha bcad la sas stib po/ brdzi bcag bya'o/ /ma bskor bar 'khor ba'i 'khor lo zhes bya ste/ de nas ri thang mtshams su zhe sdang khros pa'i gzhu bcag pa ni/ gshed po las rgyal gyi lto bar dbus su liṅga bri/ snying la sdig pa'i rgyud sde le'u gsum pa nas gsungs ro rdo rje rgya gram bri/ ma rgyud dregs pa'i srog sngags bri/ 'khor lo bshig pa'i yig 'bru bkod la / tsakra gnyis kha sbyar la tshig 'di skad brjod do/ /hūṃX/ lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la/ /sngags pa nang 'gras byed pa'i tshe/ /lha srin stobs ldan byed pa'i tshe/ /drag sngags gcod 'dren byed pa'i tshe/ /gshed po las kyi rgyal po khyod/ /skye ba snga ma'i las dbang gis/ /sgrub byed skyes bu chen po la/ /ded dpon dregs pa'i srog khang nas/ /snying rtsa sngags kyi rnam par byung / /sems ni sngags kyi brgyud du byung / /'jig rten dregs pa'i srog sngags kyis/ /dam nyams las kyis ru tra la/ /rang gshed dbab pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /dregs pa'i srog sngags tshar gcig brjod do/ /ri rab bang rim 'og tu mnan par bya'o/ /'di ni ma bskor bar las kyis 'khor ba'i 'khor le'o/ /de nas ri rab kyi rtse la gnam lcags kyis so brdar ba'i 'khor lo ni/ ri rab gzhi che bar byas te/ bang rim dang po'i dbus su 'brub khung gsum brtsegs su
bya'o kha khyer rtsangs dang thod pa dang me ris bskor la/ nang du khrag dang ro sol gyis byug go /der shog gu mdzub re pa gnyis le'u bzhi pa nasashesapar bya'o la/ gsang ba rang gshed kyi 'bor lo/ /mchog dang phag mo lto sdebs te/ /'khor lo dpe'u chung ltar bris la rtsang dmar la dgram/ thod par liṅga grub bo/ /'di ni 'bar yang 'bar la bskor ba'i 'khor la'o/ /de'i stengs su sku yongs su rdzogs pa'i mchod rten nag po bzhugs te/ sgo bzhi'i bsgrub khung nas thun nas brab pas/ tsakra'i steng du 'ong pa'i wa shing ru bya.u bhi bya'o/ /de yang stobs can rnam pa gsum gyis mchod rten te sems stobs can ni/ gdan la rus sbal bzhi gnas te de'i steng glang po che bzhis 'degs pa'o/ /bad la rigs bzhi'i klus 'degs bya ste/ sbrul dkar khra dang ser khra dang dmar khra dang sngo khra bzhis 'dogs pa bya'o/ /bang rim bzhi pa la/ phyogs bzhir gzig bzhi / zur bzhir stag gis 'degs pa bzhi bya'o/ /bang rim gsum pa la/ phyogs bzhir gzig bzhi/ zur bzhir stag gis 'degs pa bzhi bya'o/ /bang rim gsum pa la/ phyogs bzhir chu srin bzhi/ zur bzhi la gzig bzhi/ zur bzhis stag bzhis 'degs pa bya'o/ /bang rim gsum pa la/ phyogs bzhir chu srin bzhi/ zur bzhi la seṅge bzhis 'degs pa bya'o/ /'khor 'ordzo la 'brug bzhis 'degs par bya'o/ /
༄tshi/ /char khebs steng du bya khyung sbrul za ba'o/ /de nas sngags stobs can ni/ gsad pa'i sngags bang rim dang po la dgod de/ srog shar la thun myags tsitta rbad/ khas lho rtsa la breng rbad/ tsitta breng shag nub dza4༷༷srog la hur thums byang rbad/ ces pa bri/ bar pa la shar srog stam lho pa ya nub nan byang / ces pa bri/ tha ma la srog shar la raX/ thun lho yaX (mi )bzlog ri li li byang phyogiX ces pa bri'o/ de nas lha stobs can 'god pa ni/hūm̐X dge 'dun chos la dgra byung gis/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ram mda' bzlog gzu dang dpang du dkon mchog bzhugs/ ces brjod la/ bya ru bhuddha yāX ces pa bri'o/ /'khor lo la/ dharmā ya ces pa bri'o/ /bre la sang gha ya ces pa bri'o/ /de nas bum pa srog shing gi gri mda'am/ gri lcags kyi phur pa dbal khrag gis byug pa gcig /dpal tshe bdag nag por bsams te 'di brjod do/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas/ /drag po e yi gzhal yas nas/ /〈snag brgyud gshin rje nag po ni/ /nag po dug chen 'khyil ba'i sku/ /dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad/ /phyag drug mtshon chas dgra bgegs sgrol/ /sku la dur khrod rgyan dang ldan/ /khro rgyal thams cad zil gyis gnon/ /dregs pa'i lha srin rdul du rlog /dam nyams dgra bo'i gshed ma mdzod/ /ayo myags ya rngubs mugs ka dun/ /dgra bo'i tsitta hur thum dzaX srog la
breng dun rmugs breng shag rbad/ ces brjod de srog shing du bya/ de nas liṅga bzhi la/ yi ge 'bru brgyad bzhi yi bskor ba re/ ri rab kyi bang rim re rer bzhag la snying khar phur bu re 'ong bar byas la 'di skad brjod do hūm̐X/ srin po ya ma ra tsa'i sku/ /smug nag be con 'khor lo bsnams/ /dam nyams dgra po'i gshed ma mdzod/ /gshin rje myos byed 'bar ba'i sku/ /ser nag be con: dam nyams dgra po'i: bdud po arya ma ru'i (dmar po'i )sku/ /dmar nag (po )be con: dam nyams dgra bo: gnod sbyin ral pa tshar dgu'i sku/ /ljang nagazo dam nyams: ya ma ra tsa shar yo me ya (sa twa mo )ya/ /che ge mo'i srog la thun rmugs rbad/ /ya me du ru na yo ta lho ya/ /che ge mo'i srog la kham shag rbad/ /ya ta yo ni nub ra ya kṣe ya/ /che ge mo'i 〈snag la breng shag rbad/ /ya kṣe ya byang dza ni ra ma [ra ]ya/ /che ge mo'i 〈snag la yam shag rbad/ ces phur pa bgod do/ /de nas ri rab gnyis pa la/ yang liṅga sngags kyis bskor ba re bar du stems te/ yang phur bu bzhi las kyi srog gshed bzhir bsams te/ 'di skad brjod do/ /hūm̐X/ dung gi mon pa seṅge'i mgo /lcags kyi mon pa stag gi mgo /bse yi mon pa dred kyi mgo /gser gyi mon pa khyung gi mgo /sprul pa las kyi srog gshed bzhi/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i gshed ma mdzod/ /ka li dun shar ti tsitta/ ro myags rbad/
༄༅/ /ha la lho ha la/ dun ting tsitta ro myags rbad/ rag sha hu nub ti dun tir tsitta ro myags (dun ting )rbad/ garmā bha byang ti dun ting tsitta ro myags rbad/ ces gdab bo/ /de nas bang rim gsum pa la/ liṅga sngags kyis bskor ba la phur pa gdab ste/ he le khyab pa shar gyi bdud/ nag po 'dzum med lho yi bdud/ /so brdar 'khrig pa nub kyi bdud/ /ral pa smyi bcings byang gi bdud/ /las kyi bdud po chen po bzhis dam nyams dgra bo'i gshed ma mdzod/ /ru tra ru thums bha ti srog la hur thum (thur thur )ma ra ya/ zhes phur pa 'god phyogs bzhir do/ /de nas bang rim tha ma la liṅga bcu gnyis la phur pa 'god do/ /hūm̐X/lcags mkhar 'bar ba bcu gnyis na/ /'chi bdag bdud kyi be ba sa twa bdud chen po/ /'jigs byed chen po nor bu dge 'phel 'jigs pa'i bdag /gdug pa dug gi kha rlangs sprul mgo kun 'dzin can/ 'bar ba gtum po tshogs sor nag 'jom pa kyi bdag /spyan gsum ba:rdzog pa bye ba dgu khri sdang mig bsgyur/ /zhal bsgrad 'bar ba'i rag sha glog 'phreng mche ba gtsigs/ /lce spyang mchu ni khrag gis kha 'bar ral gcig rlan/ /rbersha 〈snan lag pa khrag gis yag sha za byed dmar/ /zangs gri zhags gtum po dud kha pa nag po dang / /gdug pa'i gang ba kun 'joms mtshon cha mang po 'dzin/ /snying rje med par ho ban srog len gsod byed pa/ /rngam zhing gdug pa'i tshogs bcas kyis/ /
dam nyams dgra bo'i gshed ma mdzod/ /kro sna dza ma ri dgra bo'i tsitta breng shag dza srog la hur thums dza rbad/ ces brdeg zur bzhi phyogs gnyisaganyisapa cing 'god do/ /srog bdag dkar po snying 'byin dang / /ma hā ka la 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /bdud po yab rje nag po dang / /gnod sbyin sku mchog dmar po bzhis/ /drag po las kyi sgo bzhi nas/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i gshed ma mdzod/ /ces brjod do/ /de ltar mchod rten nag po yongs su rdzogs pa las/ /lha tshogs de rnams gsal bar dmigs te/ rab tu gnas pa bkod pa ltar bya ba ni/ /e myags yi ge 'bru brgyad pa la/ /rten 'brel snying po btags te lan nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod do/ /chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung / de rgyu de bzhin gshegs pas gsung pas rab tu gnas par 'gyur ro/ /bka' bden pa chen po 'grub par gyur cig /ces brjod pa lha phyag btsal lo/ /de ni dus mtshams bsrung ba'i mchod rten nag po zhes kyang bya ste/ rdzas dang 'phrul 'ber gyi rang gshed dbab pa'o/ /de nas lha'i stobs kyi zil gyis mnan pa ni/ dang po kho na chos thams cad kyi de kho na nyid spros pa med pa'i dbyings rnal ma rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa/ skye 'gag med pa'i ngang la gnas pa las/ phyag rgya chen po lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor du rol pa chen po'i sku/ dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi/ zhal gsum
༄tshi/ /pa / g.yas dkar g.yon dmar ba/ dbus mthing ba/ phyag drug na 'khor lo dang ral gri rdo rje bsnams pa/ g.yon sdig tha ma mdzub be con dang po gtun shing bar pa bsnams pa/ zhabs bzhi ni klu 'bum gnyan khri sa bdag stong / phyogs skyong ma he rdzis pa'i steng / /nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ sku la dur khrod kyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ dbu la rigs lnga'i 'khor lo dang thod pa'i 'phreng bas gtims pa'o/ /g.yon na yum rdo rje khros ma gsod byed ma/ /sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ sku la dur khrod kyi brgyan dang ldan pa/ g.yas tsitta/ g.yon thod pa snying khrag gtso bo la stob pa'o/ /gtso bo'i thugs gar 'jigs byed ya ma ra tsa/ sku mdog smug nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas 'khor lo/ g.yon tsitta bsnams pa/ sku la dur khrod kyi brgyad kyi rgyan dang ldan pa'o/ de'i thugs gar dregs pa 'joms pa'i lha phyag na rdo rje sku mdog ljang nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon tsitta'i phreng ba bsnams pa/ sku la dur khrod kyi brgyan dang ldan pa'o/ /de'i thugs gar ma hā gser gyi rus sbal/ srid pa'i khyams khang 'bar ba bsgom/ dbu'i steng du bya khyung sbrul za ba'o/ /phrag gong gnyis na khyung smug nag sbrul za ba gnyis/ /dpung par stag mo ro za gnyis/ /nu khar seṅge ral pa sprug pa gnyis/ /sta zur gnyis su sbrul nag kha
nas me 'bar ba gnyis bsam mo/ /de nyid gnyen po sprul pa khyad gnon gyi lha brgyad do/ /gtso bo rnams kyi thugs gar yang yig 'bru la sngags gsal bar byas te/ zil gnon gyi thugs gar hūṃX mthing nag ya ma ra tsa'i thugs gar yaX/ phyag na rdo rje'i thugs khar hūm̐X sngon po/ rus sbal gyi thugs gar e/ bya khyung gi thugs gar khroX / yum gyi thugs gar yi ge ma/ de rnams sngags kyis bskor bar bsam mo/ thams cad zil gyis gnon pa ste/ phyag rgya thams cad kyi mchog tu gyur pa/ phyag rgya chen po zil gyis gnon pa zhes bya ba'o/ /de nas sngags kyi rang gshed nag pos/ bsgral ba'i gsang sngags kyi 'phreng ba la/ sngon du bya ba'i sngags rings 'di sngon du bzlas te/ sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las lnga dril ba 'di kho na'o/ /ayo ayo drag po dbang sdud sku ayo a kro te ka ya man ta ka/ ya ma yī/ ka la ru gsung pa/ ka pa yī/ hri ti thugs a pa ye/ a a ne/ a ne u u ne/ u nee/ du du nai/ du nai/ a i.u e o aX/ ra ri/ la laṃ/ du ru yī/ bya tsa yī/ sing nga yī/ hri da yī/ bi da yī/ ha la yī/ mu ka yī/ u.u ne/ u u nee/ byi tri ta/ a a/ na na/ ya ma/ ra tsa/ ya ma rag a ya ma rakṣa/ pe ta li kro ti shwa ri/ ma ma e ka tsa ti/ de ma kha la baX ril/ ru lu ru lu shrī badzra kro dha/ ya ma garmā ro sha na kri ta/ tsanta/ rag sha mon ta/ a mu ka myags thum ril/ trig nan/ sbur ya nan/ e
༄tshi/ /hur thums dzaX kham shag ro myags mugs ti rbad ya/ ces bzlas te/ nam mkha'i mthongs su mthing gi phya ra bkram pa bshig pa zhes bya ste/ rtsa ba'i lha lnga'i yig 'bru la sngags kyis bskor ba la 'phro 'du bya ste khyad par du bya khyung gi thugs ka las spros la bya'o/ /bzhig pa 'brum nag mchu yis bya'o/ /bzhig pa dang gzir ba gang yang 'grub ste/ spyi dang sgos kyi srog yig blangs te/ sngags kyi bar du gzhug par bya'o/ /de nas gsad pa kho na la 'jug ste/ mchog dang phag mo lto sdebs kyis 'khor lo mchod rten 'og tu bca' ste/ liṅga dbye dgug byas te thod ngan thod ngan gyi nang du bzhag dang 'khor lo'i bar du bcug la/ gang la yul bya ba de gsal bar byas la/ bdag nyid gang ltar gsal ba'i thugs ga'i yig 'bru la/ sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas gdug pa'i mtshon cha rang gcod chen pos gang la bya ba dgug ste/ 'khor lo mtshon cha rang gcod kyis myal myal song bar bsams la/ sngags bzlas so/ /khyad par du rus sbal gyi lto ba nas spro bar bya/ zhag grangs bdun nam bcu bzhi'am/ nyi shu rtsa gcig tu bzlas so/ /e myags ya rngubs/ mugs shag ka dun/ dgra bo'i srog la mchog gi gsad pa nni khung thums dzaX rtsa khrag snying thum ril ram shag rbad/ dgra bo'i tsitta phag mo'i gsad pa la rlung shag dzaX srog la hur thums rbad ces bzlas so/ /sdeb par 'dod na rang
gshad drug po yang sbyar te/ gang byed pa re re la gzer sngags su gdags so/ /ra tsa rgyal po nni dza thum ril ma ra ya rbad/ srog slob ma dam nyams la khur thum ma ra ya rtsa la rbad/ srog la hur yam dam tshig gcig pa la thun smugs ma ra yā rbad/ srog la rmugs sngagasapa spyi la dza hrigiX shag ma ra ya rbad/ srog ma ra ya rbad/ srog la ṇi bon po mu stegs pa la dza rmugs ma ra ya rbad/ tsitta kham shag dza drag sngags mkhan tshe bdag 〈snag la yam thun rbad/ ces gang 'dags pa re re'i sham bur sdeb par bya'o/ /skabs su drag po'i rdzas yungs gar/ yungs nag skye tshe dug dang khrag gis kyang brabs so/ /dus drug tu sgo bzhi'i thun nas brdegs pa ni/ dgra bo'i srog la khur thums ril rbad bhyo/ khram shig tsitta myogs rbad bhyo/ rtsa la dun rmugs rbad bhyo/ khrag la dun rmugs rbad bhyo/ ces pas thun sgo bzhi nasabrab po/ de yang ya ma ra sngagasakyi 'phro 'du lasatsa'am/ rus sbal gyi thugs ka nas spros pas dbugs kyi rta la zhon nas/ 'od zer mtshon cha lta bur 'phros pas/ bzas po gsal ba'i bu ga dgur thim ste/ rtsa'i sbug khengs nas/ srog rtsar 'dus te/ srog gi gzhi ma khrag gi sbal pa bsregs te/ nni ljang khu de thod pa'i 'phrul 'khor du 'chang / gcod byed kyis 'khor lo rang gcod byed kyis sha rus myal myal gcod par bsam/ kho yi ye shes sems dpa'am/ khro kro yag sha 'bar ba/ lcags kyi sdig pa mgo dgu
༄༅/ /par gyur nas rang gi srog la za nyon mongs pa'i khro bo brgyad khri bzhi stong re langs te/ rang srog rang gis gcod par bsam mo/ /skabs su thugs dam gnad nas bskul ba bya'o/ /de ltar rdzogs pa dang mnan pa bya ste/ rgya mdud brtsegs pa'i lto mchod rten la ba'am/ seṅge khog bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'bar 'og par mnan no/ /bsad pa rang gshed kyi las drug byed na sa gzhi la mnan te/ rgyal po bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'bar 'og seng ge'i khog par mnan/ slob ma chu mig gag pa bka' sher 'bab dam nyams stag gi 'dzum la mnan/ dam 'dres gzig gi thig le lu ma 'khyil pa thil thil mnan/ sngags pa spyi mun pa'i dur khrod kyi ro khung gling du mnan/ bon po mu stegs pa srin ri gzar po brag dmar po lam lhang gi rtsa nas mo'i sgroms su mnan/ drag sngags mkhan ni 'brong po'i ra ri gsum gong gisalam rgya gram du brag du mnan/ mnan pa ni nam gyi gung / nyi ma dmar thag chad pa bya ste/ thod pa dril rdza yi rus sbal gyi khog par bcug la/ la chas chas dam par byas la/ gang du gnon pa'i sar sa brus la las kyi gshin rje la gtad do/ hūm̐X/ 'byung ba brtan zhing rngam 'og na/ /las kyi gshin rje tshe'i bdag po ni/ /ya mtshan chen po rmad du byung / /mun nag 'thibs pa'i 'og tu bzhugs/ /g.yas pa'i lag pas ri rab thogs/ /gaskurdzon pa'i lag pas rgya mtsho 'khrug /zhabs kyis rlung gi 'oshesar 'o1 gnon/ /dam
nyams dgra bo las ngan 'di/ /mnan pa las kyi dus la bab/ /sgo med lcags mkhar nang du bcug /gzhin rje rnams kyis zas su byin/ /'khor lo 'bar ba'i rtsibs la bskyon/ /rgya mtsho chen po'i gting du chug /ri bo chen po rmang du non/ /nam yang gtang bar ma bya zhig /che ge mo ma ra ya staX bha ya nan/ zhes mnan no/ de nas nya stong la sogs pa la thun byas te/ rab chad kyi thod pa dug sna tshogs 'am g.yag tu g.yas par/khrag sna tshogs dang / yungs gar yungs nag la sngags kha thun la stim mo/ e myags ya rngubs/ mugs shag ka dun/ che ge mo'i srog la thun rmugs bhyo/ srog la kham shag bhyo/ srog la breng shag bhyo/ srog la yam shag bhyo/ srog la thun rmugs ma ra ya/ thun yā/ ces bzlas te/ thugs dam bskul la dgra la 'phang ngo / /rbod gtong bzlog pa'i sngags kyang yin te/ gtor ma gtong ba'i dus su gtor zor du byas nas 'phangs na/ kho rang la bzlog ste/ pho nya rkang mgyogs bzlog pa'o/ /de lta bu las rdzogs pa dang / rmi ltas su kho rang dngos su bsad pa'am/ ra g.yag gsad pa 'byung ngo / /gzhan yang las sbyor gyi dus rang tshig tshig pa'am/ khong shugs che ba dang / sems dga' zhing lus yang ba ni/ gang yang 'grub bo/ gzhan yang dmag la mtshon gyis dkrugs pa dang / shing gcod pa dang / brag bshag pa dang / byis pa dang mi
༄༅/ /nag dang / bya gcan gsad pa dang / zhib can gsad pa g.yul du dang / 'bag dang bon po bzung ba bkyigs pa la sogs pa dang / rtags mang du 'byung ste 'grub pa kho na'o/ /'grub pa la rtags med na yang bskyar nas bya'o/ /gal te 'gor na bzlog pa'i 'khor lo dang / dkrug pa'i 'khor lo zhag gsum mam/ bdun bdun tsam bya'o/ /gsang ba gshed nag snying po'i rgyud/ sdig pa snying 'dzings kyi sgrub thabs/gsang ba yang gsang du bsdebs pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po khrag 'thung zhabs kyi zhal gdams/ lag tu blangs pa'i spra khrid sgron ma rdzogs so/ sa ma yā na ra gan/ rgya rgya rgya4༷༷ gramatha/sgaḥrurngarngamamakhuḥ shusaso/ /mchod rten gyis / /
༄7/ /phung po ri bo che'i gter byang bzhugs so/ /
༄tshicaX yi dam lha la gus btud nasacaX bdag 'dra spu ngan sangs rgyas kyisacaX rgya gar bal po'i yul du lan bdun phyina'oX lan drug dam chos rtsal te lan cig zhus dag byasacaX de dus bal po'i gu rus mkha' 'gro'i gsang dpe gnang caX ban chung bdag ni bod khams yongs la mi spel te'oX lung dang mthun pa'i gnas su gter du sbedacaX chos skyong mkha' 'gro ma hā kā las bsrungasacaX g.yung gi phu yi rdza lhud nag po lacaX dam chos bka' rtags bum skur bcas pa gtadacaX g.yas ru myu gu rdo rje sgrom bu 〈tsāX dbang rtags rdo rje bka' ru bcas pa sbasacaX g.yas ru gtsang khris phung po ri bo cheracaX dbang rtags bse sgrom smug po bcas pa sbasacaX skal ldan las 'phro can la kha byang bris te bzhagacaX lan gcig rnyed nas mi spel yid la snogacaX dngos grub ya mtshan chen po 'byung nges kyi'oX kun la spel na mkha'
༄༅caX 'gro'i chad pa yisacaX yid du mi 'ong mi 'dod 'du bar ngesacaX skal ldan rnal 'byor chen po rnamasacaX gtsang gi phung po ri bo che'oX gsang sngags yang zhun sbas pa yicaX de yi lde mig 'di ltar lagasacaXdang por gtad pa'i bsrung ma mchodacaX bar du dus tshod nges par bzung caX de nas phy-i nang rtags dang rko tshad bya'oX de nas chos kyi bsrung mar bar chad bsalacaX de nas gsang sngags deb gsal bya'oX de nas dngos grub rab gnas bya'ocaX dang por gtad pa'i bsrung ma mchod pa nicaX phung po ri bo che'i 'og na klu gnas te'oX de la yang ma gtadacaX bar na btsan gnas te de la yang ma gtadacaX steng na bdud gnas te de la bdag gis gtad do/ de la las 'phro med pa dam med pa la bstan yang mi rnyedacaX rnyed par gyur kyang bar chad du 'gro bas phan pa med do'oX rnal 'byor pa las 'phro can nicaX bong khe thung bcaX
sha mdangs ser bltoX lus rme ba'i ga sha yod pagiX skra li bltoX khyi 'brug glang lo pa'igiX las can de lta bu la gtad pa'i rtsis yin pas/ de lta bu gcig gis/ dang por bdud rtsi lha byang chub la/ phud dang gtor ma la sogs pas mchod dgos te/ lug nag po'i snying dang / ri bong gi snying dang / rdo pha wang long bu dang / bya rog gi snying rnams dar nag gi khug mar chug la phud dang gtor mas mchod do/ /de la rtags 'ong nges pas bzang rtags byung na phyung ngo / /de nas phyi nang gi rtags dang bsko tshad ni/ phyi'i rtags ni ri skad kyi brag rgyud/ byang ngos kyi brag mchod rten 'dra ba/ de la brag logs la rdo rje rtse gsum gyi gzugs yod pa/de la 'dom gsum phyi la bcal te/ de na yod dogiX g.yas g.yon gyi brag ni dbus su lta ba 'dra ba'ogiX de la 'dom gang mda' gang thur la bskos pas/ sa sna mi mthun pa gcig yod do/ /de byung ba dang / phar la bskos te/ brag khung na them bcug ste/ khro chus gdams nas yod pas lcags bzang po khyer la sor kha gong ma nas g.yas su rkan no/ /de la mi nyal nas 'gror brtub tsam yod do/ /mi de phyin pa na brag phug rdza ma'i nang 'dra ba gcig na sol ba dang / ha khan gyi tshal yod do/ /de yang dus tshod nges pa ni/ ston zla ra ba'i tshes brgyad la 'don4༷༷ phud la gser brdar ba dang / snying sna gsum khung bur bzhag go /lug nag
༄tsholtoX po rtsar btags la bzhag go /de nas chos skyong gi bar chad bsal ba nigiX dang po nas bla rdo pha wang 'ordzong bu lus la btags/ dpral bar dug gi thig le bya/ bdud la gtang rag khas blangs/ rang gi bsrung ma kun la btang rag khas slong / de nas chos kyi dbye bsal bya ba ni/ chos ni rgyud dang / bsgrub yig drag sngags gsum du yod dogiX byang chub dang dmod pa gnyis/ de la rgyud ni/ nam mkha' klong yangs chen po'i rgyud/ ma rig mun sel gyi 'grel chung dang bcas pa/ 'khrul snang chen po le'u brgyad bcu pa'i rgyud gnyis ni/ sems can don gtan la 'bebs pa'i rgyud de/ chos sde ma bu gnyis la shog dril che chung gnyis yod do/ /bstan pa srung ba'i rgyud dang drag sngags ni/ srog gi rgyud la/ gnod sbyin dra ba nag po srog gi spu gri'i rgyud la/ le'u sum cu tham pa yod do/ /drag sngags kyi therdzog dril gsum yod de/ rang rgyud 'jig rten gyi gshin rje drang srong me 'bar gyi lugs yin no/ /spyang thod mi thod la bsgrub pas gshin rje dmar po yin te/ ma ra khrag gi rgyud le'u bdun pa la4༷༷ srog dang snying gi 'khor lo bcas pa ni/ wa thod rlung dmar gyi gshin rje yin te/ ma bu sgril ba la shog dril drug yod dogiX de gnyis srog las yin te/ de'i nang na ma ru rtso snying 'byin gyi drag sngags zab bospoX tshe bdag ni rang gshed la zab ste/ drag sngags mngon tu
phyung ba'i rgyud la le'u nyi shu rtsa gcig yod dogiX sdig pa phung gshog la le'u bcu drug yod dogiX de'i ma bu la rtsodag dril bcu drug yod dogiX drag po mngon du phyung ba la zab pa bdud nag po mi gcig yin4༷༷ zhag bdun las bsgrub mi dgos sogiX ser ba la zab pa ni/ drang srong g.yo 'gul le'u bdun bcu tham pa yod/ de la bsgrub ser brgya/ rdzas ser mi mthun pa bdun4༷༷ btsan thabs kyi ser ba bcu/ dus kyi 'khor sprin sdud cing 'byung po dus kyi glo bur du 'khrug pa'i ser ba gnyis yodagiX ser ba 'di kho na yin te/ gter gzhan na med do/ kyin thang gi las nyis brgya bdun cu zer ro4༷༷ bsgrub ser brgya la gza' rgod kyi bsgrub pa nyi shu/gdong mo la bcu/ gza' gdong spel ma nyi shu/ lha srin gzhan la lnga bcu yod dogiX gtad khram ni rgya mtsho dug ri kha'i rgyud dang / byol po glang mgo can gyi rgyud las/ gtad lugs mi mthun pa bcu bdun yod do/ /ro la khraX 'debs la gsum las/ shog dril bco brgyad yod do de'i nang nas zab pa dug sbrul rwa can gyi gtad la sogs rgyud rtsal rin chen snying gi 'bor lo nag po la/ ma bu la the ga dril lnga/ mu stegs phung bshog gi rdzas sbyor mtshon cha las kyi 'khor lo la/ shog dril bcu gsum yod do/ /de'i nang nas hoX nag dang rtsa drug drug gnyis zab bo/ /bdud rtsi dngos grub nye bar gyur ba'i snying po'i rgyud la/ 'grel ba dang ltoX sgrub
༄tshiltoX thabs la ༷/ga dril bcu gsum yod dogiX yang dag tsitta thugs kyi gsang tig la/ phregag dril drug yod do/ /sa bdag bsrung ba'i yang tig /snying gzer srog 'khor la ༈rdzog dril gnyis/ mi nad las thar par byed pa'i rin po che'i 'od la shog dril gnyis/ rgya nag po gyim shang gi 'ber lo/ ser ba mig mang ris chung ngu la shog dril gnyis/ zla gsang nag po'i bsgrub bskor mtsho la shog dril bco brgyad yod dogiX rin chen dum bu khrig dang / kha sbyor gyi mdzod/ rtsa ra ka las skos chung ngu / drang srong mngon shes kyi gso ba rigs pa'i sman dang / dpyad gnyis la shog dril sum cu/ de rnams bse'i sgrom bu smug po dang / zangs kyi ga'u dmar po dang / rang gi shog dril ma 'dres pa gud gud na sdebs nas yod do/ /de ni chos kyi dpe lags te/ gang mos mos su dbye'o/ /de nas dngos grub kyi rab gnas bya ste/ lo gsum mam bdun gyi bar du tshogs dang gtor mas mchod cing / mi la mi spel bar rnal 'byor mtshams gcodagiX de ltar ma byas na bar chad 'byung ngo / /'don pa'i dus su bar chad 'ong / nyes pa che bas gsang ngo ltoX sa ma ya so phag shlau kha thamagiX phrosaltoX bde gshegs spyi sgril rgya zhang giri gter ma rnams so/ ñtsha/
༄༅/ /mchod bstod gsal bar byed pa'i sgron me zhesabya ba bzhugs so/ /'di gnubs lugs zer kyang / pad lugs 'dra/
༄tshi/ /khu/lhuro:thams cad sku gsung thugs bdag nyid/ /yon tan ma lus kun ldan pa'i/ /rdo rdze 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtsa rgyud bshad rgyud snying po'i rgyud/ /yang snying nag po gsang ba'i rgyud/ /byad rtsol sgyu rtsal sngags tshig don/ /mchod bstod las kyi sgron ma bshad/ /dregs pa sngags bsnol ma can gyi ba lta bskul ba dang / lha rgyud rnams/ gzhi dang ba'i gang nasabaskul dang bskul ba dang skabasadang skabasasu bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod/ tshul dang yul kun la/ /bstod gsol gdab gnad nas bskul/ /mchod pa 'bul zhing las gnyer gtad/ /sha khrag gi gtor ma byin gyis brlabs la/ /phyag rgya chen po zil gnon gyi lha tshogs 'khor dregs pa dang bcas pa la 'bul zhing las sna tshogs bcol zhing bskul ba ni/ e/ chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas/ /drag po e yi gzhal yas nas/ /klu 'bum gnyan khri sa bdag stong
༄tshi/ /gi gdan/ /lto 'phye phyogs skyong ma he dregs pa ma he brdzisapa'i snyings brdzis pa'i khri/ /thabs dang shes rab nyi zla'i gdan steng na/ /dug lnga skam chags 'joms pa'i lha/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /ye shes rngams pa'i rgyal po zil gnon sku/ /srog bdag 'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po ni/ /gtum chen rngams pa'i rgyal po me ltar 'bar/ /sku mdog mthing nag dug chen 'khyil ba 'dra sku yang che zhing gtum chen rngams pa'i sku/ /dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgrad/ /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing rngams/ /g.yas dkar lha brgyad zas su za/ /g.yon dmar klu 'bum gnyan khri gsol/ /dbus zhal mthing la rngams pa yis/ /sku dgrar 'os pa'i dam nyams dang / /sa bdag sde brgyad lha srin gyi/ /dbang po lnga dang tsitta gsol/ /phyag drug mtshon cha 'bar ba
yis zhe sdang sa bdag klu gnyan dang / /dgra bgegs mgo lus tshal par gshogs/ /g.yas kyi dang po 'khor lo yis/ /dgra bgegs mgo lus tshal par sadzogags/ /bar pa gnam lcags ral gri yis/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i srog rtsa gcod/ /tha ma gnam lcags rdo rje yis/ /dgra bo'i spyi gtsug brgyab nas ni/ /rkang pa'i mthil du gtsag gis 'don/ /g.yon gyi dang po be con gyis/ /dgra bgegs zhe sdang mgo la bsnun bar pa gtun shing 'bar ba yis/ /dgra bo mgo lus tshal par gshogs/ /tha ma sdig mdzub me 'bar bas/ dgra bgegs lus ngag gzir zhing bsreg /sku la dur khrod chas kyis brgyan/ /dbu la bdud dang srin po dang / /btsan dang mu stegs rgyal po yi/ /thod pa'i phreng bas rab tu brgyan/ /klu chen brgyad kyi mgo bcad nas/ /do shal snying gi phreng bas rgyan du byas/ /rgyal rigs snyan gyi grong khyer brgyan/ /rje rigs mgul chu tshangs skud brgyan/ /bram ze'i rigs kyi phyag gdub byas/ /rmang rigs nag pos zhabs gdub byas/ /rigs ngan gdol pa zhabs 'og mnan/ /ba su rigs drug zas su za/ /mche ba dgu khri rtsang phur gtsos gtams pa yis/ /dam nyams dgra bgegs zhal du gsol/ /spyan nas 'jigs pa'i me 'bar zhing / /shangs nas rlung nag 'tshub ma ldang / /dbu skra sma ra ba spu las/ gdug rtsub dmar nag me chen
༄tsho/ /'bar / sku dgrar 'os pa'i dam nyams dang / /gdug pa'i klu gnyan sa bdag sreg /gang la bya ba khyod kyis shes/ /dmigs pa gang yin myur du sgrol/ /zhe sdang drag po'i sbyor ba choms/ /srog lus dbang po dngas snyigs phye/ /rtsa rgyud klad khrag rba klong skoms/ /lus srog dbang po rten dang phrol/ /'byung ba rnam shes bkrag mdangs sdus/ /bla mtsho bkrag mdangs bag chags skoms/ /lcags mkhar sgo med nang du chug 'byung ba gtan gzhi rngams kyis gnon/ /gdug rtsub me lha'i zhal du stob/ sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/ /mchod par 'bul lo kha raX khā hi/ phrin las bcol ba ni/ sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs thal ba bzhin du rab tu rlog /bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzod/ /cesakun la desa'agre'o/ /e/ g.yon gyi phyogs nas yum gcig ma/ /yum chen rdo rje khros ma ni/ /sku mdog mthing nag 'bar ba la gdug pa'i ral pa mun ltar gtibs/ ral pa'i zar bu re re la/ /gser dang mu tig rgyan 'chang ma/ /gdol pa klu yi thod pa yis/ /dbu dang phyag zhabs lhu tshigs brgyan/ /zhal nas mi ro rta ro 'phrul / / spyan nas khrag 'dzag zu lu lu/ /shangs nas rlung nag 'tshub ma ldang / /g.yas pa dgra bo'i snying phyung 'khyud/ /g.yon pa snying khrag gtso la stob/ /drag tu bskul zhing rbad tsa na/ /ma tshogs 'bum yang
gzir zhing bskul/ ma lngardzo'i ke'u kaX dgra la 'bebs/ /gang la bya ba khye1da kyis shes/ /dmigs pa gang yin myur du sgrol/ zhe sdang drag po'i zhesapa nas/ bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzod/ cesabar la desal lha kun gyi sham bur btags khrug go/ e/ zil gnon thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas/ 'byung ba sa yi dwangs ma las/ rdo rje rigs kyi khro bo ste/ 'jigs byed ya ma rā dza ni/ /sku mdog smug nag 'bar ba las/ /rngams shing dregs pa'i dgra bgegs 'dul/ /rna ba'i grong khyer sbrul gyis brgyan/ /tshangs pa'i mgo bcad do shal byas/ /g.yas pa 'khor lo rtsibs bcu yis/ /dgra bgegs mgo lus tshal par gshog /g.yon pa tsitta dmar po bsnams/ /'gal byed tsitta khong nas 'byin/ /drag tu bskul zhing rbad tsa na/ /bdud dang srin po'i don snying 'byin/ /btsan dang srog dbang po srog bdag 'joms bdag 'gong po 'joms/ /dug lnga gtum sar khros pa yis sa bdag klu gnyan gzir zhing sreg /gang la dmigs pa: e/ ya ma'i thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas/ 'byung ba me yi dwangs ma las/ rin chen rigs kyi khro bo ste/ dregs pa phyag na rdo rje'i sku/ sku mdog ljang nag 'bar ba ni/ phrin las sna tshogs mdzad pa'i rtags/ /zhal gcig rngams shing rtsigs pa yis/ /dregs pa can dang lha srin rnams/ /srog dang phral nas zas su za/ /tshems dang mche ba gtsigs pa yis/ /gdug
༄7/ /pa klu gnyan khong du gsol/ /g.yas pa rdo rje rtse dgu yis/ /ye shes dgu ldan nyon mongs 'joms/ /g.yon pa tsitta 'i phreng ba yis/ /dbang chen dregs pa bran du 'khol/ /zhabs gnyis khyad kyi dor stabs kyis/ /gdug pa'i dgra bgegs zil gyis gnon/ /dbu dang phyag zhabs lhu tshigs rnams/ /sbrul dang rin po che yis brgyan/ gang la dmigs pa: e/ dregs pa'i thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas/ /'byung ba rlung gi dwangs ma las/ /las kyi rigs kyi khro bo ste/ /rus sbal rngams pa mi zan ni/ /nyon mongs lnga yi rtsa ba gcod/ /skye ba med pa'i khams su sdud/ /thugs kyi gsang mdzod chen po rtswa /lha srin ming gi snying po 'chang / /dmigs pa'i dam nyams dgra bgegs rnams/ /lcags sder 'bar ba'i stobs kyis khug /spyan mig nyi ma'i 'od kyis sreg /rtsa bzhi dwangs ma stobs kyis non/ /dmod pa drag po'i mtshon chas chod/ /mchod rten drug gi stobs kyis non/ /gang la dmigs pa: e/ spyi gtsug gdug pa 'dul byed pa/ /'byung ba chu yi dngas ma las/ /padma rigs kyi khro bo ni/ /bya khyung rgyal po mthu bo che/ /'khor lo 'bar ba'i sa9(ga pa la/ /ral gri mtshon spu gri'i mtshon chas cha'i spu gris gtams/ /mtshon cha'i gathegag pa gtams pa yis/ /gdug byed cha lus sakhagag cing gtub/ /spyan mig nyi ma'i gzigs gzi mdangs stangs kyis/ /bag
chags rgya mtsho'i gting nas skem/ /rdo rje 'bar ba'i mchu dbal gyis/ /gdug pa'i klu rgyal smyi nas 'dren/ /gru gsum gdangs pa'i zhal bsgrad pas/ /gdug pa'i klu gnyan khong du gsol/ /gang la dmigs pa:e / yang sprul dug gi khyung chen gnyis/ spu dang gshog pa mtshon cha me/ klu bdud klu srin bsreg par mdzad/ /stag dang seṅge rngams pa yis/ /dgra bo'i sha khrag srog la rol/ /zhe sdang gdug pa'i sbrul nag gi /kha nas me 'bar stong khams sreg /dgra bo'i khang khyim rmang nas bshig /dug sbrul rlangs pa dgra la thong / /dgra bo'i khong du dug mda' rgyob/ /gang la dmigs pa: e/ shar lho nub byang sgo bzhi nas/ bla 'gugs mon pa chen po bzhi/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i bla khug la/ /mngon spyod tshul bzhin bsgral bar mdzod/ e/ rgya mtsho chen po'i gting rum na/ /ya ma bye ba dgu rings bzhugs/ /las kyi mtha' sdud khyod yin pas/ /nyams pa'i dgra bgegs myur du sgrol/ e/ 'byung bzhi rngams pa'i 'og shod nas/ /sgo med lcags mkhar bcu drug nas/ /thod mkhar 'jigs pa'i pho brang nas/ /las kyi 'chi bdag nag po bzhugs / / las kyi: dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs: e/ snang srid rakta'i gzhal yas nas/ ya ma srog bdag nag po bzhugs/ las kyi: dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs: zhes bstod cing / e/ bskal pa
༄tshi/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong 'bor 'dasapa'i lo'i gzhal yas nas/ /lcags mkhar sgo med bcu drug 'bar ba'i dbus phyogs na/ /'obs chen bcu drug 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor na/ /thod mkhar 'bar ba bzhi yis dbus phyogs na/ /pho brang lcags mkhar 'bar bas gtams pa'i nang / /klu 'bum gnyan khri sa bdag stong gi gdan/ /lto 'phye phyogs skyong ma he brdzis bsdigs pa'i khri/ /thabs dang shes rab nyi zla'i gdan steng nas srog bdud 'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po bzhengs/ /rngams pa'i tshul gyis bla rkun las la khyod/ e/ shar gyi phyogs nas dgra bgegs bla 'gugs pa/ /dung gi mon pa rdo rje rigs kyi gtso/ /sku stod zhing gi g.yang gzhi thod pa 'bum gyis brgyan/ /sku smad stag gi sham thabs mu tig 'bum gyis brgyan/ /sbrul nag gdug pas sku yi rgyan du byas/ snying dang thod pa'i phreng bas dregs pas brgyan ba dregs pas brgyan/ /zhal nas dug gi na rlangs pa'ang bun sprin ltar gtibs/ /shangs nas dug gi 'tshubs mas stong khams phyags mas 'debs/ /snyan nas rngams pa'i 'brug sgras zhing bcu zil gyis gnon/ /phyag g.yon lcags kyu zhags pas 'khrid pa yis/ /gang la dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs bla srog 'gugs/ /phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rjes mgo lus sarsāgag /mon pa chen po drag tu bskul tsa na/ chibs su seṅge chibs nas dgra bgegs tshe srog
sdud g.yas nas ga9khog pa can gyi pho nya lding zhing srog la 'debs/ /g.yon nas gcan gzan rngams pa'i pho nya rngams shing rol/ /stod na me 'bar rgya mtsho gting nas skems/ /smad nas khrag 'dzag rims nad bu yug rlobs/ /dung gi mon pa sdang ba'i dgra la bhyo/ /mon pa nag po sku yi g.yon phyogs nas/ /dung gi mon mo bla rkun rngams pa'i gdong / /sku la dar nag ber chen sbrul gyis brgyan pa gsol/ /dbu la dug sbrul cod pan khrag gi zar bu can/ /zhal nas dug gi sprul pa rta ro mi ro 'brul/ /spyan nas dug dang khrag gi rba klong chi laṃ li/ /g.yas pa snying phyung yab kyi sku la 'khyud/ /g.yon pa dug gi mda' zer dgra la 'phen yab yum gnyis su med pa'i sprul pa ni/ /dug gi mon pa nag po gcer bu 'bum/ /dug mda' lcags gzer dgra bgegs snying la 'bebs/ /spyi gtsug dung gi bya khyung ga ru ṭa/ /rdo rje'i gshog pa dung gi me chen 'bar/ /rdo rje'i sder mos klu gnyan drangs shing za/ klu nad mdze shu ka rus gcod cing skem/ /rdo rje rigs kyi srung sprul pa ma sdang ba'i dgra la bhyo/ e/ lho yi phyogs nas dgra bgegs bla 'gugs pa/ /lcags kyi mon pa nag po rngams pa'i gdong stag gi gdong / /sku stod lcags kyi zhun khrab thod pas brgyan pa gsol/ /sku smad stag gi sham thabs g.yu yi dril bus brgyan pa gsol/ /dbu dbu ral nag po la ral pa nag po
༄tshi/ /nam mkha'i sprin ltar gtibs/ /kha nas me 'bar khrag gi rgya mtsho skem/ /mche ba dgu khris dgra bo'i nang khrol 'bral/ /spyan rtsa dmar po sdang mig dgra la gzir/ /g.yon pa rlung gi 'khor los dgra bgegs lus srog 'bral/ /g.yas pa me yi 'khor los dgra bgegs rtsa rgyud sreg /mon pa nag po drag tu bskul tsam na/ /stag la zhon nas dgra bgegs phyags mas 'debs/ /me yi bskal pa gtong zhing dgra bgegs bla mtsho skem/ /zhal du sbrul dang mi ro za zhing rngams/ /mon pa nag po sku yi g.yon phyogs nas/ /mon mo nag mo g.yu yi ral pa can/ dgra bgegs bla rkun yid la jag 'gyed ma/ /spyan nas khrag 'dzag zhal nas mi ro 'brul/ /sku la mthing nag sbrul gyis rgyan yang gsol/ /g.yas pa snying phyugs g.yon pa yab la stob/ /yab yum gnyis su med pa'i sprul pa ni/ /lcags kyi mon pa nag po gcer bu 'bum ri klungs rgyud cing tshe srog sdud/ /lag na lcags mda' gzer zhing dgra snying 'debs/ /rngams pa'i nga ros stong gsum zil gyis gnon/ /gcer bu 'bum gyis dgra bgegs sgrol la shog /mon pa nag po dbu yi spyi gtsug na/ /bya khyung rgyal po mtshon cha'i gshog pa can/ /rin chen cod pan me yi bskal pa gtong / /zhe sdang klu mtsho gting nas skem zhing 'thung / /mchu dang sder mo ring la phra ba yis/ /klu gnyan sa bdag 'dzin
cing zhal du gsol/ /khyung gis gzhog brdab 'od zer 'phro ba yis/ /klu nad mdze shu ka rus gcod pa'i rtags/ /rin chen rigs kyi sprul pa sdang ba'i dgra la bhyo/ e/ nub kyi phyogs nas dgra bgegs bla 'gugs pa/ /bse yi mon pa gtum chen rngams pa can/ /sku stod bse khrab thod pas brgyan pa gsol/ /sku smad stag sham padma 'bum gyis brgyan/ dbu skra khams nag khrag gi zar bu can/ /zhal nas khrag skyugs dgra bgegs khrag tu skyug /spyan nas me 'bar dgra bgegs dug gsum sreg /snyan nas 'brug sgras stong gsum zil gyis gnon/ /klu brgya'i mgo bcad do shal phreng bas brgyan/ /phyag g.yon sbrul zhags nag pos dgra bgegs yid nas 'gugs/ /phyag g.yas ral gris dgra bgegs srog rtsa gcod/ /bse yi mon pa drag tu bskul tsam na/ /ba glang dmar po zhon nas stong gsum phyags mas 'debs/ /khrag gi mtsho rlabs khrag nad char ltar 'bebs/ /klu dang sa bdag 'bum sde zas su za/ /rngams pa'i nga ros stong gsum zil gyis gnon/ /sprul pa chen po rngam zhing dgra bo 'dul/ /mon pa chen po sku yi g.yon phyogs nas/ /mon mo tshe 'phrog khrag gi ral pa can/ /sku la rma bya'i 'jol bor chen po gsol/ /padma 'bum dang sbrul gyis brgyan/ /spyan nas khrag 'dzag zhal nas mi ro 'brul/ /g.yon pas snying phyung g.yas pa yab la 'khyud/ /
༄༅/ /yab yum gnyis su med pa'i sprul pa ni/ /bse yi mon pa gcer bu 'bum/ /khrag gi skyug pa dgra la sprod/ /ral pa bse 'od me ltar 'bar/ /me yi bskal pa dgra la gtong / /khyod kyi lag pa g.yas g.yon na/ /zangs mda' gzer chen dgra la 'debs so/ /rngams pa'i nga ros stong gsum zil gyis gnon/ /gcer bu 'bum gyis dgra bgegs sgrol la shog /mon pa chen po'i dbu yi spyi gtsug na/ /bse mi bya khyung ral gri'i gshog pa can/ /zangs sder zangs mchus sa bdag klu gnyan gzir zang / /padma stong gi spu bran me ltar 'bar/ /spyan nas khrag 'dzag klu gnyan sa bdag myos/ /padma rigs kyi sprul pa sdang ba'i dgra la bhyo/ e/ byang gi phyogs nas dgra bgegs bla 'gugs pa/ /mon pa rngams pa srid pa'i gshed chen ni/ /ser nag mi srun dug gi kha rlangs 'phyo/ /ral pa sbrul nag khrag 'dzags na bun char du 'bebs/ /sku stod zhing lpags rgya gram stong gis brgyan/ /sku smad stag sham thams cad pa'i cha ga can/ /bya dang gcan gzan gdug pa'i tshogs kyis bskor/ /phyag g.yon zhing gi zhags pas dgra bgegs gnad nas 'dren/ /g.yas pa rdo rje rgya gram dgra bo'i mgo lus gshog /mon pa nag po drag tu bskul tsa na/ /dred pa zhon nas dgra bgegs phyags mas 'debs/ /kha nas me 'bar dgra bo'i dug gsum sreg /rngams pa'i nga ros dgra
bgegs zil gyis gnon/ /mon pa chen po sku yi g.yon phyogs na/ /mon mo bla rkun dgra la gzer 'debs ma/ /sbrul nag ral sa khrag gi zar bu can/ /sku la ljang nag ber chen thod pas brgyan pa gsol/ /zhal nas dug gi sbrul dang mi ro rta ro 'brul/ /spyan nas dug dang khrag gi chu po 'bab/ /snyan dang phyag zhabs sbrul nag 'bum gyis brgyan/ /g.yas pas snying phyung g.yon pas yab la srobasa'akhyud/ /mon pa 'brong chen ra zor dgra la 'debs/ /yab yum gnyis su med pa'i sprul pa ni/ /mon pa ser nag gcer bu 'bum/ /lcags mda' gzer chen dgra la 'debs/ /rkang pa rgyug cing lag pa rtse/ /tshe srog dbang po 'gugs shing gcod/ /brla dang gsus pa 'bral zhing 'chang / /dgra bo bla dang phrol la shog /mon pa ser nag dbu yi spyi gtsug na/ /gser gyi bya khyung rgyal po ga ru ṭa/ /rdo rje rgya gram gzhog pa'i 'od zer 'phro/ /rgya gram mchu dang lcags mchu sder mo yis/ /klu gnyan sa bdag drang zing zas su za/ /gshog pa rgya gram las kyi rlung chen gyis/ /klu gnyan sa bdag klu bdud phyags mas 'debs/ /spyan gnyis nyi zla'i sdang mig ldog pa yis klu nad mdze shu ka rus gcod cing skem/ /khyung gi rngam sgra khrom khrom drag tu bsgrags pa yis/ /sa bdag klu gnyan zil gyis gnon cing gzir/ /las kyi rigs kyi sprul pa dgra la bhyo:༷༷ e/ srog bdud tshe
༄tshi/ /bdag nag po ni/ /sku ni nam mkha'i khams dang mnyam/ /gsung gi nga ro 'brug ltar sgrog /thugs ni stong gsum phye khyab par mar blta/ /zhal ni hom khung gdangs pa 'dra/ /ljags ni hom bzar brkyang ba 'dra mche ba rtsang phur gtams pa 'dra/ /khyod kyi srog dbugs bdag po ste/ /tshe bdag nag po'i thugs kyi sprul pa bzhi ni/ e/ shar gyi phyogs nas 'gugs byed pa/ ya mānta ga'i pho nya ste/ he le khyab pa srog gi bdud gti mug sa yi khams nas ldang / /kun gzhi 'khrul pa'i sa bon sreg /nag mo snying rkun mi zan ma/ /dgra bgegs snying khos rus pa choms/ /gang la bya ba'i las ngo 'ordzongs/ /dmigs pa'i dgra bo sgrol la shog /bcol pa'i phrin las dus la bab/ e/ lho yi phyogs nas 'gugs byed pa/ /ya mānta ga'i pho nya ste/ /nag po 'dzum med srog gi bdud/ /nga rgyal drod kyi khams nas ldang / /nag po 'dzum mod rtsa bzung gcod nag mo mi snyid 'byin mi thogs ma thod snying 'byin ma/ /dgra bgegs snying khos me drod sod/ /gang la bya ba'ica dmigs pa'i: bcol ba'i phrin las: e/ nub kyi phyogs nas 'gugs byed pa/ /ya mānta ga'i:so 'dar 'khrigs pa khrag gi bdud/ /'dod chags chu yi: so 'dar 'khrigs pas lus srog 'phrol/ /nag po khrag skyug snying la gzer 'debs ma/ /dgra bgegs snying khos khrag 'thungs shig /gang lazo dmigs
pa'i: bcol ba'i: e/ byang gi phyogs nas: ya mānta: ral pa spyi chings dbugs kyi bdud/ /phrag dog rlung gi: ral pa spyi chings dbugs rgyun gcod/ /nag mo smyo byed dbugs sdud ma/ /dgra bgegs snying khos dbugs la rol/ /gang la: /dmigs pa'i: /bcol ba'i phrin las dus pa bab/ /de nasalasakyi gshon rje bskul ba ni/ /sha khrag gi gtor ma byin rlabasal 'bul lo/ /dang po dang bar du lasakyi so bsdebs/ e/ yab cig 'jam dpal sprul pa ni/ gzhin rje tshe bdag nag po ste/ /sku mdog nag po nam mkha'i khams dang mnyam/ /zhabs kyi tshangs pa'i yul yang mnan/ /skra dang ba spu ral pa sbrul gyis brgyan/ /spyan nas me yi phung po 'bar/ /zhal na khrag gi rgya mtsho 'khyil/ /zas su gshin rje'i sha la za/ /skom du gshin rje'i khrag la 'thung / /zhi khro 'bar ba'i tshogs chen nas/ /las kyi khro bo khro mo dang / /gnod sbyin srin po gdug ma lusapa pa'i tshogs/ /thams cad bsgral ba'i zhing bcu bsgral zhing zhal du gsol/ /lcags mkhar bcu drug dbus na bzhugs/ /zhi khro nyid kyis sha la zo/ /khro mo nyid kyis khrag la 'thung / /dam nyams dgra dang srung mar bcas/ /zhal du bstab bo kha raX khā hi/ /las bcol 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ e/ bskal pa brgyad khri bzhi stong 'das pa'i pha rol na/ /'byung ba stan gzhi rngam pa'i zhabs 'og na/ /rgya mtsho chen po bzhi yi gting rum na/ /
༄tsho/ /mun mkhar lcags mkhar sgo med na/ /༄ dra dregs pa'i gdan steng na/ /chu glang sngon pa'i khri steng na/ /gshin rje bye ba dgu khri bzhugs/ /sku mdog mthing nag rngams pa la/ /dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgrad/ /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal/ /phyag drug phyag mtshan 'bar ba ni/ /g.yas kyi dang po ral gri bsnams/ /dgra bo srog rtsa rtsad nas gcod/ /g.yas kyi bar ma zhing dbyug bsnams dgra bo dam nyams dbang po 'joms/ /tha ma lcags kyi ri rab bsnams/ /dgra bo dam nyams gzir zhing gnon/ /g.yon gyi dang po be con gyis/ /dgra bo ma lus mgo lus gshog /bar ma lcags kyus dgra snying 'byin/ /tha ma rdo rje rgya gram gyis/ /dgra bo dam nyams gzer zhing gnon/ /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/ /mnan cing gzir ba'i las mdzod cig /sku la lcags kyi zhun khras gsol/ /thod pa zhing chung sbrul gyis brgyan/ /sku smad stag lpags zhing chung brgyan/ /stod nas nga rgyal me ri 'bar/ /smad nas 'dod chags khrag tu chu ltar 'bebasa'abab/ /sked la zhe sdang sbrul nag 'khyug /shangs nas phrag dog rlung nag 'tshub/ /dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol la shog /e/ tshe dang srog la dbang bsgyur ba/ /'jigs byed brlag byed ku be ra/ /dmar nag khrag rul kham pa nag 'dra/ /sbrul gyi ral pa spyi bor bcings/ /
kha rlangs nad kyi mtshon srin 'bab/ /zhal nas thog dang ser ba 'bebs/ /chibs su rlung dmar rta la zhon/ /me rlung las kyi 'bor lo bsnams/ /sprul pa gsod byed ging yang 'gyed/ /yang sprul dmar nag ma mo 'gyed/ /zhe sdang lcags kyi sdig pa dang / /phrag dog bse yi sbal pa 'gyed/ /dmigs pa'i dam nyams ru dra 'dra/ /dus mtha' brtul la 'du byed bskum/ /g.yon na bdud mo nag mo'i sku/ /rlung nag 'tshub ma nag mo'i dkyil 'khor na/ /lcags kyu dmar mo'i 'phro 'du las/ bdud mo khrag gi ral pa can/ /khrag mig dmar mo'i mchi ma las/ /khrag dang dug gi char pa 'bebs/ /lag na khrag gi thod pa thogs/ /khrag mda' bu yug char ltar phob/ /bdud kyi lcam mo'i dus la bab/ e/ las kyi tshe bdag nag po'i sprul pa'i sku/ /'byung ba gtan gzhi rngams pa'i 'og shed na/ /las kyi rlung nag bskal pa gtams pa'i steng dug mtsho ba tshwa gting khol nag po'i gting / /sha za rngams pas brgyan pa'i pho brang na/ /sgo med lcags mkhar bcu drug dbus shed na/ /'obs chen bcu gnyis 'bar ba dbus phyogs na/ /thod mkhar 'bar ba bzhi yi dbus phyogs na/ /pho brang gnam lcags spu gris gtams pa na/ /klu gnyan sa bdag ma he'i gdan steng na/ /lcags kyi mon pa tshe bdag mgo dgu pa/ /sku mdog sngo nag ro yi rud pa 'dra/ /sku la
༄tsho/ /glang chen dur khrod chas kyis brgyan/ /stag gi sham thabs thod pas do shal can/ /snyan dang phyag zhabs mgur chu sbrul gyis brgyan/ /dbu gsum mkha' lding rma bya'i dbu/ /gdug pa gsum dang dgra bo'i blo snying za/ /zhal gsum gtum rngams 'bar ba khro bo'i gzugs dbu/ /gdug pa'i sbrul dang mi ro rta ro za/ /zhal gsum sha za rngams pa'i dbu/ /nyams pa'i sha khrag nang khrol za/ /g.yas pa'i phyag dgus bsnams pa ni dang po 'khor los mgo lus gzhog /gnyis pa ral gris lus srog gcod/ /gsum pa rdo rjes dbang po 'joms/ /bzhi pa kha ṭaX rtse gsum gyis/ /dgra bo'i dug gsum rtsad nas gcod/ /lnga pa mdung thung snying khrag 'byin/ /drug pa mda' 'phen chen snying gzer 'debs/ /bdun pa zhing chung dbyug tho 'phyar/ /brgyad pa rdo rje rgya gram gyis/ /phrin las sna tshogs mdzad pa'i rtags/ /dgu pa gnam lcags phur pa yis dgra bo'i srog gi srog pa rtsa 'debasartsa bar 'debs/ /phyag g.yon dang po be con gyis/ /dgra po'i zhe sdang yang mgo kro gnon/ /gnyis pa gtun shing dbang po 'joms/ /gsum pa rgyu zhags dgra kro 'gugs bzhi pa sbrul zhags byad du 'jug /lnga pa sdigs mdzub dug gsum sreg /drug pa tri shul rtse gsum gyis/ /lus ngag yid gsum thal bar rlog /bdun pa dgra stus mgo lus btogags/ /brgyad pa gzhu
yis gdug pa 'dul/ /dgu pa tsitta 'byin zhing za/ /zhabs gnyis khyad kyi dor mi stabs bdud dang mu stegs gnon/ /zhabs gnyis khyad kyis dor stabs sa bdag klu gnyan 'dul/ /zhabs gnyis khyad kyi dor stabs ma he nyi zla gnon/ /zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum thabs dang shes rab tshul/ /dbu skra ba spu dug gi rlangs pa 'phro/ /srog bdud nag po sdang ba'i dgra la bhyoX g.yon nas bdud mo khrag gi ral pa can/ /ya mtshan bud med nag mo rngams pa'i gdong / /nyid kyi sku mdog mthing nag la/ /ral pa khrag gi zar bu can/ /spyan nas khrag 'dzag zu lu lu/ /zhal nas mi ro rta ro 'brul/ /sku stod zhing gi g.yang gzhi la/ /nyi ma 'bum gyi rgyan gyis brgyan/ /phyag g.yas tri shul rtse gsum gyis/ /dgra bo dam nyams srog rtsa gcod/ /g.yon pa bhanta rakta yis/ /dgra bo'i khong du dug mda' rgyob/ /bdud mo nag mo dgra la bhyoX e/ tshe bdag nag po'i spyi gtsug na/ /bya khyung rgyal po ga ru ṇa/ /gser gyi lus la gnam lcags 'bar ba'i mchu/ /spyan mig nyi mi zla ltar du 'khyil pa yis/ /dgra bo'i bla mtsho gting nas skems/ /'khor lo 'bar ba'i gshog pa yis/ /dgra po'i mgo lus tshal par gshog /ral gri 'bar ba'i gshog pa yis/ /dgra bo nyams pa'i srog rtsa chod/ /mthe'u gshog spu gri me ltar 'bar/ /klu gnyan sa bdag rtsad nas skem/ /g.yas kyi
༄tshi/ /gzhog pas klu chen brgyad kyang gnon/ /g.yon gyi gshog pas klu bdud sa bdag gnon/ gnam lcags sder mos srog gi dbang po 'dren len/ /sku ni gtum rngams brjid pa'i cha byad kyis/ /sa bdag klu gnyan lto 'phye zil gyis gnon/ /khyung gi gshog pa brdabs pa yis/ /gdug pa'i gnas khang rmang nas bzhin bsgyel/ /gang la bya ba khyod kyis shes par gyis/ /bya khyung rgyal pos gang yin lus srog 'phrol/ e/tshe bdag nag po'i thugs kyi sprul pa ni/ /gling bzhi thod mkhar bar ba bzhi yi nang shed na/ /gdug pa klu yi mon pa srog gcod bshan pa bzhi/ /dam nyams dgra po'i lus srog dbang po 'phrol/ e/ shar phyogs dug mtsho zla gam me re 'khyi li li re/ /dug mtsho zla gam 'khyil pa'i nang shed na/ /dug mtsho ba tshwa gting khol 'gyu/ /zhe sdang dug mtsho'i nang shed na/ /thod mkhar zla gam dug 'od 'bar/ /thod mkhar zla gam dkar po'i nang shed na/ /sa bdag dri za bsnol ba'i gdan steng na/ /lcags kyi mon pa rngams pa'i gdong / /dbu ral lcags tshul 'tshub nag por 'khyil/ /dug dung rlangs 'tshub ma'i dbus nas ldang / /sku la lcags kyi zhun khrab gsol/ /g.yas na dug sdong me ltar 'bar/ /dgra bgegs dug chu khrag chu skem/ /g.yon pa lcags kyi gzer chen 'debs/ /de nas drag tu bskul tsa na/ /thugs kyi sprul pa mngon byung na/ /lcags kyi
mon pa gcer bu 'bum/ /khyod kyi phyag mtshan g.yas pa na/ /gsod byed lcags kyi spu gri bsnams/ /khyod kyi phyag mtshan g.yon pa na/ /mi phreng rlon pa'i zhags pa thogs bsnams/ /zhal kha nas dug gi skyug pa 'thor dug gi dred mo lag rings ni/ /dug gi rkyal pa khur du 'khur/ /g.yas pas dug zor nag po 'phen/ /g.yon pas dgra snying 'byon cing za/ /sa bdag dgra bgegs zas skal yin/ /dam nyams srog gi bshan pa gyis gshed ma'ang snang / e/ lho phyogs g.yu mtsho sog ka me re re/ /g.yu mtsho sos ga'i nang shed na/ /dug mtsho ba tshwa gting khol 'gyu/ /zhe sdang dug mtsho'i nang shed na/ /thod mkhar sog ka g.yu 'od 'bar / / thod mkhar 'bar ba'i nang shed na/ /gnyan dang grul bum bsnol ba'i gdan steng na/ /mon pa mthing nag mdze rgod gdong / /dbu ral g.yu 'tshub nag por 'khyil/ /zhing chen g.yang gzhi sku la gsol zhing phran 'bum gyis sku la brgyan/ /khyed kyi phyag mtshan g.yas g.yon na/ /dug zor dug mda' dgra la 'phen/ /de nas drag tu bskul tsa na/ /dug sbrul dug rta dred la zhon/ /sdang mig gcer bu snying 'byin 'bum/ /sdom dang sdig sanya sprul zang sbrul sbal pa 'gyed/ /srog snying srog snying rtsa la mda' ltar rgyug /sha za khrag 'thung rus pa 'cha'/ /glo snying mkhal ma nang khrol za/ /gnyan dang dgra po za skal yin/ /
༄༅/ /dam nyams dgra kro gshed ma gyis/ e/ nub phyogs zangs mtsho zlum po me re re/ /zangs mtsho 'khyil pa'i nang shed na/ /dug mtsho ba tshwa gting khol 'gyu/ /zhe sdang dug mtsho'i nang shed na/ /thod mkhar 'bar ba'i nang shed na/ /klu bdud dregs pa bsnol ba'i khri steng na/ /bse yi mon pa khyung chen gdong / /dug gi ra ru zangs se zang / /dpral ba'i dbyings dkyil na mig gcig po/ /rna ba'i grong khyer sbrul gyis brgyan kha nas me yi dug char 'phro/ /phyag na bse mda' dug zor 'phen/ /dug gi mtsho la rngubs shing 'thung / /dbu ral me 'tshub dmar ser 'khyil/ /sku la bse byang rag zhun gsol/ /bse sbrul dug mda' khong du 'jug /bse yi mtsho bas srog snying srog snying gcod/ /bse mchu dmar pos snying khrag 'jib/ /bse yi khyung chen srog la lding / /klu dang klu bdud zas su za/ /klu nad mdze shu ka rus gcod/ /thugs srog sprul pa mngon phyung ba/ /bse yi mon pa gcer bu 'bum/ /lag na chu srin lcags gzer 'bebs/ /sha khrag 'thung zhing rus pa 'cha'/ /glo snying mkhal ma nang khrol za/ /klu dang dgra bo za skal yin/ /dam nyams srog gi gshed ma gyis/ /e/ byang phyogs gser mtsho gru bzhi me re re/ /gser mtsho gru bzhi 'khyil pa'i nang shed na/ /dug mtsho: zhe sdang : thod mkhar gru bzhi gser 'od 'bar/ /thod mkhar 'bar ba'i
nang shed na/ /gnod sbyin lto phye bsnol ba'i khri steng na/ /gser gyi mon pa dred kyi mgo /dbu ral mthing gis 'tshub mar 'khyil/ /g.yu yi yang zhun glag pa gsol/ /gcan zan gdug pa'i mgo yi brgyan/ /lcags kyi mche ba khrigs se khrig /g.yas nas bya dang gcan zan 'gyed/ /rtsa rgyud gcod cing snying khrag 'byin/ /g.yon nas ma bdud bdun srin sring mo 'gyed/ /nad dang dal gyi bu yug 'bebs/ /de nas drag tu ba skul tsam na/ /dug rta dri dang 'bring la zhon/ /thugs kyi: dug gi mon pa gcer bu 'bum/ /dred kyi dbu la bya khra'i mchu/ /bu ga dgu nas srog rtsa 'jib/ /lag na ral gri dug zor 'phen/ /sha khrag glo snying : za byed srog gi gshed po gyis/ /lte 'phye'i gdon dang dgra bo yis/ /rtsa rgyud chod la gdug pa thul/ /tshe srog bsdus la dngas snyigs phye/ /gnod sbyin dgra bo'i gshed po gyis/ /klu gnyan sa bdag gnas su sgrol yab kyi bskul mchod bstod gsal sgron rdzogs so/ /de nasayum gyi bskul ni/ e/ yum gyi thugs kyi sprul pa las/ /thugs kyi sprul pa mngon phyung ba/ /shar phyogs stong gi 'jig rten na/ /dri za 'bum la dbang sgyur ma/ /mon mo nag mo seṅge'i gdong / /sku la mthing nag ber 'jol ber chen gsol/ /dbu la ral mi 'dug pa nag po mun ltar gtibs/ /zhal nas dug gi rlangs pa 'phro/ /spyan nas dug gi char pa 'bebs/ /dug gi rkyal
༄༅/ /pa rgyab tu khur/ /g.yon pa dug zor dgra la 'phen/ /g.yas pa dug mda' lcags gzer 'debs/ /dug zor brnag pa'i dgra la rgyob/ /lcags kyi sdig pa nag po zhon/ /dug mda' dgra bo'i khong du skyol / / mon mo dug spyod dgra mda' la bhyoX e/ yum gyi thugs kyi sprul pa las/ /thugs kyi sprul pa mngon phyung ba/ /lho phyogs stong gi: grul bum 'bum: mon mo nag mo stag gi gdong / /sku la zhing chen g.yang gzhi gsol/ /dbu ral g.yu sprin mun ltar gtibs/ /zhal dang shangs kyi bu ga nas/ /dug gi kha rlangs bun ni bun/ /spyan nas khrag gi rgya mtsho 'bebs/ /dug gi rkyal pa khur du 'khur/ /phyag na dug zor lcags gzer 'debs/ /dug mda' dgra bo'i khong du skyol/ /lcags gzer dgra yi dra'i snyid la 'debs thobs/ /dug gi phag mo rta ru zhon/ /mon mo'i dug mda' spyod dgra la bhyoX e/ yum gyi thugs kyi sprul pa: / thugs kyi sprul pa mngon byung ba/ /klu bdud 'bum: mon mo nag mo khyung chen (drid kyi )gdong / /sku la rma bya'i thul pa gsal/ /dbu ral khrag gi rgya mtsho 'khyil/ /zhal nas khrag gi skyug pa 'phro/ /spyan nas khrag gi chu bo zhun tshe 'bab/ /phyag na khrag zor zags gzer 'debs/ /khrag gi rkyal pa rgyab tu khur/ /khrag zor dam nyams dgra la rgyob/ /zangs mda' gzer chen dgra la thob/ /bse yi sbal pa rta ru zhon/ /
mon mo khrag dug gsod mda' dgra la phyo'oX e/ yum gyi thugs kyi sprul pa las/ /thugs kyi sprul pa mngon phyung ba/ /byang phyogs stong gi 'jig rten na/ /gnod sbyin 'bum la dbang bsgyur ma/ /mon mo nag mo khyung gi gdong / /sku la ber nag zhing chen gsol/ /dbu ral sbrul nag mun ltar gtibs/ /kha nas dug mtsho rlob cing 'khyug /spyan nas khrag 'dzag zu lu lu/ /dug gi na bun bun ne bun/ /dug rlangs na bun dgra la gtibs/ /phyag na dug zor dgra la 'phen/ /dug gi rkyal pa khur du 'khur/ /dug mda' gzer chen dgra la thob/ /dug sbrul nag po rta ru zhon/ /mon mo'i dug mda' spyod dgra la bhyoX zhesabasad pa mchog gi lasdang / / rang gshed rang la dbab pa dang / /bsrung zhing gzir ba dang / byasapa bzhig cing zug pa dang / gsang lam dgag cing / ngag mnan pa dang / zhen pa bzlog cing byad 'grol ba la sogs pa'i/ dusathams cad du man ngag gisa'adi sbyar zhing bsgyur ro/ /mchod bstod gsal bar byed pa'i sgron me/ /slob dpon 'jam dpal rdzusaskyesakyisamadzad pa rdzogs so/ /sam ya/ sarba maṅga laX/ 'di phyi mo rang la'ang 'dra min yod/ 'dra bas the tshom byung bas mchan bur btab yod pas/ /ma phyi ngesa'agrongs byung na brtag go /
༄7/ /bsam gag stong srog gi 'khor lo'i bri yig cesabya ba bzhugs so/ /byang bdag gi sku bsrung la bab pa'o/
༄tshi/ /bsam gtan stong srog gi bri yig dmar khrid du bkod pa la/ ri rab bang rim bzhi pa kha khyer can gyi bang rim dang po'i ngos la klu/ gnyan sa bdag mtshon pa'i sbrul/ sdig pa/ sbal pa/bang rim gyi steng du ru dra pho mo gan rkyal kha sbubs spyi chings su bsnol ba'i phyogs rer ma he bzhi re gshobs pa/ de'i steng du zil gnon gyi sku yongs su rdzogs pa rgyan lha brgyad/ dbu gtsug tu bya khyung rwa phrag tu nor bu 'bar ba/ de'i steng du 'ber lo rtsibs bzhi mu khyud dang bcas pa'i lte bar rdo rje rtse lnga gyen du bsgreng ba/ gtso bo'i thugs gar myud bcu gnyis bskor ba'i lte bar ayau dbus nas brtsam te g.yas bskor du/ ma tsa/ ru a/ ya sha ya na yig 'bru brgyad kyis bskor ba/ de'i phyi'i mu khyud la pad 'dab drug cu byas pa'i 'dab ma rer/ aX suX dṛX triX sreX duX zhes 'bru re
༄༅/ /dgod / de'i phyi mu khyud la 'dab ma bcu gnyis la rim bzhin mig rna ba/ sna/ lce/ lus/ yid/ gzugs/ sgra/ dri/ ro/ reg chos rnams dgod/ de'i phyi'i mu khyud la rus sbal gyi lus mchod rten gyis brgyan pa/ de'i phyi'i mu khyud la dregs pa skyil krung du bzhugs pa'i phyag g.yas la badzra/ g.yon la pā/ pus mo g.yas la ṇaṃ/ g.yon la hūṃX/ dbu'i thad nas g.yas skor du oX a kro ra tsa dhu ra bha dhur bha snying la phril phril/ oX a kro ra tsa tsitta ni sha sha la ya rbad/ oX badzra pā ṇaṃ hūm̐X zhes pas bskor/ de'i phyi'i mu khyud la ya ma'i phyag g.yas la ya/ g.yon la ma/ zhabs g.yas la ra/g.yon la tsa/ dbu gtsug nas g.yas skor du oX e ka ya ma/ he ka ya ma/ ghri ma ya ma sarba ha rbad/ gzir thums ni nan rbad/ trig nan rbad ya/ oX a kro te ka ya ma raka thums rbad/ oX e ka he ka
ma ma snying gzir thums ma tsa tri pa ti mā ra ya gzir thums rbad/ oX bo dhi tsitta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhar tu āX oX ru lu ru lu shrī he ru ka kro dhi shwa ri hūṃX/ ya ma ra tsa satwa me ya/ ya me do ru/ ṇa yo da ya/ ya da yo ni/ ra ya kṣe ya/ yakṣe yatstsha ni ra ma ya/ badzra kī li kī la ya hūṃX/ oX da ru ma hā kro dhī/ ma hā shwa ri trag tri ta kī li kī la ya/ dum dum/ bha lhan dza tarya thā/ bho bho san nā ga a ti pa ta i daX/ nī laX ba ra dha ra shan rā ram ni hūm̐X phaṭa/ oX hrī dbang dha ri padma ta krita badzra kro dhā ha ya ṅgha ba hu lu hu lu hūm̐X phaṭaX oX nyid zhi mu kha le kro dhī shwa ri bha ga padma rgyab bde klong 'dus 'dus/ na maXtsaṇḍa badzra kro dha ya hu lu hu lu/ tiṣṭha tisma bhanta bhanta ha na ha na/ a mṛ te hūm̐X phaṭaX oX badzra tsaṇḍa ma hā/ ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐X phaṭaX oX padma kro dhī shwa ri badzra kī li kī la ya/ mahā yakṣa ga la ru pa garma raX raX dzwa la raX hūm̐X phaṭaX oX nā ga du/ tsarnye tsan dhe/ mi li mi li/bhanta bhanta/ nā ga ni hūṃX phaṭaXswā hā:༷༷ de'i phyi'i mu khyud la 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad kyi dang por e kā he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya ma ra ya rbad/ gnyis pa la phaṭa ṭa du ṭa kha la breng srog chod dun dzaX gsum pa la sa ma ya su tra tri kha yod (yed )badzra pa du gtubs ram shag khyer/ bzhi pa la tri tsa pa la rwa tsa pa la hur ra tsa kha la du sad khyung breng rbad/ lnga pa la bāXrsha shu ni shu ni tri khas tsa khug sod sod chum dril rbad nas phaṭaX drug pa

༄tshi/ /snying la thod pa ru pa tra ya rbud/ snying la dum bum rbud/ snying rlang rbud/ thums pa ma la te rbud/ sarba duṣṭan sho ti ya rbud/ nag po tsitta sarba duṣṭan ma thang ku ru ya myags ya mu ya ma myags/ nag po tsitta lha khug / ling baX/ nag po tsitta thibs phur sod/ nis phur sod/ bya kaX sod/ shag ti rbad/ rtsa dur snying la sa ma ya/ snying thur rbod gtong la bhyo zlog ya/ oX shrī ma hā kā la gha na ghu ti yo zhi shwa ri sa ma ya hūm̐X dza dza bhyo oX shrī ma hā ka la ga na gu ya raX sirnyi hūX/ oX shrī ma hā kā la ga na gu ya sirnyi hūX phaṭaX de'i phyi'i mu khyud la phyogs mtshams brgyad du rdo rje bris pa'i mtshams g.yas zhal dkar po'i thad la sngags mgo phyi bstan gyi a ā ka kha ga gha nga / g.yon zhal dmar po'i thad i ī tsa tsha dza dzha nyaX phyag g.yon 'og ma'i thad u ā ṭa ṭha ḍa dha ṇa/ sus steng ri rwi ta thā da dha na/ zhabs g.yon gyi ngar thad '-i lī pa pha ba bha maX de bzhin du g.yas thad e au ya ra la waX g.yas kyi pus steng / o bla( sha ṣa sa hakṣaX phyag g.yas 'og ma'i thad/ aX a raktagiX de'i phyi'i mu khyud la me ri bri/ khang bu brtsegs pa zhes pa ri rab bang rim gnyis pa'i ngos la shrī ma hā kā la ye hūṃX hūṃX phaṭa phaṭaXswā hāX oX ro ru ro ru bhi tiṣṭha ba to〉 ka ma la rakṣa bī hūṃX bhyo hūṃXltoX oX ro ru ro ru bhi tiṣṭha ba tohrī ka ma la rakṣa sbyi hūṃX bhyo hūṃXltoX bang rim gsum par oX ma hā kā la bi ka la ra ṭi ta hūṃX phaṭaX bang rim bzhi par

༄tshi/ /bla ma dang 'jam dpal dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon gyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 'di la don gsum ste/ sa'i cho ga dang/ sta gon dang / dngos gzhi'o/ /de la dang po sa'i cho ga la'ang lnga ste/ brtag pa dang/ blang ba dang / sbyang ba dang/ byin gyis brlabs pa dang/ bsrung ba'o/ dang po brtag pa ni kha dang / dbyibs dang / 'dug pa la sogs pa brtag pa yin te/ sa dpyad gzhan dang 'dra'o/ /sa dpyad bzang po de blang ba la gsum ste/ snang ba la blang ba ni sa de'i bdag po la rin 'jal la blang / mi snang ba la blang ba ni/ sa phyogs der phyi'i mchod pa bshams la bdag nyid lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas phyi'i mchod pa dang gtor ma dang bcas pa byin gyi rlobs pa/ sngags drug phyag rgya drug de gzhan dang 'dra/ rgyas par byed na cha gsum btang/ mchod
