༄khu/ /ta sa ma ya shri ye hūṃX/ zhes bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang/ dri ma thams cad dag dbang bzhi thob/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyi gtso mdzad rigs lngas dbu brgyan par gyur/ oX pri shrī wi de wi lo ka ma hā tā re arghaX pra tītstsha ye swāhā la sogs kyis mchod/ oX phri thi wī de wi lo ka ma hā tā re e dam ba nyunti kha kha khā hi khā hi zhes pas gtor ma 'bul/ bka' bsgo ba ni/ skyobs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul gyi khyad par las/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dbang du gyur/ /shākya seng ge skyob pa yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi dpung bcom pas/ /de bzhin bdag kyang bdud las ni/ /rgyal bar bya phyir dkyil 'khor bri/ /sa yi lha mos dpang mdzod la/ /bdud rnams zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ /zhes brjod pas/ lha mo dga' ba'i mdangs phyung nas/ /khyod ni slob dpon dam pa yin sems can don byas dkyil 'khor gyis/ /zhes zer bar bsams la/ lha mo'i sngags ni/ āoX badzra u tiṣṭha ya hūṃX/ zhes pas/ ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa phye la/ ye shes pa nam mkha' la dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba ma tshang gyi bar du dpang du gzhug dam tshig pa sa la thim pas/ sa gzhi gser du khad kyis song bar bsams la/ sa sbyang ba la gnyis te/ ting nge 'dzin gyis sbyangs pa dang/ bya bas sbyang ba'o/ ting nge
'dzin gyi sbyang ba ni/ lag pa g.yas pa'i ser mo lnga rigs lnga yab yum tu bsgoms pa sa la bzhag ste/ oX hūm̐X trāX hrīX.āX mūX laX māX pyaX tāX/ zhes brjod pas/ dbus su rnam par snang mdzad yab yum/ shar du rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum/ /lho ru rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum/ /nub tu snang ba mtha' yas yab yum/ byang du don yod grub pa yab yum ma chags thabs kyi sbyor ba mdzad pas/ sbyor mtshams nas byang sems kyi bdud rtsi babs nas sa la thim pas/ sa phyogs de'i ma dag pa sbyangs te/ 'od kha dog lnga'i rang bzhin du gyur to/ /gnyis pa bya bas sbyangs ba ni/ sa bdag lto 'phye'i lte ba nas sa pus nub tsam brkos te ro lnga byung na ngan la rin po che'i rigs la sogs pa byung na bzang bas/ brkos pa'i sa des slar bkang la snga ma bas mtho na bzang / dma' na ngan/ brkos pa'i shul dar ba'i rnam lnga byugs la chus bkang ste me tog bcug la chu skyogs gang khyer te rtsa sngags bzlas shing shar phyogs su gom pa bdun phyin la tshur log ste bltas pa chu dma' ru song ba dang / me tog g.yon du 'khyil na ngan/ chu yang dma' ru ma song zhing/ me tog g.yas su 'khyil na bzang / chu sgra dang bcas pa la thim na gdon yod pa yin pas drag po'i sbyin sreg bya/ ro lnga 'dug na sa cha de dor nas gzhan du lto 'phye brtag pa sngar bzhin bya'o/ skabs 'dir chag chag gdab ste/ chang
༄༅/ /dang khrag la a mṛ ta/ chag chag gdab pa ni/ hūṃX dbang drag dmar smug 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ padma rakta 'od kyi bdud rtsi dang/ mkha' gsang rmad du byung ba'i bdud rtsi 'dis/ stong gsum thams cad dag par chag chag 'debs/ oX bā su ta maṇḍa la hūṃX/ oX bo dhi tsitta maṇḍa la hūṃX/ sa ma ya maṇḍa la hūṃX/ oX rakta maṇḍa la hūṃX/ ha ku ha ku maṇḍa la hūṃX/ zhes dal kun khyab par gdab bo/ de nas thig gdab pa ni/ bu mo grong pa'i chos kyis mdogs pas thig skud lnga so sor bkal te/ dri bzang gis byugs la/ dkar po oX las rnam par snang mdzad dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ yum nam mkha' dbyings phyug sku la 'khril bar gyur/ sngon po hūṃX las mi bskyod pa sngon po g.yas pa gnon dang g.yon rdo rje bsnams pa/ yum sangs rgyas spyan ma sku la 'khril bar gyur/ ser po traX las rin chen 'byung ldan ser po g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon rin po che bsnams pa/ yum ma ma kī dmar mo hrīXlas snang ba mtha' yas dmar po mnyam bzhag gi steng na/ padma dmar po bsnams pa/ yum gos dkar mo/ ljang gu a las don yod grub pa ljang gu g.yas skyabs sbyin g.yon rgya gram bsnams pa/ yum dam tshig sgrol ma/ bdag nyid gshon rje gshed kyi mig g.yas pa la ma las nyi ma dang/ mig g.yon āXlas zla bar gyur pa'i 'od zer lcags kyu
lta bus rigs lnga yab yum spyan drangs badzra sa ma ya dza dzaX dzaXhūṃX baX hoX srad bu so so la thim gnyis su med par gyur/ arghaX la sogs kyis mchod/ de nas bstod pa ni/ hūṃX snang stong rdo rje nam mkha' dbyings/ /chos dbyings rnam dag rdo rje'i sku/ /byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya mdzad/ /phyag 'tshal rnam par snang mdzad la/ /gzung 'dzin rdo rje brtan pa sa/ /me long ye shes rdo rje'i sku/ /sa gnon chen po'i phyag rgya mdzad/ /phyag 'tshal mi bskyod rdo rje la/ /rin chen rdo rje 'bar ba'i me/ /mnyam nyidangu mchog sbyin chen: phyag 'tshal rin chen 'byung gnas la/ /mtha' yas rdo rje chos kyi don/ /sor rtog: ting 'dzin chen po'i phyag rgya mdzad / / phyag 'tshal snang ba mtha' yas la/ /don grub rdo rje bskyod pa'i rlung/ /bya sgrub ye shes: skyabs sbyin chen po'i: phyag 'tshal rdo rje don grub la/ /zhes pas bstod/ oX a rkyo a rgyo a nu ga ta sarba dharmā spha ra a nu pra iṣṭa/ sarba dharmā adhyaX na a nu pra kriṣṭa/ sarba dharmā oX āXhūṃX zhes bzlas pa bya/ hūṃX 'jig rten khams ni ma lus la/ /rgyal ba'i sras po 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khosar ma lus kun/ /byang chub sems ni gcig tu gyur/ /zhes pas skud pa lnga phyogs gcig tu dril la ye shes lnga'i srad bur bsam/ de nas thig gdab pa ni/ slob dpon shar la slob ma nub/ /slob dpon lhor blta slob ma byang/ /
༄tsho/ /tshangs thig thig skud slob ma 'am gnyis ni gdab par bya/ slob dpon shar lho slob ma nub byang blta/ /slob dpon byang shar slob ma lho nub blta/ /zur thig gnyis po gdab bya ste/ /gzungs ma mtshan ldan gyis 'then la/ 'di skad brjod kyin gdab/ hūm̐X stong gsum brdal ba yum gyi gzhal yas su/ /thugs rdze 'gyur med yab kyi thig gdab pas/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med byang sems kyi/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor mkha' la gsal/ /hūm̐ bi sha bi shuddhi dzñā na tsakra maṇḍa la hūṃX/ zhes mkha' thig dang sa thig rim pas gdab bo/ /de nas gzung ba ni/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor dbus su 'dug ste/ bdag bskyed rdzogs par bsgom/ phyi nang gi mchod pa 'bul/ bzlas pa yan chad byas la/ lce hūm̐X las rdo rje bskyed/ rdo rje dril bu spos 'dzin pas/ ma lus phyogs na bzhugs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang gzhin rje gshed kyi lha tshogs rnams/ /ma lus bdag la dgongs su sol/ /bdag ni rdo rje che ge mo/ /'dir ni dkyil 'khor bri bar 'tshal/ /gshin rje gshed tshogs kun byon la/ /'dir ni dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas gnang ba byin par bsam mo/ /de nas slob ma bzhir bsgoms la/ mchod bstod bya ste/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ shar nas de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba/ /de
bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /chos kun bdag med pa yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /lho nas mtshan nyid thams cad yang dag rdzogs/ /mtshan nyid min pa thams cad spangs/ /kun tu bzang po sku yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad dug sol/ /nub nas zhi ba mchog las byung/ /ye shes spyod pa rnam sbyong mdzad/ /kun tu bzang po gsung gi mchog/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /byang nas sems can kun gyi sems chen po/ /rang bzhin dag cing dri ma med/ /kun bzang thugs mchog kha lo sgyur/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba gdab/ de nas lag pa gnyis kyi rdo rje khu tshur gyis mdzub mo gnyis brkyang la rtse sprad pa 'og tu phyogs pa sgyi bor bzhag la/ hūm̐X badzra uṣṭha zhes brjod la/ bsgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor nam mkha' la 'degs/ de nas bdag nyid gshon rje gshed po zhal gcig phyag gnyis par bskyed pa'i mig g.yas pa ma las nyi ma/ g.yon pa ṭa las zla ba/ mig 'bras gnyis hūm̐X las dus mtha'i me 'bar bas/ phyogs kun tu gdangs mig blta zhing rkang mthil a las rdo rje rgya gram du bsam la/ lus ngag sems la gnas pa yi/ /bgegs kyi tshogs rnams kun nyon cig /nga ni dpal ldan gshin rje gshed/ /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo rab sbyar bas/ /rdo rje 'bar ba'i lus kyis ni/ /lus
༄tshi/ /sogs ma lus 'joms par byed/ /ces stangs stabs dang bcas pas byang shar du song ste/ gang su dag lha dang / lha ma yin dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / yi dwags dang sha za dang / sa bdag dang / gnod byed 'byung po gdon gyi tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad 'dir skad cig kyang mi gnas par gzhan du dengs shig sa phyogs 'dir bdag rdo rje slob dpon che ge mo zhes bya ba sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i ye shes thob par bya ba'i phyir dang/ slob ma che ge mo zhes bya ba mngon par byang chub rdzogs pa'i bya ba'i don du bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon gyi dkyil 'khor chen po 'bri bas gang dag su mi 'gro ba rnams kyi lus ngag rdul phran bzhin du brlag par bya'o/ zhes lan gsum brjod cing rdo rje dril bu thogs te/ hūṃX sgra stangs stabs dang bcas pa dkyil 'khor lan gsum bskor zhing khro bo'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros la bgegs bskrad/ dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi'i bar rdo rje'i rang bzhin du byin rlabs te/ rdo rje dang mtshon cha sna tshogs kyi gur gyi steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad 'khor bar bsam mo/ /spros pa la dga' na khro bo rol ba'i gar gyi phyag rgya rdzogs par bya/ spros pa chung ba la dga' na bskor mi dgos te bsam pas kyang 'grub bo/ /de nas phur pa gdab pa ni/ byang shar mtshams su
bgegs bkug la/ seng ldeng gi phur pa bsangs sbyangs te sras mchog ya ma rā dza/ sku stod khro bo chen po la sku smad phur pa'i dbal/ dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba bskyed pa de/ lag pa g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyis bzung g.yas rdo rje tho bas brdungs/ spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar phub nas dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi la bsgrags pas/ g.yo 'gul med cing bde ba chen po'i ngo bor bsams te/ oX gha gha gha ta ya gha ta ya sarba duṣṭan phaṭaX ki la yā/ kī la ya/ sarba pā baX phaṭaX hūṃX hūṃX hūṃX badzra kī la ya/ badzra dha ra adzñā pa ya ti/ sarba bighā na/ kā ya wā ka tsitta badzra ki li kī la ya hūṃX phaṭaX ces gdab ste/ de rnams ni nub dang po'i cho ga'o / nub gnyis pa sta gon la gsum ste/ lha dang bum pa/ slob ma'o/ de la dang po lha sta gon du bya ba ni/ bdag nyid yi dam lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas lha gnas rnams su gtso bo la dril/ thig le gru bzhi/gzhan rnams la zlum po dang / lha so so'i sngags dang / me tog gi tshom bu bkod la de'i mthar mchod pa lnga bshams te/ chas gos dang rgyan sprad la dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor 'dug nas bdag bskyed bsgom/ lha gnas rnams su ya ma kro dha a a zhes pa las gtso bo yab yum ya ma rā dza phyag na rdo rje/ rus sbal rngams pa bya khyung rgyal po rgyan gyi lha brgyad par gyur/ zla gam gsum la mdun du yaXlas tshe bdag nag po yab yum/
༄tshi/ /g.yas su ru las srog bdag dmar po yab yum/ g.yon du sa las 'chi bdag nag po yab yum/ shar du te las ya ma rā dza yab yum/ lho ru ka las myos byed 'bar ba yab yum/ nub tu ya las arya dmar po/ byang du māX las ral pa tshal dgu/ shar du sa las dung gi mon pa/ lho ru ye las lcags kyi mon pa yab yum/ nub tu a las bse yi mon pa/ byang du a las gser gyi mon pa/ shar lhor ne las bdud he le khyab par lho nub tu a las nag po 'dzum med/ nub byang du nee las so gdar 'khrig pa/ byang shar duspru las ral pa spyi ching/ shar nas brtsams te chos 'khor du/ du las be ba sa stu/ du las nor bu dge 'phel/ ne las ser nag 'joms byed/ du las bye ba dgu khri/ ne las yakṣa za byed/ a las gang ba kun 'joms/ i las ngang pa stobs ldan/ u las sbrul mgo kun 'dzin/ e las gtum po dud kha oX las kha 'bar ral cig/ aX las ho ban srog 'dzin/ ra la rakta glog phreng/ shar sgor dkar po snying 'byin/ lho sgor mgon po nag po/ nub sgor yab rje nag po/ byang sgor sku mchog dmar po rnams yab yum dang bcas par gyur/ lha tshogs de rnams kyi gnas gsum du yi ge 'bru gsum/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas sngar nam mkhar btegs pa'i ye shes pa spyan drangs dzaXhūm̐X bam̐ hoX gnyis su med par gyur pa'i
thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi dbur brgyan/ mchod bstod bzlas pa yan chad byas la gsol ba btab pas pus mo sa la btsug nas/ spos dang rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ gnyis pa ye shes las byung bas/ khyab bdag dngos kun bdag nyid can/ /ston pa gtso bo'i gshin rje'i gshed/ /gsod byed yum dang yang dag ldan/ /phyogs mtshams gshed bzhi yab yum dang mon pa pho mo bdud bzhi sogs/ /ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /slob ma 'di la phan pa dang/ /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa dang/ /rdo rje can bdag ces bya ba/ /nang par dkyil 'bor bri bar 'tshal rjes su brtse bas nyer dgongs te/ /byin gyi rlabs par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes brjod gnang ba sbyin par bsams la/ slar yang dag par mchod de/ sngar gyi sngags dang phyag rgyas dkyil 'khor nam mkhar bteg ste/ de rnams ni lha sta gon gyi cho ga'o/ gnyis pa bum pa sta gon ni/ rin po che'i bum pa phyi nang kun chus dag par bkrus te/ yungs dkar gyis bgegs bskrad/ gu gul gyi dud pas bdug/ dri zhim po dang ldan pa'i chus lha'i mtshan ma bri/ kha rgyan dang mgul chings dang bcas pa bya/ kha rgyan gyi steng du bdud rtsi lnga sbyar ba'i chang gis bkang ba'i thod pa bzhag de steng du rdo rje la gzungs thag btags te bzhag
༄༅/ /la / nang du bum rdzas/ nas gro 'bras so ba ma shas zhe sdang dag byed do/ gser sbrang rtsi mar til lan tshwa ste gti mug dag byed do/ gan ka ri slo tres rgya tsho'i sbu ba dbang lag shu dag dkar po ste 'dod chags dag byed do/ /gser dngul zangs lcags dung ste nga rgyal dag tsandan ga bur du ruṣka kha che dzā ti ste phrag dog dag byed do/ de rnams blugs la chu gtsang mas bkang ste/ a mṛ tas bsang / swa bhā was stong par sbyangs pa'i ngang las/ bum pa la dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ de'i ngang las muX mthing nag gcig tu gyur/ de yongs su gyur pa las tri shu lar gyur/ oX āXhūm̐X pe ta li rakṣa rakṣa sa mānta hūm̐X/ zhes brjod pas de yum du gyur/ yum gyi bha gar bhūX gcig tu gyur/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus 'od du zhu ba las rin po che'i bum pa/ phyi bum pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa/nang ye shes bcud kyi gzhal yas su gyur/ oX ya ma kro dhā hūm̐X zhes brjod pas/ de'i dbus su sna tshogs padma nyi zla'i steng du phyag rgya zil gnon sku mdog mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi dur khrod kyis chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ rtsa ba'i lha lnga rgyan gyi lha brgyad la sogs pa dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams chu la nya ldang ba'i tshul du bzhugs par gyur/ rtsa ba'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas te yungs dkar la btab nas bum
par blugs pas/ sngags kyi 'od zer gzungs thag la 'khril te bum par song ba dang / lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ gtso bo yab yum sbyor ba mdzad pas sbyor mtshams nas byang sems kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas/ chu thams cad byang sems kyi bdud rtsir gyur/ bzlas pa'i mthar lha tshogs thams cad kyang 'od du zhu ba las ye shes lha'i bdud rtsi chen por gyur par bsam mo/ /de nas oX swa bhā was stong par sbyangs pa'i ngang las baX las padma/ āXlas zla ba'i dkyil 'bor gyi steng du/ bhūX las rin po che phyi bum pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa/ nang ye shes bcud kyi gzhal yas su gyur pa'i dbus su/ baX las sna tshogs padma'i lte bar ma las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃX ljang sngon de las 'od zer 'phros/ don byas tshur 'dus 'od du zhu ba las khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa sku mdog ljang sngon zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje bsnams pa/ g.yon sdig mdzub mdzad pa/ rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs gsol ba/ me ri me dpung gi nang na zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i sgyi bor oX / mgrin par āX thugs gar hūm̐X/ hūm̐X de las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min nas khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpas bskor ba spyan drangs badzra sa ma ya dzaX dzaXhūm̐X ba hoX arghaX
༄tsho/ /la sogs kyis mchod bstod bya/ rigs lngas dbang bskur/ don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ hūṃX dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /mthu stobs gcig tu bsdus pa yi/ /rdo rje khro bo'i sku ston pa/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /āoX badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa lam̐ ha na ha na hūm̐X phaṭa4༷༷ zhes bzlas pas brgya rtsa gcig bya/ sngags kyi 'od zer gzungs thag la brten nas bum pa'i nang du song bas khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i thugs rgyud bskul/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas la mchod pa phul/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i bcud bsdus chu rgyun gyi rnam pas/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ bum pa'i chu dang 'dres pa las/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin tu gyur te/ sems can thams cad kyi las dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa thams cad sbyong bar byed pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur te/ khro bo de nyid kyang 'od du ma zhu bar byang shar mtshams su bzhugs nas las thams cad bsgrub par gyur/ bum pa ni rin po che'i bum pa sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha rgyan gyi thugs gar thim yang bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i steng du gzungs thag btags pa'i rdo rje bzhag ste/ bum pa dkyil 'khor chen po'i dbang ldan phyogs su bzhag go /gsum pa slob ma sta gon ni/ slob ma lhag par gnas pa yin te/ slob dpon gyi rnam par
bzhag pa dang / slob ma'i rnam par dag pa dang / cho ga dngos dang gsum las/ dang po ni rgyud las mang du gsungs kyang / dbang dang gdam ngag brgyud rim ma chad cing / cho ga'i lag len la mkhas pa des bsgyur tu rung la/ slob ma rnam dag mang du yod na'ang / de lta bu dus kyi shugs nas dka' bas/ sems can gyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par 'dod pa'i blo yod pa rnams rjes su 'dzin par gsungs pas/ de lta bu dang ldan pa'i slob ma rnams la bum chus khrus bya zhing / gos gsar pa gon/ rgyan gdags/ maṇḍal 'bul du bcug la slob dpon dang gtso bo gnyis su med pa la gsol ba lan gsum gdab pa ni/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /bla ma'i sku la skyabs su mchi/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin gsung / /bla ma'i gsung la skyabs su mchi/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin thugs/ /bla ma'i thugs la skyabs su mchi/ /sangs rgyas grong khyer nyams dga' bar/ /'jam dpal rdo rje 'bor lo yi/ /snying po'i dkyil 'bor 'di ru ni/ /mgon po bdag nyid gzhug par mdzod/ /dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa yi/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /mgon po chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen
༄༅/ /po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon po bdag ni gzhug par 'tshal/ /zhes phyag 'tshal te me tog 'thor ro/ /de nas slob dpon gyis gsang sngags kyi theg pa la blo dgug pa'i phyir/ gnang ba sbyin pa ni/ bu tshur theg pa chen po la/ /khyod ni tshul chen snod dang ldan/ /gsang sngags spyod pa'i cho ga ni/ /khyod la yan lag bshad par bya/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang / /de bzhin yang dag ma byon dang / /da ltar byung ba rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'gro la phan phyir bzhugs pa dang / /de dag kun gyi gsang sngags kyi/ /cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen nas/ /dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i mtshan ma brnyes gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med de/ /skyobs pa dang ldan 'jam dpal gyi/ /bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa/ /dpung chen dag kyang de yis bcom/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yi blo gros 'di gyis shig /ces yan lag bdun pa'ang bya/ de nas mthun mong ma yin pa'i sdom pa bzung ba ni/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /ma lus bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /dus 'di nas ni sangs rgyas bar/ /bla med bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis skyed par bgyi/ /sangs rgyas 'jam
dbyangs sdom pa la/ /nam du yang ni mi spang ngo / rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /padma'i rigs mchog chen po la/ /phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos kyis gzung bar bgyi las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las rnams ci nus bgyi/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gi sdom pa ma lus gzung ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis bsgrol/ /dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing / sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ /ces sdom pa gzung de nas slob ma bsrung ba ni/ /dri'i thig le gnas gsum du reg ste/ snying khar reg cing / hūm̐X las rdo rje sngon po hūm̐X gis mtshan pa/ mgrin par āXlas padma dmar po āXs mtshan pa/ spyi bor oX las 'khor lo dkar po oX gyis mtshan par bskyed la/ yas mar reg cing sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rnam par spyan drangs la gnyis su med par stims/ arghaX la sogs pas mchod/ de nas so lhang byin dbab pa ni/ so shong sor bcu gnyis pa dri bzang po
༄tshi/ /byugs shing / rtser me tog gis bcings pa la 'bru brgyad pa'i bzlas pa bya ste/ maṇḍal tshom bu lnga pa la/ kha byang du bltas pas/ so dang thal mo sbyar bas bzung ste/ sdig pa bor ba bsams la oX badzra ha sa ha/ zhes bor bas rtse mo shar du bltas na zhi ba 'grub/ lhor rgyas pa/ nub tu dbang / byang du drag po/ mtshams su las phran tshogs 'grub/ steng du bstan na mchog gi dngos grub/ 'og tu bstan pa rig 'dzin thob bo/ des ni so shing dor ba'o/ /de nas khyor chu byin pa ni/ baX las byung ba'i dri bzang po'i chu la/ oX shrīXbi shuddhi dharma sarba pa baX ninyu phya sho rha ya/ bakki sa long a sa na ya hūṃX/ zhes pa dang bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags lan bdun bzlas/ rtsa sngags kyang bzlas la khyor chu byin no/ de nas kyang ku sha dang srung skud byin te/ ku sha che chung gnyis la bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags bzlas te lag tu byin la/ ku sha gtsang ma'i rtswa mchog 'di/ /dngos grub rtags mtshan gsal bya'i phyir/ /khyod nyid nyal ba'i sngas gdan mdzod/ /oX badzra tikṣa na baX/ zhes che ba dag gdan dang chung ba sngas su byin no/ srung skud ni tshon sna lnga'i srad bu la rdo rje'i mdud pa gsum byas te/ hūm̐X las ye shes kyi srad bur bskyed/ sta gon lha'i thugs ka nas ye shes pa skud pa'i rnam par spyan drangs la stims/ ye shes lnga ldan srad bu 'di/ /sku gsung thugs kyi mdud par ldan/ /
g.yas g.yon dpung par bcings pa yis/ /sgo gsum bar chad kun bsrung thekhog /las sngags kyi gshams la/ oX badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūṃX phaṭa4༷༷ zhes pas pho'i g.yon dang / mo'i g.yas su bcings so/ de nas spro ba bskyed pa'i phyir chos bshad de 'jig rten khams ni ma lus par/ thams cad mkhyen pa 'byung mi 'gyur/ /u dum wa ra'i me tog bzhin/ /rgya lam du ni res 'ga' zhig/ /'byung 'gyur yang ni 'byung mi srid/ /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba/ /de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste/ /gnyis med zab mo'i theg pa 'di/ /sems can sangs rgyas byed pa yi/ /bskal pa grangs med mang po ni/ /sngon du byas pa'i rnam smin gang/ /de kun zad par 'gyur ba mang/ /zab mo'i dkyil 'khor mthong ba sogs/ /zhes pa dang / gzhan yang chos bshad ci rigs par bya'o/ /de ni slob ma sta gon la gnas pa ste/ nub gnyis pa'i cho ga'o/ gsum pa dngos gzhi'i cho ga la'ang drug ste/ tshon byin gyi rlabs shing dkyil gabor bri ba ni/ rdul mtshon sna lnga so sor blugs la/ rigs lnga'i sa bon rnams kyang tshon mdog dang mthun par bri ste/ dkar po āoX las rnam snang yab yum/ sngon po hūm̐X las mi bskyod pa yab yum/ ser po trī la rin chen 'byung gnas yab yum/ dmar po hrīX las snang mtha' yab yum/ ljang gu āXlas don yod grub pa yab yum rnams su gyur pa'i spyi bor
༄༅/ /oX / mgrin par āX thugs gar hūm̐X hūm̐X las 'od 'phros 'og min nas rigs lnga yab yum spyan drangs/ gnyis su med par thim/ yang hūm̐X las 'od zer 'phros/ rang rang gi rigs bdag gis dbur brgyan oX ratna ma tri tsitta sa ma ya hūṃX/ zhes brgya tshad bzlas/ rigs lnga yab yum sbyor ba mdzad pas sbyor mtshams nas byang chub sems kyi rgyun babs/ tshon so so la thim pas rin po che'i sna lnga las grub pa'i rdul tshon tu gyur par bsams la tshon so so la/ sems can khams rnams dag bya'i phyir/ 'di ni chos dbyings byin rlabs so/ sems can: 'di ni me long : sems can: 'di ni mnyam nyid: sems can: 'di ni sor rtogs: sems can: 'di ni bya grub: zhes tshon byin gyi rlabs pa'o/ de nas dkyil 'khor bri ba ni/ dbus su gru gsum mthing nag zla gam dmar po zlum po/ thod mkhar chen po bzhi/ lcang mkhar brgyad/lcags mkhar bcu gnyis/ mu khyud la 'ob chen bcu drug gru chad bzhi ljang gu khyams phyogs tshon sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi rigs dang bstun/ de'i tpū rim rnams dkyil 'khor gzhan dang mthun par bri'o/ lha gnas rnams su gsung yig 'bru dang thugs phyag mtshan dgod/ dkyil 'khor sgrub pa ni/ mtshams bcad/ bshags pa bya ba nas bstod pa yan chad las rim gsal sgron ltar bya/ de nas banta byin gyi rlabs pa ni/
padma maṇḍal ka swā la hūm̐/ zhes pas banta padma rā ga las grub pa yangs shing rgya che ba 'jig rten gyi gtos dang mnyam pa'i nang du/ phyag rgya zil gnon gyi lha tshogs thams cad sol ba'i me bus pa lta bu sku mdog dmar po g.yas thams cad rang rtags kyi phyag mtshan bsnams pa/ g.yon thams cad dngos grub dbang gi bum pa bsnams pa/ dur khrod kyi chas brgyad dang/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ de rnams kyi spyi bor oX / mgrin par āX thugs gar hūṃX/ hūṃX de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'og min nas dam tshig 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaXhūṃX baX hoXs ye shes pa gnyis su med par bstims/ rang rang la rigs bdag gis dbu brgyan yang de rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas snang srid thams cad de lta bu'i sku/ sgra ru grags pa thams cad sngags kyi rang sgrar gyur par bsams la/ e ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya sarba siddhi siddhi hūṃX/ zhes sum brgya tsam zhig bzlas pas/ yang hūṃX las 'od zer 'phros/ mchog thun mong gi dngos grub dang/ snang ba lha'i dkyil 'bor du gyur pa thams cad 'od zer gyis bsdus te/ bhanta'i nang gi lha tshogs la thim par bsam mo/ de nas tshe'i bum pa byin gyi rlabs pa ni/ bhūX las rin po che bum pa/ phyi bum pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa/ nang shel gyi gzhal yas kyi dbus su/ shel gyi padma 'dab ma stong dang ldan
༄tsho/ /pa'i lte bar nyi zla brtsegs pa'i steng du phyag rgya zil gnon gyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad sku mdog dkar po gangs la nyi ma shar ba lta bu/ dur khrod kyi chas dang rin po che sna tshogs kyis spras pa/zhi khro'i cha byad can/ phyag g.yas thams cad rang rtags kyi phyag mtshan/ g.yon thams cad 'chi med tshe'i bum pa bsnams pa/ thugs ka nas 'chi med tshe'i rang bzhin āXdakar po la bzlas pa'i sngags kyis bskor ba dbu'i gtsug na bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag tu med pa sku mdog dkar po bzhengs sku ru yod pa/ phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi steng na 'chi med tshe'i bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa/ dbu'i gtsug na tshe dpag med dam rigs lngas dbu brgyan pa de'i spyi bor oX / mgrin par āX thugs gar hūm̐X/ hūm̐X de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs/ gnyis su med par thim par gyur pa'i thugs ga'i hūṃX gi steng du yi ge āX dkar po la bzlas bya'i sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas snang srid thams cad tshe dpag med kyi sku/ sgra thams cad sngags kyi sgra 'brug stong ldir ba tsam du gyur/oX e ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya oX badzra ā yuXdzñā na g.yu tshe ā yuXdzñā na sarba siddhi siddhi hūṃX dzaX zhes pa dang / oX badzra ā yuXdzñā na bhūX dṛ dza sarba ā yuX pha la sarba siddhi siddhi hūṃX/ zhes stong la sogs pa bzlas pas
sngags kyi 'od zer gzungs thag la brten nas bum par song bar/ lha tshogs thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'jig rten las 'das pa dang ma 'das pa'i tshe dang bsod nams bkrag dang gzi mdangs thams cad snang ba lha'i rang bzhin du gyur pa thams cad 'od zer gyis bsdus te/ tshe bum nang gi lha tshogs la thim/ lha tshogs rnams kyang 'od du zhu bas 'chi med rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsam/ de nas dngos grub zhal zas ni dbus su 'brang rgyas zla gam mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa bsgrub par byed pa shar dkar po zlum po zhi ba/ lho ru ser po gru bzhi rgyas pa/ nub tu dmar po zla gam dbang gi byang du ljang gu gru gsum drag po'i las ma lus par bsgrub par byed pa bkod de/ de rnams la dbus kyi 'brang rgyas la oX / shar hūm̐X/ lhor āoṃ/ nub hrīX byang āXrnams bsams la de rnams las 'od zer 'phros pas 'jig rten khams kyi dngos grub kyi bcud thams cad bsdus nas zhal zas la thim par bsam mo/ /mar me dang phyi nang gi mchod rdzas byin gyi rlabs pa ni spyi dang mthun/ tshig gis gsal gdab pa ni/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa rgya mtsho dang bdud rtsi dza gad gtor ma rakta sbyar/ dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis rnam sprul rnams/ dkyil 'khor 'di yi rgyan du bzhes su gsol/ sarba sañtsa a mṛ ta
༄tshi/ /sa ma ya tiṣṭha dzaX oX ma hā ba ling ta sa ma ya: oX ma hā rakta mu la rakta sa: oX dzñā na a wa le ki te sa: oX badzra ā yu dzñā na sa: padma bhanta ka pā la ba linta sa ma ya tiṣṭha dzaX de nas rgyan gyi rdzas bkod de/byams pa stag gi bla re/ snying rje zhing chen gyi yol ba dang gdugs/ ba yi ban phran tsitta'i phreng bas brgyan/ btang snyoms gyi rgyu zhags ha ta dang/ bhanta bcud phor dur khrod chas/ dkyil 'khor 'di rgyan du bzhugs su gsol/ zhes dgod de/ de nas dkyil 'khor sgrub pa ni/ mtshams bcad nas tshogs yan chad tshang bar las rim gsal sgron ltar byas la/ slob dpon bdag nyid 'jug pa ni/ rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo gnyis su med par bsam la/ 'og nas ji ltar byung ba'i cho gas dbang rnams rdzogs par blangs pa'i rjes su slob ma 'jug par bya ste/ slob ma rnams yol ba'i phyi rol du/ garma las mkhan gyis las bum gyis khrus bya/ bgegs bskrad de sterdzob mar las bum gyi chu 'thor/ las sngags kyi gsham la swa bha wa btags la bsang sbyangs te/ rang gi zhal du zhugs/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib dag/lus dri ma med pa 'od kyi phung por gyur pa de sbyor mtshams nas byung ste/ mdun du rnam par snang mdzad kyi skur bsam/ sku gsung thugs byin gyi rlabs so/ ye shes lngas dbang bskur te/ oX tsakṣu bhanta spha ra ṇa ye hūṃX
gis mig dar dang/ ā kham wi ra hūm̐X gis me tog byin te/ maṇḍal phul la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ hoX khyab bdag ye shes 'jam dpal gyi/ /lhun gyi grub pa'i pho brang du/ /bdag cag 'jug par 'tshal lags kyis thugs rjes yongs su bzung du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba gdab/ de nas lan du slob dpon gyis/ rigs kyi bdag po'i dkyil 'khor du 'jug par 'dod pa'i bu khyod nyon/ las rnams rim gyis bsgrod la bla med thegs mchog 'bras bu 'byung/ /mngon spyod las kyi sangs rgyas kyi/ /bstan pa dam pa bsrung pa'i phyir/ /'jam dpal sku yi dkyil 'khor nas/ /dbyings dang byang sems sprul pa yi/ /gzhin rje'i tshogs kun gnas pa yin/ /'jigs med zhum pa med pa yis/ /dkyil 'khor 'di la 'jug nas sam/ /zhes dri/ yang slob dpon gyis/ bu khyod su yin gang la dga'/ /zhes dri de'i lan slob mas/bdag ni skal pa bzang po lags/ bde ba chen po la dga'o/ /zhes zhu/ slob dpon gyis slob ma'i spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ dril bu gsil zhing/ oX sarba yo ga tsitta u pa ta ya mi/ su ra te sa ma ya stuX ho siddhi badzra ya tha su khaX/ zhes pa dang/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad byin gyi rlabs par 'gyur ro/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba'i dam tshig 'di ni/ dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams
༄༅/ /la smra bar mi bya'o/ ma dad pa yang mi bya'o/ zhes brjod cing ayau rings kyis bgegs bskrad la/ hūm̐ 'khor ba'i sems can thams cad kun/ /rgyud lnga lam gyis sgo bcad de/ /mtho ris thar pa'i sgo phye nas bla med gnas su drang bgyi'o/ /oX badzra sa ma ya dza dzaX zhes brjod la/ rdo rje nas bzung ste/ slob ma la gdong g.yog dang bcas pa yol ba'i nang du drang bar bya'o/ de nas slob dpon gyi dkyil 'khor nub sgor 'dug ste/ shar nas blta ste/ hūṃX/ drag po e yi gzhal yas khang/ /pho brang lhun grub dkyil 'khor nas/ /zil gnon dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bzhugs/ /shar lho nub byang sgo bzhi nas/ /rnam par thar pa'i rta babs las/ /drag po'i dkyil 'khor sgo phyes shig e maṇḍal tsakra hūm̐ pra be shya phaṭa4༷༷ ces sgo dbye/ 'jigs byed drag po'i dkyil 'khor du zhes pa nas brda' phyag 'tshal/ zhes pa nas dam bca' ba rnams las byang ltar byas la/ de nas dam la bzhag pa bzhi'i sgo nas dam la bzhag ste/ phan yon gyi sgo nas bzhag pa ni/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su bzhugs so/deng ngas ye shes bskyed par bya'o/ ye shes gang khyod de bzhin gshegs pa'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan ltar smos kyang : dgos/ 'di ni khyod kyi dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams la smra
bar mi bya'o/ dam tshig la yang 'da' bar mi rung ngo/ 'di ni khyod kyi dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba rnams la smras na/ dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re/ nyes dmigs sgo nas bzhag pa ni/ snying gar rdo rje bzhag la/de yang 'jam dpal rbesna rje nyid/ /khye1da kyi snying la yang dag gnas/ /gal te tshul 'di smra ba ni/ /de ma thag tu bral te gshegs/ a mañdza shri hūṃX/ phan yon dang nyesadamigs gnyisaka'i sgo nasabazhag pa ni/ sman phud dang las bum gang rung gi chu khyor gang byin la/ /'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das nas bsreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub 'byung / /rdo rje dam tshig chu 'thung zhig / oX badzra a mri ta u ta ka ṭha/ bla ma'i bka' nyan sgo nasdam la bzhag pa ni/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ deng phan chad khyod kyi phyag rgya zil gnon nga yin gyis nga la brnyes par ma byed cig gal te brnyes par gyur na bde ba spangs nas 'chi ba'i dus bya ste/ sems can dmyal ba chen por lhung bar gyur ta re/ zhesabarjod/ de nasaye shesapa dbab pa ni/ slob ma rnams langs te thal mo spyi bor sbyar te/ rkang mthil du yaX las rlung gi dkyil 'khor kha dog sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can/ g.yon pa ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ sgrom su raX las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po raX gyis mtshan pa/ lte bar baX las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po baX gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du yi ge j-i cig bsam/ spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu gar yi ge
༄༅/ /hrīXdakar po mgo thur du bstan pa zhig bsam ste/ ngag tu bla ma dang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / dpa' bo mkha' 'gros thams cad kyis byin rlabs kyis dpal 'jam dpal rgyal pos rdo rje bdag la dbab par gyur cig /ces lan gsum brjod pas rkang mthil gyi yaX las rlung byung ste/ me spar lte ba'i chu bkol dzaX gros spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga'i hrīXzhu bas/ lus thams cad ye shes kyi bdud rtsi skya mer gyis khengs par bsam/ rang dang slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo thams cad kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i khams thams cad sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad bsam gyis mi khyab pas khengs par gyur pa de dag thams cad kyang phyag rgya zil gnon gyi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs su gyur nas/ rang gi sgyi gtsug nas mar bar ma chad par babs nas thim par bsam zhing/ las sngags kyi bshams la oX ra rā tsa la sa tsa la ya a be sha ya a be sha ya a dzwa la sa ma ya tiṣṭha dzaX zhes brjod cing spos dang gu gul gyi dud pas bdug rol mo bsgrags pas sku gsung thugs phebs ba'i rtags yongs bar yang gsungs so/ /de nasadakyil 'bor bstan pa ni/ mig dar dang bcasate dkyil 'bor lta ru gzhug ste/ kha mdog ji ltar mthong dris pas/ dkar po/ ser po/ dmar po/ ljang
gu nag po/ kha dog sna tshogs pa'o zhes zer ba bzhin du/ zhi ba dang / rgyas pa/ dbang / drag po/ mngon spyod/ las sna tshogs pa'i dngos grub thob bo zhesarim par bzhad de/ me tog dor ba ni/ slob mas lag pa thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du me tog thogs la dkyil 'bor gtso bo la dmigs te dor/ slob dpon gyisa'adi skad brjod/ yang dag pa yi dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /bdag 'dis slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ /lha rnams kyi ni rigs ji bzhin/ /de ltar bsod nams ji bzhin shog / pra tiṣṭha badzra hoX de de nas slob dpon gyis me tog slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag la/ me tog gang la babs pa'i lha de khyod kyi lhag pa'i lha 'di zhes bya ba/ yin no/ zhes ngo sprad cing mar me gcig las gnyis chad pa'i tshul du/ slob ma'i spyi bor thim par bsam zhing/ oX pra ti spyohā stuX/ i maX sarba ma hā bā la sems dpa' stobs po che khyod kyis zungs shig / cesapa ni cod pan gyi dbang ngo/ de nasagadong g.yogs 'grol zhing dkyil khor bstan pa ni/ slob ma'i mig gnyis la rdo rje reg cing oX re bsam ste/ 'jam dpal rdo rje nyid kyis khyod/ /de ring phan chad mig phye'o/ /bla na med pa rdo rje'i mig /thams cad mig ni phye bar 'gyur he badzra sa sha khiX/ dzñā na tsakṣu hūṃX a swā hā/ zhesapas mig dar bsal la/ dkyil 'oshesar bzang po 'di la 31sa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rigs su 'khrungs/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyi rlabs/ /'a11 ba phun lhangogs
༄༅/ /dngos grub kyang / khyed la yang dag phyogs par 'gyur/ /dngos grub thob phyir dam tshig skong / /gsang sngags la yang brtson par bgyis/ /sgo ba bzhi nas brtsams nas ni/ /gtso bo la ni thugs gi bar bstan pa'i dkyil 'khor gzhug pa yin/ zhesaltar gzhug go/ de nasadakyil gsor gyi de nyid dang lha'i de nyid bstan pa ni/ phyag rgya gsal sgron las shes par bya'o/ /de nas sngags kyi bzlas lung byin pa ni/ /slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo gnyis su med pa'i sku gsung thugs las sngags tshan gsum 'od zer dkar dmar mthing kha'i rnams par byung nas/ slob ma'i gnas gsum du thim par bsam la/ hūm̐X gsang sngags rgyal po 'di dag ni/ /'khor lo'i 'phro 'du gsal sgoms te/ /khyod kyi rtag tu bzlas par bgyis/ /gsang ba gzhan du spel mi bya/ /zhes sku'i sngags yig bcu gsum dang / gsung gi bcu gnyis thugs kyi brgyad pa rnams slob dpon gnyis ka phreng ba gcig la 'jus nas lan gsum bzlas pa'i dus su/ sku'i sa bon la 'ja' tshon lta bu'i 'od zer ba spu'i bu ga nas/ gsung gi 'od zer la ljags kyi rtse mo la me'i tshwa tshwa lta bu'i 'od zer dang/ thugs kyi sa bon la 'gal me klad 'khor ba lta bu rnams kyi bdag gzhan gyi sdig sgrib thams cad dag nas gshin rje gshed kyi go 'phang thob par bsam mo de nasayang dbang dngosal bdun te/ bum pa'i dbang
dang gsang dbang shes rab ye shes/ dbang bzhi pa/ lung bstan pa/ dbugs dbyung ba/ gzengs bstod pa/ 'jug bsdu ba'o/ /bum pa'i dbang la'ang gnyis te spyi dang khyad par ro/ /dang po ni maṇḍal phul zhing gsol ba gdab pa ni/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chenaji ltar stsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang rab tu bsgral ba'i phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rjes deng bdag stsol/ cesagasol ba gdab pa ni/ slob dpon gyi las sngags dang / bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags chus bsangs/ oX badzra ar ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūṃX phaṭa4༷༷ oX e ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya hūṃX phaṭa4༷༷ oX swa bhā wa shuddhā sarba dharma swa bhā wa shudhe haX/ stong pa nyid du gyur / stong pa'i ngang las slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso kro gnyis su med pa'i zhal du zhugs/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib dag/ mkha' gsang du dri ma med pa 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ yab yum bde ba'i sgras phyogs bcu'i bde bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs/ spyi bo nas zhugs/ rjes chags kyi mes byang sems kyi rnam par zhu nas slob ma dang gnyis med du 'dres par phaṭa dzaXzhes pa'i sgra'i sbyor mtshams nas mdun du glang chen padma nyi zla'i gdan la rnam par snang mdzad yab yum gyi skur gyur pa'i spyi bor oX / mgrin par āX thugs gar hūṃX/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'og min nas rnam par snang mdzad yab yum spyan
༄tshi/ /drangs gnyis su med par bstims/ ye shes lngas dbu brgyan par gyur pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo gnyis su med pa'i thugs gar phog/ de las kyang 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs nam mkha'i khams gang bar spyan drangs/ arghaX la sogs pas mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la bum pa'i dbang bskur du gsol/ zhesagasol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ byang chub sems pa rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa phul te/ debazhin gshegs pa rnams 'od du zhu nas rnam snang yab yum gyi skur gyur/ rnam snang yab yum 'od du zhu nas bum nang gi chu dang 'dres par gyur te/ che ba'i yon tan kun rdzogs shing byang chub sems chus rab gang ba'i/ /rnam par dag pa'i 'bras bu 'dis/ /de ring khyed la dbang bskur ro/ oX sarba ta thā ga ta a dzhai ṣiñtsa sa ma ya shri hūṃX/ de ltar bgyis pas phung po rnams la gzugs kyi phung po gnas su dag/ nyon mongs pa rnams las gti mug gnas bsgyur/ ye shes lnga las chos kyi ye shes rgyud la bzhag/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams las rnam par snang mdzad yab yum gyi skur gyur/ dbang
rtags su yang rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/ dbang rnams las bum pa'i dbang thob pa lags so/ de nasadabu rgyan gyi/ dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar / / bdag kyang rab tu bsgral ba'i phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag rtsol/ /zhesagasol ba btab/ bgegs bskrad/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo gnyis su med pa'i zhal du zhugs/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib dag/ mkha' gsang : yab yum gyi bde: phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs 'od du zhu spyi bo nas zhugs/ rjes chags kyi mes byang sems kyi rnam par zhu nas/ mkha' gsang du slob ma dang 'dres par phaṭa dza'i sgras sbyor mtshams nas mdun du rta mchog nyi zla padma'i gdan la rin chen 'byung gnas yab yum gyi skur gyur/ gnas gsum nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes pa spyan drangs stims/rigs lngas dbu brgyan pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams spyan drangs/ arghaX sogs kyis mchod de/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams 'od du zhu/ rin chen 'byung gnas yab yum gyi skur gyur/ de yang 'od du zhu/ dbu rgyan dang gnyis med du 'dres nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad khro bo rnams: byang chub sems dpa'aja mchod
'tsho/ /pa'i lha mo: 'gro: sangs rgyas kun gyi rin po che/ /dbu rgyan rin chen dam pa ste/ /rin chen kun gyi mchog gyur pa'i/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi dbang bskur ro/ /oX sarba ta thā ga ta ratna ku la mu chu trī a bhi ṣiñtsa āX oX āXhūm̐X swāhā/ ka ya bi shwa dha na ye swā hā/ de ltar bgyis pas phung po rnams tshor ba'i phung po gnas su dag nyon mongs pa rnams las nga rgyal gnas bsgyur/ ye shes lnga las mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes rgyud la bzhag de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rin chen 'byung gnas yab yum gyi skur gyur/ dbang rtags su yang rin chen 'byung gnas yab yum kyis dbur brgyan/ dbang rnams las dbu brgyan gyi dbang thob pa legs so/ de nas rdo rje'i dbang zhu ba'i don du maṇḍal phul/ gsol ba gdab/ bsang sbyangs bya/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo gnyis su med pa'i zhal du zhugs/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib dag mkha' gsang du lus dri ma med pa 'od: yab yum bde ba'i: de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs/ spyi bo: sgras mdun du rma bya padma nyi zla'i gdan la snang ba mtha' yas kyi skur gyur pa'i spyi bo goX sa bstims / rigs lnga dbu brgyan pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gtso kro gnyis su med pa'i thugs gar thim/ de las kyang phyir 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'
nam mkha'i khams gang bar spyan drangs/ mchod pa arghaX: de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la rdo rje'i dbang: zhes gsol ba btab pas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams 'od du zhu nas snang ba mtha' yas yab yum gyi skur gyur/ snang ba mtha' yas yab yum kyang 'od du zhu rdo rje dang 'dres/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dbang bskur/ rdo rje lag tu gtad la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang / de ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ sangs rgyas thams cad rab bsgrub phyir/ rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis longs/ oX sarba ta thā ga ta a nti sa ta stuX a bhi ṣiñtsa āX oX taṣṭha badzra sa ma ya stuX/ de ltar bgyis pas phung po rnams las 'du shes gnas su dag nyon mongs pa rnams las 'dod chags: ye shes lnga las so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes rgyud la bzhag de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad snang ba mtha' yas yab yum gyi skur gyur/ dbang rtags su yang 'od dpag med yab yum gyi dbu brgyan/ dbang rnams las rdo rje'i dbang thob pa lags so/ de nas dril bu'i dbang zhu ba'i don du maṇḍal phul/ gsol ba gdab/ bsang sbyang bya/ 'od du zhu/ zhal du zhugs/lus ngag nas mdun du shang shang padma nyi zla'i gdan la don yod grub pa yab yum gyi skur gyur pa'i spyi por: nas: bdag la dril bus dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol: de bzhin gshegs pa rnams 'od du zhu
༄tshi/ /nas don yod grub pa yab yum gyi skur gyur/ don grub yab yum 'od du zhu nas dril bu dang gnyis su med par 'dres par gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur bas dgongs pa mdzad/khro bo: byang chub sems dpa'acha mchod pa'i lha: sangs rgyas kun gyi dril bu'i dbang / de ring khyodangu sangs rgyas: dril bu'i dbang ni: oX sarba ta thā ta ganta stum/ a bhi ṣiñtsa āX de ltar bgyis pas phung po rnams las 'du byed: nyon mongs pa rnams las phrag dog: ye shes lnga las bya ba grub pa'i ye shes: de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad don grub yab yum gyizo dbang rtags su don grub yab yum gyizo dbang rnam la dril bu'i dbang thobaza de nas ming gi dbang zhuza gsol bza gsang sbyangs bya 'od du zhu zhal du zhugs lus ngagaza nas mdun du seng chen padma nyi zla'i gdan la mi bskyod pa yab yum gyi skur gyur pa'i spyi boza nas rdo rje'i ming gis dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol: de bzhin bshegs pa thams cad 'od du zhu nas mi bskyod pa yab yum 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i ming gi rdo rje spyi bo bzhag la/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur: khro bo: byang chubaza mchodaza sangs rgyas kun gyi ming: de ringaza sangs rgyas: rdo rje'i ming ni: oX sarba ta thā ga ta che ge mo bi shwa dharma dhā tu bi shudha3haX/ a kṣi: de ltar bgyis pas phung po rnams las rnam par shes
pa gnas su dag/ nyon mongs pa rnams las zhe sdang / ye shes lnga las me long lta bu'i ye shes rgyud: de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mi bskyod pa yab yum gyi dbang rnams las rdo rje'i ming gi dbang thob pa lags so de nasaye shesalha'i dbang gi don du mardza phul/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ ston pa'i sgron me bcom ldan 'das/ /lha dang slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ /dregs pa stobs kyi tshul ston pa/ /'gyur med bde chen pho brang nas/ /dregs pa'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol/ /dam tshig bka' thub sdom pa'i mchog /rigs kyi rigs te rigs kyi gtso/ /rigs rigs pa'i bdag po zhesasnang kyi rgyal po bdag la stsol/ /phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor bdag la stsol zhes gsol ba btab/ bgegs bskrad/ bsang sbyangs/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gnyis su med pa'i zhal du zhugs/ phung po khams dang skye mched kyi sdig sgrib dag yab yum bde ba'i sgras phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa spyan drangs/ rjes chags kyi mes 'od du zhu/ yab yum gnyis med kyi spyi bo nas mkha' gsang du rang dang gnyis med du 'dres phaṭa dzaX mdun du klu 'bum gnyan khri sa bdag stong lto 'phye bzhi phyogs skyong bcu gshin rje pho mo ma he glang rgod padma nyi zla'i gdan la/ phyag rgya zil gnon sku mdog mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa rtsa ba'i lha lnga rgyan gyi lha brgyad dang bcas par gyur pa'i smyi bor oX / mgrin
༄tshi/ /par āX thugs gar hūṃX/ hūṃX de las 'od 'phros ye shes pa spyan drangs stims/ rigs lngas dbu brgyan par gyur pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ slob dpon dang gtso bo gnyis med kyi thugs gar phog des kyang 'od zer de bzhin gshegs pa nam mkha'i khams gang ba spyan drangs/ argha mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyi dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol: /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ khro po: byang chub sems dpa'aza mchod pa'i: heX glang chen ko rlon stag sham zhing lpags sbrul/ /thod pa snying phreng keng rus me ri brgyad/ /dur khrod chas brgyad rjerdzogs pa'i dbang bskur bas/ /dregs pa'i mthu stobs ma lus rdzogs par phre(ga /e ka ya ma hu tim hā nā ge kem ga ta a ti pa ti stuX/ a dzhai ṣiñtsa āX a tiṣṭa sa ma ye stuX/ phyag mtshan g.yas par gag de / hūm̐X/ 'khor ba sgrol byed 'khor lo dang / /nyon mongs gcod pa'i ral gri dang / /chos dbyings skye med rdo rje yi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dbang thob shog /e ka ya ma tsakra khargabadzra a bhi ṣiñtsa hoX phyag mtshan g.yon par gag la/ hoX be con dug lnga ye shes lnga ru sgrol/ /gtun shing gdug pas dgra bgegs gnas su sgrol/ /sdigs mdzub bag chags ye shes dbyings su dag /rig pa skyobs kyi dbang mchog thob par thegag /e
ka ya ma bi sa hūṃX/ ti ta hoX de nasalha las 'gyur ba med pa'i dbang ni/ sngar nam mkhar spyan drangs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams 'od du zhu/ phyag rgya zil gnon gyi lha tshogs su gyur te/ bar mtshams ma chad par rnam rgyal bum pa'i nang gi lha tshogs la thim/ de rnams kyang 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i slob ma'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur te/ spyi bor bum pa bzhag la/ hūṃX mkha' dbyings bum pa chen po ni/ /rigs kyi dkyil 'khor chen por bzhugs/ /gnyis med ye shes dbang bskur bas/ /khams sum rigs kyi bdag por bzhugs/ /khams gsum dbang du bsdu ba dang / /srid gsum zil gyis gnon pa dang / /dam can las la 'dzud pa yi/ /dbang mchog dam pa thob pa therdzog /e ka ya ma kṣa a ghi ṣiñtsa hūX bhrūṃX hūm̐X āX rda nasasman phud kyi dbang ni/ nang mchod thod par spyi bor bzhag la/ hūm̐X 'chi med rang byung ra sa yan/ bkra shis mtshan ldan lhag pa'i rdzas 'phel 'grib med pa'i dbang bskur bas/ /rigs lnga ye shes lnga yi dbang thob thekhog /e ka ya ma sarba sañtsa a mṛ ta dzñā na brnya a bhi ṣiñtsa hoX de nasamar me'i dbang ni/ mar me spyi bor bzhag la/ hūṃX ye shes lnga ldan gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /sems kyi dper bzhag ye shes rang snang ba'i/ /rnam dag mun pa sel ba'i mar me 'di/ /rig pa dbyings su bde chen me tog pa/ /ye shes lnga ldan gsang ba'i dbang bskur bas/ /
༄༅/ /skye 'gag med pa'i tshogs kyi dbang thob rtsodag /oX dzñā na a wa lo khri te/ swa bhā wa urma ga3haX/ de nasabanta'i dbang ni/ rakta spyi bor bzhag la/ hūm̐X dur khrod gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du du/ /gsang ba rmad du byung ba'i rdzas mchog dag /dngos grub yid bzhin mchog rab brgyan pa yin/ /sngon gyi rig 'dzin rgyal po gshegs pa'i shul/ /rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa'i rigs can la/ /mtshan ldan bhanta mchog gis dbang bskur bas/ /dngos grub rgya mtsho kun la dbang bsgyur phregag /e ka ya ma padma banta ka pā la a bhi ṣiñtsa āX de nasadangosagrub zhal zasakyi dbang ni/ zhal zasalag tu gag la/ bkra shis zla gam dbang gi zangs sder du/ /tshe dang 'brang rgyas māX sa gal phyi sogs/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag phan gnod las rnams dang/ /mchog dang thun mong kun la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /dngos grub rmad byung rol pa'i dbang thob therdzog /oX sarba pha la hūm̐X āX de nas tsho'i dbang bskur ba ni/ tshe'i bum pa spyi bor bzhag la/ hūṃX bkra shis dngos grub ga'u rtswa /mi 'gyur brtan pa'i tshe bskyil nas/ /rang rtags tshe yi dbang bskur bas/ /mi 'gyur brtan pa'i dbang thob therdzog /e ka ya ma a yu dzñān a bhi ṣiñtsa siddhi hoX de nasagator ma'i dbang ni/ gtor ma spyi bor bzhag la/ hūṃX snod kyi 'jig rten gtor gzhong du/ /bcud kyi sems can gtor mar sbyar/ /'byung ba sna lnga gtor ma'i rgyu/ /lhun grub bde chen gtor
ma'i rgyan/ /'dzin chags med pa'i 41bas kyis lnga(la/ /e ka ya ma hā ba hla ta pu dza a bhi ṣiñtsa rdedzhaltoX de nasabaX gyi dbang ni/ baX yod na rab med na ni sha chen phyag rgya zil gzhon gyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i dngosagrub kyi rdzas khyad par can du byin gyisarlabasal/ lag pa g.yon du gag de/ hoX rdo rdze padma mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /padma rakta byang chub sems/ /baX chen rme ba don dang sbyar/ /brtul zhugs rol pa'i dbang bskur bas/ /mi zad rgyan gyi dbang thob rtsodag /e ka ya ma ghu ya rakṣa hā ya kro dhi tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hoX māX sa rakta tsitta pā dza ke ni ri ti a bhi ṣiñtsa a hoX de nasagri gug g.yas su gag de/ hoX dpa' brtul sngags kyi byin bskyed pa'i/ /baX chen ro la mnyam par rol/ /rdo rje brjid pa'i dbang thob nas/ /bde chen mnyam nyid 'di rtogs thegag /e ka ya ma a dhi pa ti siddhi a ghi ṣiñtsa a/ zhes pas bum dbang rdzogs par bskur te/ de ltar bgyis pas/ phyi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang thob/ gtso bo lus kyi dri ma dag lam bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu sku rdo rje sprul sku thob pa'i skal ldan du byas pa yin no/ zhes go bar bya'o/ de nasagasang dbang zhu ba'i don du maṇḍal phul nas/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ ston pa'i 〈snal ba bcom ldan 'das/ /lha dang slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ /'gyur med bde chen pho brang nas/ /dregs pa'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol/ /slob
༄tshi/ /ma mtshan ldan yum gyi dkyil 'khor du/ /brtul zhugs drag po'i tshul gyis bzhug tu gsol/ zhesagasol ba gdab/ byang sems dkar dmar lce'i steng du byin la/ hoX sbyor ba dag pa'i byin rlabs las/ /rtsa rgyud dag pa'i thig le bskyil/ /byang chub sems dang rme ba bsres/ /bkra shis mtshan ldan bum par bskyil/ /brtul zhugs rab 'byams dbang bskur ro/ /e ka ya ma gu hya wāka rbadhi tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hoX slob mas gdong g.yogs bcings la/ slob dpon gyis rang gtso po rig ma gtso mor bskyed la rdo rje padma byin gyis rlabs la snyoms par zhugs pas dga' ba'i sgras/ sangs rgyas yab yum dpag tu med par spyan drangs/ spyi bo nas zhugs/rjes chags kyi mes/ byang sems kyi rnam par zhu nas rim gyis babs pas dga' ba bzhi ka nyams su myongs/ nor bu'i rtse mor gtan por gnas par bsams la/ hūm̐X sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga ye badzra swa bhā wa urma ko3haX zhes brjod pas/ byang sems de yum gyi padmar babs pa ste/ /slob ma'i lces blangs par bsam zhing / /dngos su nang mchod lte thog tu byin te/ btung ba rin chen 'di de ni lus kyi rdo rje rab gsal byed/bu khyod rtag tu shes nas kyang / yid las byung ba'i chu 'thung mdzod/ ya ma kro ta hūm̐X/ zhesapas byin/ desakyang / a ho ma hā su kha hoX zhes brjod la mid do/ de nas yum gyis kyang / rang gi padma la gnas pa'i thig le
lhag ma de slob ma'i rnyu thog tu byin la/ 'das pa'i rdo rje 'chang sogs kyi/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas sras dbang bskur/ /de ni byang chub sems bzang pos/ /bu khyod la ni dbang bskur bya/ /ya ma trag rakṣa hūṃX zhes pas byin te/ slos mas kyang sngar bzhin du blangs so/ de nas gdong g.yogs sogs bkrol la/ bha gar ltar bcug la/ khyod kyi gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ gsang ba'i dbang thob/ gtso bor ngag gi dri ma dag/lam srog rtsol rlung gi rnam par sgom pa la dbang/ 'bras bu gsung rdo rje longs sku bsgrub pa'i skal ba can du byas pa'o/ zhes go bar bya'o/ de nas nus pa'i dbang bskur ba ni/ nyan pa dang / bshad pa dang /bsgrub pa dang / las byed pa dang / rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ngo/ dang po nyan pa'i dbang ni/ rna ba gnyis su byang sems kyi thig le byas te/ hūm̐ 'od du zhu ba las rin po che'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi dang ldan pa/ de'i dbus su rta mchog padma nyi zla'i gdan la trāX ser po las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus 'od du zhu ba las/ rin chen 'byung gnas sku mdog ser po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas mchog sbyin dang/ g.yon rin po che bsnams pa rin po che sna tshogs pas spras pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ yum ma ma kki dang gnyis med du
༄tshi/ /sbyor ba/ de'i spyi bor oX / mgrin par āX thugs gar hūṃX/ hūṃX las 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'og min nas bcom ldan 'das rin chen 'byung gnas yab yum la 'khor lo rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum la 'khor lo rin chen rigs kyi dpa' bo dang sems dpa' dang sems ma bsam kyis mi khyab pas bskor ba spyan drangs/ dzaXhūm̐X bam̐ hoX gnyis su med par bstims/ rgyal ba rigs lngas dbu brgyan par gyur/ de nas lag tu ka li dang khri'u gtad la/ shes rab rnam gsum dag pa yi/ /shes pa'i rgyud rnams grol ba'i phyir/ /bde gshegs bka' yi byin rlobs las/ /dam pa'i rjes su bsgrub pa dang / /gsang chen thugs kyi man ngag dang / /phyi nang theg pa mtha' dag kun/ /rna ba'i dbang po'i nyan pa dang / /shes rab blo yi 'dzin pa dang / /nyan pa'i dbang rnams thob par shog/ oX dharmā ṣe na a bhi ṣiñtsa āX zhes so/ gnyisapa stad pa'i dbang ni/ lte'i steng du byang sems kyisathig le byas la/ hūm̐ las rin po che'i dbus su rma bya padma nyi zla'i gdan la hrīX dmar po las 'od zer 'phros/ don gnyis byas tshur 'dus/ snang ba mtha' yas sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa mnyam bzhag gi steng na padma dmar po bsnams pa/ /rin po che sna tshogs kyi: zhabs rdo rje'i skyil: yum gos dkar mo dang gnyis med du sbyor ba/ de'i spyi bor oX / mgrin par āX thugs dkar hūm̐X/ hūm̐X las
'od zer 'phros pas snang ba mtha' yas yab yum la 'bor padma rigs kyi sems dpa' sems mas bskor bca dzaXhūm̐X bam̐ hoX gnyis su med pa bstims/ rigs lngas dbang bskur/ dbu rgyan phyag shing dang pusti byin la shes rab rnam gsum dag pa yi/ /'dren pa skyes bu bla med ston pa'i mchog /theg pa mtha' dag thugs la mnga' ba yi/ /shes rab rig pa mdzod kyi kha phye las/ /gsang ba'i gsung byung kun gyi go ba yi/ /phyi nas rgyud sde mtha' dag bshad par rtsodag /oX dharmā dhā tu ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa āX gsum pa bsgral ba'i dbang ni/ snying khar byang sems mig le byas la/ hūm̐ las rin po che'i dbus su glang chen padma nyi zla'i gdan la hūm̐ las mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas sa gnon dang / g.yon rdo rje bsnams pa/ rin po che'i: zhabs rdo rje'i: yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dang gnyis med du sbyor ba/ de'i spyi bor oX / mgrin par āXthugs gar hūṃX de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'og min nas mi bskyod pa yab yum la/ 'bor rdo rje rigs kyi sems dpa': dzaXhūṃXza gnyis su med par: rigs lngas dbang bskur/ dbu brgyan/ hūṃX rnal 'byor chen po sku gsung thugs kyi bdag /sdug bsngal gnas nyid byang chub bde bsgrub pa'i/ /rdzas nyid ye shes lngar sgrub phyag rgya'i mchog /rnam shes phung po lnga rnams dkyil 'khor dang / /skye mched khams rnams ma lus dkyil
༄༅/ /'khor lha/ /sgrub pa'i dbang mchog ma lus gang yin pa/ /rnal 'byor slob ma khyod kyis thob par rtsodag /oX sarba yo ga tsitta a: bzhi pa las byed pa'i dbang ni/ yan lag bzhi yi tshigs chen la/ byang sems kyis thig le byas la/ hūm̐ las rin po che'i dbus su shang shang padma nyi zla'i a ljang gu las 'od zer: don: tshur: don yod grub pa sku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas skyabs sbyin dang / g.yon rgya gram bsnams pa/ rin po che'i: zhabs: yum dam tshig sgrol ma dang gnyis: de'i spyi bor: mgrin: thugs gar: de las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min nas don yod grub pa yab yum la/ 'khor las kyi rigs/ dza:gnyis su med parazo dbang bskur: rigs lngasadzdza (༷ shes rab rnam gsum dag pa yi/ /shes pa'i rgyud rnams grol ba'i phyir/ /thar pa'i phrin las mdzad pa'i phyir/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag mngon spyod dang / /ta na ga ṇa'i sbyor sgrol sogs/ /sbyor ba dag pa'i phrin las rnams/ /ma lus sngon du grub pa yi/ /thar pa'i phrin las mdzad par shog /oX garma ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa āX lnga pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ni/ spyi bor byang sems thig le bya/ zhabs su rdo rje 'khor lo brgyad gting / rdo rje dril bu dang pusti dung rnams gtad la/ spyi bor hūm̐ las rin po che'i gzhal yas gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi dang ldan pa'i dbus su/ seng chen padma nyi zla'i
gdan la/ oX dkar po las 'od zer 'phros/ don: tshugs: rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya'i rtse mo la 'khor lo bsnams pa rin po che'i rgyan:zhabs: yum nam mkha'i dbyings phyug ma dang gnyis: de'i: mgrin: thugs: hūX/ 'og min nas rnam par snang mdzad yab yum la/ /'khor du buddhā rigs kyi sems dpa' sems ma/ dzaXza gnyis su: rigs lngas: dbang bskur: lhaX/ shes rab thabs las grub pa yi/ /rang bzhin rdo rje dril bu 'di/ /khyed kyis dad pas rab tu bzung/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pas/ /rnal 'byor khyod kyis slob ma bsdus/ /badzra ghanta āX zhesapas g.yasasu rdo rje dang/ g.yon du dril bu byin/ dpung par pusti dang lag tu dung gag la/ oX bde gshegs sras po dam pa mchog /sngon gyi thugs dam bka' las mi 'da' zhing / /daskyurdzongs pa yid bzhin nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam/ /phrin las thabs kyi rdo rje slob dpon mchog /'gro ba ma lus yongs kyi re ba skong / /ston pa'i sgron ma lus la kha lo bsgyur/ /shes pa'i mtha' rdzogs yon tan lhun gyi grub/ /sdug bsngal skyobs mdzad ma lus 'dren mdzad cing / /chos nyid don ston kha lo sgyur byed pa/ /sangs rgyas gdung gsos rdo rje slob dpon mchog /gang yin sngon du lhun gyi grub pa yis/ /dbang rnams ma lus khyod kyis shes
༄tsho/ /par therdzog /ga ru sha ra/ gu ru rā tsa a: zhesabarjod cing mchod pa 'bul/ bkra lhasabarjod do/ de nasashesarab ye shesakyi dbang gi don du maṇḍal phul la/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ hoX ston pa'i sgron me bcom ldan 'das/ /lha dang slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ /'gyur med bde chen pho brang nas/ /dregs pa'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol/ /bde chen mnyam pa'i pho brang gsang ba rtswa /rig pa brtul zhugs stobs kyis gzhug tu gsol/ /dam tshig dka' thub sdom pa'i mchog /shes rab rol pa bdag la stsol/ zhesagasol ba btab/ slob dpon gyis phyag rgya byin gyis rlabs la/ slob ma ting 'dzin phog ste/ hoX rig pa stobs ldan sbyor ba'i gnas/ /'khrul pa'i bag chags sprin lta bu/ /ye shes rol pa'i sgron mes gsal/ /mnyam pa'i stobs kyi brtul zhugs 'o(ngas/ e ka ya ma pradzñā dzñā na a: zhesaslob ma la rig ma phog la 'khyud pa'i tshul byed du bcug hoX gzungs ma yid 'ong 'di de ni/ /bsten byar sangs rgyas rnams kyi btags/ /rdo rjes chags pa sbyor ba yis/ /bde ba dam pa myong bar gyis/ /thabs gzhan gyis ni sangs rgyas min/ /'gro gsum de yang dag pas ste/ /de bas 'khor bar sbyor sgrol ni/ /khyod kyis nam yang ma byed cig /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rig ma'i brtul zhugs bla na med/ /rmongs pa gang zhig 'da' byed pa/ /de la mchog gi dngos grub med/ ces
gsal btab la byin no/ /gzungs ma de gcer bur padma rgyas par ston cing/ dri chen dri chung bza' ba dang/ /de bzhin khu ba khrag dang sha/ /bud med gus mchod de bzhin du/ /bha ga padma brtsams pa ni/ /bu khyod spro ba yin nam ci/ /ji ltar bde ba bus smros shig/ cesazer bar bsam/ slob mas de'i lan/ dri chen dri chu sogs za ba/ lha mo ci phyir bdag mi spro/ /bud med rnams la rtag gus dang / /bha ga padma nyid la brtsams/zhes brjod pas/ rig ma mnyes te/ e ma bdag gi padma 'di/ /bde ba kun dang yang dag ldan/ /gang zhig cho gas brten byed pa/ /de yi mdun na bdag gnas so/ /sangs rgyas mnyes pa la sogs pa/ /padmar bya ba ji bzhin gyis/ /bde chen rgyal po rang nyid ni/ /'di nyid du ni rtag tu gzhug /bhanta mokṣa hoX zhesabarjod par bsamasal/ slob ma gtso rbo dang rig ma yum du bskyed/ /rdo rjes padma byin rlabs la/ /rdo rje'i rtse mor phaṭa ser po/ /byang sems mgul pa bkag par bsam la/ /rdo rje dang padma snyoms par zhugs te/ rim gyis bsrub pas byang sems gsang gnas kyi bar babs pa ni/ khyad par gyi dga' ba/ nor bu'i rtse mor mthar thug par gang nas/ phyir la zag pa na lhan skyes te/ dang po byang sems spyi bo nas mgrin par babs pas dga' ba/ snying khar babs pas mchog dga'/ lte bar babs pas khyad par gyi dga' ba/
༄tsho/ /gsang gnas su babs pa ni lhan skyes kyi dga' ba'o/ mar yar bstan pa ni/ gsang gnas nas lte bar sleb pa ni dga' ba/ snying khar mchog dga'/ mgrin par khyad par gyi dga' ba/ spyi bor sleb pa ni lhan skyes kyi dga' ba'o/ de nyid du rnal 'byor pas ni ji srid du/ byang sems sbyin par mi byed pa/ /de srid thob 'gyur rgyun mi chad/ /dga' ba la skyes bde gzhan ci/ /dngos grub kun gyi gter gyur pa/ /byang chub sems ni lhung gyur na/ /phung po rnam shes rgyal ba las/ /ma smad dngos grub ga la yod/ /ces pas brda don shes rab ye shes kyi dbang du ngo sprad de/ gdong g.yogs bkrol ba kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ gtso bor sems kyi dri ma dag lam rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnal 'byor sgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu thugs rdo rje chos sku bsgrub pa'i skal ldan du byas pa'o/ zhesago bar bya'o/ de nasadabang bzhi pa'i don du maṇḍal phul la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ ston pa'i sgron me bcom ldan 'das/ /lha dang slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ /lhun gyi grub pa'i pho brang nas/ /ma lus mnyam pa'i rgyal po dgongs su gsol rig pa byang chub mchog gi dkyil 'khor du/ /rang tsam ye shes lnga yi gzhug tu gsol/ /dam tshig dka' thub sdom pa'i mchog /ye shes rol pa bdag la stsol/ zhesagasol ba gdab/ hūṃX lhun grub ye shes
'char sgo yi/ /brtul zhugs drag po'i dbang bskur bas/ /'khor ba rnam dag chos skur gsal/ /rang byung ye shes dbang thob shog e ka ya ma dzñā na sañtsa a: zhes pas me long shel dang nyi zer gyi dpe bstan nas don gyi ngo sprod bya/ sems nyid 'das pa'i rjes mi gcod/ ma 'ong pa'i sngon mi bsu/ da ltar gyi shes pa la bcos mi byed par bsgom bya sgom byed dang bral ba'i ngang la re zhig bzhag ste/ bsam pa thams cad yong spangs nas/ nyi ma gcig gis brtag par bgyi/ /bsgom med sgom pa po yang med/ /lha med sngags kyang yod med do/ /phra rabs rdul gyi chos nyid 'das/ /spra dbab pa yi rang bzhin can/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa'i/ /phyag rgya chen po de la 'dud/ /stong la gsal ba nam mkha' 'ja' lta bu/ zung du 'jug pa ni me long la spra dbab pa lta bu yin no/ 'di dag ni tshig gi sgo nas ngo sprod tshig dbang rin po che zhes bya'o / don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag lam phyag rgya chen po sgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu ye shes rdo rje ngo bo nyid kyi sku thob pa'i skal ldan du byas pa'o / zhes rtogs pa bskyed do/ de nasalung bstan pa ni/ bstan pa'i bdag po yin pas thub pa'i cha lugs su zhugs la/ lag pa g.yon pas chos gos kyi grwa nas gzung ste/ lag pa g.yas pa mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya
༄༅/ /slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag la/ oX nga yi khyod la lung bstan bgyis/ srid pa'i ngan 'gro thams cad ston/ srid pa mchog tu bsgrub pa'i phyir/ 'jam dpal rdo rje de bzhin gshegs/ kyai gshin rje'i gshed ni mthar phyin pa'o/ /zhesaso/ de nasadabugs dbyung ba ni/ cho ga 'di yi byin rlabs kyis/ ngas yis ji ltar lung bstan pa bzhin du/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i khams gang ba thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu lung ston par mdzad pa yin pas/ khyod myur du gsang mtshan dang mthun pa'i de bzhin gshegs par mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par 'gyur ba la the tshom dang som nyi ma byed cigkyai rdo rje che ge mo/ sarba ta thā ga ta siddhi sa ma ya sarba bur bu wa swāhā/ zhesaso/ gzengs bstod pa ni/ slob ma rnams kyi spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la dril bu gsil zhing / mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ mthong ba dang ni zhugs pa yi/ /sdig pa kun las nges grol ba'i/ /khyod rnams 'dir ni legs par gnas/ /bde chen theg pa 'dir phyin nas/ /phyin chad 'chi ba yod min te/ /mi tshugs pa dang mi gsod pa/ /cis kyang mi 'jigs dga' bar bgyis/ /dam tshig sdom pa bsrung ba ni/ /rtag tu khyod kyis mthun par bsrungs/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi mthun par bsrungs/ /de la brtag pa'i bka' yin no/ /de ring bdud las rnam par
rgyal / / grong khyer mchog tu rab tu zhugs/ /khyod rnams kyis ni sangs rgyas khrid/ /de ring thob par the tshom med/ /rang gi dam tshig mi bzad brten/ /yid ni rab dwangs rdo rje nyid/ /cho ga 'di yis gshin rje gshed nyid dang / /mtshungs rtags nyid du khyod rnams phyin par 'gyur/ de nas slob mas/ deng bdag skye ba 'bras bur bcas/ /bdag gis gsod na'ang 'bras bu yod/ /de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skye/ /sangs rgyas sras bu da gyur to/ /deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ /khye1da la bdag nyid 'bul lags na/ /khyod kyi slob mar gzung ba dang/ /cha yis kyang ni spyad du garbershal/ zhesagasol ba btab la yon 'bul lo/ mjug bsdu ba ni/ slob mas dga' ba sgom/ kra/ slob dpon gyi cho ga lhag chad kha skong/ bshagasapa bya zhing lhag chog bya/ gtor ma btang ye shesapa gshegs shing dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ bkra shisabarjod cing bsngo bas rgyas btab so/ bla ma gong ma'i phyag bzhesaji lta ba bzhin du gnubasaye shesargya mtshosabagyid pa dge legs su gyur cig/ sarba maṅga laX/
༄tsho/ /nad gdon sdig sgrib dag par byed pa bum pa khrusakyi las rim bzhugs so/
༄༅caX na mo mañdzu shri ye/ (dpal ya man ta ka la phyag 'tshal 'o(/) rgyal ba kun gyi spyi gzugs can/ /phyag rgya zil gnon rnal 'byor gyis/ /'gro ba rnams la phan gdags phyir/ /bsam gtan bum khrus cho ga bshad/ /de la nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dag par byed pa bum pa khrus kyi las rim la/ phyi nang gsang ba gsum las/ dang po phyi ltar bsam gtan bum pa'i cho ga bya bar 'dod na bsnyen par rdzogs shing bskyed rim gyi gdeng dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ gnas yid dang mthun par maṇḍal legs par bshams te/ me tog gis mdzes par byas/ de'i dbus su rin po che'i bum pa byi dor byas te nang du 'bru lnga/ spos lnga/ snying po lnga/ rin po che lnga/ sman lnga/ dri lnga la sogs rtsal/ chu sna dgu la sogs pas bkang la/ kha brgyan mgul chings kyis brgyan/ gzungs thag dang
༄tshiltoX bcas / maṇḍal dbus su stegs bu'i khar bsham mo/ /de'i mthar mchod pa'i bye brag rnams kyang ci 'byor du bsham mo/ /byin gyis brlabs so/ /de nas bdag nyid stan bde ba la 'dug ste/skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang la/ /chos nyid stong pa nyid la blo bzhag go /mi rtog pa'i ngang las 'gro ba'i rgyud la snying rje chen pos/ chos dbyings ngang las thugs rjes bzhengs pa'i sku/ phyag rgya chen po zil gnon rtsa ba rgyan gyi lha dang bcas pa gsal sing gi bsgom/ bdag gi thugs mchog hūṃX yig 'bar bar bsams te hūṃX zhes brjod de hūṃX las 'od zer 'phros pas bum pa'i dngos por 'dzin pa sbyangs te/ stong pa nyid du bsgom/ stong pa'i ngang las bhūX las bum pa rin po che'i gzhal yas khang du bskyed la/ phyi nang gi sgrib pa shel gong dag pa lta bu/ gnam sgo can du bsgom/ de'i nang du gdan
rnams gsal ba nas brtsams te/ zil gnon gyi lha tshogs rnams sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs ldan par gzhung bzhin gsal bar bsgom/ 'khosar dang bcas pa spyan drangs bzhugs su gsol/ dngos su 'byor dang yid kyi sprul pa'i mchod pa'i bye brag gis mchod cing gus pas 'bul lo/ de nas bum pa la gzungs thag dkar po btags pa'i rtse nas bdag gi srin lag gis bzung la/ sngags rnams bzlas pas lha rnams 'od kyi gong bur gnas pa'i klong nas ye shes kyi 'od zer 'bar bar bsam ste bzlas brjod ci 'grub tu bya'o/ de nas yungs dkar la sogs pa la sngags drag du bzlas te bum par bstim la lha rnams kyi ye shes 'od zer gyis nad gdon sdig sgrib sbyong zhing / sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub bsdus par bsam/ e ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya/ sarba tsitta ro myags kha tham/ srog gzir sbur nan 'drid phyung hri shag rbad ces bzla'o/ de nas sngags kyi 'od zer 'phro 'du yis lha rnams 'od du zhu ste ye shes kyi bdud rtsir bsam la des khrus byas pas/ ma rig pa'i rnam rtog dang des bskyed pa'i nad dang / gdon dang / grib dang sdig sgrib dang / mi gtsang ba la sogs pa thams cad dag par bsam la/ dper na/ nyi ma shar bas mun pa bsangs pa'am/ snod kyi dri ma bkrus pa'am/ dung la rdul phyis pa bzhin du bsgom/ de nas
༄tshiltoX sems nyid rig pa rtog med nam mkha' dwangs pa ltar bzhag go lus shel sgong phyis pa ltar bsgom zhing / bum chu khong du 'thungs pas lus bdud rtsis khengs te ba spu'i bu gar nyug tsam re byung ba khro chung gi gtams par bsgom/ rang gi sems nyid rtog med nam mkha' dngasapa ltar bzhag go mchan/ de ltar sgom zhing khrus byas pas las dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang / nad dang / gdon dang / dug dang / byad kha dang / rbod gtong gi gnod pa thams cad sel lo/ byad stems dang bgegs kyi gnod pa thams cad bzlog gdon 'gegs kyi sbyor ba ngan pa thams cad 'ching bar byed do/ gdon thams cad kyi kha 'ching ngo / bgegs kyi sbyor ba 'joms / byad stems rbod gtong gi gnod pa bzlog 7/ gnyis pa nang gi khrus ni bsam gtan rgyun gyi sngags khrus kyis bsrung ba ni/ rang nyid phyag rgya zil gnon du bsgom pa'i snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab brgyad du gnas pa la/ snying ga'i dbus su dwangs ma lnga 'dus pa'i 'od zer gyi thig le la hūm̐X nam mkha'i mdog can 'od 'phro ba bsgom/ rtsa 'dab brgyad la/ e myags yig 'bru brgyad kyis spras pa bsgom/ de nas sngags bzlas pas dbus kyi yi ge hūm̐X gi 'od zer gyis/ rtsa 'dab kyi yig 'bru brgyad po bskul ba las sngags rnams ye shes kyi 'od du zhu ste/ 'od zer gyi tshogs rnams lus kyi nang dang rtsa sbubs su 'phros pas ma
rig pa nyon mongs pa'i rnam rtog dang / dug lnga las bskyed pa 'byung ba bzhi'i nad dang / bar du gcod pa'i bgegs kyi gnod pa dang / byad dang / stobs dang / sbyor ngan gyi mthu dang phral gyi rkyen mi gtsang ba'i nyams grib rnams ye shes kyi 'od zer gyis sbyangs shing 'od du zhu nas stong par yal yal song bar bsam/ lus sems yang zhing dwangs pa shel sgong ltar bsam/ nad gdon sdig sgrib dag nas/ stong gsal phru ma bus pa ltar bsam/ 'di ni bsam gtan nang gi khrus te nad gdon sdig sgrib sbyong zhing bsrung ba'i mchog yin no/ rgyud las/ gdod nas rnam dag ye shes sku/ /lhun gyis grub pa yin pa la/ /rtsol bsgrub re dogs 'dzin pa bral/ /rnam rtog bag chags sprin lta bu/ /nam mkha' lta bur 'dzin med na/ /bsrung ba kun gyi mchog tu bshad/ /ces pa'o/ rmya/ gsum pa gsang ba chos nyid rnam par dag pa stong nyid don gyi khrus nigiX rang gi sems nyid stong gsal spros pa dang bral ba las mi 'da' ba'i gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po chos kyi sku ye nas yin pa la/ spangs blangs brtsol bsgrub bya mi dgos te/ rang ngo shes pas rang 'byung lhun grub tu nyams su blang bar bya'o/ de'i ngang las ma 'gag pa'i rol pa/ rig pa'i rtsal nyon mongs dang rnam rtog ltar/ snang ba ji ltar snang zhing byung yang sems nyid gnas lugs/ chos nyid spros dang bral ba/ cir
