gi phur pa zur gsum pa chung ba la bris te/ lging re re la gdab pa'am/ liṅga'i tha ma sngags kyis bskor te/ bar bar du mnan pa bya'o/ de las rnal 'byor pas/ e myags 'bru brgyad pa la rten 'brel snying po gdags te/ nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas te/ bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' bden par gyur cig /ces brjod la/ mchod rten la phyag 'tshal la/ mchod rten nag po bzhugs su gsol/ de ni mchod rten stobs chen 'du ba'i mchod rten yong rdzogs zhes bya'o/ sgri'oX khraXcaX rdzogs so/ dge'o/ sarba maṅga laX/ shu bhaX/ /
༄7/ /drag sngags mtshon cha nag po'i rgyud bzhugs so/
༄tshi/ /rgya gar skad du/ e mant+ra ma rang ka la la tan tra/ bod skad du/ drag sngags mtshon cha nag po'i rgyud/ dpal gshon rje gshed po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thams cad gsum ldan bde ba yi/ /gzungs thub mtshan ma kun spangs shing / /yon tan ma lus kun ldan pa/ bde ba chen po khyod la 'dud/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das chos kyi dbyings mtha' dbus med pa'i wo brang ye shes lhun gyis grub pa'i gzhal yas khang na/ 'jig rten dregs pa can dbang du sdud pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyom par bzhugs so/ de'i tshe 'bor rdo rje snying po la sogs pa ma sgribs chos kyi dbyings na gnas pa rnams dang/ sa lam la gnas pa rnams dang/ bgrod pa phyin ci ma log pa rnams dang/ dregs pa 'dul pa'i khro bo'i tshogs dang/ 'jig rten khram 'debs 'thoms pa'i tshogs
༄tshi/ /dang / khrag skyug shan pa srog la rngam pa'i tshogs dang/ gdug pa gsum dang bcas pa'i sde dpon dregs pa can dang/ thams cad 'dus pa'i dbus na/ 'jam dpal rdo rje snying pos rdo rje 'chang la 'di skad gsol/ rnam dag chos sku'i rang bzhin la/ /'gro ba 'dul phyir mtshan ma'i sku/ /thabs kyi rgyal po bde ba che/ /ye shes rol pa'i las rnams kun/ /rdzogs pa'i tshul du rgyas mdzod la gdug pa 'dul ba'i don mdzod cig /ces gsol to/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis mnyam pa nyid mi g.yo ba las/ rngam tsig drag po'i ting 'dzin las bzhengs te/ ayo badzra sarba duṣṭaX/ zhes gsungs pas/ 'jig rten thams cad 'ur 'ur rab tu 'ur/ chem chem rab tu chem/ g.yo zhing ldog go /de'i tshe 'khor thams cad brgyal zhing srog dang bral du cha'o/ /lus sa la bsdebs shing smre
sngags 'don te/ /rig pa'i rgyal po bde ba che/ /'khor du 'dus pa srog dang bral du nye/ /srog gi snying po 'di bzhes la/ /dkyil 'khor chen po sprul pa mdzod/ /ces gsol ba gdab bo/ de nas bcom ldan 'das 'khor rnams la gzigs ste/ rngam pa'i sgra 'di bsgrags so/ kun gyi rang bzhin gcig pa la/ /rtog spyad snang srid kun khyab brdal/ /ye shes chen po kun 'byung pa/ /sna tshogs sbyor ba rgyas pa'i zhing / /ces gsungs pas/ 'khor rnams kyis thos nas/ 'khor gyi gtso bo 'jam pa'i rdo rjes 'di skad ces gsol to/ yang dag bde ba'i lam mchog las/ /gsang ba rin chen grub pa'i don/ /zung 'jug thabs dang shes rab lam/ /smod pa drag po rgyas par mdzod/ rtse/sa gsol to/ de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag rgya chen po nyid dregs pa can 'dul zhing smod pa'i las rgyas par mdzad pa'i phyir zil gyi gnon pa'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di lta ste/ chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang na/ /drag po e yi gzhal yas khang na/ /stobs can dregs pa 'dul ba ste/ /dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgrad/ /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal/ /'khor lo rdo rje ral gri g.yas/ /be con gtun shing sdig mdzub g.yon/ /zhing chen g.yang gzhi ko rlon dang / /stag gi sham thabs rab tu mdzes/ /sbrul dang rin po che yis mdzes/ /
༄tshi/ /snyan cha mgur chu tshangs skud dang / /phyag zhabs ro nyes rab tu mdzes/ /dbu la he ru lnga yis brgyan/ /bdud rgyal srin po'i thod pas spras/ /thugs mchog smug nag 'khor lo snying/ /dregs 'dul ljang nag rdo rje phreng / /rus sbal rngam pa glog 'gyu ste/ /dbu la mkha' lding gdug pa 'dul/ /stag dang seng ge rngam pa la/ /yang sprul smug nag ro nye 'dren/ /dug sbrul rlangs pa dgra la gtong / /bdud mo g.yon na nye ba ste/ /snying mkhyud dung dmar gtso la stobs/ /'khor gyi mon pa rla 'gugs dang / /'chi bdag tshe bdag srog bdag bcas/ /ma skyes gdod nas lhun gyis grub/ /stong pa'i ngang las rang bzhin 'char/ /las dang sbyor ba sna tshogs pa/ /ye shes rol pa'i rgyan du che/ /sgro dang phyag rgya stobs can gyis/ /stobs chen snying pos rang lus srun/ /dus ngan las kyis mnar ba'i tshe/ /sdang sems can dang 'gugs byed la las kyi 'khor lo snying la bskor/ /'byung ba rgyu ba'i phung po bshog /nyon mongs lnga gsum rang gshed dbab/ /pho nya'i za kha'i nang du bstan/ /'byung bzhi dkrug cing kyin thang dbab/ /las kyi mtha' bsdu mkhas pas brtag /gsal gsum yin pa gsum gyi gdengs/ /lhun gyis grub pa'i las su bshad/ mtshon cha nag po sku'i rgyud las gleng gzhi rtsa ba'i le'u ste dang po/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dregs pa'i rang
gshed rang la dbab pa'i 'phrin las 'di gsungs so/ dur khrod gdug pa'i dben gnas su/ /mchog gsum tshang pa'i mtshams gcad la/ /maṇḍal mthing nag gru gsum la/ /phung pa gsum la dug khrag sbru/ /lho ru rtse bstan rtsang dmar bskor/ /sha sna snying snas gtor ma brgyan/ /mon pa'i don dang dpa' bo'i rta/ /khyi spyang bya spre'u lug dang ra/ /rabs chad nal mo yug sa phag /nal bu rgya tshil bung bu sbrul/ /'bras bu gcad dang don snying la/ /dregs pa'i dam rdzas bzung la dbye/ /lta ba chos nyid zab mo'i gdegs/ /dbang rdzogs rdo rje yi ge dang / /ye shes lhun grub phyag rgya gsal/ /spyod pa spyi dang sgo yi gzer/ /gnod byed gzer ba de bzhin yin/ /chos sku mnyam rdzogs gzir mi dgos/ /log rtog nyam chags 'khrul pa yi/ /dug lnga'i nad kyis zin pa la/ /bde ba'i stobs med zhen chags can/ /log pa'i stobs gzhom drag po gzir / / gshon rje la sogs dregs pa yi/ /rang rang srog dang spyi srog dril/ /yi ge'i gnad kyis 'joms par byed/ /khams gsum dbang byed dregs pa can/ /dregs pa'i de nyid shes gyur na/ /dregs pa rang gshed rang gis byed/ /kun gyi srog snying e la sdud/ /'bru gsum snying rtsa mgrin par gnas/ /'bru gnyis mgo dang yan lag gnas/ /gnod byed 'bru drug shes rgyud dbang/ /de la sngags kyi stobs kyis
༄༅/ /gzir / / rang gshed phyag cha rang la bskor/ /lha bsnyen brtan thob sgra la dbyung / oX a kro te ka ya ma ta ka ha na ma tha ban dza hūm̐X phaṭaX bdag nyid sku gsum rdzogs par bsgom/ /stobs kyi drag sngags 'bum tsho bcu/ /snying sna dam rdzas gang 'grub dbye/ /smyi dril las dang rang rang dbye/ /myur dang stobs dpag med par 'byung / /sgrub bya las kyi shes rgyud la/ /rno dbal mtshon cha'i yi ge gnas/ /snying la snra gnas mgrin par hur/ /lte bar thums dang gsang bar dza/ /klad par trig nan mgo stengs nan/ /rtsa bzhi 'dud pa 'bru bzhi gcod/ /mtshon cha'i rgyal po rno dbal ldan/ rtsa srog shes rgyud dran pa gcod/ /de bskul mtshon cha rgyud la ldang / /stobs kyi sngags kyis 'phen par byed/ e badzra sarba duṣṭan/ mi trig nan/ e hur thums dza ma ra ya rbad/ /de yis sbyor ba stobs zhan na/ /ming dang snying po 'bru re sbyar/ /'bru bzhi mtshon cha'i stobs kyis bcad/ las la sbyor ba rtsa dang srog thams cad gang 'dod mi 'jigs gcod/ /gang brtsams las la don med na/ /stobs dang bcas pa dril la brdeg /rang lus brtan pa'i shes rgyud la/ badzra sarba duṣṭan gnas/ rang lus gnas pa'i go chas bsrung / zhes gsungs so/ mtshon cha nag po sku'i rgyud las rang gshed dbab pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o/ des na bcom ldan 'das kyis drag sngags
kyi snying po 'di gsungs so/ e ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya/ e badzra sarba duṣṭan/ trig nan/ hur thums dza/ e ma ra ma rbad/ srog la tsa sha ru ti carnom ra ya rbad/ srog la ma ra la rni ma ra ya rbad/ srog la tsitta 'gu li snra ma ra ya rbad/ srog la e bam̐ ram̐ yam̐ khaṃ zam ra ya rbad/ srog la khyer kham shag ma ra ya rbad/ snra hur thums dza/ stam pa ya nan/ a gu sha dza ag ne dzwa la raX/ srog la ki li ki la ya trig nan big nan/ snying la gzir sbur nan/ khur thums dza/ myags thums ril rbad ya/ mtshon cha nag po sku'i rgyud las drag sngags bstan pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dregs pa cham la dbab pa'i phrin las 'di gsungs so/ ngo wo ma bcos bde ba chen po'i ngang/ /chos nyid ye nas lhun gyis grub/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor snang la rang bzhin med/ /sprul pa sna tshogs log rtog 'dul la mkhas/ /tha snyad tshig rnams don la yang dag stong / /de rtogs sangs rgyas yin pas gsad mnan med/ /bden don ma rtogs sdug bsngal phung por smin/ /lus ngag sems kyi 'du byed kyis/ /gzhan las lhag pa'i stobs rab rnyed pas/ /dregs pa'i lus ngag sems su snang / /gdug pa'i sems kyis gcod cing rngams/ /de la sngags kyi sbyor ba bsdeb/ /rang bzhin btsan thabs drag pos brdeg /rang bdud phyag cha rang la
༄tshi/ /bskor / / khams gsum dbang byed dregs pa yin/ /dregs pa'i de nyid shes gyur na/ /dregs pa'i rang gshed rang gis byed/ /yi ge smyi yis gzir byas la/ /dregs pa'i rnam shes yig 'bru gcig /'phrog byed yi ge 'bru gsum gyis/ /snying gi dkyil nas 'phrog cing 'dzin/ /gcod byed mtshon cha 'bru bzhi yis/ /rang srog rang gis gcod par byed/ /dregs pa spyi'i dregs pa sgo'i sbyor ba'i stobs/ /las dang nus pa sbyar la gzud/ /gzir dang srog dbrog rbad pa'i las/ /rang gnad gzhom pa 'di lta ste/ /zhi khro gshin rje phur pa dang / /ma mo bdud mo srin mo dang / /bdud dang mu stegs rgyal po btsan/ /dmu dang ru tra srin po dang / /gnod sbyin skyes bu ging dag dang / /thug bdag sri can gdug pa gsum/ /de nyid shes na rang srog gcod/ /dregs pa'i chags cha rang kha 'khor/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsang sngags 'di dag bstan te/ e badzra sarba dudzin sarba sha truX e shrī badzra kro dha/ oX ya ma ya/ ma ma tu lu/ ma dun ting ki la ya/ ta tir ti/ ka ru tra du de ba a dan ting med/ mun mun sa ra tsa tsa rag sha/ ra rag mo ra/yag sha kṣa/ shu la dza badzra sa du tri hi shang tri ru tri ru sa na ga phu de dag sngags kyi grong khyer te/ sngags pa nang 'gras byung ba dang / dregs pa'i lha 'dre rgyud la gnod pa dang / rtags dang sbyar zhing sngags dang phyag rgya
rang la bskor/ rtags rnams 'khrugs na stong srog gcig tu dril gzir/ /bdun nam bcu bzhi nyi shu gcig /gsum mam lnga ru drag por gzir/ /dang po rang sgrub snying po bgrang / /klad du gzir cing dgug par bya bso shing gzir la srog snying dbrog /ming dang rnam shes 'bru bzhis gcod/ /tha ma mnan bsreg dam brdar gces/ mtshon cha nag po'i sku'i rgyud las dregs pa gzir pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsad pa las kyis rang gshed/ mtshon cha rang bzlog gi 'khor lo 'di gsungs so/ phung pa'i 'brub khung mthing nag tu/ /mtshon cha dmar mo srin mo 'gros/ /dur khrod ras sam rgya shog la/ /'khor lo rim pa gsum pa ste/ /drag po rang la 'khor lo brgyad/ /dregs pa gang bsgrub lto bar bca'/ /ming dang rnam shes bsgyur cing gsad/ /rang gshed rang la dbab cing bskor/ /des kyang lus sems ma byed na/ /dug lnga sngas kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /dug gsum shes pa ar la gtad/ /tsitta gnad la dbab cing gsad/ /'byung ba dkrugs pas phung po 'jig /rang sgrub dam can rang la bzlog /tsitta dkrug pa'i sngags dang bsdeb/ /gshed po las rgya lto bar gsad/ /gu ru seng ge'i khog mi bshig /dam tshig gcig dang sngags pa spyi/ rdo rje spun dang a ting pa/ las kyi skabs sbyar 'khor lo dkrug/ 'di min las gzhan
༄tsho/ /yug pa brkyang / mtshon cha nag po sku'i rgyud las gsad pa srog tig las kyi 'khor lo'i le'u ste lnga pa'o/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyin thang drag po chu 'khyags dbab pa 'di gsungs so/ gnyan sa gdug pa'i gnas dag tu/ /rabs chad thod pa spyang zhi'i khrag /gsum la khrag gis kha so bku/ /khrag dug yin min bsun pa bzhug /rta nag lug gi dkar snying dang / /ra dmar rgya bo sbrul gyi snying / /dri'o rabs chad nag po'i snying / /dam rdzas brten la sde brgyad brten/ /thod pa dong bur yugs sa rme/ /dri dang bsnol gyis khrag blug la/ /drag sngags 'bum tsho bcu ru bstim/ /rta tshe gsum po me thab tshul/ /yul gyi kyang mdun dbus su gzhug /dril dang bzlog sngags sngon du dbab/ /ma phebs sbyor ba stobs zhan na/ /sde brgyad snying po gnad nas dbrog /dmar nag dug khrag klong du bsdu/ /sngags rnams dkrugs la sde brgyad gzir snying sna bsres pa 'og tu gzhug /gshin rje gshed dang stobs chen bsgom/ /snying po 'bru brgyad bsreg cing sdud/ /de yis cho rgod ri ltar gtibs/ /dril dang gtor ma bsnol mar rdeg de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis chu 'khyar dbab pa 'di gsungs so/ e badzra sarba duṣṭaX ma ma/ ya ma ra tsa mu sa trig nan/ ku ma hri ta phroX phroX shar shar kham kham khur thob phob tri sa mu tsa da la ya/ hril shar phraX phraX ya ma mu tsa dza tsa mun
pa tri hur thums dza trig nan phraX phraX hril hril/ kham shar hril hril bhyo/ su trig nan sa na ga kham shar hril phob/ /de yis 'khyag pa ri ltar spungs/ /ma phebs sbyor ba stobs zhan na/ /zhing lpags brgyangs la gsum du bskor/ dbus su thig bzhi le tshe brgyad/ phyi rim rtsibs drug yang logs mtshon/ /lte bar e dang badzra la/ /phyogs bzhir stabs la mtshams bzhi srog /drug la srog dbrog gzir ba ste/ /tha mar mtshon cha 'bru bzhis gcod/ kha sbyar bcas la dug mes bdug de dus las rnams 'grub par bshad/ mtshon cha nag po sku'i rgyud las chu 'khyags dbab pa'i le'u ste drug pa'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dregs pa rnams kyi brtags gzung ba 'di gsungs so/ sngags la sbod gtong 'gras pa'am/ /dregs pa tshogs kyis brtags bstan pa/ /mon dang zhib can mdze can rnams/ /gshin rje'i rtags su bshad pa'o/ /khrag mtsho mun pa ma mo'i rtags/ me 'bar phur pa na bun rtags/ /bya nag shing chen bdud kyi rtags/ /'bag seng btsad po rgyal po'i rtags/ /nag po g.yid 'bro bya nag 'thab/ /me 'bar 'tsheg pa bdud mo'i rtags/ /rje'u dang ban de dge bsnyen rtags/ rta pa khyi spyang btsan gyi rtags/ /khyi dmar khrag mtsho the brang rtags/ /g.yag dang bon po mu stegs rtags/ /me 'bar sha rgal srin po'i rtags/ /kyang mul skya bshar the brang
༄༅/ /ngo / / bya nag bud med dam sri'i rtags/ /rgol dang 'bro na sbod gtong yin/ /las byed gar stabs sha la rol/ /ded dang rtog na thub pa'i rtags/ /rmi lam sna tshogs phyi yi rtags/ /dbang po mngon sum nang gi rtags/ /lus yang sems gsal gsang ba'i rtags/ /ces pas rtags bzung 'khor lo bskor/ /gnam na shing lo gtibs pa'i sprin/ /bar snang rlung sgra 'od dang me/ /sa la 'khyags rom stobs ma stom ma lud cesapa'ang snang lud/ /dug rlangs 'chol pa kyin thang rtags/ /mtshon cha nag po sku'i rgyud las rtags kyi le'u ste bdun pa'o/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi mnan pa'i las 'di gsungs so/ /gzhan gyi sbod gtong mnan pa dag /zhi khro ya ma phur pa ni/ /sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor 'og tu mnan/ /ma mo bdud mo srin po rnams/ /bka' rten byin can 'og tu mnan/ /bdud dang mu stegs 'gong po rnams/ /ro khang sgo bsrungs 'og tu mnan/ /rgyal po dge bsnyen dkor bsrungs rnams/ /khyi tshang lam ga'i 'og tu mnan/ /btsan dang srog bdag srin po rnams/ /sha ru spyang thod gong gsum mnan/ the'u rang chags 'gong gshin ngog rnams/ glang rur bcug la lam mdor mnan/ /bon po rig 'dzin khyi tshang mnan/ /sri can chu bya them 'og mnan/ /srin po gdug pa'i thod pa la/ /ri rab rgya gram dang bcas la/ /thugs kyi snying po rab
mdzes pa/ /mnan pa thod pa'i 'khor 'ordzo bshad/ /gri lcags phur pa gdug pa la/ /rdzas rgod gdugs te snying la gdab/ /bco brgyad rdzas kyi du bas bdug /dregs pa gnad la dbab par bshad/ /bsreg pa me'i 'khor lo dag /me thab bcas la me lha bskyed/ /ling ga bdugs la dug khrag nyug /dug sngags brab cing bsreg par bya/ /las rnams rjerdzogs nas stong nyid la/ /dregs pa thams cad zhi bar bsgyur/ /phyis kyi dngos grub bsdu bar bya/ /lha la stong pa'i rgya yig gdab/ /ces gsungs so/ /de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ sngags thub gzer la dbab bya ba/ /thod khrag dug chu stong skor tshad/ /ldan pa gsum dkyil zor du 'phong / /nyungs gar thal chen rdo thun brab/ /gzugs dang thal ba dong rer sbad/ /gnad pa gsang ba'i las su rig /ces gsungs so/ mtshon cha nag po sku'i rgyud las las kyi mtha' sdud kyi le'u ste brgyad pa'o de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'bor la rgyud gtad pa/ /e ma rdo rje snying po che/ /nga yi bka' rgyud me lte 'di/ /rgyal ba kun gyi mdzad spyod te/ /skye med rdo rje bsam dpag dka'/ /stong phrag bdun dang brgya phrag brgyad/ /snying po don gyi don bsdus pa'o/ /brjod pa kun grol bka' dang ldan/ /bde ba gcig gis bsgrod pa 'di/ /sangs rgyas spyod lam kun grol med/ /gab pa gsang ba'i lam can 'di/ /
༄7/ /rigs can rdo rje snying pos zungs/ /nga yi bka' yi gsang rgyud 'di/ /ma 'ongs dam can bsgrub byed na/ /nga yang dam las mi g.yel bsrun/ /rdo rje bde ba'i rgyal po dang / /stobs dpag med pa'i khro tshogs kun/ /dam can bsgrub byed bsrung zhing gnas/ /rgyud kyi snying po rab tu zungs/ /rnam rtog mtshan ma rang grol ba'i/ /rdo rje rgyal po bde ba'i bka'/ /lcags thog spu gri sbab chen 'di/ /lha dang mkha' 'gro gsang ba yi/ /thun min rigs dang thun mong kun/ /snying po sngags kyi gsang rgyud zungs/ /dam tshig 'byung dang thugs brtse'o/ /de skad gsungs pas 'khor thams cad rjes su yi rangs te/ mngon par bstod do drag sngags mtshon cha nag po sku'i rgyud las/ rgyud gtad cing yi rangs pa'i le'u ste dgu pa'o/ /sde brgyad cham la 'beb shing rang gshed rang la 'beb pa'i rgyud/ rdo rje thog 'beb sku'i rgyud ces bya ba/ lha yul du grags pa rdzogs so/ /bal po bha su dha ra dang bod kyi sgra bsgyur gyi lo tsā ba slob dpon sangs rgyas kyis ba ta sa ru mkha' 'gro dang bka' bgros te bsgyur ba'o/ snying po'i rgyud dam pa/ snying po don gyi rgyud/rtsigs su bzhag pa lags so/ rgya rgya rgya/ pha rgyud lags rbersha/ 3|/
༄7/ /drag sngags nag po snying 'dzingasalas/ sgrub khog chen mo'i dbab pa zhesabya ba bzhugs so/ /zil gnon gyi bsgrub khog chen mo'i rtsa ba bzhugs so//

༄7/ /bu tri ham shang tri 'gong po nā kyu ga phu4༷༷ tsitta dkrugs dgra bo dṛ ma ra ya rbad/ ces pa zhag gsum bzlas rgyal po bskul dum ro gtang skabs su thun brab la tig go/ rtags ni tsitta 'dar ba dang / 'tshags pa 'ong gal te ma byung na nyin zhag phrugs gcig tu bzlas so/ ya ma ra dza tsitta 'bru brgyad bshams la dkrugs/ dgra po'i srog la breng shag/ dṛ mā ra ya rbad 'og ma kun la sgril lo ces btags so/ spyir gnod pa de nyid ngos ma zin na/ dregs pa dril la bgrangs/ ngos zin na rkyang par bya ba'am/ yang na gnod byed bshams su bzhag par bya'o/ sngags phyi ma des snying 'gas par 'gyur ro/ zla ba mi 'gor bar ma traX bsgral ba bzhin 'gro'o/ gong gi sngags/ ayau ayau ayau ring la nan tan bya ba ces so/ gong gi sngags grub na 'khor 'o1 la sogs pa ma byas kyang / sngags kyi skabs la 'og gi las sngags kun btags nas byas pas 'grub par 'gyur ro las kyi btsad liṅga rang rang ltar bcas bo dang / rdo rje'i spun dang / slob ma dang / bon po dang / ur mo nang 'gras kyang/ mai mo a mu sngags ring sham bu ka rā dza dṛ dza thums ril mā ra ya rbad las kyi btsad po srog la hur thums mā ra ya rbad/ (kha༄༄1ga la slob ma dam nyams las hur thums mā ra ya rbad/ (nga༄༄1ga dam tshig gcig pa la hu' yam thun rmugs mā ra ya rbad (nga)srog la sngags pa spyi la mug dzaX hri shag mā ra ya rbad/ srog bon po mu stegs can la
dṛ dza thun mugs mā ra yarbad/ tsitta rag sngags mkhan khaX/ shag dza/ srog la yam thun rbad ces sham bur btags te/ rang rang gi liṅga byas te las kyi brabs btab nas/ (ka)seng ge'i sgrub pa'i dar 'gor khog pa/ (ga)stag gi chu mig chu shar re 'bab 'dzum dang / (kha)gzigs gi lu ma 'khyil par mnan thig le dang / (ngadamun ra ba'am khang snying par mnan pa'i gling dang / (ca)srin brag dmar chu gsher 'bab pasamo'i sgroms dang / 'brong ri nag po'am brag nag po gi ra sprag tu mnan par bya'o/ shin tu zab bo/ ngan drag sngags la dor ba sngags snying la sdig pa nag po ru 'dzings rno myur dang bcasapa pa'i dril sgrub/ gsang ba las kyang gsang du bka' rgya bcas pa med pa/ rgya drag sngags kyi bdag po gar mkhas pa gtsug lag dpal dge'i ngan sngags su phyung thabasashesarab snying po yi brgyud lasayang mdzod khyad par gyi gdamasapa kyi gdams pa shin snod ngan la tu gsang ba rjerdzogs so/nga'274na ཿ—tshoṣṭhakha'atsha54pa 73mar64mthakhyo ru dum pa rgya ston la/ ru bral bayo yas dpal des zhus/ ru bral rgya gar 'od la de la gangs bgris dar ban gyis zhus/ so/ e ma hoX ngo mtshar che gu hya shin tu gsang ngo : rgya rgya rgya/ sarba maṅga laX/
༄༅/ /'khor lo gsang ba'i spra khrid zhesabya ba bzhugs so/
༄༅/ /'di kho na'o/ 'di kho na'o/ 'di kho na'o/ dregs pa thams cad 'joms pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ gsang ba tsitta la brten pa'i gdams pa 'di la/ bsad pa'i las la 'di med don med yug pa rkyang zhes grags so/ shin tu gdug cing dben pa'i gnyan pa'i sar/ rang nyid bde shin tu gsang ba'i mtshams bcad la/ drag sngags lha tshogs thams cad la gtor ma bshams la/ dpa' bo grir bsad pa'i snying nang du/ liṅga rkang rjes 'dug rjes chu shul skra dum la/ 'dra 'bag byas la liṅga mnan/ ro ras dag gam zhing ras la/ gdug byed sdig pa nag po gri lcags dang lce phyesal/ dug dug gi rab tu byug pa khrag dbang gis rab tu byug dug gi 'khor 'o( bri bar bya/ mu khyud rim pa gsum red du bskor/ dbus su brnag pa'i a mu ka phyi rim bzhi pa la rdo rje mo 'khrugs bri/ de la rtsa sngags 'bru e myags
༄tshi/ /brgyad dgod/ spu gri gcod pa'i rtsibs drug la/ bsad pa'i drag sngags srog la bring khung nag po dgodalusasrog 'brel/ lcags srog la myags kyi sdig pa nag po ni/ rwa bgrad tshul du bri bar bya/ bsad pa drag po'i 'khor lo'o/ dpa' bo gri sgod grir bsad lpags pa la/ phra dog gri khrag gi bse yi sbal snying khrag 'jib pa bri/ mu khyud rim pa gsum du bskor/ dbus su gnag pa'i liṅga srog la myags bri/ phyi rim rdo rje rtsa chen bzhi gcod pa rgya gram la/ drag sngags e myags gnam thogs 'bru brgyad daskyurdzod/ spu gri gcod pa'i 'bru bzhi rnam shesatshogs brgyad 'joms la/ drag e myags sngags gnam thog chen lngardzo dgod/ bse yi sbal pa dmar po bri/ rabs chad thod kṣu bdag zhal phyed pa gshag pa'i nang / tsitta'i 'khor lo sgril la gzhug ag rtse bar yar thun lo bstan/ de nas drag dug spangs dkar zer po thun rdzas sna tshogs gsog sngo dmar
skud pas dril nas kyang / byad bcug gu gul sbyar bas bdug lha dang dbye zhing 'brub/ khung kha la skyon/ re ba nag pos dril la bdun nag gi bcad par bzhag de nas phyag rgya go cha bsrung ba'i 'khor lo zil gnon du gsal bar bsgoms la/ sngags bzlas rṣi nge 'dzin pas bse yi sbal pa dmar po de las bzas pa po'i rtsa bzhi bcad nas/ rdo rjes tsitta khong du 'khrug cing / rtsibs bcu gnyis kyis kho'i rnam par shes pa tshogs brgyad 'joms shing bse yi sbal pas snying khrag 'jib par bsam mo/ mtshan mo nag sdig pa po'i sngags bzlas pas/ sngags la dug gi me 'bar nas/ rdo rjes tsitta dkrug cing bzas pa po'i tshe srog gtubs nas/ lcags kyi sdig pas snying khrag rngubs par bsam mo/ dgong dang tho rangs thun ayau ayau ayau cesapasasngags ring mos brab pas/ ma gshin rnams kyi sha rus 'bu yi snyigs shing sha khrag rnams lha srin rṣi 'dzin rnams kyi za bar bsam mo rtags ni sems can bsad pa dang/ dngos su bsad dgra bo pa dang / ra g.yag bsad pa dang tsitta 'dar ba dang / 'tsheg pa dang / tsitta 'gas pa 'ong ngo / de ltar byung ba dang / nyin mo sbal pa dmar po'i las zhag gsum bya/ mtshan mo sdig pa nag po'i las bya/ bar re 'ga' bar du thun dril la brdeg go de rnams sbams la/ gza' ngan pa dang / bdud kyi nyi ma la mchod rten la mnan/ yang na lam rgya gram du mnan/ kha
༄tsho/ /la bal nag gis bgab/ ri rab kyi mnan par bsam/ don bya ba thams cad grub yod grub pa'i pho brang thebs par bsam/ dus thams cad du thun gyi las nyi tshe bya/ drag sngags lha tshogs la gtor ma gtong /bcol spyi chosakyi bskul bya/ ma nyes pa'i dpang gzug phyis kha gso kyang thun 'phang ngo / gong gi sngags ring thems pa shin tu/ phyi phyisalhasatshan che mchod rten la brten nas bsad pa'am/ nang kha tu 'khor lo la brten nas/bsad pa dang / 'di ni gsang ba tsitta la brten nas bsad pa'o/ 'di kho na'o/ 'di kho na gsang ba'o/ bdag 'dra sangs rgyas ye shes la/ gu ru'i rgyal po ba su dha ra yis/ khyad par gsang ba'i snying po'i rab tu gsang brgyud do rgyud/ sdig pa nag po snying 'dzings bcud du phyungs/ de'i nang nas bsad pa'i las/ rang gshed bsad pa'i snying thun zab/ 'di 'dra'i drag sngags zab par byed pa yis/ las can gcig gis chongs la ma spel cig nga ru 〈 ba gcig dang 'phrad par shog sgron ma pra khrid nang nas rang gshed bsad pa'i snying thun sgron ma rdzogs so/ tshos/ /tthaX/ sarba maṅga laX/ /
༄tsho/ /mnan pa'i zhal gdams zhig yod/
༄tshi/ /bsgrub pa dang drag sngags gang sgrub pa'i/ /shan pa drag po'i bsad sngags 'di/ /rab kyis rkang (skang )thon bsnol mar brdeg /'bring gi bcu phrag bsnol mar brdeg /tha mas brgya phrag bsnol mar brdeg /drag po'i thun gyi liṅga bri/ /phyag rgya zil gnon skur bsgoms la/ /thugs las bshan pa'i tshogs spros la/ 'od zer sngo dmar tshogs spros te/ /bshan pa'i tshogs dang yig 'bru yi bzas pa'i snra dkrug 'khor lo bsgyur/ /tsakra mtshon cha rang gcod kyi/ /bdud kyi gnas gzhi 'joms pas ste/ /shing rta 'khor lo'i 'phang lo bzhin/ /rgyun mi chad par spros nas kyang / /mgo bskor yid dkrug khrag tu skyugs/ /thams cad srog gi me mar bsad/ /nad dang dug gi rtsa rgyas nas/ /lus srog gtan gyi me mar bsad/ /bsgom bskul drag sngags bsnol mar brdeg /bsad
༄༅/ /pa'i sbyor ba de ka la/ /rkyang pa'i mtshon cha bsnol mar brdeg /bla chen bzhi yi rtags byung na/ /drag sngags 'di dag rtags la bzlas/ /srog la pri shag dza/ tsitta breng shag rbad/ /bla'i sprul pa brgyad byung na/ /de la drag sngags 'di dag brdeg srog la dun rmugs dza/ tsitta breng shag rbad/ yang sprul bcu gnyis rtags byung na/ /dgra bo'i srog la snra khung thums dza/ /tsitta breng shag dun rmugs rbad/ /chags sdang lnga byung sngags 'dis brdeg /dgra bo'i srog la thun gzir shag tsitta breng shag rbad/ /bla rtags kun byung sngags 'dis brdeg /dgra bo'i srog la thun gzir rbad/ tsitta breng shag rbad/ bla rtags gang yang ma byung na/ /de la drag sngags 'di dag brdeg par bya'o/ /dgra bo'i srog la yam yam snra dza bram shag rbad/ rtags sbyar spu gri bsnol ma'am/ /yang na spu gri sham bur
gdag par bya/ /skabs su drag po'i thun brab cing/ /nyungs gar nyung nag skye mos brab/ /de ltar las kyi mtha' brtul nas/ /dur khrod gling ngam rgya gram lam/ /zam zur dag gam klu'i gnas/ /sa brkos phur pa 'khor los brab/ /ya ma gtum po'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /'byung ba'i sgo phye gshin rje la/ /skal pa gsum gyi bar du gtad/ /rdo rje rgya gram bcas pas mnan/ oX hri tri bi tri ta na na mo la/ /dgra bo ma ra ya nan/ces brjod cing sa yang brdzib/ /don yod grub pa'i pho brang gdab/ /de ltar byas na myur du yang/ /tshangs pa'i tshe dang ldan yang brlag drag sngags kyi rgyal po yang gsang bcu gcig pa'i man ngag srog gi 'khor lo rdzogs so/
do༅/ /sngags kyi zhabrul 'khor sdig pa snying 'dzingasadrag po dbang sdud bzhugs/
༄tshi/ /sngags kyi 'khrul 'khor sdig pa snying 'dzings drag po dbang sdud kyi man ngag gocaX ayo ayo ayo/ a kro te ga ya mān ta ga ya ma ye ka la ru pa ka pa ye/ hriṣṭi a pa ye/ a a ne a nai/ u u nai u nee/ du du nee du ne/ a e/ u e/ o aX/ ra ri/ la laṃ/ du ru ye/ bya tsa ye/ sing nga ye/ hri da ye/ bhe ta ye/ ha la ye/ mu ka ye/ u u nee/ u.u ne/ byi tri ta/ a a/ na na/ma ya ra tsa/ ya ma rag sha ya ma rag a/ ya ma rakṣaX pe ta li/ kro ti shwa ri/ ma ma e ka dza ti/ de ma kha la bam ri/ ru lu ru lu/ shrī zhi khro lha brgyud badzra kro ta/ ya ma las kyi galnga mo garmā ro sha na tri ta tsanta rag sha mon las kyi mon pa ta/ a gang la bya ba mu ga myags thums ril/ trig nan [sbur ya nan/ mnan pa/ bsnyan pa la/ āXhūm̐X dza tya/ a mu ka la mi 'jug e srog 'jug] dgra srog dzaX kham shag ro
༄tsho/ /sbyor ba rtsom myags mugs ti rbad ya/ drag sngags gnam thog ltar du las kyi sdebs yig gsang ba 'di la/ bzla lugs gnyis te/ bsgrub pa dang drag ngedzi gnyis so/ bsgrub pa'i dus su bdag nyid gzhin rje gshed po khro bo zhal kha thun ltar gsum phyag drug pa'am/ mo byang ltar zhal drug pa'am/ zhal cig pa gang yang rung spyi bor oX ñtsa steng du gyiXdamar po bar bsgom mo'oX thugs rin po che tsitta gur phub gzhal yas khang smug po pa 'dra ba'i nang na nyi ma las ma'i dkyil 'khor the bong rtsi/ de'i steng du ye shes sems dpa'i sku mdog smug mtshon gang pa nag phyag mtshan mi mnga' ba zhig bsgoms/ de'i thugs khar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yi ge hūm̐X mthing thugs la 'gyur ba med pasaye shesalnga nag 'od zer kha dog lnga 'phros pa zhig bsgom mo/ de la bzlas pa bya ba'i sngags e e g.yon bskor du kyi phreng bas klag phyogs su bskor bar bsgom mo/
hūṃX de las 'od zer 'phreng bar 'phros pas ñtsa stengs su 'phros te gong ma'i nang du yi ge hrīXl bskor bar ngag gi sgrib pa sbyangs bsam/ dung khang du āoX la lusakyi sgrib pa sbyangs bskor bar bya ste/ sku gsung thugs kyi gnas su 'od zer 'phro 'du byas pasagyis lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa sbyangs chosanyid te/ 'od zer phyir 'phros pas bde bar gshegs pa'i gnas su 'phros pas 'og min du ye shesapa'i thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul 'gro drug gi sems can la phog pas sprul pa la sprul pa rol 61ga rtog sems can gi sgrib pa sbyang nas/ yul dgra bgegs rnams la ba mo la nyi ma shar ba bzhin phog pas/ bya lhag mes bcom pa/ ltar tshan la rtsa sbur mi chags pa bzhin bsam/ slar 'dus pas bkrag dang gzi mdangs thams cad rang la 'dus pa las ye shes kyi sku shin tu brjid che ba/ ba spu thams cad rdo rje khro chung du gtam par bsgom mo/ drag po'i dus su bdag nyid phyag rgya zil gnon du gsal ba'i thugs tsitta rin po che'i nang na nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ 'od tshon gang pa'i rtse mo la yi ge hūṃX mthing nag nas tsam pa gnas par bsgom mo/ de'i thugs ga'i phyi rol ya ma ra dza/ de'i steng du 'od kyi rtse la yi ge ya mthing nag cig bsgom/ de'i thugs ga'i phyi rol du dregs pa phyag na rdo rdze bsgom mo/ de'i thugs tsitta'i nang du yi ge hūm̐X mthing nag gcig yungs 'bru tsam bsgom mo/ de'i thugs gar rus sbal gyi rgyal po bsgom mo/
༄༅/ /de'i tsitta'i nang du yi ge e gcig bsgom mo/ bya khyung gi thugs gar yi ge khroX gcig bsgom mo/ yum gyi thugs gar yi ge ma gcig bsgom mo/ de rnams kyi tha mar sngags ky-i lusagrib ma med pa bskor bar bsgom pa ni lha dang sngags gsal ba'o/ de nas yul gsal ba ni gang la bya ba de rnams la sngags kyi phreng bas ba〉stor bas/ lha rnams kyi 'od zer lcagasadakyu lta bu 'phrosate snying ga nas bkuga.e'i khyams khang nang na gsal ba ba spu'i bu ga nas rlung gi 'khor lo lta bu bus pas rang dbang med par 'gugs pas te/ gzir ba'i dus spyang mo drug go su ri gzar gyi rbab gnam lcags kyi thog lta bus mgo bkas te rang dbang med par bsam mo/ bsad pa'i dus su gnam lcags kyi rbersha dang spu gri'i rbersha sngagasakyisa'od zer mtshon cha lta busadagra bgegs lta bus nyal nyal gcod par bsam/ bsrung ba:rdzog gnyis ka 'dis bya/ e rings rdo rje'i mkhar du me ri du dung gi gseb tu rnal 'byor pa bdag nyid 'bor dang bcas pa bskyed bsrung ba'i dus su gang la bya ba de rdo rje'i me lta bus bsreg par bya ste/ rdo rje me 'od mgar gyi sol mal la lcags zhun rang zil gnon du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer thebs pa'i tsha tsha 'phro ba la/ gang gis kyang mi tshugs pa ltar bsam/ ngag gamu pa'i dang stobs mnan pa'i dus su dgra dang bgegs yul gang la bya ba'i lce steng du/ gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar gnam ri rab las brjid che ba'i lcags kyi phur pas thal phyungs te dgra bo'i lce
ri rab lta bus mnan par bsam/ bzhig pa'i dus su gsal bya'i dgra bgegs snying kha la sogs pa ru 'od dgra bgegs kyi lusangag yid gsum la 'od zer phog pas zer 'khor lo lta bu 'phros te thor zor nyal nyal song bar bsam gsang lam dgag pa'i dus su/ kho rang brten pa'i lha bdud bsrung ma gang byed du babs te/ gtor ma 'phangs pa la khyi rub pa kho rang gi sha khrag la rngub te zosapar bsam bzhin du kho rang la rub par bsam mo/ zug pa dbyung ba'i dus su ye shes kyi 'od zer gyi rang la zug pa'i nad gdon dang sdig sgrib thamasacad dang / byad thams cad thul thul ye shesakyi me 'bar te bsreg par bsam ste/ snang stong dbyer med du lha'i sku gsal gsal bsgom/ drag po bzlas so 'khrul 'khor gsang ba'i man ngag sbas tig gsang ba'i man ngag rnal 'byor pa'i snying la bzhag pa'o/ sbas tig nag po rdzogs so/ dang po rdo rje'i mkhar du/ mi shog pa'i go cha bsrung ba'i tsakra sku bskyed pa dang nam mkha'i mthongs su/ sbyor ba'i stobs bzhig mi dang mi ma yin pas byas pa thamasacad pa dang / ri rab kyi lce la gnam lcags bsad pa'i tsakra kyi drasna brdar ba dang / ri thang mtshams su zhe sdang khros pa'i gzhu bcag bzlog pa'i tsakra pa dang / rgya mtsho'i gting du mun mnan pa'i tsakra pa'i dmag bsdu ba dang / 'khor ba'i rgya gling du srid 'phrug pa'i tsakra pa'i ri bsgyel ba dang drug go 'di drug gi don rnams bsgrub thabs che chung gnyis na gsal lo4༷༷
༄tshi/ /logs su shes par byas la dpyod: bsgrub thabs gnyis po 'og tu gsal lo: snying 'dzings kyi man ngag shin tu zab pa'i lag len no/ stos/
༄7/ /lha srin ming srog 'phrog pa'i ting 'dzin yig chung bzhugs so//
