༄tshi/ /bcom ldan 'das zil gnon phyag rgya chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ rus sbal khra bo'i spra khrid ni: chu mig lkugs pa 'khyil pa ste: kha ni phyogs bcur bltas pa la: rus sbal nag po gnas pa yin: rus sbal lto ba gshags byas la/ bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis gtad mig btsal: tha chung bzhi la shar du ltaX 'bring po bzhi la lho ru lta: ra ba bzhi la nub tu lta: byang dang shar du lta ba yin/ rtag tu kha bug gnas pa yin/ /nyin gung mtshan gung gan rkyal gnas/ /dbus kyi chu mig snying khar 'dod/ /snying nas kha ru 'dom gang yod/ /kha nas lag par 'dom re yod/ /kha nas lag pa'i bar dag tu/ /khru de las ni rwa yin te/ /snying nas 'dom gang sa ru na/ lag pa nas ni 'dom re bcal/ /de nas mchan khung g.yas g.yon yin/ /snying nas mjug mar 'dom gang ni/ /lte ba yin par shes par bya/ /lte ba nas ni 'dom gang dang / /mchan khung nas bcal 'dom gang du/ /lto ni g.yas g.yon yin par 'dod/ /lto ba nas ni mjug bar du/ /'dom gang dag tu 'dod pa yin/ /de nas g.yas g.yerdzon 'dom re ste/ /lho nas 'dom re rkang pa yin/ /mjug ma g.yas g.yon khru re ste/ /gsang ni g.yas g.yon gnyis su 'dod/ /dkyus su 'dom ni gsum pa la/ /zheng du 'dom ni do re ste/ /gru bzhi gab ba'i gzugs su brtag /de la gtad mig bcu gnyis bya/ kha la sbrul 'o1 gtad par bya/ /ra g.yas la ni 'brug 'ordzo pa/ /lag pa g.yar pa yos bu gtad/ /mchan khung g.yas par stag 'ordzo gtad/ rkang pa g.yas par glang 'o1 gtad/ /gsang ba g.yas par phag 'o1 gtad/ /gsang ba g.yerdzon par byi
༄tsho/ /ba'o / / rkang pa g.yon par khyi lo ste/ /lho ba g.yerdzon la bya le'o/ /mchan khung g.yon par spre'u ste/ lag pa g.yon par lug lo gtod/ /rwa g.yon la ni rta gtad do/ /snyan khar gcig la man ngag ste/ /bcu gnyis 'khor lo'i pra khrid yin/khams chen lnga yi gtad bshad pa/ /kha nas snying khar 'dom gang la/ /mgo la byi khams gtad par bya/ /mjug la gsang gnad phyir 'dom gang / /de ru 'u khams gtad par bya/ /lto g.yas su ni gag khams so/ /lto ba g.yon du kung khams gtad/ /yan lag bzhi la gsham khams gtad/ /khams chen lnga yi gtad dmigs so/ /rnam shes bang po'i sbyor ba las/ /mi rigs brgyad kyi gtad thabs bstan/ /kha la sngags pa gtad par bya/ /kha nas mgo la khru phyed la/ /sna yod pas na ben po gtad mgo nas g.yas g.yerdzon khu re re/ /mig gnyis yod pas rgyal po gtad/ /mig gnyis mjug nas khru phyed phyed/ /rna ba gnyis la rje rigs gtad/ /rwa re gnyis la dmangs rigs gtad/ /snying ga ru ni yul bsrungs ma/ /lte bar blun po gtad par bya/ /gsang gnas 'og tu khru byed la/ /der ni lha mi gtad par bya/ /mi rigs gtad pa'i spra khrid de/ /nad rigs rnams la bya ba ni/ /snying ga g.yas su glo ba ste/ / gru gang g.yas su bcal ba'o/ /de la gtad na snying 'bog 'ong / /snying la gtad pa'i las lhas so/ /lte ba'i 'og tu khru gang la/ /rgyu mar gtad na rims nad 'ong / /snying nas khru phyed mar bcal bar/ /mchin par gtad na 'bog nad 'ong / lto ba g.yas g.yon khru re'i sar/ /mkhal ma la ni lha dang dbye/ /nad rims sbyar
ba'i gtad thabs so/ /rus sbal lus kyi khyon dag la/ /gtad pa'i sbyor ba 'di yin te/ /mgo nas rgyab tu khru gang du/ /ske la gtad na rengs dang lkugs/ /chu po'i thad dkar 'dom gsum na/ /rkang pa gnas te zha grum 'ong / /snying ga'i 'thad nas 'dom gsum na/ /lag pa gnas te zha grum 'ong / /mdze nad ba ci ka ya 'ong / /mig nad 'dom bzhi gyen la bcal/ /spyi don ra rtse yod pa yin/ /mgo 'khor nad dang gri rgod 'ong / /mtshan ma nas ni 'dom bzhi na/ /rkang rten pa de phye 'od zer 'gro / / yan lag bzhi ni phyir dgye bas/ /'dom ni bzhi yi ba dag na/ /dreg dang grum bu mdze 'bras dang / /yang na gong bur 'gro ba yi/ /tshad can gtad pa'i lugs 'di dag /klu yi lus la nges med pas/ lus tshad 'jal bar mi 'os te/ /ri bo ma la ya dang ni/ /yag sha 'khrug pa'i nas dag tu/ /klu yi bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir/ /rnal 'byor de yi tshad kyi gzhal/ /klu rnams ri bo khur du 'khur/ /de bzhin klu yi 'dug tshul dang/ /chu mig rtags pa de yi tshad/ /mkhas pas rtag la brtan par bya/ nad dang 'chi ba'i ngos bzung dang / /mig la phog na myur ba yin/ /zlog dang kham pa dus yin pas/ /dus dang lho phyo kun la sbyar/ /rus sbal nag po'i lus kyi spra khrid 'di dag klu'i lus la nges pa med rdzogs so/ /
do༅/ /snying 'dzingasasnying po'i brtsa phyung ba srung ba'i man ngag cesabya ba btsos so/ gu hya/
༄tshi/ /bdag 'dra sangs rgyas ye shes kyis/ /gdug pa klu gnyan sa bdag 'dul ba'i phyir/ /gdug pa klu la rang gshed dbab pa'i phyir/ /sdig pa ru 'dzings snying po bcud du/ e ma ho/ /thams cad sku gsung thugs bdag nyid/ /zug rngu mtshan ma kun spangs te/ /yon tan ma lus kun ldan pa/ /bde ba chen po mchog la 'dud/ /snyigs ma lnga yi dus nyid du/ /gdug pa ye shes dar ba la/ zhen chags 'joms byed bcud len bshad/ /lha gsal sngags dang rdzas rnams kyi/ /drag po yang snying bshad par bya/ /de la sa bdag klu gnyan gyi nad ni/ 'gras pa 'di dag las ldang ste/ rigs na gnod pa dang / rang gi las thabs kyi 'gras pa dang / gzhan gyi gtad khram bcug pa dang / rang gi gtad khram log pa las ldang ste/ rkyen gyis ldang ba'o/ /'byung ba'i nad 'khrugs pa las gyur pa dang / tshe rabs kyis ldang ba ste/ nad de rnams zug pa dbyung ba dang / zhen pa bzlog pa'i phyir/ drag po sngags rgod kyi las 'di bshad do/ /de yang dang po maṇḍal khru gang pa rtse mo lhor bstan pa cig mi bsad pa'am g.yul bkye ba'i sa la bya'o/ /kha dog nag por byas la rtsang gis bskor/ 'khor lo bca' thabs la rgya ༄rdzog la gdug pa'i rdzas byugs shing thig skor bzhir byas/ dbus drag por byas la/ sa nā ga phu shri 'brub khung bzhir ma mo dang /rgyal po dang / mdze 'dre dang / btsan bri/ phyi rim rdo rje rgya gram la rtsa ba'i sngags dgod/ mtshams su sa bdag klu gnyan gyi gzugs bri/ phyi rim gdug pa'i rwa ba mtha' ma 'khrul mi mig bcu gcig snying po drag sngags spu gri dgod/ de dag kyang rus
༄tshi/ /sbal gyi lto bar bri ste/ kha sbyar gnyis 'brub khung du rtsang dmar la dgram mo/ de la dug dang me khrag gis byug go de ltar bcas legs pa dang / lha gsal bar bya ste/ lus la sra ba'i go gon/ dang po stong pa chos nyid kyi ngang las/ e zhes rngams par grags pas chu la chu bur rdol ba'i tshul du/ e chos 'byung gru gsum dbus su/ klu 'bum gnyan khri/ sa bdag stong / de'i steng du phyogs skyong bcu/ de steng ma he brgyad kyis brdzis pa/ de yi steng du nyi zla padma'i gdan la/ bdag phyag rgya zil gnon lha bu gsum pa la/ g.yas dkar ba/ g.yon dmar ba/ dbus mthing ba/ g.yas dang po 'khor lo/ bar ba ral gri/ tha ma na rdo rje/ g.yon dang po na be con/ bar pa na gtun shing / tha ma sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ sku mthing la rngams pa/ zhabs bzhi bsgrad pa/ thugs ka na dbang chen bran du khol ba/ ya ma rā tsa smug nag g.yas 'khor lo/ g.yon tsitta bsnams pa/ de'i thugs ka na dregs pa phyag na rdo rje sku mdog ljang nag g.yas rdo rje dang / g.yon snying gi phreng ba bsnams pa/ de'i thugs ka na srid pa'i khyams khang na rus sbal khra bo thur du bltas pa/ lho na gang dmigs pa'i srog snying 'chang ba/ gtso bo'i dbu'i steng na bya khyung sbrul za ba/ phrag gong gnyis na khyung mo mug nag gnyis/ nu ma gnyis na seng ge gnyis dpung pa gnyis na stag gnyis/ sta zur gnyis na sbrul gnyis/ de ltar lus la gnas par bsgom/ de nas sngags gsal nas/ klu gnyan sa bdag gi stobs gzhom pa ni/ drag sngags kyi snying ped(/ /e ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya/
sa na ga srog la greng breng dun dun thum ril sha dza sa nā ga srog la breng breng dza dza thum ril shag sa nā ga srog la dun dun thum ril shag sa nā ga tsitta thum rim shag sa nā ga rtsa la rbad thums ril shag sa nā ga dum rlang khas thum ril shag sa nā ga srog hur thum ril shag sa nā ga rtsitta thum ril shag sa nā ga snying gzer sbur nan thum ril shag sa nā ga du mo ma ma srog gzir thum ril shag sa nā ga tsa tri tri shu la thum ril shag sa nā ga ro ni tri ya lhag nan gzer thum ril shag drag sngags me dbal 'khor lo dang 'dra ba 'di zhag bdun nam bcu bzhi/ nyi shu rtsa gcig tu bzlas te/ dug dang / khrag dang / yungs dkar gyis brab kro/ mthar 'khor lo de phag thod du brub ste/ gang gnod pa'am/ macod rten la mnan pa bya'o/ /de yang sngags kyi bzlas thabs gnyis/ rang bzhin gyi bzlas pa ni/ lha gsal bar byas la/ sngags stong stong dal bar bzlas/ btsan thabs su bzlas pa ni/ rdzas rgod kyi du bas bdug cing bzlas/ drag po gong gi 'khor lo bcas la/ gang gnod pa'i sa nas blangs te/gzugs byas la sngags kyis brab cing / drag po'i rdzas rgod kyis brab bo/ gnod tshabs che na sbyin sreg kyang bya/ lha gsal ba gal che/ sngags dang dmigs pa yang gsal bar bya'o/ /bum pa'i khrus kyang bya/ rin po che'i snod mdzes pa rsā chu sna dgu la sogs pa la/ spos la sogs pa'i dri'i rnam pa yang blugs la/ sngags bzlog gi yungs dkar kyang bum par blugs la/ ye shes kyi zer yang sngags kyi chus lus bkrus la/ zhen chags thams cad 'joms par byed do/ sarba tsitta ro myags kha tham/
༄tsho/ /srog zir bur nan 'drid phyung hri shag rbad/ ces pas nya stong la khrus bya'o/ /bgegs tshabs che na gnad rdzas kyi nad pa bdug ste/ mi rta bya yi tshil bu dang / nya sbrul sbal pa'i sha dang / khyi phag spyang zhi'i brun/ mdzo rtag dre'u'i spu/ rnal khrag dang spyang dug ra dug thar nu/ ba glang rwa'i gzhob/ rta rmig gi gzhob dang / de rnams kyis bdug sngags brab bo/ /rmi lam gyi rnam pa ni ci byung yang dga' ba dang rtog pa mi bya/ lus yang zhing sems gsal ba dang / khong shugs che ba byung na las grub pa'o / athi+-i/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga'i rim pa na phung pa gsum maṇḍal khru gang pa cig brtsigs la rgya sol dang khrag gis byug dbus su rgya gram ljang gu bya'o/ /der ho shing brtsigs pa'am/ bam po byas te/ me sta zhon la gnas par bya'o/ /de nas liṅga sen gang pa brgya rtsa brgyad byas te/ bag phye dang dug chus sbrus pa'i ril bu bzhag go bya dang phag pa'i sha tshil/ gi waX til mar yung nag /mar khu yungs dkar la btsan dug gi chus byugs la brab bo/ me thab tu lhun gyi grub pa'i phyag rgya'i tshogs/ 'byung ba'i me gnyis par bzhugs par bsams la/ sngags brgya brgyas ril bu dang bsregs rdzas dbul lo/ /e ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya/ sa nā ga'i srog la hur thums rbad dzwa la raX shag rbad ces srog go stoni/ sa bdag klu gnyan lus la zhugs yod na/ khrag ngan bton la bsreg go /lus la zhugs pa med na sngags stong gis bsrung / gnod mi gnod brtag pa ni/ sla nga'am/ 'khar phor du chu ngan blugs la/ grib ma la bzhag go /grangs nas mdog log tsam na sa bdag gi gzugs
'ong ngo / de ma byung na 'byung ba 'khrugs pa'i nad yin pas sman gyi bcos so/ /rgya rgya rgya/ sdig pa snying 'dzings snying po'i bcud phyung ba'i bsrung ba'i man ngag lha/ sarba maṅga laX/ /
༄༅/ /bcom ldan 'das phyag rgya zilaganon gyi phrin lasakyi rim pa gsal bar byed pa'i sgron me bzhugs so//
༄tshi/ /'jam dpal gshin rje gshed phyag rgya zil gnon gyi phrin las bsdus pa'i rim pa gsal bar byed pa'i sgron me zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed phyag rgya chen po zil gnon tshe bdag nag po dregs pa thams cad 'joms par byed pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ skyabs 'gro ni/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams laca sangs rgyas la: chos laca dge 'dun laca sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ zhes pa nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog ji ltar 'jig rten mgon po rnams/ zhes pa nas/ dam pa bdag gi bskyed par bgyi/ zhes pa nas/ sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ tshogs zhing spyan 'dren ni/ rang nyid phyag rgya zil gnon du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa phyogs bcur 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das phyag rgya chen po zil gnon gyi dkyil 'khor/ bla ma rigs bdag gi rnam pas gtso bo'i dbu brgyan pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ mkha' 'gro dpa' bo dam can srung mar bcas pa rnams spyan drangs/ oX badzra sa ma ya hūm̐X dza: bdag mdun rnam dag gi sgo nasabasod namasakyi tshogs gsog pa ni/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid/ dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste/ bla ma'i sku la phyag
༄tshi/ /'tshal lo/ bla ma'i gsung la: bla ma'i thugs la: rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/ dus gsum bzhugs laca sangs rgyas kun gyi ngobo nyid/ zil gnon 'khor bcas la phyag 'tshal/ bdag mdun rnam dag gi sgo nasamachod pa 'bul ba ni/mchog gsum ston pa'i zhing gyur pa/ gnyis med sems kyi skyabs su mchi/ dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i/ dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ bshagasapa ni/ dngos grub chu bo gcod pa'i bgegs/ nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi/rjesasu yi rang ba ni/ phyogs bcu 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos/ ma chags spyod la rjes yi rang / dag pa'i mtha' bzhi dri ma med/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do/ bde gshegs byang chub sems dpa' la/ dgos pa gsum phyir lus 'bul lo/bsngo ba ni tshe rabs bgrangs pa'i las rnams su/ bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo/ mdun gyi tshogs rten gyi lha rnams 'od du zhu/ dzaXhūm̐X bam ho: rang gi snying khar thim/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag/ tshad med bzhi bsgom pa ni/ sems can thams cad bde gyur cig/ sdug bsngal dag dang bral bar shog/ bde dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing/ chos kun mnyam nyid rtogs par shog/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag gi rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang rin po che thob par bya/ de'i ched du bcom ldan 'das phyag rgya zil gnon gyi dkyil 'bor chen po bsgom zhing mchod pa rgya chen pos mchod par bya'o/ /ye shesakyi tshogs gsog pa ni/ oX ma hā shu n+ya ta dzñā na badzra swā bhā ba urma ko3haX/ mchod pa mchod byed/ mchod pa'i ngo bo/ 'bor 'das lam gsum
gyi bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin rnam par dag pa'i ngang nas/ brtan g.yo thams cad gshin rje gshed kyi rnam par 'od du zhu nas bdag la rim/ bdag kyang 'od du zhu ste mi dmigs pa stong pa/ chos thams cad stong zhing bdag med pa/ stong pa'i ngang las pam las padma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐X yig sngon po yongs su gyur pa las byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / ra thams cad rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ de'i lte ba mthing nag la padma dang nyi ma'i steng du/ rang nyid skad cig gis phyag rgya ril gnon du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer rab tu tsha ba'i tshogs grangs med par phyogs bcur 'phros/ 'phags pa'i tshogs mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ bar du gcod pa'i bgegs tshar bcad/ steng du 'phros pas mtho la yangs sgang rgya che ba rdo rje'i gur dang bla bres/ 'og tu 'phros pas sra la brtan pa'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ phyogs dang phyogs mtshams rnams su 'phros pas rdo rje'i 'greng bur gyur pa la brtan cing go skabs mi phyed pa/ rdo rje'i ra ba dang / dra ba/ de'i phyi rol kun tu rdo rje'i me ri kha dog lnga dang ldan zhing me lte rab tu 'bar ba/ bskal pa'i me lta bu 'phro ba/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i bsrung ba'i 'ber lo yangs shong rgya che ba/ 'od zer de dag tshur 'dus/rang lhar gsal ba la thim pas/ shin tu brjid pa'i gze brjid dang ldan pas dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad mnan pas nga rgyal bas/ mtshams gcod pa ni/ hūm̐X nag po'i cha lugs brjid pa'i sku/ /zil gnon phyag rgya chen po nyid/ /tshul dgu
༄༅/ /chas dgu rgyan dgu dang / /gar dgu stobs dgu rngams shing brjid/ /'khor lo ral gri rdo rje 'phen/ /be con gtun shing sdigs mdzub brdeg /nag po gyen pa sgyel te mnan/ /pho nya sprul pa gdan du btings/ /skye 'gag gnyis med ye shes sku lhun po ri rab lta bur brjid/ /e ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya ru tra tam pa la hūm̐X phaṭa: (༷ ya ma badzra ha la'i sku/ /rang rang lag cha 'khor sprul nas/ /nga yis bsgo ba'i las rnams bgyis/ /sangs rgyas bka' 'khor bsrung zhing skyobs 'jigs byed 'bar ba khro bo'i dkyil 'bor 'dir/ /ye shes bskal pa'i me ltar rab 'phro ba/ /me ri 'bar ba'i mtshams las ma 'da' cig /gal te 'das na lus bsreg thal bar brlag/ e ka he dun/ rakṣa ru tra phaṭa: ri dzā la ram hūm̐X phaṭa: rang nyid lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa phyogs bcur 'phros te/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can srung mar bcas pa rnams spyan drangs/ srung 'khor gyi nang mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi thog ma med pa nas da lta la thug gi bar du bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib thams cad bshags/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i dam tshig gang yin par dam bcas shing yi dam lha'i byin rlabs dang nus mthu thamasacad da lta nyid du stsol cig pa'i sgo nas/ oX badzra sa ma ya hūm̐X dzaX hūm̐X dmigs med mkha' ltar dag pa khyab pa'i sku/ /ma 'gags rnam dag bde ba chen po'i gsungs/ /spros bral ye shes 'gyur ba med pa'i
thugs zil gnon lha tshogs gsan cing dgongs su gsol/ /rang rig ye shes blo dang mi ldan te/ /rtags dang mtshan ma myur du ma phyin pas/ /zil gnon 'khor bcas thugs dang ci 'gal ba/ /khro gtum rngam pa'i tshogs la bzod par gsol/ /don dam 'gyur med snying po lhun grub la/ /dge sdig gnyis su 'dzin pa mi bdag ste/ /ma rtogs dbang gis dge sdig gcig pu rtogs/ /gzung 'dzin dbang gis nga dang bdag tu gzung / /de ltar 'khrul rtogs las rnams ci bgyis pa/ /'gyod mos gus pa'i tshul gyis mthol lo bshags/ /hūṃX zil gnon khro rgyal ye shes sku/ /dregs pa 'dul mdzad thugs rje can/ /lha mchog 'khor bcas bdag la dgongs/ /bdag ni rgyal srid longs spyod dang / /rang don 'dod yon mi bsgrub ste/ /'gro ba'i don du 'bad rtsol gyis/ /drag po'i brtul zhugs spyad par bgyi/ /gsang ba'i theg pa bla na med/ /rab sdang gnod pa'i tshul 'chang rnams/ /drag po sngon byung nus mthu yis/ /myur du bsgral ba'i las bgyi'o/ /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas ni/ thog chen bla med thug bar du/ /dpal chen zil gnon 'khor bcas kyi/ /thugs dam bzhin du spyad par bgyi/ /byin dbab pa ni/ hūm̐X bde gshegs rgyal ba kun gyi bdag nyid che/ /drag po las kyi lha tshogs dgerdzongs su gsol/ /chos dbyings drag po e yi gzhal yas nas/ /bcom ldan phyag rgya zil gnon yum dang bcas/ /rtsa ba'i lha drug rgyan lha bdag po gsum/ /gshed bzhi mon bdud 'chi bdag sgo srung ste/ /drag po'i las mdzad pho nya dam can tshogs/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyis byin phob
༄༅/ /cig bdag cag sems can las kyis mnar ba la/ re zhig dpung gnyen gzhan na ma mchis pas/ thugs rje chen pos 'gro la brtser dgongs nas/ byin rlabs myur du dbab pa'i dus la bab/ 'jam dpal khros pa'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas / sngags tshig spyug pa brda yis spyan 'dren na/ mi dmigs chos kyi dbyings nas sku bzhengs la/ drag po'i dkyil 'khor 'di la byin chen phob/ sgrub mchog rnal 'byor bdag la dbang bskur rtsol/ sgrub rdzas dam pa 'di la mthu stsol cig drag po phrin las mdzad pa'i dus la babs/ bdag cag re ba'i 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ hūm̐X mdun gyi dpang po'i lha thams cad dgyes bzhin pas 'od du zhu nas bdag la thim pas sgo gsum gyi sdig sgrib thams cad dag dngos grub rnam gnyis thob/sman raka gtor gsum byin gyi rlabs pa ni/ rang nyid lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas ye shes 'byung ba gsum gyi sa bon mchod rdzas kyi dngos po rnams la 'phros pas/ ma dag pa'i skyon thams cad ram̐ las ye shes kyi mes bsreg smre las chos nyid kyi rlung gis stor khaṃ las mtshams med kyi chus bkrus/ oX āXhūṃX sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūṃX hrīXṭhāX zhes pas snod ka pā la 'jig rten gyi khams dang mnyam pa'i nang du/ bcud smad du byung ba'i gtor ma ri rab tsam du gyur/ 3༷7 āXhūṃX ma hā rakta dzwa la maṇḍa la hūṃX hrīX:zhes pas snod bhanta 'khor yug tsam gyi nang du bcud rakta'i rgya mtsho lbu ba la ye shes lnga'i 'od zer 'phro bar gyur/ /ting nge 'dzin rnam gsum bsgom pa ni/ /hūṃX rtog pa med pa'i chos nyid las/ /dngos po med pa'i ngang nyid du/ /stong pa'i ye shes cir yang
gsal / / chos nyid du ni dbyer med gyur/ /oX ma hā shu tyā ta dzñā nas ma ti hūm̐X/ /hūm̐X gsal ba'i rang bzhin dngos po med/ /kun gyi rang bzhin gsal ba las/ /'dzin sems med par cir yang snang / /gsal zhing dag pa dbyer med gyur/ /oX dharma dha tu sa ma ti hūṃX/ hūṃX rig pa'i ye shes gsal ba la/ /chos rnams kun gyi rtsa ba ste/ /byang chub sems kyi rtsa ba yin/ /stong pa'i chu 'phrul cir yang 'byung / /oX ma hā dzñā na sa ma ti hūṃX/ 'byung ba bzhi rim brtsegs bskyed pa ni/ /e yam̐ ram̐ ra su keX raX hūm̐ e akka sha dzwa la maṇḍa la/ yam̐ bha ya maṇḍa la/ ram̐ dzwa la maṇḍa la/ ra rarta sa mi tra maṇḍa la/ su sa ba ra maṇḍa la/ ke ni ri ti dzwa la maṇḍa la/ hūṃX sku lnga gdod nas dag pa yi/ /nam mkha' stong pa dngos med la/ /de la rlung gi dkyil 'khor 'chags/ /me 'od rab tu 'bar ba las/ /rakta'i rgya mtsho rba rlabs 'khrug/ mchog phran zhing gi sa gzhi'i steng / /sna tshogs keng rus ri rab 'bar/ /rten gzhal yas khang bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐ bi shu bi shudhe bhanta dzñā na e maṇḍa la/ /hūm̐X dur khrod chen po'i gzhal yas khang / /ye shes chen po'i gnas chen po/ /mtha' dang dbus med nam mkha'i dbyings/ /phyi dang nang med kun tu nang / /rang bzhin chos sku mnyam nyid las/ /lhun gyis grub pa'i pho brang mchog/ ye shes chen po'i gzhal yas khang / /kun 'byung mi 'gyur brtan pa'i gnas gru bzhi sgo bzhi rin po che'i/ /gzhal yas rta babs rgyan dang ldan/ /lha brgyad klu brgyad tshang pa'i zhing / /rus sbal glang chen stag gzig 'brug /zhing chen zhing chung thod pa sbrul/ /gnam lcags khro chu chu srin thog /sgyu ma tsitta'i keng rus
༄tshi/ /brgyan / / drag po gzhal yas rab 'jags pa/ /a ya pho brang therdzogs mkhar bzhi/ /lcags mkhar brgya dang bcu gnyis ldan/ /gru khyad khyams dang sgo bzhir ldan/ /rang bzhin lhun gyi grub par gnas/ /gdan bskyed pa ni/ gzhal yas khang gi dbus su gru gsum mthing nag gi nang du/ na ga/ de wa ru tra ma he paX padma maṇḍa la a tsani maṇḍa la/ /rgya chen e yi pho brang du/ /klu 'bum gnyan khri sa bdag stong / /phyogs skyong ma he brdzis pa'i khri/ /padma nyi zla gdan du bting / /de lta bu yi gdan steng du/ e ka he dun snying khrag ra ma tsa ya/ /brten pa lha'i gtso bo bskyed pa ni/ /gdan steng skad cig dran rdzogs kyi/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid/ /phyag rgya chen po zil gnon sku/ /nag po dug chen 'khyil ba'i mdog /dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgrad g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal/ /'khor lo ral gri rdo rje g.yas/ /be con gtun shing sdigs mdzub g.yon/ /dbu la rin chen gzhal yas khang / /rigs lnga klu brgyad thod pas mdzes/ /bdud srin mu stegs rgyal po btsan mgo dang tsittas do shal byas/ /snyan ma mgur chu phyag zhabs sbrul/ /rin chen nor bu 'bar bas brgyan/ /zhing chen glang lpags stag sham gsol/ /zhabs bzhir brkyang bskum tshul gyis bzhugs/ /yum bskyed pa ni/ yum ches rdo rje khros ma ni mthing nag dur khrod chas kyis brgyan/ /g.yas pa tsittas yab la 'byud/ /g.yon pa bhan dmar gtso la stobs/ /ya ma rā dza bskyed pa ni/ thugs gar 'jigs byed ya ma ni/ /sku mdog smug nag gcer bu ste/ /g.yas g.yon tsitta'i 'khor lo
bsnams / / thod sbul dur khrod chas kyis brgyan/ /phyag rdor bskyed pa ni/ /ya ma'i thugs dkar phyag rdor ni/ /ljang nag rdo rje snying phreng 'chang / /rin chen dbu brgyan sbrul gyis brgyan/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad dregs pa'i sku/ /ru sbal bskyed pa ni/ /dregs pa'i thugs dkar rus sbal ni/ /rme ba'i thig le khrag dang dug /tsitta 'od kyi gsang mdzod nas/ /lha srin mi yi bkrag mdangs 'chang / /bya khyung bskyed pa ni/ dbu gtsug bya khyung rgyal po dkar/ /spu gshog mtshon cha mchu sder lcags/ /nyi zla khro chu spyan dang tshem/ /sbrul dug za zhing klu gnyan 'dul/ /khyung bskyed pa ni/ /phag gong khyung chen smug nag gnyis/ /spu dang ga31ga pa mtshon cha me/ /mchu dang sder mo lcags kyu 'bar/ /klu rgyal za zhing gdug pa 'dul/ seng ge bskyed pa ni/ /nu khar seng chen brjid pa gnyis/ /mtshon cha'i spu la sder mo dbal/ /sbrul gyi gshog pa khro chu'i so/ /dgra bgegs za zhing sprul pa 'gyed/ stag bskyed pa ni/ sog khar stag chen rngams pa gnyis/ /mche ba rtsang phur sder mo lcags/ /dung gi so la spu gri'i rkang / /dgra bgegs glo snying nang khrol za/ sbrul bskyed pa ni/ /sta zur zhe sdang gdug pa'i sbrul/ /dug lnga skam chags bsreg cing 'joms/ /gang dmigs snying khrag klad khrag 'thung / /dug rlangs dug sbrul 'phro/ /mgul nas zhabs kyi 'irdzong bu'i bar/ /ye shes khro chung mtshon re sa/ /me rlung las kyi 'khor lo 'phro/ /nyi ma'i gdan la bsrung / /zil gnon sku nyid chos nyid dbyings/ ye shes lhun grub chos kyi sku/ rgya chen e yi pho brang du/ phyag rgya chen po brtan par brjid/ /bdag po bskyed pa ni/ /e zla
༄༅/ /gam dmar po gsum pa ni/ /sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa gsum/ /sku yi sprul pa 'chi bdag ni/ /sku mdog sngo nag 'bar ba la/ /dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi pa/ /g.yas ser g.yon ljang dbus sngo nag /thod dbyug ral gri dgra sta g.yas / / thod mdung lcags kyi ri rab g.yon/ /sku la lcags kyi zhun khrab gsol/ /dur khrod chas kyis 'jigs par brgyan/ /yum chen srin mo gsod byed kyang / /g.yas pa tri shu yab la 'byud/ /g.yon pa thod khrag yab la stobs/ /chibs su mā he sngo nag chibs/ /i gsung gi sprul pa srog bdag ni/ /mdog dmar zhal gcig phyag gzhi pa/ /g.yas gnyis be con rgyu zhags dang / g.yon gnyis lcags kyu bse mdung bsnams/ /rus sbal g.yang gzhi'i na bza' gsol/ /dur khrod chas kyis 'jigs par brgyan/ /sgrol yum ma'i srun ro langs ma/ /g.yas pa spu gri yab la 'byud/ /g.yon pa thod khrag gtso la stobs/ /chibs su bse yi gyi ling chibs/ /i thugs kyi sprul pa'i tshe bdag ni/ /sku mdog mthing nag 'bar ba la/ /dbu dgu phyag bzhi bco brgyad te/ /zhabs bzhi brkyang bskum tshul gyis bsgrad/ /steng zhal rma bya dur bya khyung / /bar pa khro zhal dkar dmar mthing / /rtsa ba stag seng ma he'i zhal/ rngam zhing 'jigs pa'i cha byad can/ /rdo rje zhing dbyug dar mdung dang / /'khor lo ral gri dgra stu dang / /kha ṭāX gru zhig rdo rje yam/ /thod pa g.yas na rim bzhin bsnams/ /bhanta 'ug pa be con dang / /gtun shing sdigs mdzub lcags kyu dang / /zhags pa mi snying zhing chung gi /rgyal mtshan g.yon na rim bzhin bsnams/ /sku la
zhid lpags g.yang gzhi gadrasnal/ /stag lpags rlan pa'i sham thabs can/ /thod sbrul la sogs 'jigs pa'i chas/ /dur khrod rgyan gyis rab tu brgyan/ /yum chen bdud mo gsod byed rgyal/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhing lpags gyon/ /g.yas pa tsittas yab la 'byud/ /g.yon pa bhan dmar gtso la stobs/ /las kyi sprul pa gshed bzhi bskyed pa ni/ /i phyogs bzhi thod mkhar 'bar ba nas/ /las kyi sprul pa gshed po bzhi/ /shar phyogs ya ma ra dza ni/ /smug nag gcer bu dur khrod brgyan/ /lho lho phyogs myos byed 'bar ba ni/ /ser nag gcer bu dur khrod brgyan/ /nub phyogs ārya dmar po ni/ /dmar rag gcer bu dur khrod brgyan/ /byang phyogs ral pa tshar dgu ni/ /ljang nag gcer bu dur khrod brgyan/ /kun kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa 'jigs tshul khro bo'i cha lugs can/ g.yas pa gcong byed 'khor lo bskor/ g.yon pa zhing gi dbyug pa bsnams/ yum chen srin mo nag merdzo dang / e ka dza ṭī bdud mo dmar/ gnod sbyin nag mor bcas pa rnams/ yab la 'khyud cing thod khrag stobs/ mon pa bzhi bskyed pa ni/ i phyogs bzhi lcags mkhar 'bar ba nas/ srog gshed nang gi mon pa bzhi/ dung gi mon pa seng ge'i mgo/ lcags kyi mon pa stag gi mgo bse yi mon pa dred kyi mgo gser gyi mon pa khyung gi mgo g.yas pa ri rab g.yon zhags pa/ 'jigs tshul dur khrod rgyan gyis brgyan/ yum chen mon mo bla rkun ma/ tshe 'phrog ma dang g.yu ral can/ snying la gzer 'debs yum rnams kyang / yab la 'khyud cing thod khrag stob/ bdud po bzhi bskyed pa ni/ ayau mtshams
༄tsho/ /bzhi'i lcags mkhar 'bar ba nas/ phyi gshed bdud po khrom 'debasabazhi/ he le khyab pa dkar po 'khor lo 'dzin/ so 'dar 'khrigs pa 'dar gseg gser mdog ral gri 'debs/ nag po 'dzum med dmar nag spar bu 'dzin/ ral pa phyed 'chings ljang nag zhags pa 'phen/ g.yon kun bdud kyi khram bam nag po bsnams/ 'jigs tshul dur khrod rgyan gyis brgyan/ yum chen bdud mo snying rkun ma/ snying 'byin ma dang snying gzer ma/ myos byed bdud mo chen mo rnams/ yab la 'khyud cing thod khrag stab/ 'chi bdag bcu gnyisabaskyed pa ni/ i phyi rim lcags mkhar bcu gnyis na/ las kyi 'chi bdag bcu gnyis ni/ /bhe wa satwa mthing nag be con brdeg /nor bu dge 'phel ser nag 'khor lo bskor/ ser nag 'joms byed khros pa lcags kyu 'dzin/ bye ba dgu khri ljang nag dbyug tho bsnams/ yakṣa glog phreng dmar nag rgyu zhags 'phen/ yakṣa za byed sngo nag spu gri thogs/ gtum mo dud kha brgyad kyi khram kha 'phyar/ gang ba kun 'joms dkar ser mda' gzhu 'gengs/ kha 'bar ral gcig dmar nag ral gri 'phyar/ /sbrul mgo kun 'dzings sngo skya lcags mdung 'phen/ /ngad pa stobs ldan ser po dgra stu 'brub/ /hon bo srog 'dzin nag po bdud zhags brdeg /kun kyang khros pa'i cha lugs can/ /'jigs tshul dur khrod rgyan gyis brgyan / sgo ma bzhi bskyed pa ni/ mai gzhal yas phyogs bzhi'i sgo bzhi nas/ drag po'i las mdzad sgo ma bzhi/ shar sgo dkar po snying 'byin ni/ g.yas po ru mtshon g.yon 'khor lo/ lho sgor mgon po nag po ni/ g.yas pa be con thod khrag g.yon/
nub sgor yab rje nag po ni/ g.yas pa khram zhing bdud zhags g.yon/ byang sgor sku mchog dmar po ni/ g.yas pa dbyug tho g.yon pa mdung / mdog dang mtshungs pa'i ber chen g.yon/ rngam zhing khros pa'i cha byad can/ 'jigs tshul dur khrod chas kyis brgyan/ dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i phrin las mdzod/ sgrol ging las gshin rje pho nya bskyed pa ni/ mai drag pe'i gzhal yas bar khyams nas/ sgral gying chen po bco brgyad dang / las gshin drug khri drug stong song / pho nya bye ba sa yar bcas/ kun kyang dgra bgegs sgrol mdzad pa'i/ bshan pa chen po srog gshed bdag rngam zhing khros pa'i cha rgya can/ grangs med bsam yas lhun gyi grub/ snyan gsan dbab pa ni/ chos dbyings e yi gzhal yas nas/ klu 'bum gnyan khri sa bdag stong / phyogs skyong ma he brjis pa'i khri/ padma zla ba'i gdan steng nas/ mi rtog dbyings las ye shes sku/ sangs rgyas sku lnga'i bdag nyid can/ khyab bdag ye shes lnga yam bdag/ zil gnon 'khor bcas dbyings nas bzhengs/ e ka he dun sa ma ya dza dza: spyan 'dren pa ni/ i dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ tshur spyon zil gnon 'khor dang bcas/ gdug pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i phyir/ thugs dam dbang gis gshegs su gsol/ e ka he dun e hye hi dzaXhūṃX bam̐ hoX bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ i 'khor lo 'bar ba'i lte ba la/ klu gnyan sa bdag phyogs skyong dang / ma he padma nyi zla'i steng / brkyang bskum tshul gyis brjid par bzhu/ e ka he dun tiṣṭha badzra/ phyag 'tshal ba ni/ i chos dbyings skye ba med pa la/ /spros bral bde chen dag pa'i sku/ /rang bzhin
༄tshi/ /gnyis med dag pa'i gsung / /ma sgribs don dam dag pa'i thugs/ /sku gsung thugs nyid rnam dag pas/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa/ /zil gnon 'khor la phyag 'tshal lo/ /e ka he dun a ti pu ho: pra titstsha ho: bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul ba ni/ /i rang byung gdod nas rnam par dag /rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba yi/ /rigs lnga dam tshig lnga yi dngos/ /ye shes lnga rdzogs bsgrub pa'i rdzas/ /rgyud lnga sems can kun sgrol zhing / /dug lnga sel ba'i bdud rtsi 'di/ /zil gnon 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas mthu dang dngos grub sprul/ /e ka he dun ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raX khā hi/ sman gyi dngosagrub blang ba ni/ oX āXhūm̐X oX lce yi rdo rje'i dam tshig las/ rdo rje can du gsum bsgoms nas/ bdud rtsi lnga dang sbyar ba'i sman / zos na sku gsung thugs thob 'gyur/ oX sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badzra siddhi oX wāka badzra siddhi āX tsitta badzra siddhi hūm̐X/ gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ i/ bsgral ba'i zhing bcu'i sha rus rnams/ khrag chen dag dang sbyar ba yin/ dmar gyi gtor ma'i mchod pa 'di/ zil gnon 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ e ka he dun ma hā ba linta pu dza khā hi/ rakta 'bul ba ni/ mai nyon mongs chags pa rtsad bcad phyir/ khams gsum gdug pa bsgral ba'i khrag dmar chen rakta'i mchod pa 'di/ zil gnon/ e ka he dun ma hā rakta: phyag rgya gar mchod ni/ i ye shes snang ba yab kyi sku/ dbyings nyid stong pa yum gyi sku/ sems kyi dkyil 'khor 'od gsal bar/ thabs dang shes rab dbyer med pa'i/ phyag rgya gar gyi mchod pa 'bul/ e ka he dun ma hā mu dra pu
dza khā hi hoX bzlas bsnyen sngags kyi mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ rang nyid phyag rgya zil gnon du gsal ba'i thugs gar nyi ma'i gdan la hūm̐X mthing nag ya ma rā dza'i thugs gar yagoX sprig nag phyag rdor gyi thugs gar hūm̐X ljang nag rus sbal gyi thugs gar 'kherdzor 'das kyi srog dang las kyi dngas ma e dang ka mthing ga las 'od 'phros/ dgra bgegs dang 'bor 'das kyi srog rang dbang med par 'od zer gyis bsdus nas/ e ka la thim/ bya khyung gi thugs gar khroX dkar po/ yum gyi thugs gar ma mthing nagde rnams kyi mthar bzlas pa gang byed kyi sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer gyi me 'od kyi rnam par 'phros pas/ 'phags pa'i tshogs mchod/ sems can gyi sgrib pa sbyangs/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can rnams rdul du brlag 'od zer tshur 'dus pas rnal 'byor pa bdag gi dngos grub thob/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyai sku gsung thugs kyi cha lugs 'jigs tshul khros pa'i cha byad shin tu gsal bar gyur/ sku'i sngags yig 'bru bcu gnyis pa/ e ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya/gsung gi sngags yig 'bru bzhi pa/ e dun ka yaX/ thugs kyi sngags yig 'bru brgyad pa ni/ e myags ya rngubs mug shag ka dun bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi yang snying 'jam dpal rgyud kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad rdzogs pa'i drag sngags yig 'bru brgya bzhi bcu rtsa dgu pa ni/ ayau ayau ayau/ a kro te ka ya mānta ga ya ma ya/ ka la ru pa/ ka pa ye/ hriXṣṭi a pa ye/ a ā nee a ne/ u u nee u nee/ du du ne du nee/ a i u e o aX/ ra rwi/ la lī/ du ru ye/ bya tsa ye/
༄7/ /seng ha ye/ hri dā ye/ bi da ye/ tsitta ye/ ha la ye/ mu ka ye/ u u ne u u ni/ bi tri ta/ a a na na/ ya ma rā dza/ ya ma rakta/ ya ma ratsho/ ya ma rakṣa/ be ta liṃ/ kro ti shwa ri/ ma ma e ka dza ṭī/ de ma kha la bam ril/ ru lu ru lu/ shrī badzra kro ta/ ya ma garma ro ṣa ṇa/ kro nti tsaṇḍa/ rakṣa mānta āXhūm̐X dzaX 'dzab bstod 'bul ba ni/ phyag rgya zil gnon chos kyi dbyings kyi gsung / thugs dam gsung gi ye shes rol pa las/ thabs dang shes rab yig 'bru dpag med mkhar/'khor lo bskor zhing yig 'bru'i rang sgra las/ grags stong dbyer med rgyal ba'i gsung mchog ste/ 'od zer 'phro 'du nyi zla'i 'khor lo bzhin/ phar 'phros 'phaṭa mched sems can sgrib pa sbyangs/ dam can rgyud bskul lha srin gnad la 'bebs/ dgra dang bgegs la phog pas rdul du brlag slar 'dus rnam 'byor bdag gi dngos grub thob/ bcom ldan dpal chen phyag rgya zil gnon gyi/ gsung gi bzlas pas gsung gi rgyud bskul zhing / sku yi cha lugs 'jigs par ston mdzad pa/ bde gshegs zil gnon gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ dngosagrub blang ba ni/ mai bde gshegs rgyal ba thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ bcom ldan zil gnon tshe bdag 'khor bcas rnams/ rnal 'byor bdag gis rtse gcig gdung ba yis/ bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol nas/ bsnyen cing bsgrubs nas las kyi 'phro 'thud nas/ skad cig tsam yang mi brjod khyed bsgrubs nas/ dus 'di nyid la bdag gi bsam sgrub phyir/ khyad par gyur pa'i mchod pa'i tshogs rnams dang / bzlas brnyen sngags kyi mchod pa 'di
'bul bas/ thugs dam dbang gi myur bar bzhes nas kyang / dngos su bsgrub pa'i 'bras bu gang lags pa/ dus 'di nyid du bdag la gsol ba ni/ khams gsum dbang sdud srid gsum zil gnon pa/ theg dgu bgrod cing sa rnams non gyur nas/mthar thug 'bras bu sku lnga'i bdag nyid mchog bcom ldan zil gnon go 'phang myur thob stsol/ de ma thob kyi gnas skabs rnams su yang / tshe ring nad med longs spyod 'phel ba dang / che btsan dregs pas 'gro ba 'dul ba dang / bstan pa rgya mtsho bdag gis bsrung skyong dang/ dgra bgegs 'joms shong rbod zor bzlog pa dang / zor rnams rang 'gags mnan pa rang rul dang / lha rnams rang gshed mi g.yo mi 'gul zhing / phyi nang bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang / drag sngags phyi la tshugs shing rno ba dang / bsrung bskrad bcom gzer dbab gcad la sogs kyi/ stobs chen thams cad dril gyis gnon pa dang / phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyi grub pa dang / zhi rgyas dbang drag dngos grub ma lus te/ bcom ldan phyag rgya zil gnon 'khor bcas kyi/sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub ma lus pa/ rnal 'byor bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum gyi/ rgyud la da lta nyid du thob par stsol/ zil gnon 'bor bcas bstod cing phrin las bskul ba ni/ mai chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang gi /drag po e yi gzhal yas nas/ khro bo'i rgyal po zil gnon gyi/ thugs dam chen po'i dus la bab/ gang la bya ba khyod shes kyis/ sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/ dmigs pa gang ming myur du sgrol/ zhe sdang drag po'i sbyor ba tshom/ lus srog dbang po dngas snyigs phye/ 'byung
༄tshi/ /ba rnam shes bkrag mdangs sdus/ rtsa rgyus khrag dang bla mtshe skem/ drag po'i las rnams 'grub par mdzod/ dusal bab/ cesapa nas/ drag po'i lasarnams 'grub par mdzod/ cesapa'i bar sbyar ro/ i g.yon gyi phyogs nas sku byung ma/ yum chen rdo rje khros ma ni/ mo gdon 'bum sde gzir cing 'joms/ khyod kyi: i zil gnon thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas/ 'jigs byed ya ma rā dza ni/ dgra bgegs ma lus sgrol mdzad pa/ khyod kyi: i ya ma thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas/ dregs pa phyag na rdo rje ni/ dgra bgegs ma lus 'joms mdzad pa/ khyod kyi: i dregs pa thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas/ rus sbal mi zad rngams pa ni/ spu gri'i gnas nas ma btang cig khyod kyi: i zil gnon dbu yi spyi gtsug na/ bya khyung rgyal po mthu bo che/ klu gnyan sa bdag zil gyis gnon/ khyed kyi: i zil gnon phrag gong g.yas g.yon nas/ yang sprul dug gi khyung chen gnyis/ gdug pa 'dul ba'i las ngo long / khyod kyi: i zil gnon thugs ka g.yas g.yon nas/ seng ge ral pa sprug pa gnyis/gdug pa ma lus zil gyis gnon/ khyod kyi: i zil gnon sog kha g.yas g.yon nas/ stag chen ro la rngam pa gnyis/ dgra bgegs sha khrag dron mor gsol/ khyed kyi: i zil gnon sta zur g.yas g.yon nas/ zhe sdang gdug pa'i dug sbrul gnyis / dug sbrul nag po dgra la bhyoX khyod kyi: i zla gam dmar po gsum la ni/ sprul pa rnam gsum yum dang bcas/ las kyi mtha' sdud khyod yin pas/ khyod kyi: i phyogs bzhi thod mkhar 'bar ba nas/ khro rgyal las kyi gshed po bzhi/ /
yum dang bcas pa'i tshogs rnams kyi/ thugs dam chen po'i dus la bab/ mai/ phyogs bzhi lcags mkhar 'bar ba nas/ srog gshed nang gi mon pa bzhi/ yum dang : thugs dam: e mtshams bzhi lcags mkhar 'bar ba nas/ phyi gshed khram 'debs bdud bo bzhi/ yum dang : thugs dam: i phyi rim lcags mkhar bcu gnyis nas/ dam nyams sgrol ba'i las mdzad pa/ ma rung las gshin 'chi bdag tshogs/ thugs dam: i gzhal yas phyogs bzhi sgo bzhi nas/ drag po'i las mdzad sgo ba bzhi/dgra brtags sgrol ba'i las mdzad pa/ drag po ma rungs dregs pa'i tshogs/ khyod kyi: i drag po'i gzhal yas bar khyams nas/ sgrol ging las gshin pho nya'i tshogs/ grangs med bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ thugs dam chen po'i dus la bab/ gang la bya ba khyod shes kyis/ sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/ dmigs pa gang ming myur du sgrol/ zhe sdang drag po'i sbyor ba tshom/ sngags kyi dug mda' khong du bskyel/ /lus srog nus pa nyams par gyis/ /drag po'i mtshon cha srog la bskerdzor/ /lus sems thal ba'i rdul du rlog /'byung ba brtan gzhi rngams kyis gnon/ /'ob chen bcu gnyis nang du chug /'khor lo 'bar ba'i rtsibs la skyon/ /lcags mkhar sgo med nang du chug /lus srog dbang po dwangs snyigs phyes/ /'byung ba rnam shes bkrag mdangs bsdus/ /rtsa rgyus khrag dang bla tsho skem/ /drag po'i las rnams 'grub par mdzod/ /tshogs byin gyisarlabasapa ni/ ram̐ yam̐ khaṃ/ oX bi shuddhi a mṛ ta hūm̐X phaṭa: dharmā a mṛ ta hūm̐X phaṭa: badzra yakṣa kro dha hūm̐X/ ma suya maṇḍa la hūm̐X spha ra ṇa phaṭa: saX ha ra ṇa hūm̐X/
༄tshi/ /saX padma maṇḍa la/ āXspha ra ṇa phaṭa: phre ha ra ṇa hūm̐X/ a tsant+ra maṇḍa la/ oX spha ra ṇa phaṭaX saX ha ra ṇa hūm̐X/ oX ma hā ba inti te dzwa ba lam̐ ta/ ba la ba te gu hya sa ma ye swā hā/ tshogs la spyan 'dren pa ni/ i chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang gi/ drag po e yi gzhal yas nas/ zil gnon yab yum 'khor bcas rnams/ ting 'dzin sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ thugs dam dbang gis spyan 'dren na/ tshogs la rol phyir gshegs su gsol/ e ka he dun/ e hye hi dzaXhūm̐X bam̐ hoX dang po 'bul zhing bskang ba ni/ mai zhal zas 'dod yon lha mor byin rlabs pa/ snang stong dbyer med kun bzang mchod pa'i tshogs/ zil gnon yab yum 'khor bcas dkyil 'khor du/ gnyis med thim pas dgyes pa'i tshul gyis bzhes/ e ga he dun/ ga ṇa tsakra pu dza kha hi ho7༷ bar pa bshags par bya ba ni/ oX rang rig ye shes blo dang mi ldan pas/ rtags dang mtshan ma myur du ma phyin par/ chags sdang gti mug nga rgyal phrag dog rnams/ yang dag lam du ma shes rang gar spyad/ ru dra'i rgyu bsags lta spyad dam tshig nyams/spyad 'khrul bka' las 'gal gyur mthol lo bshags/ tshogs tha ma la dkyil 'bor bskyed pa ni/ e ram̐ dzwa la ram̐ e ka dun/ bla ma dkon mchog yi dam srung ma'i tshogs/ bden dang bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis/ sangs rgyas bstan dang de 'dzin skyes bu dang / rdo rje slob dpon sems dpa' thams cad dang / bdag la gnod pa'i dgra bgegs las gnas 'di/ skad cig thang cig yud tsam 'di nyid la/ gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ mtshan ma gzugs kyi dkyil 'khor 'di
nyid la/ da lta myur ba nyid du phog cig gzir/ khro bo spro ba ni/ hūm̐X hūm̐X hūm̐X bi shwa badzra kro rha dzwa la maṇḍa la phaṭa phaṭa phaṭaX ha la ha la ha la hūm̐X phaṭa: dgug bya dgug gzhug bya ba ni/ badzra dzwa la ram̐/ tri yam̐ dzaX mṛ yaX dzaX badzra aṅku sha dzaX badzra pā shwa hūm̐X/ badzra sproṭa bam̐/ badzra gaṇḍi lhastoX pra be sha ya phaṭa: a be sha ya āX dzaXhūm̐X bam̐ hoX de nasapho nya rbad pa bzas pa po sgrol ba ni/ mai 'jam dpal khros pa'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas/ drag po'i phrin las mdzad pa'i dus la bab/ log rtog bdag gir 'dzin pa'i zhing bcu la/ mngon spyod rtags kyi phrin las 'di chod cig e myags ya rngubs mugs shag ka dun mṛ tri la srog khur thums ril ram shag rbad/ dgra bephu) tsitta brang shag dzaXsrog la khur thums rbad/ e ka he dun sa ma ya snying khrag ra ma tsa ya/ dgra bo shāming yig byed na ma gtogs gzhan dgra bgegs thamasacad zer ga.a mu ga'i srog la dun mugs bhyoX dre ga la kham shag bhyoX dgra bo'i srog la mā ra ya rbad/ dgra bo'i srog la stulha ya nan/ tshogs mtha' ma zhal du stob pa bya ba ni/ /i srid gsum dag pa'i dbyings su rol par mdzod/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med bha gar thim/ /bar gcod dgra bgegs zil gnon zhal du stob/ /tshems gtsigs ljags rkyongs zhal phyes kha ram khā hi/ tshogs kyi lhag mchod bya ba ni/ i chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang gi drag po e yi gzhal yas nas/ bcom ldan zil gnon 'khor dang bcas/ 'dir gshegs gtor ma 'di bzhes lhag /e gzo ma hā pañtsa.a mri ta khā hi/ ma hā ba linta khādzdza ma hā rakta khā hi/ phrin las bcol ba ni/ i bcom ldan 'das dzrel gnon yab yum 'khor
༄tshi/ /dang bcas/ /dam can rgya mtsho mthu rtsal ldan rnams kyis/ /sngon gyi thugs dam ji ltar dgongs bzhin du/ /sangs rgyas bstan dang bstan 'dzin gang zag la/ bar chad bdud kyi dmag dpung pham par mdzod/ /gnod pa'i dgra bgegs thal ba'i rdul du rlog /sdug bsngal med cing rnam rtog zhi ba dang / /nyams grib bag chags thams cad sel bar mdzod/ /dmyal sogs mi bzad 'khor ba'i 'tsho las skyobs/ /thugs rje mchog gi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'dis bzhes la/ /bcol pa'i phrin las thams cad grub par mdzod/ brten ma skyong ba ni/ hūm̐X bod khams skyong bar khas blangs brten ma'i tshogs/ /bdag nyid chen mo la sogs bdud mo bzhi/ /gangs dkar sha med la sogs gnod sbyin bzhi/ /kong btsun de mo la sogs sman btsun bzhi/ /bstan skyong chen mo bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas/ /sngon tshe ji ltar dam rdzas ji bzhin du/ /gtor ma 'di bzhes rnal 'byor grogs mdzod cig /bcol pa'i phrin las thams cad grub par mdzod/ /brtan skyong chen mo bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du ma hā panyu kha hi/ ba li ta: rakta: khyed la phrin las zhu ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / bstan 'dzin gyi gang zag la sdang bar byed pa'i dgra thul/ gnod par byed pa'i bgegs tshom rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa'i bsam pa dang re ba thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ ya hi gasma gtang rag gi mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ bcom ldan phyag rgya zil gnon 'khor bcas la/ khyad par mchod pa pañtsa amṛ ta/ ma hā ba lam̐
rakta bcas la 'bul/ bzhes nas bla med dngos grub stsal du sol/ chos dbyings ngang las khro bo'i skur ston pa/ lha yi lha mchog bcom ldan gshin rje gshed/ bdud kyi bdud chen ma rungs 'dul ba'i lha/ khro rgyal kun gyi gtso la phyag 'tshal lo yi dam lha mchog zil gnon 'khor bcas kyi/ bsnyen sgrub phrin las gzhung bzhin bgyis pa las/ bdag cag ma rig log rtog dbang song nas/ 'gal 'khrul nongs pa ci mchis bzod par gsol/ gshegs su gsol ba ni/ hūm̐X hūm̐X hūm̐X/ gzhal yas rtsa ba'i lha drug rgyan lha brgyad/ gtso bo zil gnon nyid kyi thugs gar thim/ zil gnon nyid kyang mi dmigs chos dbyings ngang / 'khor rnams rang rang gnas su gshegs par mdzad/ badzra muX e ka he dun/ smon lam ni/ bdag gi dge 'dis nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam gyi/ 'gro ba thun gyi sdogs gnyis myur rdzogs te/ gshin rje gshed ldir bcom ldan nyid 'grub nas/ phrin las rnam bzhis gdul bya'i don byed shog/ bkrisani/ gang zhig bla med bcom ldan gshin rje gshed/ sku gsung thugs kyi yon
༄7/ /sngags kyi 'bru bshad them yig bzhugs so/ /rmya ringasasngags kyi 'bru 'grel dang / stong srog 'khor lo nag po drag sngags kyi yang snying dril ba'ang yod do//
༄tshi/ /'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ rang gshed sdig pa snying 'dzings kyi/ sngags kyi 'bru bshad them yig 'di/ yig 'bru tsheg bar drang don ni/ drag po sngags kyi mi 'gyur bsdams / rtsa ba rnam pa gsum du bshad/ lus dang so dang them dang gsum/ lus ni brgya dang bzhi bcu rtsa dgu pa'o/ them ni sum cu rtsa dgu ste/ so ni yig 'bru nyi shu pa'o/ oX ayau ayau ayau/ a kro te ka ces pa nas/ āXhūṃX dzaX lus kyi sngags su bshad pa yin/ oX ni 'khyil sbrul lta bu/ ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin te/ sngags rnams kun gyi klad du bshad/ e gsum drag po dbang sdud par byed/ a kro sku yi gsang sngags te/ ya mānta ka gshin rje gshed po'i sku/ ya ma ye ni ye shes sems dpa'i sku/ ka la ru pa gsung gi sngags te/ a sa ye ni gsung gi gsung yang yin/ hri hrīXnyi sti thugs kyi gsang
༄tsho/ /sngags te/ a pa ye ni thugs kyi thugs su bshad/ a a ni a ni zhes pa ni/ lha srin 'dul ba'i drag sngags te/ 'jig rten lha 'dre dbang du sdud par byed/ u u nee u.u ne zhes pa ni/ be wa sa twa'i sku ru bshad/ du du ne du ne zhes pa ni/ nor bu dge 'phel sku ru gsal/ du ru ye zhes bya ba ni/ ser nag 'khyil pa'i sku ru gsal/ bya tsa ye zhes byung ba ni/ bye ba dgu khri snang rigs sku ru gsal / seng nga ya zhes bya ba ni/ yakṣa klog phreng sku ru gsal/ hri da ye zhes bya ba ni/ yakṣa za byed sku ru gsal/ bi ta ye zhes bya ba ni gtum po dud kha'i sku ru gsal/ ha la ye zhes byung ba ni/gang ba kun 'joms sku ru gsal/ mu ka ye zhes byung ba ni/ kha 'bar ral cig sku ru gsal/ u u nee zhes byung ba ni/ sbrul mgo kun 'joms sku ru gsal/ u u ne zhes gnyis pa ni/ ngad pa
stobs chen sku ru gsal/ byi tri ta zhes byung ba ni/ ho phan srog 'dzin sku ru gsal/ a a gnyis dang na na dang/ a i u e o aX dang/ ra ṛ la '-i bcu gnyis ni/ dbyangs kyi yi ge bcu gnyis te/ 'chi bdag bcu gnyis gsung gi sngags/ ya ma rā dza sras mchog ya ma rā dza'i sku/ ya ma rakta myos byed 'bar ba'i sku/ a ya ma rag a ārla dmar po'i sku/ ya ma rakṣa ral pa tshar dgu'i sku ༄ rshasnogs/ be ta li kro ti shwa ri zhes pa ni/ sbyor yum be ta li yi sku ru snogs/ ma ma e ka dza ṭī zhes pa ni/ sgrol yum ral gcig sku ru snogs/ de ma kha la bam ril zhes pa ni/ bdud mo bzhi yi sngags su bshad/ ru lu ru lu zhes pa ni/las kyi mkha' 'gro'i sngags su bshad/ shrī badzra kro rha zhes pa ni/ ye shes sems dpa'i sku ru gsal/ ya ma garma zhes pa ni/ las kyi gshin rje'i sku ru gsal/ ro ṣa na zhes byung ba ni/ phyag na rdo rje'i sku ru gsal / tri ta bya khyung rgyal po ste/ tsandha rakṣa phyag rdor ro/ mornya mon pa bzhi yi sngags su bshad/ āXhūm̐X dzaXni sku gsung thugs nas 'thon pa yin/ lus kyi gsang sngags thems yig yin/ bsnyen pa'i skabs su gsungs pa yin/ 'brum phrag gcig tu bzlas par bya/ bar du sgrub pa'i thems yig bshad pa ni/ shri badzra kro rha ya ma ma ma ru lu ru lu dunting kī la ya titta ga de ma rakta ru tra/ yakṣa/ ra tsa/ shu la/ haX shaX/ badzra
༄tshi/ /sa pa sa gzhan na snang rba/ ru tri/ nā ga yi ge phreng ba'i bar du ltems par bya/ shri badzra kro rha zhi khro'i ming / ya ma gshin rdze yab yum mo/ ma ma ru lu ru lu ma ma 'dus pa'i ming / dunting kī la ya ni rdo rje gzhon nu'i ming / titta ka ni mu stegs dbang phyug ming / de wa lha chen brgyad kyi ming / rakta srin po laṅka rnams kyi ming / ru tra bdud po bcu yi ming / yakṣa gnod sbyin rnams kyi ming / rā dza rgyal po kun gyi ming /shu la btsan gyi snying po ste/ haX shaX 'gogs po kun gyi ming / badzra sa dhu skyes bu kun gyi ming / ru tri dam sri dam zan ming / nā ga klu yi ming du bshad/ ming dang srog tu gsungs pa ste/ srog ni rang gi ngo bor bshad/tsheX ༷༷ yaX maX taX duX aX raX rhaX kṣaX tsaX dzaX triX triX ruX phuX dregs pa bco lnga'i srog tu bshadagiX skabs kyi phye la bar du stem/ sgrub pa'i rim pa gsungs pa yin/ zhi khro gshin rje ma mo phur mu stegs lha dang srin po dang / bdud dang gnod sbyin rgyal po dang / btsan dang 'gong po skyes bu dngas/ dam sri gdug pa'i srog tu gsungs/ bar du sgrub pa'i thabs su shes par bya/ tha ma so so'i las rnams ni/ a mu ka myags thums ril trig nan/ sbur ya nan/ e khur thums dzaX kham shag ro myags mug ti rbad ya/ rbersha rbersha'i las su bshad pa ste/ a mu ka zhes bshad pa ni/ rang rang dmigs pa gsal
bar bya/ myags zhes brjod pa ni/ kho'i mthu stobs bshig par ro/ thums ril ngag rnams krug par 'gyur/ trig nan rang rang nus pa gzir/ sbur ya nan gyis stobs mnan te/ e yi skabs su srog rnams gzhug kham shag lus srog 'byed pa yin/ ro myags lus srog rmugs par byed/ mugs ti lus srog rengs par byed/ rbad kyi lus srog thub par byed/ ya zhes gshin rje las la bskul bar byed/ mjug gi spu gri / las la sbyor ba'i sngags su gsungs skabs dang sbyar te spu gri gdags/ skabs mi shes na a mu ka dang e bzhi gzhug yang dang yang du yid la gnag rang gshed sdig pa snying 'dzings kyi/ sngags kyi 'bru bshad them yig yin/ rdzogs so/ e rings sngags kyi 'bru 'grel ni/ sgaṭhamā 'di kho na'o/ 'di kho na'o/ 'di kho na'o/ 3tshil oX gyi ye shes las 'byung ba/ chos sku kun tu bzang po'i sku ru rdzogs/ ayau yis ye shes las byung ba/ longs spyod rdzogs sku rigs lngar rdzogs/ au gyis ye shes las byung ba/ 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i sku ru snogs/ ayau yi ye shes las byung ba/ drag po dbang sdud zil gnon sku ru rdzogs āXyi ye shes las byung ba/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i sku ru snogs/ kro ta ya mānta ga'i sku ru ndhags/ te ya ma rā dza'i sku ru snogs/ ka myos byed 'bar ba'i sku ru snogs/ ya ārya ma ru'i sku:
'tsho/ /man ral pa tshar dgu'i sku: ta rdo rje khros ma'i sku: ka ye shes kyi ya ma rā dza'i sku: ya ru sbal rngams pa'i sku: ma bdud mo khrag ral can gyi sku: ye phyag na rdo rje'i: ka rdo rje bya khyung sku: ma tshe bdagaza tu srog bdag: pa 'chi bdag: ka garma he ru gcu sa padma he ru ga: hrīXrdo rje hrī rta mgrin gardo rje gzhon nu zhesasnang gzhon nu/ sa dung gi mon pa/ ye lcags kyi mon pa/ a bse'i mon pa/ āXgaser gyi mon pa/ he he le khyab pa/ a so 'dar 'khrig pa/ ne nag po 'jum med/ u ral pa spyi chings/ u seng chen ral sprugs/ no stag mo ro za ba u khyung mo klu srog za ba/ ne dug sbrul kha nas me 'bar ba/ du be wa satwa/ du nor bu dge 'phel/ ne ser nag 'joms byed/ du bye ba dgu khri/ ne yakṣa za byed/ a gang po kha 'bar/ ī ngad pa stobs ldan/ u sbrul mgo can/ e nag po klog phreng / o kha 'bar ral cig aX hong ban mthong ba / ha ra snang raka nag po/ ri bdud 'joms nag po la kong rtse brag 'joms/ li phya sangs/ du tel pa/ ru lha mchog dud kha/ ye ya ba ti/ bya gshin rje/ tsa chos kyi rgyal po/ ye a wa glang mgo sing la sogs pa mgo dgu nga rmig pa/ ye mig dmar/ hrīXbadud bye ba dgu rings/ rha lha ma hā de wa/ ye gza' klog srin kha 'bar nag po/ bi bi na ya ga da btsan shu kro srog len/ ye srog mi gcig ha gnod
sbyin gang ba bzang po/ la ma hā kā la/ ye rdo rje dbyings sgrom/ mu las kyi gshin rje gtum po/ ka srin po klog phreng / ye bdud lha 'dre stag stags snang gi thabs/ u ma na srog len/ u 'chi bdag nag po gter chen ne gling bzhi phung byed/ u nag po bkrag med/ u ta bu spyan gcig ne sbrul gyi sgyu ma can/ byi kha tong me 'bar/ kri mi kha spre'u mgo can/ ta 'da' sha shrī ba/ a yakṣa gri ba/ a ma hā gri ba/ na rha nti gī ma na bdud khu le ya bdun brgya nyi shu'i busapa sgrib ba ya ma rā dza ye shes kyi ya ma rā tsa ya ya thob lta busagazigs ba'i khyisakhang nang bsags ba'i kho na'o ma raka myos byed 'bar ba/ ya pha rol gyi stobasabazlog pa ma rag a ārya ma ru/ ya drang srong dkar skya ba che ba can ma raka ral pa tshar dgu se gtum po ru ru kha 'bar/ ta gza' srin tshogs pa ral pa can/ li be ta li/ kro srin mo mgo 'chang ba ti ro ma ti/ phre/ mi zad rdo rje ral cig ma/ ri nyams can khrag gi ral pa can/ ma me lha / ma 〈sna rje ral gcig ma/ e khu/ ka ba lam dre sna la tri yang gab ma bzhi/ de ma kha phyag na rdo rje'i nusamathusadakar po las kyi bya khyung klu bdud klu rig bsad dang lha srin rtol pa klu rnams gzer zhing bsad pa'o/ nyi gshed sum brgya drug bcu nuspa thams cad sgril ba e'i khyams khang du bsad cing kha rol gyi stobasabazhig pa la bam ril/ 〈co sbyo/ 〈co ṭa// shri badzra spre1 dha rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha rgyud gzer zhing bdag la bsrung ba'i zhusapa bsgril ba/ ya ma garma las kyi gshin rje gzer nas zhe rang kho rang bsod pa nag 31 zhug
༄༅/ /'gro snang ro ṣa ṇa/ tri ta tsanta rakta mornya aXhūṃX dzaX drag po e rings sngags rgod 'di/ zhi khro phur pa gshin nde ma mo lha srin rnams kyi srog snying 'di gu ru 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis/ dga' rab dbang phyung bdud kyi sde rnams bcom/ de nas gu ru gtsug lag dpal dge nyid la brgyud/ mu stegs dung mgrin can phung bar byas/ des ba su rha ra la/ sde pa phung bar byas/ des ban chung bdag sangs rgyasasnang la gnang / log lta mu stegs bon po phung bar byas/ rnyu 'dir gsal sgron len gsung ngo / ring drag po sngags kyi 'bru len 'di/ sngags pa ru dra nag po'i gshed mar gsungs/ yang mdzod kyi gdams pa 'di kho na'o/ 'di kho na'o / 'di kho na'o/ athi+-i/ rgya rgya rgya/ gamramal stong srog 'khor lo nag po drag sngags kyi yang snying dril ba/ stobs chen nus pa bral zhing bshog pa la/ dang po stong pa'i ngang las phyag rgya zil gnon du bsgoms la / sngags bzla pas sngags kyi 'od zer ral gri bus/ dmigs par bya ba nyal nyal song bar bsamagiX nad pa'am thug phrad du dgos na rdzas rgod kyis bdug thod ngan du liṅga bcug la gzir/ ngan sngags 'di bzlas sogs/ ayau ayau ayau a kro te ka ya manta zhes pa nas raklo mornya a mu ga myags thums dril trig nan sbur ya nan e hur thum dzaX khaX shag ro myags mug ti rbad ya rang phyag rgya zil gnon du gsal la sngags
spu gri mtshon char gsal ba liṅga bzas pa sor gsal ba gal che'o/ /de nas skabs su las sbyor byed na gong gi thod par rgyu rkyen drug las byas pa'i liṅga de 'brub khung du bzhag la drag pe'i thun gyis bsad de/ ra rur dug sna mang po tshogs tshad 〉migs dang / khrag sna med par khyi phag bzhi dang / phyed gsum dang jo zangs lcags ste tshe shangs tshe 'bru lnga sbyar la/ bdag hu tshe nyung dkar yung nag nyid ya mānta gar gsal bar byas la zhag dgur mi tshig gis bar ma47da par byas la sngags brdeg go myi athi+-i ayau a kro te ka ya manta ka ye hrīXṣṭi a pa ye ya mānta ka byi tri ta ka li kro ta a ni.u ni dun ne bya tsa ye du ru yi tsitta ye nya la ye ya ma kri ta ya ma kro ta mornya ya ma rakṣa ya ma byi sha hū ti mon hrīXtsa ye a mu ka tsitta breng shag myags thun bhyo/ thum ril khrag la myong bhyo/ dunting hri shag hal yaX bhyo/ dgra bo'i snying khrag tshal pa myogs rbad/ srog la mā ra ya rbad/ ni sha ku ru ni rbad/ ni hur long breng breng dun dun hur thums dzaX tsitta ya rbad/ ces bzlas shing liṅga la brab/ zhag dgu nas liṅga de spyang thod dam/ rwa tur bcug la/ chas dang ldan par klu yod par bzhug de nas nya stong la zor kha gsos la/ dgra'i khang par 'phang na rang gshed phebs/ brten pa bdud du 'bab bo/ dmangs gzhan la yang byar gtub bo/ bsad pa zor gyi las las sbyor gsum las 'di zer gyi bsad las kho na'o sbyor ro/ sa ma yaX na
༄༅༅/ /ra gan/'di khu dag dka' tshegs chen po byasakyang /dpe ma gcig pa'i skyon gyi the tshom du bdogaslar 'di ka bshul pa'i ma ma las gtugs na legs snyam dge'o//
༄༅/ /'jam dpal sku'i bsnyen yig yid bzhin nor bu zhesabya ba bzhugs so//
༄༅/ /na mo gu sa 'jam dpal sku'i bsnyen sgrub kyi rim pa ni/ 'jam dpal thugs sgrub kyi sgom khog las/ sgrub gtor ni/ dngos grub blang ba dang / gter du sbas par bya/ mchod gtor la/sbyin sreg dang / lhag phud yar gnas mchod pa bya/ zhes 'byung lnga rdzo/ sngags kyi bzlas thabs bstan pa la/ phyi skor sku'i drag sngags/ nang skor gsung gi drag sngags/ gsang 'khor thugs kyi drag sngags yang gsang rgod kyi drag sngags bzlas thabs so/ /dang po ni/ bdag gi thugs gar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūṃX gi mtha' bskor du sku'i sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'ja' tshon lta bur byung bas ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas 'phros te/ bdag g.yin gyi sdig sgrib dgra bgegs thams cad ba mo la nyi ma shar ba bzhin dag par bsam zhing / ayau ka he du ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya/ de yang
༄༅/ /sngags kun gyi thog mar sku'i sngags bzlas par gsung te/ sngags don gsal sgron du/ drag po sngags kyi yig 'bru gnyis po 'di dag ni/ zhal gyi dmod pa drag po sngon du byung bas te/gsang chen gcig tu dril bas sngags thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin te/ kun gyi mgo la drang bar bya'o/ zhes gsungs so/ /grangs ni 'bru 'bum tsam skabs su babs so/ gnyis pa ni/ /bdag gi ljags kyi rtse mo las 'od zer me ye tshwa tshwa ltar 'phros pas/ las ngan pa'i bag chags dang / bar du gcod pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad bya sgro dang me 'phrad pa lta bur bsam zhing / ayau myags ya rngubs/ mugs shaka ka dun/ zhes bzlas par bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ thugs ga'i hūm̐X las sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'gal me ltar 'khor zhing 'phros pas/ bdag gi sdig sgrib thams cad ltag mtshan la phur mi
chags pa bzhin du song bar bsams la/ ayo dun ka yam/ zhes bzlas so/ /gsung dang thugs la grangs ni 'bum tsam mo/ de dag kyang bsnyen pa ltar bzlas pa yin gyis/ rang rang gi spu gri'i sgo nas las phan gnod sgrub pa ni/ man ngag ltar shes par bya'o/ /dmar yig lugs su/ sku yi sngags sbyor nag po dang / dmar ling snying chung 'bru brgyad gsungs/ drag sngags sbyor ba'i rgyal po bshad/ zhes dang / ayo dun ka yam gsang skor thugs kyi drag sngags te/ spu gri rnam gsum ma nges 'gyur/ zhes dang / kun kyang chos nyid ma bcos pa'i/ ma 'gags rang snang rol pa'i rtsal/ chos sku snying por gyur pa yi/ 'jam dpal gzhon nu yin par bshad/ ces gsungs so/ ba su dha ras rgyud kyi spyi spyod las/ phyi skor sku'i drag sngags/ nang skor gsung gi drag sngags/ gsang skor thugs: yang gsang rgod kyi drag sngags so/ /de la phyi skor sku'i drag sngags ni/ rtsa ba'i yig 'bru bcu gnyis pa las/ phan gnod dang bcas pa'o/ nang skor gsung gi drag sngags ni/ rtsa ba'i 'bru brgyad dang bcas pa'o/ /gsang skor thugs kyi drag sngags ni/ rtsa ba 'bru bzhi pa las dang bcas pa'o/ /bzhi pa dgra kro bdud yang gsang rgod ni/ drag po ayau rings dang bcas pa'o/ /yang gsang rgod kyi drag sngags bzlas thabs ni/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi yang snying 'jam
༄༅/ /dpal lha rgyud kyis/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad rdzogs pa'i drag sngags/ drag po ayau rings kyi sngags de/ 'di la bsnyen par bzlas pa dang / drag por bzlas pa gnyis kyi dang po ni/bdag nyid zil gnon du gsal ba'i thugs kyi tsitta gur phub pa 'dra ba'i nang du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la ye shes sems dpa' sku mdog phyag mtshan mi mnga' ba zhig bsgom/ de'i thugs dkar nyi ma'i steng du/ hūṃX mthing ga 'od zer kha dog lnga 'phro ba cig bsam/ de la sngags kyi phreng klag thabs su bskor bar bsam/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa'i zhal nas thon te/ rang gi snyu padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i ze'u 'bru la hrīXdamar po gnas pa'i mtha' skor du/ sngags phreng gis bskor ba la phog slar de las kyang 'od zer steng du 'phros pas klad pa dung khang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng / oX dkar po gnas pa'i mthar sngags pho brang gis bskor ba la phog yang lte steng nas thugs gar 'phro zhing / de ltar 'phro 'du 'khor lo byas pa'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa thams cad byang nas 'od zer phyir 'phros te phyogs bcu'i bde bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs gnas su 'phros pas thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul te 'od zer tshur 'dus/ bdag nyid kyi gnas gsum du thim pas sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thob/ yang 'od zer
phyir 'phros/ 'gro drug sems can rnams la phog pas/ sdig sgrib sbyangs/ mthu dpal gzi mdangs thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par tshur 'dus bdag la thim pas/ bdag nyid ye shes kyi sku shin tu brjid pa dang ldan par gyur/ yang 'od zer phyir 'phros/ yul gnod byed kyi dgra bgegs rnams la phog pas bya sgro mis bsregs pa ltar bcom/ 'od zer tshur 'dus bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams rgyas/ bdag la thim zhing bdag gi ba spu'i bu ga thams cad du/ nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa'i khro chung phyag na rlung gi 'khor lo thogs pas gtam ste bar chad thams cad bsrung bar sgom zhing / las dang po pas de dag la khrid du bya ba'am/ brtan pa cung zad thob pas 'phro 'du rnams cig car du bya ba yin la/ de yang thob mar e rings 'bum phrag gcig tu bzlas pa bya'o/ /de skad du'ang/ rtsa ba lus kyi drag sngags la/ yig 'bru brgya dang zhe dgu yod/'bum phrag gcig tu bzlas pa bya/ zhes pa dang / de ni lus kyi tshul yin te/ bsnyen pa dang ni nye bar bsnyen/ zhes gsungs so/ /de nas rgyun du 'grub tshad bzlas/ zhes dang / rgyun du lha srin stobs gzhom bzlas / zhes pas dus rgyun du ji tsam 'grub tshad bzlas par bya'o/ /drag po e rings ni/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kun gcig tu dril ba'i sngags yin pas 'di kho na gtso bor bzlas shing / phyi skor nang
༄khu/ /skor gsang skor rnams ni skabs mtshams su bzlas pa phyag len/ drag po e rings ni/ ba su dha ras/ dang po kho nar drag por dbang sdud sngags rings la nan tan byas te/ de yang sku gsung thugs kyi phreng ba las bcu bdun pa dang / gnad la dbab pa dang / grong khyer dkrugs pa dang / gnad la brda ba dang / ming nas 'bod pa dang / srog gzir ba dang / sreg pa dang / spyad pa'i las thams cad sngags kyi byed pas rang bzhin bsnyen par bya'o/ /zhes 'byung ngo / sa ma ya3|/ sarba maṅga laX/ dge'o//
do༅/ /tshe bdag brgyud pa'i phyag 'tshal byin rlabs rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs zhesabya ba dang 'phags pa 'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi yang snying bzhugs so/
༄༅/ /'jam dpal tshe bdag gi bla ma brgyud pa la phyag 'tshal zhing gsol ba gdab pa'i rab tu byed pa byin rlabs rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs g.yo ba zhes bya ba rje btsun bla ma 'jam pa'i dpal la phyal 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ khyab bdag ye shes lnga yi dngos/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gshin rje gshed po bgegs kyi rgyal/ /phyag rgya zil gnon la phyag 'tshal/ /rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las bdag /rdo rje snying po la: /'jam dpal rnam 'phrul phrin las gter/ /'jam dpal bshen rje la: /sangs rgyas kun gyi sprul pa'i sku/ /padma 'byung gnas la: /drag sngags gtsug rlag kun dbang bsgyur/ /gtsug rlag dpal dge la: /rgyal rigs lnga rigs grub pa brnyes/ /ba su dha ra la: /mdzod gsum gsang 'dzin lo tsā ba/ /sangs rgyas ye shes la: /gnubs chen thugs sras kun gyi
༄tshi/ /mchog / yon tan rgya mtsho la/ /'jam dpal rol pa'i tant+ra brnyes/ /ye shes rgya mtsho la: /gdul bya drag po rjes 'dzin pa'i/ /padma dbang rgyal la: /'khor lo rnam bzhi'i dgongs pa can / / lha rje 'jam dpal la: /ya mānta gas rjes su gzung / /rgya gar rdo rje la: /bam chen gsang ba smin cing grol/ /chos kyi ye shes la: /byang chub lam la dmod pa'i lam/ /mthar phyin khro bo 'bar la 'dud/ /mngon spyod phrin las rab tu brnyes/ /dar ma rgyal la: /sbyor sgrol lam gyi dgongs pa can/ /yang dag rdo rje la: /mang thos sngags kyi sgrub pa thob/ /shes rab rgyal mtshan la: /shes rab gsum ldan nus pa'i gter/ /sdog ston 'bum legs la: /sngags 'chang kun gyi gtsug gi rgyan/ /'bro ston chen po la: /rdo rje theg pa ji bzhin gzigs/ /blo gros rgyal mtshan la: /
gsang sngags rgya mtsho gdams pa'i mdzod/ /shākya mgon po la: /mkhyen rab rtogs pa'i dpal dang ldan/ /spug sten dpal mgon la: /mkhyen brtse nus pa mthar phyin pa'i/ /chos kyi rgyal mtshan: /basprin mnyam med chos kyi rje/ /bde legs rgyal mtshan la: /gzhan yang mchog gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /mchod 'os kun la bstod par bgyis/ /phyi nang gsang bar sbyar ba yis/ /mchod pa rab 'byams rgya mtsho 'bul / / nyams chag sgrib pa'i tshogs rnams kun/ /mi 'chab rab tu gus pas bshags/ /rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras rnams kyis/ /rnam dag dge la rjes yi rangs/ /bstan pa rgya mtsho'i chos char gyis/ /khyab bdag 'jam dbyangs rdo rje'i sku/ /stug po bkod pa'i rgyan du bzhug/ /dus gsum dge ba ci mchis pa/ /'gro kun byang chub thob phyir bsngo/ /bdag ni srid la mi zhan par/ /ma gyur sems can kun don du/ /rdo rje theg pa'i lam zhugs te/ /sgrub la brtson par byin gyis rlobs/ /bde can sku dang mchog gi bam/ /gzungs ma lus kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /rab byams bsgrod pa rnam gsum gyis/ /bdag rgyud smin par byin gyi rlabs stong nyid lta ba rtogs pa yi/ /lhun grub khang par lkog bzhengs lha/ /thug phrad sngags kyi mthu grub nas/ /phrin las rdzogs par byin: /shes rab thabs kyi phyag rgya la/ /rnyed pa'i ye shes dga' ba
༄7/ /bzhi / / bcu drug cha yi rdzogs pa nyid/ /nyams su myong bar: /mi lhag lus kyi 'ber lo bzhi/ /sku bzhi'i gar thabs bde ba che/ /lhan skyes mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku/ /tshe 'dir grub par/ /gal te 'dir ni ma grol na/ /'chi khar gnad cod mi 'byung zhing / /'gro ba'i mar me ye shes sgron/ /ngo yi zin par: /bar dor 'chi bdag dran gyur nas/ /las nyon rlung gi g.yengs pa na/ /cir snang 'khrul par thag bcad nas stong nyid dran par/ /keng rus mche ba gtsigs pa sogs/ /gshin rje'i snang ba shar ba'i tshe/ /ye shes khro bo bgegs kyi dgras/ /rang ngo shes par: /de tshe mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /bdag la nyer 'tshe'i bar chod rnams/ /bsrung zhing mchog gi go 'phang nyid/ /skad cig cig gis grub par mdzod/ /sangs rgyas sku lnga'i bdag nyid can/ /khyab bdag 'jam pa'i dpal thob nas/ /'gro kun 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las/ /sgrol ba'i ded dpon byed par 31ga /gnas skabs kun tu mchog sgrub pa'i/ /'gal rkyen kun zhi mthun chen kun/ /'bad med lhun gyi grub pa yis/ /'gro kun bde la 'god par therdzog /ces baX chen gsang ba rab 'byams kyi dbang gi brgyud pa ltar byas pa yin la/ de las gzhan pa'i brgyud tshul yang rim pa ltar brjod par bya'o/ de la brgyud pa'i thog mar ni/ rgyud kyi ston pa ste/ de yang dbyings dang ye
shes lnga ste/ drug pa spyi'i gzugs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rang bzhin nam ngo bor gyur pa'o/ de la 'jam pa'i dbyangs she'am/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje zhes pa'am/ rdo rje 'chang chen po'am/ phyag rgya zil gnon la sogs pa'i ming gi rnam grangs kyi brjod pa yin pas de dag gang rung gi bya bar brjod pa yin la/ rdo rje 'chang du brjod bar spro na/ sangs rgyas kun gyi spyi gzugs can/ rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo/ zhes brjod rgyu sdud pa po ni rdo rje snying po ste/ de nyid ston pa las mi gzhan pas logs su ma smos kyang chog la/ bam chen gsang ba'i rgyud yig na'ang mi gsal lo/ logs su brjod par spro na/ rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las bdag/ rdo rje snying po la phyag 'tshal/ zhes pa'i rjes su 'jam gshed brjod/ 'jam bshes/ khrag 'thung / padma/ shānti/ gtsug lag dha na sogs rjes su bzung ba yin pas/ padma dang gtsug lag bshad pa ltar dang / dpal chen dngos grub rab tu brnyes/ khrag 'thung nag po la phyag 'tshal lo/ drag sngags dmod pa'i lam bsgrod pa'i/ shanti garbha la: log lta tshar gcod phrin las bdag dha na dha la la: zhes bya'o / bde brgyud pa gnubs lugs dang / pad lugs shes phal che ba la grags shing / gnubs lugs la'ang bka' ma dang gter ma gnyis kyi dang po ni/ mu tig phreng ba'i dbang gi brgyud tshul te/ de yang /
༄tshi/ /rdo rje 'chang / phyag na rdo rje/ 'jam dpal bshos gnyen/ gtsug lag dpal dge shintaX garbha/ dha na dha la/ khrag 'thung nag po/ ba su dha ra/ jo bo sangs rgyas/ yon tan rgya mtsho rnams rim par brjod pa'i rjes su/ nges don rtogs pa mthar phyin pa'i/ sde ston lcags po ba la 'dud/ rab gus dran pa bde legs 'byung / me ston dran 'byung lazo mtha' yas srid pa gsum gyi gnyen/ dran ston mtha' bral la: dkon mchog gsum dngos 'gro ba'i dpal/ me ston dkon rin la: dngos grub mchog brnyes phrin las gter/ bkra shis rgyal mtshan la/ bskyed dang rdzogs pa snying po'i lam/ mthar phyin lha bsgom la:drag po'i brnyen sgrub las mthar phyin/ gangs pa shaka 'bum la: shes bya kun gzigs grub pa brnyes/ rgyal ba g.yung ston la: zhes dang/ de nas/ phag/ spug/ mkhas grub rje/ slob dpon chen po sogs gong ltar ste/ rje dpang gi brgyud tshul bkod pa'o/ rje sgrol ma la ba ltar na/ me ston dkon rin yan snga ma ltar/ de nas/ 'gro mgon skyes mchog mkhas pa lha/ rin chen grags pa la: thos bsam sgom pa'i dpal dang ldan/ bsod nams byang chub laza sangs rgyas mkhyen pa'i rin chen gter/ 'dzam gling paṇa chen la: rab byams bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ shes rab rdo rdze la: mkhas btsun ngo mtshar snang ba'i
dpal / dkon mchog bzang po: 'gro ba'i skyabs cig 'jam dpal dbyangs/ bsam grub rdo rje la: zab dang rgya che'i chos sgra sgrog sgrol ma pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ zag med ting 'dzin rgya mtsho brnyes/ chos grags dpal bzang la: snying rje'i rgya mtshos thugs rgyud gang / nam mkha' rgyal mtshan: rnal 'byor dbang phyug sgrol ma pa/ nam mkha'i rnal 'byor la: zhes bya'o/ /gter ma'i brgyud pa ni/ gnubs yan snga ma ltar dang / de nas skye ba skye bar sngags kyi bdag sprul sku rgya ston la: dam pas rjes bzung mthu thobs bdag bral te salho la: 'jam dpal gsang ba rol pa'i bdag bkris dar la phyag 'tshal lo/stobs gsum nus pa'i rtsal dang ldan/ gangs ri dkar ba la 'dud/ de nas gangs pa shāka 'bum nas g.yung ston sogs snga ma ltar ro/ pad lugs gter ma la'ang bam chen gsang ba'i brgyud pa dang / pad lugs gter ma gnyis kyi dang po ni thog ma nyid du brjod zin la/ pad lugs gter ma ni/ bla ma bkris dar yan gnubs lugs gter ma dang/ de nas sdog ston 'bum legs sogs bam chen gsang ba ltar ro/kun gyi rjes su yan lag bdun pa dang / 'dod don gsol gdab sbyar ba bya'o/ zhes pa 'di yang se'i bande sgom pa rin chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos dpal rgya mkhar gyi yang dben du bris pa'o/ dge bas 'gro
༄༅/ /kun gyi rgyud la tshogs gnyis kyi rgya mtsho chen po zad mi shes pa gtams par gyur cig/ maṅga lam/ kyu/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi yang snying bzhugs so/ pad lugs rgya gar skad du/ ārya mañdzu shri tant+ra tsitta rgya gar khungs btsun pa'i phyir smosapa'o bod skad du sgra bsgyur ba'i tshig smosamed/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal rgyud kyi yang mtshan rmosapa'i yang snying snying 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal 'di yi dam lha la phyag 'tshal phyir smod pa'o 'o1 / 'di 'di la sangasargyasathams cad kyi mtshan 'dusaso ltar sangs rgyas ba〈snam ldan 'das/ ye shes 'di la sangasargyasathams cad kyi sku 'dusaso sku ste rang byung ba/ ye ro|sa 'di la sangs rgyasathams cad kyi thugs 'dusaso mig gcig dri ma med/ ye shes 'di la sangasargyasathams cad kyi ngo sprod 'dusaso snang ba lam me ba/ a ra pa tsa na ya te/ na 'di yig 'bru dgu la thig pa rim dgu 'dusapa'o mgiX ye shes sku nyid khyod la 'dud 'di la sangs rgyasathams cad kyi gsungs 'dusaso/ rdzogasapa'i sangs rgyas kun gyis bshad/ 'di la sangs rgyasathams cad kyi yon yam̐ 'dusapa'o bcom ldan 'das 'jam 'di la sangasargyasathams cad mtshan dang bstod pa 'dusapa'o dpal ye shes sems dpa'i don dam pa'i mtshan yang dag par brjod pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub dongs kyi bka' byin brlab 'dusapa'o pa'i zhal nas gsungs pa rdzogs so/ gu ru zla ba ga:ga gi grub pas the tshom ma zad cig padmas jo mo shel bza' sgron la gnang ba 'di/ mtshan brjod tshar re dang mnyam mo
gsungs so/ sarba maṅga laX/ /
sbas tig nag po/༄༅/ /sngags kyi zhabrula'akhor sdig pa snying 'dzingasadrag po 'bru 'grelabazhugs so/
༄tshicaX 'khrul 'khor sngags kyi mgo phye ayo ayo/ a kro te ka/ ya man ta ka/ ya ma ye/ ka la ru pa ka pa ye/ hri ti a pa ye/ a a ne a ne/ u u ne u ne/ du du ne du ne/ a i u e 37 aX/ra ri/ la li/ du ru ye/ bya tsa ye/ sing nga yi/ hri da ye/ bhi ta ye/ ha la ye/ mu kha ye/ u u ne.u nai/ u u ne.u ne/ byi tri ta/ a a/ na na/ ya ma ra tsa/ ya ma ragha/ ya ma rag a/ya ma rakṣa/ pe ta li/ kro ti shwa ri/ ma ma e ka dza ti/ de ma kha la bam ril/ ru lu ru lu/ shri badzra zhi khro lha brgyad kro ta/ ya ma las kyi galnga mo garma ro ṣa na/ tri kha thug ltar du rha tsanta/ ragha mon las kyi mon pa ta a gang la bya ba mu ka/ myags drag tu gzir ba thum ril/ trig mnan pa nan/ sbur ya nan/ e dgra srog hur thums dza/ kham shag sbyor ba gcod pa ro myags smugs ti rbad ya/ drag sngags las kyi sdebs yig
༄tshi: gnam thog lta bu gsang ba 'di la bzlas lugs gnyis te/ sgrub pa'i dus su bdag nyid gshon rje gshed po khro bo zhal gsum phyag drug pa'am/ zhal drug mdo byang ltar pa'am zhal gcig pa gang yang rung bar bsgom mo/ thugs rin po che tsitta gur phub pa 'dra ba'i nang gzhal yas smug po na/ nyi ma'i dal ma las the bong tsam ga:ga dal/ de'i steng du ye shes sems dpa' sku mdog tshon gang pa smug nag phyag mtshan mi mnga' ba gcigabasgom mo/ de'i thugs gar nyi ma'i dal gyi steng du yi go hūm̐X masang thugs las 'gyur ba med pa nag/ las 'od zer lnga ye shesa'aphro ba gcig bsgom mo/ de la bzlas ayo phye ayo g.yon bskor du pa bya ba'i sngags kyi phreng bas klag phyogs su bskor bar bsgom/ hūṃX de las 'od zer 'phreng bar 'phros pas lte stengs su 'phros te yi ge hri la ngag gi dri ma sbyangs bskor bar bsam mo/ dung nang du khang du oX la skor lusakyi dri
ma sbyangs ba byas ste/ sku gsung thugs kyi gnas su 'phyo 'du byas pa 'od zer gyis bdag rnal 'byor pa'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa sbyangs chosanyid kyi te/ 'od zer phyir 'phros ba mo la nyi ma shar ba bzhin du bas bde bar gshegs pa'i gnas su 'og min du yi ge pa'i 'phros pas/ thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul 'gro drug gi sa pon la phog pas 'o(ga rtog gi sgrib pa sbyangs nas/ yul dgra bgegs rnams la phog pas bya sgro mes bcum pa ltar du/ rtar tshan tsi sbur mi chags pa bzhin bsam/ slar 'dus pas bkrag dang gzi mdangs thams cad rang la 'dus pas ye shes kyi sku shin tu brjid lci ba ba spu thams cad rdo rje khro chung gis gtam par bsgom mo/ drag po'i dus su bdag nyid phyag rgya zil gnon du gsal ba'i thugasatsitta rin po che'i nang du nyi ma'i dkyil 'bor gyi steng na/ 'od mtshon gang pa'i rtse mo la yi ge hūṃX mthing nag nas tsam gnas par bsgom mo/ thugs ga'i phyi rol na ya ma ra dza/ de'i steng du 'od kyi rtse la yi ge ya mthing nag gcig bsgom mo/ de'i thugs ga'i tpū rol du dregs pa phyag na rdo rje bsgom/ de'i thugs tsitta'i nang du yi ge hūṃX mthing gas 'bru tsam nag gcig bsgom/ de'i thugs gar rus sbal gyi rgyal po bsgom/ de'i tsitta'i nang du yi ge e gcig bsgom/ spyi bo bya khyung gi thugs gar yi ge hri gcig bsgom/ yum gyi thugs gar yi ge ma gcig bsgom/ de rnams kyi mtha' mar sngags
༄7: lusadri ma med pa rnams kyis bskor ba bsgom pa'i lha dang sngags gsal ba'o/ de nas yul gsal ba ni/ gang la bya ba ste de rnams la sngags kyi phreng bas bskor/ lha rnams kyi ba spu'i bu ga nas rlung gi 'khor lo lta bus rang dbang med bar 'gugs pa sprosate e yi 'khyams khang du sngags kyi ste/ gzir ba'i dus su spyang mo drug gi ri rgyal gyi rbab rnams lcags kyi thog lta bus maskyurdzo 'od zer lcagasakyu lta bu 'phrosaste snying kha nas bkugs e'i nang na gsal ba la 'gas ste rang dbang med par bsam/ bsad pa'i dus su gnam lcags kyi so dang spu gri'i rbesna lta bus myal sngagasakyi 'od zer mtshon cha lta busanyal gcod par bsam/ bsrung e rengs kyi bzlog gnyis ka 'dis bya/ bsrung ba'i rdo rje'i mkhar me ri me dpung gi gseb tu rnal 'byo pa bdag nyid 'bor dang bcas pa bskyed dus su gang la bya ba de rdo rje'i me lta bus bsregs par bya ste/ rdo rdze me 'od mgar gyi sol mal la lcags zhun thebs pa'i tsha rang nyid zil gzhon du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer tsha 'phro ba la gang gis kyang mi tshugs par bsam/ ngag gamu pa'i dang stobs mnan pa'i dus su yul gang la bya ba'i lce dgra bgegs steng du gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar gnam lcags kyi phur pa thal ri rab la sa brjid che ba phyung ste/ ri rab lta bzas pa po'i lce bus mnan par bsam/ bzhig pa'i dus su gang la bya ba'i snying kha la sogs pa sa 'od zer 'khor lo lta bu 'phros te/ thor thor myal dgra bgegs kyi lusangag yid
gsum la 'od zer phog pa nyal song bar bsam mo/ gsang lam dgag pa'i dus su/ kho rang brten pa'i lha bdud du babs bsrung ma gang byed te/ gtor ma 'phangs pa la khyi tub pa bzhin snang stong dbyer med du kho rang la tub kho rang gi khrag la tub te sbosapar bsam par bsam/ zug pa byung ba'i dus su ye shes kyi 'od zer gyis rang la zug pa'i nad dang/ byad gnod dang sdig sgrib thamasacad thams cad thul thul bsreg par bsam ye shesakyi me 'bar te te/ lha'i sku gsal gsal bsgom/ drag po'i bzlas pa'o/ sbas tig nag po rdzogs so/ sngags kyi bzlas thabs bstan pa3|ltoX dang po rdo rje'i mkhar du mi shig go cha bsrung ba'i tsakra pa'i sku bskyed pa dang / nam byasakha bzhig pa'i tsakra mkha'i mthongs su sbyor ba'i skabs mi dang mi ma yin gyi byas pa thamasacad bzhig pa dang / ri rab bsad pa'i tsakra kyi rtse la gnam lcags kyi so brdar ba dang / ri bzlog pa'i tsakra thang mtshams su zhe sdang khros pa'i gzhu gcag pa dang /rgya mtsho'i gting du mun pa'i dmag bsdud pa dang / 'khor ba'i rgya gling du srid pa'i ri bsgyel ba dang / drug go 'di rnams kyi sgrub thabs che chung gnyis na gsol 'od logs su shes par byas la dpyad do/ sgrub thabs gnyis po 'og na gsal lo/ snying 'dzings lhan tu zab pa'i kyi man ngag skrag lag len no/ athi+-iltoX
༄7/ /mchod rten lag tu blang ba'i man ngag dang spra khrid dbabasazhesabya ba bzhugs so/
༄tsho/ /dpal 'jigs byed kyi rgyal po tshe bdag nag po la phyag 'tshal lo/ 'jam dpal gshin rje'i tant+ra 'bum sde bkod pa nas/ gsang ba'i rgyud sde bco lnga la sogs pa gsungs pa yang / snying po gsang ba'i rgyud/ sdig pa nag po snying la ru 'dzings pa/ gsang ba gshed skor nag po las/ nyams su blang ba'i man ngag lag tu blang ba'i spra khrid do/ dang po rnal 'byor pa dam tshig dang ldan zhing dbang thob pas/ ye shes lha'i bsnyen pa sngon du song ba'am/ lta ba de kho na nyid dang ldan pas/ brtul zhugs kyis sgrub pa la 'jug ste/ gnas dben par sngon du 'gro ba'i rim pa bya/ 'jig rten pa'i lha 'dre dregs pa can la phud btang / bden pa bsgo/ ma nyes pa'i dpang gzugs so/ de nas gsang ba gshed nag gi las la 'jug ste/ rdzas dang lha dang sngags dang gsum mo/ dang po rdzas kyi rang
༄tsho/ /gshed rdzas zlog nag po'i rdzas dang / 'khrul 'khor gyi rang gshed dbab pa dang / lha'i rang gshed ting nge 'dzin sngags bzlog nag po lha'i stobs kyis zil gyis mnan pa dang / sngags kyi rang gshed sngags bzlog nag po'i drag sngags kyis bsgral ba'o/ rdzas kyi rang gshed rdzas bzlog nag po lha'i sku yongs su rdzogs pa'i mchod rten nag po rdzas rnams tshogs pas tshad dang ldan par bya ste ba cesapa bzhugs so te gzhug rdzas rnams 'tshogs par bya ste/ 'khor rnams kyang bri/ liṅga'i mtha' rnams bca' gzhi rdzogs par bya rdzogs par byas la/ stegs bu'i steng du bzhag la tshogs phud la sogs pas mchod de sha khrag gi gtor ma le'u gsum nas 'byung ba ltar yang gtong / de nas gsang ba gshed skor nag po'i las la 'jug ste/ 'khor lo rnam pa bzhi'i dang po rgya mtsho'i ru sbal gting du mun pa'i dmag bsdus la
mnan pa dang / ri thang mtshams su phyag na rdo rje zhe sdang khros pa'i gzhu bcag la bsnyal ba dang / ri rab kyi rtse la gnam lcags ya ma ra dza kyi so brdar ba la bcad pa dang / nam bya khyung gi mkha'i mthongs su mthing gi phya ra ba bkram pa la bzhig pa'o/ rgya mtsho'i gting du mun pa'i dmag sdud pa ni rnal 'byor pa'i lho phyogs su dong gru gsum khru gang pa brus te/ de nas kham pa'i gwa'u srid pa'i ru sbal 'dra ba'i lto bar 'khor lo gzhung bzhin bcas la/ 'khor lo 'og ma'i liṅga la/ khrag dug nyung ngar gyis brab cing drag sngags 'di bzlas shing brdeg go e myags ya rngubs mugs shag ka dun/ ra tri ra khrag srog snying la yam yam tri rlang / dgra bo'i srog snying la shag rbad/ e ka ya ma srog la hur thums thibs gzir nan dgra bo'i snying la shag rbad/ nag kṣu bdag po'i nā ga be ta srog la dza la dza la ni/ thums dgra po'i snying la rbad/ ces brgya'am stong tsam bzlas / 'di brjod do/ hūm̐X nyon mongs las kyi ru dra 'di/ ma rig mun pa'i smug rum du/ dug gsum stobs kyis gnon mdzad pa/ 'chi bdag bdag po tshe bdag bdag dang srog bdag bdag gsang ba'i gshed kyi lha khyod kyis/ rang gshed nag po'i las mdzod cig ces 'khor lo steng mas bkab la sngags 'di brjod do/ e bam̐ ram̐ yam̐ khṛ shog tsitta rngubs chi mo pas gtibs/ mes tshig chus/ chus khur/ rlung yen/ kha
༄tshi/ /ri ba ltag sna ri tsi ri stibs/ kha yen dgra bo mā ra ya nan/ ces brjod la/ g.yam pas kha bcad la pas bstig go ldi bcag bya'o/ ma bskor bar 'khor ba'i 'khor lo zhes bya'o/ de nas ri thang mtshams su zhe sdang khros pa'i gzhu bcag pa ni/ gshed po las rgyal gyi lto bar dbus su liṅga bris/ snying la sdig pa'am rdo rje bri/ mu khyud le'u bdun pa nas blangs so la dregs pa'i srog sngags bri/ 'khor lo bshog pa'i yig 'bru bkod la/ tsakra gnyis kha sbyar te tshig tu 'di skad brjod do/ hūm̐X lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la/ sngags pa nang rgyas byed pa'i tshe/ lha srin stobs 'gran byed pa'i tshe/ gshed po las kyi rgyal po khyod/ skye ba snga ma'i las dbang gis/ sgrub byed skyes bu chen po la/ de dpon dregs pa'i srog khang gnas/ snying rtsa sngags kyi rnam par phyungs/ sems ni sngags kyi rgyud du dbyung/ 'jig rten dregs pa'i srog sngags kyis/ dam nyams las kyi ru dra la/ rang gshed dbab pa'i phrin las mdzod/ dregs pa'i srog sngags tshar gcig brjod do/ ri rab kyi 'og tu mnan par bya'o/ 'di ni ma bskor bar las kyi 'khor ba'i 'khor le'o/ de nas ri rab kyi rtse la gnam lcags kyi so bdar bar bya ba ni/ ri rab gzhi che bar byas la/ bang rim dang po'i dbus su 'brub khung sum brtsegs su bya'o/ kha khyer rtsangs dang thod pa me ris bskor/ nang dug khrag dang ro
