brab / 'og ma phag mo'i 'khor lo ste/ snying khrag rngubs par bsam pa'o// skabs skabs su sha khrag gtor ma btang la/ lha tshogs kyi thugs dam bskul lo/ de ltar rnal ma dang / bzlog pa dang / lto dkrug pa gsum ni/ sgrub pa dang / spog pa dang / shi sa gsum yin la/ lto log nag po ni/ dpa' bo log 'then zhes bya ba/ mi 'grub mi srid pa'i gnad yin no/ las kyi mtha' rgya ni/ nam mkha' dang / sa gzhi bar snang la sogs la/ mnan pa'i las kun gzhung bzhin rdzogs par bya'o// yang na gri thod nang du rtsal la btsan bdud drag po'i rgyu srang du mnan no/ des ni zhag gsum dag na gze grir 'chi bas ya bag sha'i las yin ces bshad do// de ltar 'khor lo bskor ba'i las 'di/ mchog dang phag mo'i lto sdebs pa ni gsang ba/ rang gshed kyi las drug tu sdebs pa ni/ yang gsang ste/ gsang ba yang gsang sdeb zhes bya'o//de la pha rol gyi bsad sngags sam/ bsnyen sngags bzlog nas bsad sngags sbrel te/ brgya brgya'am/ bcu re bsnol nas bzlas na rno ngar te/ yang gsang rno ngar du sdebs pa'i mchog go / gsad pa'i las rang gshed nag po/ yang gsang rno ngar dang bcas pa nang 'bor lo la brten te/ bsad pa'i las gsal bar byed pa'i sgron ma rdzogs so//
༄tshi/ /dpal ya man ta ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ de nas gsang ba tsitta la brten te/ bsad pa'i las bstan pa ni/ rno myur ldan pa'i snying sgrub nag pos/ btsan thabs su bsad pa'i las bya ba 'di kho na'o//bsad las kun gyi mthar thug 'di yin te/ 'di med na bsad pa'i las kun yug sa rkyang zhes bya'o// shin tu gdug cing dben pa'i sa phyogs su/ drag po'i lha tshogs rnams la mchod gtor bsham mo// dpa' bo grir bsad pa'i tsitta'am/ de ma rnyed na khyi nag gam/ ra rog po'i snying nang du rang gshed dbab pa'i tsakra bri ba ni/ ro ras sam/ zhing lpags sam/ yang na dug shog la/ gdug byed zhe sdang lcags kyi sdig pa nag po'i ltor/ mu khyud rim pa gsum du bskor la/ dbus su brnag pa'i liṅga bri/ de'i phyir rdo rje rgya gram gyi rwa la/ e myags 'bru brgyad bri/ de'i phyi rim rtsibs drug la/ spu gri gcod pa'i drag sngags 'di/yig mgo phyir bstan la bri/ srog la breng shag rtsa khrag snying thuX ril raX shag rbad/ nag po rag sha snying la thum ril rbad/ nag po rag sha rtsa la breng shag rbad/ nag po rag sha snying khrag sham long rbad/ nag po rag sha gar pa ni dza/ ces pa bri/ de'i phyi rol du/ sdig pa nag po bsgrad pa'i tshul du bya'o// yang ro ras sam gri lpags la/ phrag dog bse'i sbal pa dmar po'i lhor/ mu khyud rim pa gsum du bskor la/ dbus su
brnag pa'i liṅga bri/ phyi rim rgya gram la/ gnam thog drag po e myags 'bru brgyad pa bri/ phyi rim rtsibs chen bcu drug la/ srog gcod gsang sngags 'di rnams bri/ che ge mo'i srog la rbad/ thuX ril rbad/ rtsa khrag tsitta phyung / ddhi srog khung thuX dza/ ces pa'i yi ge mgo phyir la bstan bri/ de'i tpū rol du/ bse'i sbal pa kha gdangs pa bri/ de nas zhe sdang lcags kyi sdig pa nag po dang / phrag dog bse'i sbal pa dmar po de gnyis sdebs te/ kha sbyar la tsitta'i nang du gzhugagiX gu gul gyis bdug lha dang dbye/ sngo dmar gyis bcings te tsittar rtsal la/ tsitta de rabs chad kyi thod pa bshag pa'i nang du brtsal te/ gshin rje'i mun khang thar med du bsams/ ag rtse ba yar bstan la/ de 'brub khung du bcug kha la rtsang dmar dgram mo/ de nas drag po'i thun rdzas/ nyung dkar dang dug dang zi ra la sogs pa bsag de nas mnan rdzas dang /thun rdzas rnams la bsngags la/ thod pa'i ag rtse nas mar/ snying la brdeg ste/ rang zil gnon du gsal bar bskyed la/ drag po'i sngags 'di bzlas so// ting nge 'dzin ni/ nyin dmar po'i sngags bzlas pas / bse'i sbal pa dmar po/ de'i sngags las 'od zer mtshon dmar 'phros/ gzas pa po'i rtsa bzhi bcad/ rdo rje rgya gram gyis tsitta khong du 'khrug cing / rtsibs bcu drug(bzhi )/ kho'i rnam shes tshogs brgyad
༄tshi/ /bcom zhing / bse'i sbal pas snying khrag 'jib par bsam la/ drag sngags 'di yis brdeg go /e myags ya rngubs mugs shag ka dun/ a mu ka yi srog la ma ra ya rbad/ thuX ril rbad/ rtsa khrag tsitta phyung ddhi srog hur thuX dza/ ces thun la sngags/ nang dgongs thun brdeg pas/ thun gyi sngags rnams/ sbal sdig mang por gyur nas/ snying khrag 'jib par bsam mo// nyin mo nyung dkar dang tshe dang dug gi brab bo/de bzhin srod dang tho rangs gnyis/ mtshan mo ni nag po'i sngags bzlas la/ nyungs nag dang lcags phye dri khrag gis brab/ sngags la dug gi me 'bar nas/ rtsa srog bcom par bsam mo/ rdo rjes tsitta dkrugs shing /gzas pa'i tshe srog gtubs nas/ lcags kyi 'khor los rnam shes bcom/ lcags kyi sdig pas tshe srog gtubs par bsams/ ngan sngags 'di yis skye ba'i rgyun gcod par bsam zhing bzlas so// e myags ya rngubs mugs shag ka dun/ a mu ga'i srog la breng shag rtsa khrag snying thum ril/ nag po rag sha snying la thur na rbad nag po rag sha srog la hur thuX rbad/ nag po rag sha rtsa la breng shag rbad/ nag po rag sha snying khrag tshal pa sham long rbad/ gar pa nni dza/ bhan dha ri bhi ti staXbha ya nan/ ces mtshan mo nyung nag dang gri khrag dang lcags phyes brab bo// thun rnams 'du ba rnam bzhi'i nad du gyur nas/ dgra'i khong du dug nad
rgyas nas bsad par bsam mo// de ltar nyin mtshan gnyis su phyed la bzlas pa bya ste/ mtshan mo nag po'i las bya zhing / nyin mo dmar po'i las bya'o// nyin mtshan gyi mtshams kun tu bskul zhing gtor ma phul la de'i rjes su thun gyi las bya'o// nang nub thun sngags gnyis po gril la sngags te brab bo// de bzhin srod dang tho rang gnyis/ sngags rings kyis kyang brab pa yis/ ma gshin rnams kyis sha rul 'bus g.yengs pa bzhin du bshig nas lha srin kun gyis zos par bsam/ rtags ni rab tsitta rang dngos su 'gas/ 'bring me stag 'phro zhing 'tshig tha ma 'dar zhing rmi lam du dgra bo de rang bsad pa'am/ ra dang g.yag dang /sems can bsad pa 'byung bas/ tsitta tsakra dang bcas pa de/ mchod rten nag por bcug la/ gza' skar ngan pa la gtad la/ mchod rten nam lam rgya gram du mnan no// kha bal nag gi dgab cing ri rab kyis mnan par bsams/ bum par don yod grub pa'i wo brang btab/ de nas rgyun du thun gyi las bya zhing / gtor ma gtang la dregs pa bskul lo// zhag nyer gcig la rtags 'byung nges so// gal te zhag nyer gcig las 'gyangs na/ rang gshed nag po 'di bzlas pas/ rang gi 'bugs kyang thum thum 'byung ngo / dregs pa ni 'khrug cing brgyal lo/ e myags ya rngubs mugs shag ka dun a mu ka dza thums/ srog hur
༄7/ /thums smṛ/ rtsa khrag tsitta phyung / thuX ril rbad/ srog la rbad/ rbad long shaX nag po raka snying tshal pa rbad/ shag nag po rtsa la rag sha greng / rtsa khrag thuX snying ril gar pa nni dza dza/ ban dha bi stuX bha ya nan/ces dkrug pa 'di nyid zhag gcig bzlas nas/ lha chen srog dang 'chad pas rtags dang sbyar ro// tsitta 'khor lo dang bcas pa mchod rten nag por bcug la mnan no// gsang ba tsitta la brten nas bsad pa'i las / gsad pa'i la dor ba/ mnag pa'i mthar thug pa rdzogs rbersha// maṅga lam/ bha wantu/dpal ya man ta ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ yang gsang drag po thun la brten te gsad pa ni/ thod pa mtshan ngan du/ ra rog po'i snying du liṅga bcug la/ liṅgal gar pa nni dza 'god sngo dmar gyis bcings so// bdag lhar bsgoms la sngags bzlas so// thun rdzas ni/ pho lha rang gshed dbab pa'i phyir/ skye tshe dang / shang tshe/ mo lha rang gshed dbab pa'i phyir/ lcags phye dang zangs phye/ yul lha rang gshed dbab pa'i phyir/gu gul dang rdo phye/ thun de rnams brab pas/ kho'i bsrung ma rnams kho rang la rub nas/ khyi ro 'bus g.yengs pa ltar gsad par bsam mo// de dag ni brab pa'i rdzas so// 'phang ba'i thun rdzas ni/ g.yag ru'i
thun dong du mi rta khyi phag bzhi'i khrag dang / zangs lcags rdo phye gsum dang / nyungs gar nyung nag skye tshe shang tshe ju tshe rnams la zhag dgur sngags la 'phang ngo / ayo ayo ayo/ a kro te ka/ ya man ta ka/ ya ma ye/ka la ru pa ka pa ye/ hri ṭi a pa ye/ ya ma ta ka byi tri ta/ ka hla kro ta/ a ne.u ne du nai/ bya tsa ye/ du ru ye/ tsitta ye/ ha la ye/ ya ma tri ta/ ya ma kro ta/ ya ma mon ta/ ya ma rag sha/ ya ma byi sha/ hu ti mon ta/ hri tsa ya/ a mu srog la breng shag/ myags thun bhyo/ thuX ril khrag la myogs bhyo/ dun ting hri shag ha la yam bhyo/ dgra bo'i snying khrag tshal pa myogs rbad/ srog la ma ra ya rbad/ ddhi shag ku ru ni rbad/ddhi hur long breng dun dun/ hur thuX dza tsitta rbad ya/ tsitta ma ma rag sha/ srog tung tung bhyo/ srog shing bhyo/ ces brab cing 'phangs te/ de yang thebs nges pa'i dus ni/ tho rangs dkar chen gyi dmag dpung dbab pa zhe bya ste/ srog lha bdud du dbab pa'i thun rdzas kyis brab bo// nyin dgung la 'chi bdag zan 'tshol ba zhes bya bas/ yul lha'i thun rdzas kyis brab bo/ srod la ni bdud chen sdud pa zhes bya ste/ pho lha'i thun rdzas kyis brab bo// nam phyed la ma mo'i dal dbab pa zhes bya ste/ mo lha dang zhang lha'i thun rdzas kyis brab bo// thun rdzas de rnams ni/ gsad pa rang gshed kyi thun rdzas zhes bya ba/ rdzas rkyang pas kyang rang gshed
༄tshi/ /phebs pa yin pas/ sngags drag po dang bcas pas ni/ kho rang gi lha bdud du phebs nges so// thun rdzas la bsngags pa'i dus su me stag 'phro ba dang / skad 'don pa 'byung ngo / mjug bsdu ba ni/gza' skar bdud nyi 'dzom pa na/ sta che chung dang / mig dmar phur spen la/ lam rgya gram mam/ klu gdug pa can gnas sar/ dong gru gsum brus la/ liṅga spyang thod dam glang rur bcug la chas dang ldan par mnan mchod rten bang rim gsum pas mnan/ kha bal nag dang tsher mas bcad/ thun brdeg go /de nas thun kha gsos la 'phang ba ni/ nya stong ngam/ ki gang ngam/ yang na zhag re zhing yang rung ste/ thun rdzas la sngags kyi ngar gyis kha gsos la/ lha tshogs rnams la sha khrag gi gtor ma phul te/ drag tu bskul/ nam phyed na 'phang ngo / khyad par thun de rnams/ gri mda'am/ gnam lcags kyi phur pa bskus la/zhag gsum sngags drag tu bzlas dgra phyogs su 'phang ba'am/ dgra'i khang pa la brgyab na/ mod la cog 'gyel du 'chi'o// gzhan yang dregs pa'i sbyor ba bcad pa/ pho nya myur mgyogs bzlog pa'i zor ni thun rdzas yang na yi dam gyi gtor zor kyang rung ste/ sngags 'di'i 'phang ngo // e myags ya rngubs mugs shag ka dun/ a mu ka dgra bo'i srog la thun mugs bhyo/ srog la khaX shag bhyo/ srog la breng shag bhyo/ srog la
yaX shag bhyo/ srog la thuX ri lam̐ lam̐ bhyo/ ces drag tu bzlas la 'phang ngo // kho'i pho nya dang / bdag la gnod pa'i dregs pa thams cad bzlog par 'gyur ro// yang gsang drag po'i thun la brten te gsad pa/ drag po thun gyi kha gso ba dang bcas pa rdzogs so// dpal ya man ta ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ sgyi don bzhi pa de nas/ ri thang gi mtshams su zhe sdang drag po'i gzhu bcag pa/ phyir bzlog pa 'khor lo'i las/ spyang mo drug gi dgongs don/ stong srog gi gnad dang bcas pa bstan pa ni/ rtsa ba e ring kyi sngags kyi phreng ba de la/ spu gri ru spyang mo drug gi gang dgos pa re'i so brdebs la/ gang 'dod kyi las la sbyar te/ rtsa sngags pho dkrugs 'di lha rgyud thams cad kyi snying po dang / nus pa gcig tu dril ba'i sngags 'di yin no/ las sngags spu gri'i mtshams su/ ming srog gi 'byin 'jug gis/ gang 'dod pa ltar bcug la/ a mu gas brda' sbyar la tsheg drag mtshams su shes par bya ste/ spu gris mtha' bsgyur ro// de la dang po gzir cing gzhom pa'i spyang mo/ so ru brdeg pa ni 'di'o/ che ge mo a mu ka trig nan/ myags thuX ril rbad/ trig nan sbur nan/e hur thuX dza kham shag ro myags/ mugs ti rbad yā/ ces so// byas pa bshig pa'i spyang mo'i so gdags pa ni/ che ge mo a mu ka tsa sbur ya/ srog nan/ snying gzer breng shag yaX rbad/ e hur thuX dza/ khaX shag ro
༄tshi/ /myags mug ti rbad yugiX ces so// zug pa dbyung ba'i spyang mo ni/ che ge mo a mu ka du raX tri yang 'drid phyung / srog la gzir nan chung ya/ e hur thuX dza/ khaX shag ro myags/ mugs ti rbad ya/ gsang lam dgag pa'i spyang mo ni/ che ge mo a mu ka man tra daX duX ma ha ra ga du raX thuX ling rbad/ e hur thuX dza/ kham shag ro myags mugs ti rbad ya/ phyir bzlog pa'i spyang mo ni/ che ge mo a mu ka e nan yaX bzlog 'drid bhyo e hur thuX dza/ khaX shag ro myags mugs ti rbad yugiX ngag mnan g.yu'i spyang mo ni/ che ge mo a mu ka/ bhi taX staX bha ya nan / e hur thuX dza/ kham shag ro myags mugs ti rbad ya/ ces so// de ltar spyang mo drug po de la/ gang dgos pa re/ sgo sgor sbyar la bsdeb so/ de'ang gnod byed ngos zin na de'i ming dang sgos srog la btegs te bsdebs so// ngos ma zin na/ a mu gas brda' sbyar la/ stong srog e la sbyar te/de ni spyi srog yin pas so// de ltar spyang mo drug po gang dgos pa bsgyur te bsdeb bo// sgom bya'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ rang zil gnon rtsa ba'i lha/ brgyan gyi lha dang bcas pa gsal par bskyed la/ lha'i sku dang thugs ga'i yig 'bru las sngags kyi 'od zer 'phros pas/ yul gang la bya ba/ rang dbang med par gzir nas srog gi ngo bo'i nang na yod pa'i/ rnam shes kyi yig 'bru de so// hur thum dza ces pas/ rang dbang
med par 'phrog rang gi thugs kyi rus sbal rngam pa'i khyams khang du/ e dang ka la bsdus par bsams zhing / ming srog btem mo// khyad par spyang mo drug gi dgongs pa so so ni gong gi bskyed rim gyi skabs su/bkod pa ltar sgom mo/ phyir bzlog 'khor los/ ri thang gi mtshams su/ zhe sdang khros pa'i gzhu bcag cing dregs pa'i stobs gzhom pa rdzogs so//dpal ya man ta ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ spyi don lnga pa/ de nas mnan pa'i 'khor lo'i las bya ba/ rgya mtsho'i gting du mun pa'i dmag bsdu ba ni kho'i gtad khram gyi sbyor ba bzlog pa dang / 'jig rten pa'i lha 'dre rbod gtong drag po'i stobs mnan pa dang / ban dhe nag po ngan sngags mkhan gyi ngag mnan pa dang gsum mo// de la thog mar gtad bzlog pa ni/ rgyud las/ gdug pa klu'i gtad khram bzlog ces pas gal te gtad mkhan dang 'gras shing nang rgyas byung na/ 'chi bdag nag po spu gri nang 'thab/ rus sbal nag po mjing bsnol gyi/ las kyi 'bor lo 'di ltar bca' zhes dang / sa bdag klu'i gtad khram bzlog ces pas ta la'i lo ma'am rgya shog la/ klu bdud mgo dgu'i lto bar 'khor lo bcas la/ zhag bdun drag sngags kyi 'khor lo bzlas te bskor la/ tsakra rus sbal gyi khog par bcug ste/ rang gi gnas mchod rten
༄༅/ /nag po'i rmang 'og ri rab kyi khram bar du mnan no// sngags brgya rtsa re bzlas lhang klu'i sbyor ba bcom pas dug can gyi klu kha 'ching zhing / gtad mkhan de myur du brlag par 'gyur ro// rang nyid lhar gsal ba'i mdun du/ bka' nyan 'chi bdag nag por gsal bar bsgom zhing / gtad bzlog gi drag sngags 'di/ zhag gsum mam bdun du drag tu bzlas la/ tsakra rus sbal gyi khog par bcug la/ mchod rten nag po'i 'og tu mnan no/ drag po sngags rgod 'di kho na'o// e dun ka yaX/ dgra po tsitta breng shag dza/ srog la hur thuX breng shag rbad/ e myags ya rngubs/ mugs shag ka dun/ nag po baX/ tsitta la rgyob trag thur snying la thur/ snying 'gul myags myags/ rtsa bzhi bskums/ shan shan/ srog la shan/ thur thur dgra bo'i tsitta la rbad/ sa na ga ha la ha la/ rtsa ma ri dgra bo'i snying la thuX bhyo:༷༷ ces pa'i sngags tshan gnyis so// mtshon cha bsnol mar bzlas so// gtad bzlog pa ste/ klu'i stobs mnan pa'o// de'i rjes nas kyang skabs skabs su/ brgya rtsa tsam re bzlas shing / thun 'phangs pas/ gtad mkhan phung bar byed do// yang na rang gshed kyi 'khor lo mchog dang phag mo'i mu khyud bar ma dag la gtad 'dre'i ming dang sngags bsdebs la bri ste/ bsnol mar bzlas shing / 'khor lo bskor ro// rjes ni nag po'i klu la gtad
par bya'o// de yang khos gtad pa'i klu khungs chod na rab tu legs/ ma rnyed na che zhing gnyan sa la gtad do// des ni gtad 'dre'i klu dang / gzhan yang rigs brgyud nas gnod pa'i klu dang / las kyi dbang gi gnod pa'i klu dang / bya spyod log par 'gras nas gnod pa'i klu la sogs pa klu gdon thams cad bzlog/ yang khos gtad byas pa'i klu ngos zin pa'am 'on te ma zin na yang gtad mkhan de la klu rang gshed du dbab pa ni/ 'brub khung nag po rgya dpangs khru gang par/ tsakra dpe chung ltar bris la kha sbyor/ bdag nyid lhar gsal ba'i mdun du 'chi bdag nag po bsgom/ gtad bzlog nag po'i drag sngags bsnol la zhag dgu 'am gsum du brdeg go/ e myags ya rngubs/ mugs shag ka dun/ na ga ru tra ka la dgra po'i snying la bhyo/ sa na ga ha la tsa ma ri dgra po'i snying la thuX bhyo/ ces pa dang/ e myags ya rdubs/ mugs shag ka dun nag po baX tsitta la rgyob/ drag thur snying la thur/ snying 'gul myags myags/ rtsa bzhi skum shan shan srog la shan thur thur dgra bo'i tsitta la rbad/ ces brgya brgya bsnol mar bzlas te/ nyung dkar nag dang mtshon cha brdar ba'i phye ma dang / brag nag 'gram pa'i rdo phye rnams la/ brgya la sngags shing stong la brab bo// zhag dgu rdzogs nas kho'i byas pa der mnan no// de ma rnyed na'ang / klu che zhing gnyan pa la
༄7/ /gtad pas/ gtad 'dre'i klu dug can de/ kho rang la bzlog go /des ni gtad mkhan phung par 'gyur ro// yang na mchog phag gi mu khyud bar ma la bskor la/ las mtha' klu nag po la gtad do//gnyis pa rbod gtong mkhan dang 'gras na 'jig rten lha 'dre spyi'i rbod gtong mkhan gyi dregs pa spyi'i ngag mnan pa ni/ rgyud las / stobs chen 'joms pa drag po'i mtshon/ /sbyor ba kha gso sngags pa 'joms/zhes pas/ kho'i gzugs dang ming rus dang / kho'i bsrung ma rnams kyi ming gzugs shog bu la bris la/ khyi thod dam phag thod du bcug la dug khrag dang / nyung dkar nyungs nag dang / tsha ba gsum dang / gu gul dang / thal chen dang / gri khrag dang / khyi khrag la sngags shing thun gyis ling ga la bsnun no// e myags ya rngubs mugs shag ka dun/ srog la thuX ril rbad bhyo/ rtsa la dun rmugs rbad bhyo/ khrag la mugs ti thun rbad bhyo/ snying thur nag po khas khas/ yin yin/ gar pa ni dza/ hūṃX dza dza/ bhi taX staX pa ya nan / ces bzlas shing thun brab bo/ skabs su bskul zhing gtor ma dbul/ zhag bdun rdzogs nas/ phag thod dam khyi thod du bcug la/ thod pa rgya chas byas la re bas dril/ lha 'dre rgyu ba'i zam tur ram/ yang na rang dang kho'i so mtshams kyi rgyun srang gnyan po'am/ yang na bka' rten byin can 'og gam/ rang gi them 'og
tu mnan no// des ni pha rol gyi lha 'dre'i stobs dang kho'i ngag mnan par byed do// pha rol po bsrung ma dang bcas pa'i nus pa thams cad 'joms shing 'jigs pa yin no// gzhan yang kho'i pho nya rkang mgyogs kyi 'byung ba'i byad dang / byol kha bzlog pa ni/ rgyud las/ 'jig rten lha 'dre'i khams 'khrug cing / /mtshon cha'i 'khor lo bzlog pa ltar/ kho rang rgyud la ldog pa ni/ pho nya bzlog pa'i las su rig ces pa dang mgyogs pa'i pho nya bzlog cing bsad/ ces pas/ ro ras brtul sbyangs byas la/ yug sa mo bkra ma shis kyi 'og tu zhag gcig mnan/ de la tsakra dpe chung ltar bris la gnyis kha sbyar te/ 'brub khung nang du rtsang la rgyang ngo // thod ngan du ling ga bcug la 'brub khung du bzhag g.yag ru'i nang du dug khrag dang / brag nag po'i rdo phye dang / nyungs dkar nag skye tshe/ zi ra til nag mtshe rdo phye/ lcags phye sbyar la bzhagrang nyid lhar gsal bas bskul zhing bsngags la brab bo// e ka he dun ya ma/ snying khrag ra ma tsa ya/ a mu ga'i srog thun mugs bhyo/ srog staX pa ya nan/ srog la khaX shag bhyo:༷༷ srog la staX pa ya nan/ srog la breng shag bhyo:༷༷ srog staX pa ya nan/ srog la yaX shag bhyo:༷༷ srog staX pa ya nan/ ces/ zhag bdun du brabs la/ 'khor lo dril thod par brtsal la rgya chas bya/ thun rdzas lhag ma zor du 'phang ngo las mtha' ni
༄tsho/ /rigs can rigs med gnyis las/ rigs can ni/ rang gi mal 'og gam/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'og gam/ them 'og tu mnan no// rigs med ni 'khor lo liṅga thod par brub ste/ kha dgra la bstan la lam rgya gram mam zam dur gnyan par dong gru gsum du brus la mnan no// thun lhag kha gsos la/ sngags gong ma de ltar bzlas shing / dus gnyan la zor du 'phang ngo // des pho nya rkang mgyogs rnams kyi stobs gnon zhing / nus pa bcom nas bzlog par byed do// gsum pa sngags pa kho rang gi ngag gi nus pa dbral zhing stobs mnan pa ni/ rgyud las/ nag po stobs dang dbral ba dag /rgya gram dregs pa'i sngags bris te lte steng ri rab rtsang gi mnan/ ces pa dang / ngag mnan 'bor lo bcas pa mnan/ zhes gsungs pas kho'i zag pa'i rdzas brtsal la/ 'dra 'bag ru pa bya/ de la ming rus dgod/ ling ga'i rnyu snying khar drangs la/ lce la sngags bkod de/ snying khar sngags kyi 'khor lo bris la/ lte steng du phur pa sor bzhi pa gcig gdab bo/ /gti mug nag po'i snying zhes pas/ lug gam phag gi tsittar bcug la/ mchod rten bang rim gsum pas mnan no// ting nge 'dzin ni/ khos sngags bzlas pas/ gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs bcu drug pa gnyis kyi bar du/ lte stengs nas/ de lcags phur gyi gzer gyis btab nas/ lte yis 'gyur
mi shes par bsam mo// mchod rten de nyid ri rab tu bsam ste/ lcags kyi ri rab kyi 'og tu mnan par bsams/ phur pa de nyidaya ma ra tsar bsam ste de yang lcags kyi ri rab kyi khong seng na/ ya ma ra tsa sku stod khro bo/ sku smad phur pa me 'bar bas/ dgra'i lle dang snying la gzir zhing / 'gyur dbang med bar bsam mo/ de yang zla ba nag po khong dur du zhugs pa'i dus te/ mar ngo la/ gza' phur bu dar ba/ skar ma lag sor la bya'o// de dus ngan sngags 'dir bzlas te las la sbyar ro// e myags ya rngubs mugs shag ka dun/ a mu ka snying du nan/ pri du nan/ dza du nan/ snying gzer sbur nan/ ka ya waka tsitta badzra tilgaman tra dzhai taX staX pa ya nan/ ces bzlas so// sngags de 'bum mam/ khri phrag gcig gam gsum rdzogs nas/ rtags ni/ kho'i lce skrangs shing lce 'og tu 'brum pa 'byung / de nas dregs pa gdug pa can la mnan gtad bya'o// phyis kyang e ring kyi sham bur ngag mnan pa'i sngags dum re bzlas shing / ting nge 'dzin sdeb pas/ ngag mnan gyi kha gsos pas/ kho'i nus pa gtan nas 'bral lo// khyad par du sngags pa nag po'i drag sngags mkhan nus pa can gyi ngag mnan cing stobs gzhom pa ni/ rgyud las/ zhi khro gshin rje phur pa nas/ /sa bdag klu srin yan chod kyi/ /sngags kyi bzlas brjod ci byas pa/ /ri rab rgya gram chen po
༄tsho/ /yis / / ngag gi nus pa gnon par byed/ ces pas/ lha khang rnying pa'i sa dang / klu nag po gnas pa'i sa dang / khams sa spyin po dang gsum la/ dug khrag bsres la/ mchod rten nag po bang rim gsum pa mtho do pa gcig bya/ rgya shog gam ro ras la/ ngag mnan pa'i 'khor lo dpe chung ltar bris la rtsibs lnga la du du nan lnga bri/ phyi rim rgya gram la/ lha srin dregs pa'i srog sngags bri/ mchod rten nag po la mnan pa'i sngags dang bcas pa bri/ de 'dra ba gnyis bris la/ ro g.yam re la 'khor lo re re sbyar ro// zag rdzas la ling ga byas la/ shog bu la rnyu byas pa/ rnyu snying gar drangs la/ rtsibs lnga pa la rgya gram dang bcas pa gang ma ltar lce la bri/ liṅga de 'khor lo kha sbyar gyi bar du bcug la/ tsakra'i lte ba la sbug pa phug la/ dug shing gi phur pa sor brgyad pas btab bo// mchod rten gyi zhabs su/ che ge mo'i/ ngag gi nus pa bhi taX staX pa ya nan/ zhes pa bris la mnan no// logs bzhi la bum pa nas thur du/ staX pa ya nan zhes pa tshar bzhi bri/ mchod rten gyi bum par rgyal por spyan mig bzang gi snying po bzhugs/ 'khor lo liṅga lce dang bcas pa la/ phur pas gzer btab ste/ phur pa de ri rab khong seng brgyud de/ mchod rten gyi srog shing du bya'o// de nas rang nyid zil gnon rtsa ba'i lha drug rgyan gyi lha dang bcas pa'i thugs ka nas/ dza bzhi
las bla 'gugs pa'i mon pa bzhi/ dung gi mon pa seng ge'i mgo la sogs pa 'phros te/ dgra bo rang dbang med par bkug la/ liṅga la bstim mo// sngags bzlas shing ting nge 'dzin gyis mnan pa ni/ dgra bo'i lte snying gar drangs la/ rdo rje rgya gram gyi mnan te/ 'gyur mi shes par bsgom mo// kho'i sngags bzlas pa'i nus pa thams cad lce'i steng du 'khor lo rtsibs lnga pa gcig tu smin cing gyur nas/ de yis kho rang gi rnyu btub cing gcod par bsam/ de'i steng du lcags kyi ri rab chen po/ ri rab ngo bo dang mnyam pa'i khong seng du phur pa de nyid las kyi tshe bdag chen po sku stod khro po sku smad phur pa gnam lcags me 'bar ba lta bu yis 'bor lo rtsibs lnga pa'i lte ba nas thal phyung ste/ lce stem snying la gzir bar bsgom mo// sngags kyi mnan pa ni/ ayo ayo ayo/ hri ṭi a pa ye/ byi tri ta na na hūṃX che ge mo'i ngag dzhai taX staX pa ya nan/ laX laX/ laX laX nan ra kṣe na ya ma/ ma ma rag mo/ rag sha kṣe ma/ shri badzra kro ta/ dun ting kī la ya4༷༷ bhe la ni/ ayo dun tri/ tri sha ni/ ra tsa ha sti/ ra tsa mu trag sha truX sti/ ro dṛ trig nan/ a tri pa du/ tsa tri ra tsa ra tsa na ga dhe ba ru tri / kha rag kṣe ma tri/ dun ting dun ting tri/ srog ma ra ya ma ra ya/ gha na pa ti/ bhi na ka ro/ ka la du srag byi du ra na ga mo ti/ sa na ga byi du/ sarba sha truX/ che ge mo/ a mu ka/ du du nan/
༄tshi/ /du du nan/ du du nan/ du du nan nan/ myags thuX ril trig nan/ sbur ya nan/ khaX shag ro myags mugs ti rbad ya/ zhes bzlas so// skabs su sngags 'di yang brgya rtsa re bzlas/ ayo ayo ayo/ hri ṭi a pa ye/ byi tri ta nan/ hūm̐X staX bha nan/ che ge mo'i ngag bhi taX staX pa nan/ ces bzlas so// de ltar zhag dgu rdzogs nas/ kho'i gnas khang de nyid dam yang na shar nub kyi grib mas non pa'i ngos la mnan/ grib ma phog pas nges par 'chi/ yang na klu'i gnas su gtad do// gang du gnon kyang dong gru gsum brus la ro sol gyis byug de'i nang du ro g.yam 'khor lo can bting / de'i steng du ling ga gan rkyal du gyel/ snyu stengs su ro g.yam gyis 'khor lo can/ phur lce dang stems la/ mchod rten gyi mnan pa de/ rgya gram gyi kha bcad la sa yi byib/ steng du don yod grub pa'i pho brang bsam/ las 'dis ni/ sngags pa de yi bdun rgyud yan chad nus pa dang bral lo// ngag mnan pa mun pa'i jol dong nag po zhes bya ba rdzogs so// de dag ni mnan pa'i 'khor lo'i las yin no//dpal ya man ta ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ spyi don drug pa/ de nas dkrug pa'i 'khor lo'i las/ 'khor ba'i rgya gling du srid pa'i ri bsgyel ba ni/ gal te ma grub cing las 'gor ba'am/ rdugs na lha srin dregs pa'i
tsitta dkrug cing ar la gtad pa ni/ las kyi mtha' rgya yin pas/ las gang yang ma grub cing las gzhan du ma yin no// de yang rgyud las/ tsitta dkrug cing rang gshed dbab ces pas dur khrod kyi ras la/ sme ba'i khrag gis thang pa byas la/ rme khrag gi gshed po'i lto ba rtswa 'khor lo dpe chung ltar byas la/ phung sa la 'brub khung byas la/ rtsang la 'khor lo gnyis kha sbyar la steng 'og tu dgram mo// ra rog po'i tsitta'i nang du dgra'i ling ga bcug la/ thod pa mtshan ngan kha g.yel du bcas la/ 'brub khung du bcug ste steng 'og tu brab cing dbub bo// dug dang rme khrag bsres pa'i thun rdzas bshams la/ sngags shing skabs su brab bo// phur pa yang skabs su gdabs so// rang nyid khro rgyal zil gnon du gsal bar bsgoms/ drag sngags 'di bzlas so// e myags ya rngubs mugs shag ka dun/ ya ma tsitta dkrugs/ dgra bo mṛ ma ra ya rbad de bzhin du dregs pa bco brgyad po kun 'gre ste/ tir ti ka rtswa ru tra dha/ dhe ba a/ rag sha ra/ rag mo ra/ yakṣa kṣa/ yaka mo sto mun mun pa/ shu la dza ra tsa tsa/ badzra sa du tri/ hab sham tri/ na ga phu / tsitta dkrug dgra bo mṛ ma ra ya rbad/ de ltar zhag gsum du bzlas shing / dregs pa rnams kyi tsitta dkrug go/ skabs su sha khrag gi gtor ma phul la/ bskul zhing thun brab bo// rtags ni tsitta 'dar ba
༄tsho/ /dang / 'tshegs yong ngo / gal te de la rtags med na/ nyin zhag phrugs gcig tu sngags 'di bzlas so// ya ma tsitta ya dkrugs/ dgra bo'i srog la breng shag mṛ ma ra ya rbad/ ces btags te dregs pa bco brgyad la de bzhin du 'gre'o// de ltar dkrugs te spyir gnod pa ngos zin na/ gang yin la rkyang 'ded bya ba rung ste/ ma zin na dregs pa bco brgyad la bya ste kun dril la bya'o// yang na gang gnod pa kun gyi sngags kyi dug dbal phog ba'i phyir/ gsham du bzhugs par bya ces pa ni dril sgrub nas gsungs so// sngags phyi ma des ni/ snying 'gas par 'gyur te/ zla ba mi 'gor bar / ma trang bsgyel ba bzhin du 'gyur ro// gong du sngags ring la nan tan bya ba ni shin tu gces so/ sngags ring de nyid grub cing 'thems na 'khor lo la sogs pa ma byas kyang / sngags so so'i 'byin 'jug mtha' bsgyur ba tsam gyis/ las sngags 'og ma rnams btags nas bzlas pa drag po byas pas kyang / las gang 'dod 'grub par gyur ro// gzugs can nang rgyas kyi dgra drug la/ gang dang 'gras pa'i rang gshed drug gi sngags gang dgos pa re/sngags ring kyi sham bur btags la/ liṅga de'i thun rdzas gang yin pas brab la phur pa btab la gnas drug po gang yin par gtad par gsungs so// de drug gi sdebs ni/ mchod rten skabs na gsal bar bstan
pa ltar shes par bya ste/ de ltar 'khor lo la brten pa'i skabs su shes par bya'o// gnas drug ma yin na/ dregs pa'i tsitta dkrug pa'i las mtha' ni klu nag po gnas pa'i chu mig tu/ sdig pa nag po lus kyi spra khrid gyis/ lus tshad brtag cing btsal la gtad do// rgyud las/ sdig pa'i lus tshad rtag la gtad/ ces so// de ni zla ba gcig mi 'gor bar phung bar nges so// 'khor ba'i rgya gling du srid pa'i ri bsgyel ba ches bya ba/ dregs pa'i tsitta dadzo/ga pa'i las kyi mtha' rgya bstan pa'i man ngag rjesags rbersha// de ltar sgron ma drug gisasdig pa snying 'dzings kyi rang gshed dbab pa'i man ngag gsal bar bstan te/ sgron ma 'di drug tu ma 'dusapa'i man ngag gang yang med do//3)
༄tsho/ /'jam dpal tshe bdag lcagasa'adra'i stobasachen mchod rten gtso gyur gyi man ngag gnad kyi sgron ma bdun pa zhesabya ba bzhugs so/ /
༄tshi/ /oX swā sti dza yantu/ gtum drag nyams brgyar 'bar ba zhal gyi sgo/ /bdud sde'i khrag rgyun lbu 'phreng 'khrugs klong nas/ /hūm̐X phaṭa nga ro'i gad mos gshin rje'i dpung / /thar mdzad 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon gyi/ /rang byung don gyi ye shes 'khrul med du/ /thugs chud grub brnyes rig 'dzin tshogs spyi dang / /khyad par dus gsum kun mkhyen padma 'byung / /mkha' khyab rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs der phyag 'tshal/ /zab don mdzod rgyar mnga' brnyes nor 'dzin can/ /rnam bzhi'i las kun thogs med yang dbang gter/ /gsang ba'i rgya 'grol gter ston zhang khrom che/ /gshed bskor 'khor los bsgyur dbang rnam gsum rgyal/ /shes bya kun mkhyen zil gnon bzhad pa rtsal/ /rnam kun gtsug gi rgyan mchog gter bdag gling / /zla med smra ba'i nyi ma chos kyi dpal/ /skal bzang bdud rtsis 'gro
༄༅/ /la dge legs stsol/ /gshed skor man ngag kun gyi snying po'i bcud/ /phyag rgya zil gnon ye shes 'khor le'i lha'i/ /sgrub thabs snying po gnam lcags thog 'dra'i chos/ /phas rgol mthar byed rang srung cho ga'i mchog /bsnyen sgrub las kyi sbyor ba zab mo'i bcud/ /gsal byed gnad kyi sgron ma don gnyer 'gro /blo gros spobs pa sbyin byed bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /bla medagasang ba'i sgo 'phar deng 'dir byed/ /stobs chen dregs pa 'joms byed 'khrul 'khor gyi/ /bdud sde pha mthar skrod la mtshan ma'i rdzas/ /'cha' tshul lag len gnad gyi sgron ma 'di/ /rtsa bar gces pas skyes bu'i lus dang 'dra/ /bzlog brtul 'joms gsum ma rig mun khung du/ /chu tshe ri mo'i zlos gar tshad dngar yang / /don grub min phyir 'khor le'i gnad sgron 'di/ /mchog tu gces pas tshe srog zung 'brel
'dra ting 'dzin bdud rtsi'i zungs kyis nyer gzung nas/ /cha tshad bye brag phra mor ltos min kyang / /'khrul bral nges rnyed tshad ma bslu med phyir/ /thig rgyan gnad sgron nor bu'i do shal 'dra/ /don dam chos nyid dbyings su 'khor 'das chos/ /rnam 'byor med mod kun rdzob rten 'brel mthu/ /phra mo yis kyang 'bras bu mchog bskyed phyir/ /rdzas thems gnad sgron lhab lhub gos dang 'dra/ /lam 'dir las kyi sbyor ba sgrub pa'i tshe/ /lha sngags ting 'dzin gsum dang mi ldan na/ /'bras grub min phyir cho ga'i gnad sgron 'di/ /yang bcud snying po rnam par shes dang 'dra/ /zab mo'i thabs dang mi ldan gya tshom du/ /spyad na 'dod pa'i gnas su phyin min phyir/ /zab mo'i man ngag gnad gyi sgron ma 'di/ /kun la thogs med rgyal po'i bka' rtags 'dra/ /thabs shes zung sbyor drag po'i rgyu rtsal gyis/ /gdug can phye mar 'thag la thogs med du thob byed ur ma'i las sbyor gnad sgron 'di/ /dpa' rtul ldan pa'i blo ldan grogs dang 'dra/ /de ltar phas rgol ming gi mthar byas nas/ /rnam shes 'jam dpal dpa' bo'i dgongs klong du/ /rdzogs las 'phags nor rin chen rnam bdun las/ /spyod phyir gnad kyi sgron ma bdun du phye/ dang po'i las can dag la blo gros mig /ster byed gsang ba'i zin thun yi ge'i phreng / /mchar du dngar gang skal mnyam 'gro
༄tshi/ /ba la/ /phan bde'i dga' ston zla med 'di rmad byung / na mo mañdzu shrī ye gang du mchod rten bca' gzhir sa steng gru bzhi mtho man mtshams pa'i nang ngos 'brub khung zur gsum rtse mo mchod rten gyi rgyab phyogs su bstan par brus la/ de'i nang du rtsa brgyud le'u bcu gnyis pa las bshad pa'i rgya mtsho'i gting du mun dmag bsdu ba'i 'khor lo lte ba zur gsum de'i phyi'i mu khyud rim gsum gyi nang mar sngags/ bar par rtsibs/phyi mar me ri can gnyis kyi gcig la liṅga gsum yod 'og dang / gcig la sdig pa gsum yod steng du byas pa kha sbyar 'og nas yar mtshon cha ltem las gshin dmar nag mtshon pa'i skud pa sngo dmar gyis bcings/khams pa'i rus sbal lto sbyar gyi nang du bcug pa'i ya khams gyi rus sbal rgyab la/ dbus su rme gling dgu de'i phyir spar kha'i phyag rgya brgyad de'i phyir lo bcu gnyis rnams bris shing / spro na gza' skar gyi gzugs dang sngags sogs kyang mgo nang bstan du bri bar bshad/ de nyid mnan gtad spyi ltar/ dang po nang du 'jug cing las la sbyar/ ro g.yam gyi mas ngos su stong khams dang / steng du rdo rje rgya gram bris pas kha bcad la zhal bas mtshams bcad de 'og bcas dang po'o/ de'i steng sngar 'dra'i brub khung du/ lcags sdig gi gom pa chu'i thum po las byung ba'i gtad bzlog 'bor lo kha sbyor dang / rgyu ma khug pa ring po las byung ba'i byas
pa bshig pa'i 'khor lo kha sbyor gnyis so so'am sdebs su lteb chings sngar byas pa khams pa'i ga'u gzhug ral du bcug nas mnan/ 'di la rtsa rgyud le'u bcu gcig pa nas bshad pa'i gtad bzlog bcug na skabs su bab pa 'dra yang phyag bzhes su mi mdzad/ gang ltar yang de ni 'og bcas gnyis pa'o/ sngon la lcags 'dra rang la 'og bcas 'di med kyang rung / de man chad la rgya mtsho'i gting du mun dmag bsdu ba zhes bya'o//de'i steng sngar 'dra'i brub khung du rtsa rgyud le'u bcu gnyis pa nas bshad pa'i gshed po las rgyal rkyang gcig dbus su liṅga'i lto bar sdig pa bzhi liṅga'i sgrom de'i phyir ling tshe phying dang rtsibs bcas gshed po'i lto bar bris pa gyen bstan mgo nub ngos su bstan te bkram thabs su bcug pa la dar ras shog pa lta bu'i zhal khebs kyis bcad do// ri thang mtshams su zhe sdang khros pa'i gzhu bcag pa zhes bya de ni 'og bcas gsum pa'o// de ltar na 'og bcas la 'brub khung sum brtsegs sam/ lcags 'dra khe rkyang gi dbang du byas pa'i nyis brtsegs gang yin kyang sa 'dzin chad du shong ba dgos shing / de'i steng zhal ba sogs dpyis phyin par bya ba yin no// mchod rten gyi seng khri'i nang du brub khung logs mdun bstan bang rim gsum ba'i gting du/ dur rdo'i skyed pu gsum gyi steng / mo nam rabs chad kyi thod pa mig gi g.yas skyor nas sor phyed dang gsum ltag
༄tshi/ /pa'i 'bur nas sor bzhi tsam nas breg gzhan las breg kha mtho bar bya/ de ltar bsgrub pa'i 'chi bdag zhal dbye'i mo thod 'khor lo can gyen bstan/ yum gyi dbu rgyab ngos su gtad pa'i nang du/ 'og 'degs rlung gi 'khor lo lte bar mda' gzhu/ de'i phyir rtsibs brgyad mu khyud can gyi mde rtse nub bstan du bkram pa'i khar rgyud kyi le'u bzhi pa nas bshad pa'i phag mo gsang 'khor lo dbus gru gsum gyi lte bar ling ga de'i tpū rgya gram rtsibs rtse phyi nang du bstan pa'i mu khyud de'i phyir rus sbal dang phag gzugs gnyis mgo go log tu byas pa'i lte ling gi mgo nub bstan du bkram 'dis mtshon liṅga mgo shar bstan du byed pa gong ma dag phyag len du yod/ las dmigs gsal dang 'brel ba'i tshe phag mo gsang 'khor gyi lte ming yang btsad po bsad pa la sogs te sgron drug so so'i liṅga dang mthun par bca' ba gnad yin/ de'i steng stong srog gi 'khor lo lte ba gru gsum/ mu khyud zlum/ rtsibs brgyad/ de'i phyi ling rtse phyi nang bcas rus sbal gyi lte bar bkod pa'i dbus su liṅga / ling rtse rnams la longs spyod ayau ring gi mthar/ gzir bzlog byas pa bshig pa zug dbyung gsang lam dgag pa ngag mnan te spyang mo drug gang byed btags pa cha bsgos nas bris pa bkram/ de'i steng rgyal po grar langs pa la seng ge'i khog pa/ rtsad dgrar langs la/ seng ge kha 'thab/ ma
mo mkhan la/ shwa na rnyu 'thabs gshin rje mkhan la khyung mo gsheg 'thab/ bya khyung mkhan la rma bya 'jil bsnol/ sngags pa nang 'gras la/ rus sbal lto sdebs/ slob ma dam nyams sam yang na sngags 'gras la/stag mo mche 'thab/ urmo mkhan nang 'gras sam sde mang po la/ glang chen mche 'thabs/ yang na dam 'das slob ma la rdo rje me 'thabs gtad mkhan sbrul nag ñtsa 'thab ste 'khor lo bcu po gang dgos sngar ltar gting ba'i khar dgra gang yin dang mthun par / slob ma dam nyams/ bon po lha chags/ urmo nang 'gras/ rtsad po bsad pa/ dam tshig gcig pa'i sngags pa/ dam 'dres spyi'i spun la bya ba ste rtsa rgyud le'u drug pa nas bshad pa'i sgron drug gi ling ga dpe'u ris ltar bkod pa gang byed gan rkyal du bzhag rjes 'og gi phag mo gsang 'khor nas 'di'i bar brtsegs pa mtha' nas dbus mtshon cha lteb sbub tu byas pa'i ling ga'i lte ba'i mṛXyig la thun phog nges yong ba'i migs bzhag nas bya thag sngo dmar gyi bcings pa la 'chi bdag pho'i thod pas bkab pa'i ag rtse'i nang nas yar gyi bya thag gi skud sne drangs pa steng gcod nam mkha'i 'bor lo lte bar sngags byang / de'i phyi rdo rje brgyad ldan mu khyud can dang lhan gcig thun phur la dkris pa'i phur rtse ag rtse'i nang du tshud tsam byas nas 'jug brub khung gi bang rim gsum la 'og nas rim bzhin rtsang srin mo
༄tshi/ /thod ra/ me ri rnams kyis brgyan/ de'i steng rgyud kyi le'u bzhi pa nas bshad pa'i rus sbal mchog gi 'khor lo lte ling ma gtogs ma bzhi phag mo gsang 'khor dang phyogs mtshungs rus sbal phag mi gzugs gsum gyi lto bar bris pa kha sprub lte ba'i gru gsum zur nub bstan/ gong du sa'i phag mo gsang 'khor dang bsnol mar yong rtsis kyi bla bres ltar bkram pa seng khri'i nang ngos kyi zur bzhir 'dogs mchog 'khor gyi lte bar bug pa phub pa'i nang nas gong gi thun thag drangs te seng khri'i shar sgo'i thun khung nas phyir 'then sgo bzhi thun khung gru gsum re byas pa nas lcags sbubs lta bu btang ba'i rtse bzhi mchog 'khor gyi lte khung du zug pa'i zhal dbye'i ag rtser nyug gi yong ba byas te thod nang dug gi ling ga'i mṛXyig la thun phog nges bya/ spro na de'i steng lcags sdig mkhris pa dwangs ma'i mdzod phugs nas byung ba'i gnam lcags so brdar gyi 'bor lo kha sbyor tshun bcings pa/ ra thod kyi 'gram pa g.yas su 'brug dang / g.yon du glag gzugs bris pa'i nang du bcug nas/ ra thod kyi rna mchog 'khor gyi thun bug gi steng ngos su sgo ba bzhi 'thad slebs tsam byas te/klad khung gyen bstan gyi nang du mchod rten srog shing gi gri mda'i rtse nyug tsam yong ba byas nas 'dogs/ de man chad ni ri rab kyi kha la gnam lcags kyi so brdar ba zhes bya ste bar bcas so/ sngar bshad phyogs bzhi'i
thun bug gi steng ngos su sgo ba bzhi/ de'i steng bde chen gyi thog bkal bar mas nas rim bzhin bang rim 'og ma'i nang du 'khor lo rtsibs bcu gnyis mu khyud bcas pa 'chi bdag bcu gnyis/ bang rim gnyis pa dang gsum par 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi mu khyud can la bdud po bzhi dang / mon pa bzhi bang rim bzhi par dkyil 'khor gong 'drar nang gshed bzhi/ bum gdan padma'i steng thod ras bskor ba'i nang gru gsum mdun steng ling rtse dgu par gri mda'i ngos dbus su gtso bo ling rtse brgyad la shar du phyag rdor/ lhor ya ma ra dza/ nub tu rus sbal/ byang du sgrol yum sbyor yum gnyis/ shar lhor seng gī gnyis/ lho nub tu stag gnyis nub byang tu sbrul gnyis/ byang shar du khyung nag gnyis te rtsa lha drug dang / brgyan lha brgyad gtso bo'i dbu gtsug tu mkha' lding / zla gam gsum la g.yas su sku sprul/ g.yon du gsung sprul/ rgyab tu thugs sprul ste de ltar lha tshogs rnams lha gnas so sor kha sa'i liṅga sen gang pa'i lte bar ming byang ma ra ya rbad kyi sham bu can gyi shog dril bcug pa'i snying gar lha so so'i shing byang phur zhabs can gtso bo srog shing la rgyab brten dang gzhan rnams zhal nang bstan du 'jug de rnams so so'i g.yas g.yon sogs gang bder be con khram shing / ral gri ste/ ma 'byor na phyogs rer tshar re tsam gyis chog lha gnas gong 'og re re bzhin thog gis
༄tshi/ /phubs pa'i dbus su bug pa zur gsum du phub par srog shing gi spri mda' thal mar 'gro 'on kyang lcags 'dra rang gzhung ltar na lha rnams gtso bo'i sku la 'god pas dbus su rlang rtse dgu byed ma dgos shing / bsdus na rtsa rgyud las/ gri mda' snyug rgod khrag chen ldan/ /srog shing zil gnon sku ru gsal/ zhes gsungs pas gri mda' nyid gtso bor bskyed dgos phyir gtso bo'i sku snyan zur du ma bkod kyang chad pa'i skyon du mi 'gyur bang rim rnams kyi nang ngos su khyad par gyi sngags 'bod pa ni/ yas nas mar grangs pa'i bang rim dang po'i shar du/ srog la thun myags tsitta rbad/ lhor khas rtsa la bran shag rbadagiX nub tu tsitta la breng shag dza/ byang du srog la hur thum rbadagiX gnyis pa dang gsum pa'i dang shar du srog lhor sambha/ nub tu ya/ byang du rbad/ tha ma'i shar du srog la/ ram shag rbad/ lhor thun yam bzlogagiX nub tu kha thun4༷༷ byang tu ri hla hla bhyo:༷༷ zhes bris/ srog shing gri mda' gri khrag gis byugs par sku gsung thugs sngags/ ayau ring / mai thung sogs rtsa sngags rnams mda' stod nas g.yon bskor sbrul 'khyud ris bris/ bre nas gdugs tog gi bar du dkon mchog gsum dang brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi mtshan sngags/ rgyud sde gong ma rnams kyi yi dam lha'i gzungs/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel sogs sel med byin rten sna tshogs
gzhug cing / de rnams ni rdo rje'i mkhar du mi shig pa'i/ khyad par tog gi nang du/ na mo bhuddha ya/ bdag cag 'bor dang bcas pa rnams sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o// de bzhin du na mo dharma ya/ chos la: sre khebs la/ na mo saṅga ya/ dge 'dun la: zhes sbyar ba 'jug ste/ de rnams ni rdo rje'i mkhar mi shig ba'i sku bskyed pa dang rjes 'brel gyi bskor ro// gshig pa bya khyung so brdar gyi 'ber lo lte ba zlum po rtsibs bzhi mu khyud can de srung stabs spyi ltar byas pa g.yas nas dril te tshon skud lngas bcings pa/ rtse'i bya khyung gi lto bar bzhugs pa ni nam mkha'i khams su sbyor ba'i stobs bshog pa'i mthing gi phyar ba bkram pa zhes bya'o// de rnams ni steng bcas so// sa bcad tha ma 'bor ba'i rgya gling du srid pa'i ri sgyel ba ni/ ma 'grub na sbogs pa'i cho ga re gzhan du shes so// 'jam dpal tshe bdag lcags 'dra'i stobs chen mchod rten nang bca' tshul gyi zin bris gsal bar bkod pa gnad kyi sgron mdzos/ gu hye/ pad gnubs dgongs don zung 'jug gnam thog mes/ ma rig dug gsum bcom las mi 'gyur srog /'pho med bde chen bsgrub byed snying gi bcud/ /drag sngags rgya ma'i snying po 'di nyid lags/ lhe/ na mo mañdzu shrī ya/ 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon lcags 'dra'i stobs chen la dgos pa'i 'bor lo'i bri tshul la/ dang po mun smag bsdu ba'i
༄༅/ /'khor lo ni/ dbus su gru gsum zur rgyab bstan/ zla gam mu khyud gsum rim can gnyis bris pa'i steng 'khor gyi dbus su sdig pa gsum mgo sprad sprul pa gsum gyi rang bzhin so so'i snying gar/ tsitta breng shag snying ma ra ya/ zla gam gsum la/ sde brgyad gang gnod dang rjes mthun gyi spu gri bris te dper na ma mo ru lu trig nan che ge mo ma ra ya rbad/ lo che ge mo khaX che ge mo ma ra ya stum bha ya nan/ mthu dang nus pa thams cad/ zhes mgo nang bstan/ 'og 'khor gyi lte bar liṅga gsum mgo sprod kyi snying gar mṛ/ dpral bar sa yan lag bzhi dza hūṃX baX ho:༷༷ zhes sogs rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs par bri/ gang ltar lte 'khor gyi sdig pa gsum dang ling gsum 'phrod pa bya/ zla gam gsum la/ kho'i lha 'dre chos skyong thamasacad kyi stobs nus nan/ kho'i lha dang chos skyong dang kho rang gi lo rus khams rnams kho rang gi gshed du phob/ zhes pa lta bu'i dmod byang nang bstan/ de 'og gi 'khor gnyis ka la mtshungs par mu khyud nang ma la/ nag po na ga be ta srog la dzwa la dzwa la bri hur thum dgra bo'i snying la rbad/ e ka ya ma srog hur thibs gzir nan dgra bo'i snying la shag rbadaX ra tri khrag srog la yaX yaX tri ling dgra bo'i snying la shag rbadaX yig mgo phyir bstan du bri/ mu khyud bar ma rtsibs so gnyis la/ e baX raX yaX khaX shog tsitta rngubs pas gtibs mes tshig chus
bskur rlung g.yen kha ri ba ltag rna ri tsi ti khas g.yen dgra bo mā ra ya/ mig 'bru re mgo phyir bstan du bri mu khyud phyi mar me ri'o// brag ltag pa rdor rin gyis mdzad pa'i sgron drug na rtsibs dang me'i bar du sbrul gyi ra ba bri bar bshad/ gnyis pa lcags sdig gi sgang pa chu'i thum po las byung ba'i gtad bzlog ni/ klu bdud pho mo dmar nag chu srin gyi gdongs can g.yas sbrul zhags dang g.yon nad rkyal/ smad sbrul mjug can gyi lto bar pho 'khor mo 'khor gnyis ka mtshungs par phyi nas rim bzhin/ rus sbal/ mu khyud zlum/ rtsibs brgyad rim bzhin rtse bsnol gyi bar du liṅga / de'i nang zlum skor gyi phyir dbus su rus sbal gyi lto bar dgrar gzugs kyi rkang lag bzhi nas rus sbal des za zhing / phyogs bzhi nas sbrul nag bzhi'i za ba/ ling ga'i lto bar zlum skor gyis dbus su gru gsum la sogs mdun bstan gyi nang du/ steng 'khor la sdig pa gsum dang 'og 'khor la liṅga gsum spro/ zla gam gsum la/ kho rang gi lha srung bdud du phob cig ces so// bye brag tu/ pha rol po'i yi dam/ chos skyong ye shes pa/ 'jig rten pa lha lnga bcas gshed 'bebs kyi dmod byang rnams zla gam re mgo nang bstan/ rtsibs rim gnyis kyi nang rus sbal gnas pa'i khyams gang la e ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ya ma ra tsa ya4༷༷ ya ma ra tsa sa do me ya ya me do ru ṇa yo da ya ya da yo ni ra yakṣe
༄tshi/ /ya yakṣe yatstsha ni ra ma ya4༷༷ ayau phe lam hūm̐X/ nag po ti pa tsa ya na ga rakta yakṣa du sha phe lam sha sho/ nā ga ra tsa/ dgra mol phos phos/ shog shig na ga du na du na/ klu sbrul nag po dgra bo'i snying la mā ra ya rbad bhyo:༷༷ phu pa na ga du bhyo bzlogagiX zhes pho sngags mgo phyir bstan gyi nang gi rtsibs la/ pha ma phu pa na ga rbad bhyo:༷༷ zhes 'bru re rtsibs nang mar phyi bstan dang / phyi mar nang bstan/ ling ga rnams kyi snying gar dṛ sogs gnad yig phyi'i mu khyud la ayau myag ya rdubs mug shag ka dun/ ma ma rag mo rag mo na ga ru tra ka hla dgra bo'i snying la bhyo:༷༷ nag po bam tsitta la rgyob/ trag thur snying thur/ snying la 'gul 'gul/ myags myags rtsa bzhi bskum bskum shan shan srog la shan/ rbud rbud dgra bo ma ra ya rbadagiX sa na ga ha la tsa ma ri dgra bo'i snying la thum bhyo bzlogagiX nang bstan no// gsum pa rgyu ma khug pa ring po las byung ba'i byas pa bzhig pa ni/ 'chi bdag pho mo mthing nag khram shing dang sbrul zhags 'dzin pa'i lto bar steng 'og gi 'khor lo gnyis gar mtshungs par mu khyud zlum bskor gsum rim gyi nang du rtsibs bcu drug pa ste/ de'i lte bar liṅga spyi mthun gyi yan lag bzhi nas sdig pa res za zhing / phyogs bzhi nas ral gri res zung thabs kyi yu ma phyir bstan/ rtsibs rim gsum gyi rtsibs bar rnams la ling ga mgo nang bstan de/ rtsibs nang mar badzra
kro ta du na ti ki la ya/ ma ma rag mo/ tri du/ shaX tāX haX trag rakta/ dun tri/ bhi ma ni/ la du tri/ tri sha na/ ra hu ha ti/ ya me/ raklo/ rakta/ yakṣa/ rtsibs bar mar/ drag na/ a tra sa du/ ra tri ra ra tsa na ga ru tra ru tri/ kha rag ma/ she ma maX / tri/ shu tta du tri/ ma tri ya/ ga na pa ti/ 'bri ga ro ga na la du trag ra sha na na/ tsa mun tri/ sha phu tri/ ra sho ra/ rtsibs phyi mar/ sarba tsa sbur srog nan/snying gzer breng shag ya rbadagiX sarba sha chun stam bha ya nan hūṃX/ lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la/ /sngags pa nang rgyas byed pa'i tshe/ /lha srin stobs 'don byed pa'i tshe/ /drag sngags gcod 'dren byed pa'i tshe/ /gshed po las kyi rgyal po khyod/ /skye ba snga ma'i las dbang gis/ /sgrub pa byed pa'i skyes bu la/ /de dpon dregs pa'i srog khang gas/ /snying la sngags kyi rnam pa byung / /sems kyi sngags kyi rgyud las skyes/ /'jig rten dregs pa'i srog sngags kyi/ /dam nyams las kyi ru tra la/ /rang gshed dbab pa'i phrin lasamadzod/ ces pa rnams mgo phyir bstan du bri'o// bzhi pa rtsa rgyud le'u bcu gcig pa las bshad pa'i gtad bzlog 'khor lo ni/ rus sbal gyi lto bar mu khyud rim pa lngar bskor ba'i dbus su ling ga gnad yig can/ mu khyud gnyis par ling tshe brgyad du bcas pa'i phyogs bzhir klu rigs bzhi sbrul gzugs dang / mtshams bzhir sa
༄tsho/ /bdag sbal pa'i gzugs can bzhi mgo nang bstan mu khyud gsum par nub nas bzung rtsibs bcu bzhi la/ dgra bo'i tsitta breng shag dza srog la hur thums breng shag rbad/ 'bru re g.yas bskor phyi bstan/mu khyud bzhi bar/ e dun ka yaX/ ayau myags 'bru brgyad/ nā ga ru tra ka la dgra bo'i snying la bhyo:༷༷ nag po baX tsitta rgyob trag thur snying 'gul myags myags rtsa bzhi breng bskum shan shan/ srog la shan/ thur thur dgra bo'i tsitta la rbad na ga ha la tsa ma ra/ dgra bo'i snying la thum bhyo:༷༷ nub nas mgo nang bstan/ mu khyud lnga pa'i phyogs bzhir sna tshogs rdo rje'i rwa bzhi thon pa'i nub kyi rwa g.yas pa nas g.yas g.yon gyi ra re la ayau myags 'bru brgyad phyi bstan no4༷༷ yang 'di la sgron drug nas bshad pa ltar na 'khor lo de dang phyogs mtshungs klu bdud sbrul mgo dgu pa sbrul zhags can gyi lte bar bri bar bshad do// lnga pa gshed po las rgyal gyi 'khor lo ni gshin rje mthing nag g.yas zhing chung dang / 'khor lo 'dzin pa'i snying gar/ mu khyud rim pa lnga'i lte bar sdig pa bzhi sgrom mgo nang bstan gyi rwa brgyad la ayau myags 'bru brgyad pa'i 'bru re phyi bstan/ sdig pa bzhi po'i lte bar/ tsitta breng shag dṛ tri dam nyams dgra bgegs gnod sbyin 'byung po mā ra ya rbad/ mu khyud gnyis pa'i nang du liṅga bkod pa'i snying gar gong gi sdig pa bzhi po yong bar byas la/ de'i bar stengs
g.yas su/ na ga me ti/ g.yon du sa ga byi du/ 'doms su byi du ra/ mgo phyir bstan/ mu khyud gsum pa dang bzhi par ling rtse bcu drug re bcad pa'i phy-i ma la liṅga'i rkang phyogs nas/ ya ma/ rag mo/ rakta/kṣe ma/ shrī badzra kro dha/ mdun da run ti ki la ya/ ma ma raklo/ nyid du bstubs he sha/ rakta trag du khrag dun ting / bhe la ni/ a dun tri/ tri sha na/ ra tri ha ti/ ling tshe nang ma la sngar ltar/ ra dza mu tra / sha chun na te ta ra ni ra tri/ a tri pa du/ tsa tri ra tsa/ ra tsa ba ga dhe wa ru tri/ kha rag snye ma tri/ dun tri/ dun ti tri/ srog ma ra ya/ gha na pa ti/ bhi na ka ro ka ma du khrag mu khyud lnga par rtsibs nyi shu rtsa gnyis la/ ling ga'i mgo phyogs nub nas g.yas bskor phyi bstan du/ sarba sha truX/ stam/ bha ya nan4༷༷ 'dridagiX rbad sarba rtsa sbur/ srog la nan snying gzer breng shag ram yam rbadagiX zhes pa rnams phyir bstan sarba gcig tu brtsis pa'i 'bru re'ogiX gong gis 'di yang 'khor lo mtshungs pa gnyis byas te kha sbyor byed pa yang bshad do// drug pa 'og 'degs rlung gi 'khor lo ni/ 'khor lo mu khyud gsum bskor ba'i lte bar mda' gzhu bkang ba mde'u rtse nub bstan/ mu khyud gnyis par rtsibs brgyad la yaX re/ mu khyud gsum par nub nas ayau myags ya rngubs mug shag ka dun dgra bo'i srog la dṛ khur thum dza/ rtsa khrag snying thum ril raX
༄༅/ /shag rbadagiX e yam ram kham rṇi sha ku ru mā ra ya/ zhes phyi bstan no/ bdun pa phag mo gsang 'khor ni/ lte ba gru gsum logs mdun bstan gyi dbus su liṅga gnad yig can/ de'i phyir sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba'i zla gam gsum la pha rol po'i lo khams yi dam chos skyong sogs gshed 'bebs kyi dmod mo bri/ rgya gram gyi g.yas g.yon gyi rwa brgyad la e myags 'bru brgyad/ de'i phyi rim bcu bzhi la dgra bo'i srog la / mṛ hur thum dza tsa khrag snying thum ril ram shag rbad/ zhes nub nas dgra bo'i srog dang zhes pa gcig tu byas pa'i 'bru re phyi bstan/ de'i phyi'i mu khyud la/ yig phreng gnyis shong bar byas la/ rang gi yi dam lha'i drag sngags ayo myags lta bu dang / rang khams yi dam chos skyong sogs gshed 'bebs kyi dmod mo bri/ rgya gram gyi g.yas g.yon ra brgyad la ayau myags 'bru brgyad/ de'i tpū rim rtsibs bcu bzhi la/ dgra bo'i srog la / dṛ hur thum dza tsa khrag snying thum ril ram shag rbad/ zhes nub nas dgra rba'i srog dang zhes pa gcig tu byas pa'i 'bru re phyi bstan de'i phyi'i mu khyud la/ yig phreng gnyis shong bar byas la/ rang gi yi dam lha'i drag sngags ayo myags lta bu dang / rang gang byed kyi chos skyong gi sngags bsham du/ a mu ka e dgra bo'i srog la thum ril rbad bhyo:༷༷ a mu ka thun thun khram shig tsitta myags rbad bhyo:༷༷ a mu ka tsa la dun rmugs
rbad bhyo:༷༷ a mu ka yam khrag la mug ti thun rbad bhyo:༷༷ sngags pa snying du sod srog tsitta 'ordzong myags myags mā ra ya tsitta la thun bhyo:༷༷ zhes nub nas mgo nang bstan dang / dgra bo'i yi dam dang chos skyong gang byed sngags sham du/ dgra bo che ge mo lha dang chos skyong 'di zhes bya ba kho rang gi gshed du phob cigaces so// pha rol gyi yi dam dang chos skyong ngo ma shes na/ ban dgra 'di zhes bya bas byas pa'i sbyor ba ngan pa thams cad che ge mo 'di zhes bya ba'i gshed du phob cig kho rang gi lha srung kho rang gi bdud du phob cigaces mgo phyi bstan gyi lto ldebs su bris/ de'i phyi rim 'khor lo rtsibs bcu gnyis rtse mo nang bstan la/ dgra bo'i tsitta ta breng shag dza srog la hur thum rbadagiX ces nub nas 'bru re mgo nang bstan/ de'i phyi rus sbal mgo nub bstan/ de'i yang phyi rim du phag nag mgo shar bstan gnyis ka gan rkyal du bri'o// brgyad pa stong srog gi 'khor lo ni/dbus gru gsum mdun bstan gyi lte bar liṅga / zla gam gsum la lha srung bri tshul sngar dang 'dra/ de'i phyi rtsibs brgyad la nub nas/ khaX shag ro myags mug ti rbad ya4༷༷ 'bru re phyi bstan/ de'i phyi ling tshe nyer brgyad pa rim pa gnyis kyi phyi ma'i nub nas rim bzhin du/ oX ayo ayo ayo a kro te ka/ ya manta ga ya ma ye/ kā la ru pa/ ka pa ye hriṣṭi a pa na ye/ a a nai a ne/ u u ne u ne/ du du ne du ne/ a i/ u e/ 3rdzo
༄༅/ /aX / ra rwi/ la lī/ du ru ye/ bya tsa ye/ seng ha ye/ hri da ye / bi da ye/ tsitta ye/ ha la ye/ mu ka ye/ u u ne/ u u nai byi tri ta/ a a na na/ ya ma ra dza/ ling tshe nang ma la/ ya ma raka ya ma rag a ya ma raka/ pe ta li/ kro ti shwa ri/ ma ma e ka tsa ti/ de ma kha la baX ril/ ru lu ru lu shlau badzra kro ta/ ya ma garma/ ro ṣa ṇa kri dha/ tsanta raka/ mornya de lhag ling tshe bcu bzhi la las gang byed kyi spyang mo cha bsgos nas gdags te/ de la gzir ba g.yu spyang ni/ che ge mo a mu ga myags thum ril trid nan sbur ya nan/ e hur thum dza/ kham shag ro myags mug ti rbad ya/ byas pa bshog pa'i g.yu spyang ni/ che ke mo a mu ka rtsa sbur ya srog nan/ snying gzer breng shag yaX rbadagiX e khur thum dza4༷༷ kham shag ro myags mug ti rbad ya4༷༷ zug pa 'byin pa g.yu spyang ni/ che ge mo a mu ka du raX tri ya 'drid phyung srog la gzir nan phyung / e hur thum dza4༷༷ khaX shag ro myags mug ti rbad ya4༷༷ gsang lam dgag pa g.yu spyang ni/ che ge mo a mu ka munt+ra dum ma hā ra ga du laX thum li rbad/ e hur thum dza/ kham shag ro myags mug ti rbad ya4༷༷ bzlog pa g.yu spyang ni/ che ge mo a mu ka e nan yaX bzlog 'drid bhyo:༷༷ e hur thum dza/ kham shag ro myags mug ti rbad ya4༷༷ mnan pa g.yu spyang nigiX che ge mo a mu ka be tang stum bha ya nan4༷༷ e hur thum dza
kham shag ro myag mug ti rbad ya/ mgo phyi bstan no// de'i phyi rus sbal gan rkyal du bri bar bya'o// 'di ni stong srog spyang mo drug gi 'khor lo zhes bya ste/ 'khor lo 'dra min gzhan zhig mchis pa dang 'di ga dang gnad gcig pas gang bde byas chog go/ 'on kyang 'di'i ling tshe phy-i nang la 'phrin las dang / thugs gsung gi drag sngags bri bar 'khor lo gsang ba'i pra khrid nas bshad do// dgu pa rme 'thabs spu gri'i 'khor lo ni rgyal po dgrar langs la seng ge'i khog pa/ rtsad po dgrar langs la seng ge kha 'thab ma mo mkhan la shwa na lcam 'thabs/ gshin rje mkhan la khyung mo gshog 'thab/ bya khyung mkhan la rma bya 'jing snon la/sngags pa nang 'gras la rus sbal lto sdebs slob ma dam nyams sam yang sngags pa nang 'gras la stag mo mche 'thab/ urmo mkhan nang 'gras sam sde mang po la glang chen mche 'thab/ yang dam 'das slordzob ma la rdo rje me 'thab/ gtad mkhan la sbrul nag lte 'thab ste khog pa bcu po gang dgos kyi dbus su bcu ka la mtshungs par dbus gru gsum la sogs mdun rgyab bstan la so so'i ma ling / de'i phyi sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba'i zla gam gsum la lha srung gshed 'bebs/ rgya gram gyi g.yas g.yon gyi rwa brgyad la ayo myags 'bru brgyad/ de'i phyi 'khor lo rtsibs bcu gnyis la/ e ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya sku sngags 'bru re phyir
༄tshi/ /bstan / de'i phyi'i mu khyud la las so so dang rjes mthun du rang gzhan gyi drag sngags lto lteb lugs sngar bshad pas mtshon/ de'i phyir rtsibs nyi shu la/ srog la yam shag hring myags rbad dgra snying gzer rbud nan ha la ha la tsa ma ti phyung mgo phyir bstan/ de'i phyi zlum skor dang sems can so so'i khog pa 'phrod par bya'o// gzhan yang / dme 'thab spu gri'i 'khor lo nang tshan/ pho nya rkang mgyogs bzlog pa zhes bya ba 'khor lo gong 'dra la pho nya dregs pa mthing nag g.yas mtshon 'khor dang g.yon ral gri can ro smad rta gzugs kyi rnam pa pus mo bzhi ldan gyi lto bar bris pa dang / gnam lcags thog 'khor zhes bya ba thog med zur drug gru gsum bsnol ba'i rnam pa can gyi dbus su bris pa ste/ gnyis po rim bzhin lha chags bon po dang drag sngags mkhan la bya bar rgyud kyi le'u bcu drug pa nas bshad pa de bcu pa sgron drug so so'i ling ga bca' tshul ni ling ga gnad yig spyi 'gro las slob ma dam nyams la ling ga rkang pa gnyis tsog bu'i rnam pa snying gar sdig pa nag po mgo gyen bstan mṛ la za ba'i tshul du bris pa'i mthar/ che ge mo'i srog la khur thum ma ra ya tsitta la rbad ces bri/ bon po lha chags la ling ga'i snying ga'i mṛ la phag nag gis za ba'i tshul can gyi mthar che ge mo'i srog la mṛ dza thum mug ma ra ya rbad/ urmo mkhan nang 'gras la ling ga'i snying gar mṛ yig dza kha
sprod du ltebs pa'i mthar/ che ge mo'i tsitta la kham shag dza srog la thun rbad/ btsad po bsad pa la ling ga'i snying gar mṛ yig dzas stems kyi 'og ngos nas ral gri bris pa'i mtshon rtse mṛ la zug pa'i tshul can gyi mthar che ge mo ra tsa mṛ dza/ thum ral ma ra ya rbadagiX dam tshig gcig pa'i sngags pa ling ga'i snying gar mṛ yig dzas ltems kyi mthar/ che ge mo'i srog la rbad hur yam thun mugs mā ra ya rbadagiX bse'i sbal pas spyi bo nas za ba'i tshul lo/ spyi'i spun g.yin rnams la/ ling ga'i snying gar mṛ yig dzas ltems kyi mthar che ge mo'i srog la mugs dza hri shag ma ra ya rbadagiX liṅga'i ske nas rgyab tu bam bltab pa'i mgrin pa nas sbal pas za ba'i tshul lo/ de thams cad kyi mthar bsad sngags spel tshig can dang dza gram gyis bskor ro// bcu gcig pa steng gcod nas nam mkha'i 'khor lo ni/ 'khor lo mu khyud gsum gyi lto bar mnan pa'i spyang mo glegs bam bri ba ltar yig phreng ci rigs su bri/ mu khyud gnyis par rdo rje phyed pa brgyad mu khyud gsum bar sngags mtshan bri ste/ nag po rakta snying la rbud nan/ nag po rakta srog la hur thum rbad/ nag po rakta tsa la breng shag rbad/ nag po rakta snying khrag tshal pa shaX long rbad/ nag po rakta gangs dṛ dza ban tra bi dang stum bha ya nan/ nub nas mgo phyi bstan no// bcu gnyis pa rus sbal mchog gi 'khor lo ni/ gong gi phag mo
༄༅/ /gsang 'bor dang mtshungs pa las khyad par dbus kyi lte ling spang pa'i gru gsum gras te phub nas thun lam bya/ 'khor lo'i phyir rus sbal rkang lag bzhis mchod rten gyi rtsa ba nub nas bzung ba/ de 'og phag nag de 'og mi gzugs rnams gan rkyal lte ba'i gru gsum gyi zur ngos su mgo bstan pa'o/ /bcu gsum pa lcags sdig gi mkhris pa dwangs ma'i mdzod phug nas byung ba'i gnam lcags so brdar ni/ pho 'khor mo 'khor gnyis ka mtshungs pa lte ba gru gsum la sogs mdun bstan gyi zla gam la lha srung/ de'i phyi'i mu khyud la/ e ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya ya ma ra tsa sogs nyin bzhi/ a mu ga'i srog la breng shag/rtsa khrag snying thum ril nag po yakṣa snying la hur thums nan/ nag po yakṣa sha srog la hur thum rbad/ nag po du sha tsa la breng shag rbad/ nag po trag rakta dgra bo'i snying khrag tshal pa sham long rbad/ ghargha mṛ dza/ brnye bon po stam bha ya nan/ zhes nyin sngags nub nas phyi bstan/ de'i phyi rtsibs sngon bcu drug la/ ya ma rbad dzaX zhes pa re tpū bstan/ de'i phyi ling tshe ser po brgyad la dgra gzugs gnyis te mgo bo dang rkang pa bsnol thabs lcags sgrog gis bcings pa mgo phyi bstan/ de'i phyi rtsibs sngon bcu drug rtse mo nang bstan la sngags gong mtshungs mgo nang bstan/ de'i phyi mu khyud la/ e myags ya rngubs mug shag ka dun bhyo:༷༷ a mu
kaX ma ma e ka tsa ti snying khrag dun rmugs yaX bhyo:༷༷ ma raklo snying tshal pa khur thum rbad bhyo:༷༷ ma yag mo dgra snying sha truX ma ra ya rbad bhyo:༷༷ ban bon snying la shwa sha ka rbad bhyo:༷༷ thun drag dun dun rbad bhyo:༷༷ zhes mtshan sngags nub nas nang bstan no// khyad par pho 'khor gyi lte bar sdig pa gsum dang mo 'khor gyi lte bar ling ga gsum bri tshul sngar bshad pa dang 'dra zhing / pho 'khor sdig pa dang mo 'khor phag pa mgo nub bstan gyi lte bar bri'o// bcu bzhi pa bshog pa bya khyung so brdar gyi 'khor lo ni 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi mu khyud dang bcas pa'i lte bar/ byi tri ta e myags ya rngubs rbad phyogiX rbad dkrugs thur thur shud shud khyer dṛ sad chil4༷༷ rbad thur dun dun nan char char che ge mo dṛ ma ra ya rbudagiX zhes yig phreng gang shong du bri/ rtsibs bzhi la e nan yaX bzlog che ge mo la dril bhyo:༷༷ zhes pa re phyi bstan rtsibs mchan bzhi la shar lho nas g.yas bskor du snying gzer breng shag yaX rbad che ge mo e hur thum dza/ rtsa sbur srog nan/ zhes dang / phyi'i mu khyud la/ e ring gi mthar byas pa bshig pa'i g.yu spyang btags pa nub nas phyir bstan no// zhar byung 'chi bdag zhal dbye thod 'khor bri tshul la/ mo 'khor ni/ 'khor lo mu khyud rim gsum du bskor ba'i lte bar ling tshe dgu mu khyud gnyis par sngags gyi phyogs bzhi'i ling tshe'i bar du gnyis re ste bcu gnyis mu khyud phyi mar phyogs bzhi'i
༄tsho/ /ling tshe'i bar du gsum gsum ste bcu drug tu cha bgos la/ lte ba'i ling tshe'i dbus na shar sogs phyogs bzhi de'i phyi'i shar nas g.yas bskor du rim bzhin/ ya ma ye/ da kṣe ra dza sa do ru ṇa yo ni/ ra ya tsa ni/ phyi'i bcu drug la shar nas rim bzhin / oX hrī ṣṭi wi tri tā na na dgra bo ma ra ya hūṃX hūṃX phaṭa4༷༷ 'bru re tpū bstan no// de'i phyir gshin rje yum mthing nag chu gri dang snying 'dzin pa'o// pho 'ber ni thod par rang grub kyi gshin rje'i gzugs ro rkyang gnyis lag pas bzung zhing khar tshud pa'i tshul de mtshon gyis gsal bar byas pa'i tpū dpral bar phyogs nas g.yas bskor gyi phyi bstan du/ dgra bo dṛ dzaX dgra bo dṛ dza/ ni smri rdzi dza4༷༷ dgra bo ma ra ya dza4༷༷ 'byung po ma ra ya dza4༷༷ khrag rtsa ma ra ya dza4༷༷ hring u tsu dngar du na nan dza hring / u tsu dngar du nan/ lam kham nan/ oX badzra tsan nan/ khram shi the yam/ tsitta bi ma la a garsha ya badzra pra ma ni hūṃX dza4༷༷ mant+ra 'ubs mā ra ya rbad/ ces kha thun dmod pa'i drag sngags dang / gshin rje'i snying ga'i thad du ag rtse'i mdun ngos su ya yig bcas bri'o// yang spro na yum thod kyi phyi ngos la dug gsum mtshon pa'i phag sbrul bya gsum/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis/ 'gro ba rigs drug gi bkod pa rnams bskor thabs su bri bar yang bshad do// 'jam dpal tshe bdag lcags 'dra'i/ stobs chen mchod rten gyi 'khor le'i mṛ yig
zin bris gsal bar bkod pa gnad kyi sgron ma i thi gu hya/ pad gnubs dgongs don ma 'dres ji bzhin du/ /ston byed phyag rgya'i sbyor ba 'gyur med mthus/ /bdud tshogs pha mthar byed pa'i grags snyan sgra/ /skal bzang rgya mtsho'i rna bar 'god 'di mtshar/ na mo mañdzu shrī ye/ 'dir 'jam dpal tshe bdag lcags 'dra'i stobs chen mchog rten gyi thig rtsa dang / rgyan bkod kyi rnam bzhag bstan pa la/ dang po thig gi 'deb tshul ni/ gnubs kyi rtsa ba'i yi ge las4༷༷ rnal 'byor sgrub po'i lag g.yas kyi/ dpangs su brkyang 'bru bzhi btang la4༷༷ rgyar yang de bzhin btang bar bya4༷༷ cha chen drug bcu rtsa bzhir 'godagiX ces sogs gsungs pa'i don lag len snying bor dril na logs rer 'dom gang gi tshad can gru bzhir byas pa la tshangs zur gyi thig spyi ltar btab rjes/ shar nub lho byang so sor cha chen drug cu rtsa bzhir bgos la lag g.yon so sor cha chen po gnyis re bzhag pa'i bar gyi rtsa thig mchod rten gyi snying por byas te cha bgo zhing / de la dpangs tshad ni mas nas yar rim bzhin du/ sa stegs la cha chen bcu gnyis/ lhun po la cha chen nyi shu/ gdan khrir brgyad / ces pa tsam las ma gsungs kyang spyi mthun bzo nyes 'gog phyir/ sa 'dzin dang bad la cha chen phyed gnyis re gdan khri dngos la cha chen lnga/ dmangs dge la cha phran gcig bang rim bzhi por cha chen re de
༄tshi/ /dag so sor pad chung cha phran re/ bum gdan padmar cha chen gyi sum cha gnyis zla gdan la sum cha gcig bum pa la cha chen drug bre 'gul dang bre thog la cha chen re/ bre gdong la cha chen gnyis bshad pa'i cha phran gcig dmangs dge'i dpangs su btang bas skabs 'dir cha chen gcig dang cha phran gsum/ 'brug 'degs 'khor dang bcas pa cha chen brgyad de drug cu re bzhi'o// de'i steng char khebs bkab pa'i las sna nas ze srog gi rtse'i bar gyi dpangs la cha chen gsum btang bar bya'o// zheng tshad ni rtsa bar rgya dpangs mnyam zhes gsung pa thig gi cha dbye ba'i tshangs zur gyi thig 'debs pa la dgongs pa yin gyi gzhan du rgyar ni cha chen 'di lta ste/ sa steng cha chen bzhi bcu la4༷༷ zhes sogs gsung pa'i don/ sa stegs la rtsa thig gi g.yas g.yon so sor cha chen nyi shu re ste bzhi bcu/ de bzhin du lhun po nyer bzhi/ sa 'dzin la nyi shu/ gdan khri dngos la bco brgyad/ bad chen la nyi shu/ dmangs dger bco brgyad bang rim dang por bcu drug gnyis par bcu bzhi/ gsum par bcu gnyis/ bzhi par bcu/ pad chung rnams bang rim so so las cha phran re 'phyang bang rim gsum pa'i steng gi gzur nas chos 'bor gi tshangs thig gi bar g.yas g.yon so sor bcad pas bum rgya shugs kyi rten/ bre zhing dngos su ma gsungs kyang / bre 'gul dang bre thog so sor cha chen
lnga re dang bre gdong la cha chen bzhi/ 'brug 'degs dang bcas pa'i chos 'bor gyi smad char cha chen bzhi dang / stod char cha chen gcig btang ba'i bar g.yas g.yon so so nas sbrel bas chos 'bor 'grub/ char khebs cha chen bzhi/ de'i steng nyi zla dang tog dang bcad pa'i steng bya khyung 'god pa'am bya khyung tsam yang byang chog ste gang ltar bya khyung gi tshad sor brgyad tsam byas na legs/ mchod rten gyi tshad ni gnubs chen gyis mdzad pa'i tshe bdag nag po'i mchod rten gyi rnam nges so bzhag dang / mthong rgyud ltar na g.yung ston rin po che phyag len gtan phebs ltar bkod pa yin la/ de ltar na bcas chog skabs kyang 'og bcas gsum dang zhal dbye'i thod pa sa stegs nang nas lhun po'i nang gi brub khung du rgyud par byas nas/ sa 'dzin gyi steng gdan khri'i smad cha'i phyogs bzhir thun khung gtod dgos pa'ang shes par bya zhing / gzhan du dpal byang pa bkra shis stobs rgyal yab sras sogs/ grub brnyes gong ma 'ga' zhig gi phyag len ltar sgrub par 'dod na cha tshad dang che chung gi nges pa gzhan du shes so// mchod rten gyi rgyan bkod tshul ni/ sa stegs kyi phyi gru bzhi dang lhun po bang rim bzhi ba'i gru bzhi gang bder byas pa'i bre man chad nag por byugs la/ sa 'dzin gyi phyogs bzhi'i thun khung gi 'og ngos nas/ chur gnas pa'i rus sbal re gdan khri'i phyogs rer glang chen
༄tshi/ /gnyis re ste brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rnam pa can/ zur ngos rdo rje rin po che'i ka bas 'degs pa/ bad chen la sbrul chen rigs lnga/ dmangs dger padma drug cu rtsa bzhi wo nya drug cu'i tshul dang / de'i steng nang ngos nyi zla'i gdan zlum po'i tshul/ bang rim dang po'i logs bzhir stag de bzhin du bang rim gnyis par gzig gsum par seng ge bzhi par chu srin de dag gi bar mtshams rnams su rdo rjes mtshon pa'i rin po che'i ka ba pad chung rnams la thod rwa bum gdan la padma so gnyis dang zla gdan zlum bskor bum pa'i sked sdom utpal ris/ bre la yang rin po che'i ka bas btegs pa'i tshul dang / bre thog la padma thur bstan ris / chos 'khor gyi gdan gyi phyogs rer 'brug re/ chos 'khor steng gi padma gyen bstan shang kha can/ char khebs la seng ge'i kha nas 'phyang ba'i dra ba bsnol ma/ steng gi bya khyung lag gzhog dengs shing sbrul za ba spyi bor nyi zla dang nor bus brgyan pa'o// yang gnubs kyi rtsa ba'i yi ge 'di nyid du/ de nas phur pa bkod thabs nigiX bum pa'i rmang du zil gnon bkodagiX g.yas g.yon mdun du nag po gsumagiX gri lcags dag la byas pa gzugs4༷༷ bang rim dang por gshed bzhi bskoraltoX gnyis par mon bdud bkod par bya4༷༷ gsum par 'chi bdag bcu gnyis bkodagiX bzhi par sgo srung bzhi 'god dogiX gri lcags dug shing gang rung la4༷༷
phur bu rtse sor bzhi pa bya4༷༷ liṅga sen gang re la gdabaltoX bang rim phyi nang logs dag la4༷༷ drag po e ring sngags rgod bri4༷༷ stobs chen rdzas kyi legs par byugs4༷༷ zhes gsungs pa'i gnad shes par bya'ogiX yang 'og gi sa stegs sogs kyi nang du brub khung gi tshad ni/ snga ma las/ brub khung gsum ni 'di ltar yin4༷༷ zhes pa ltar bca' zhing brubs khung gsum gyi 'og mar mun smag bsdu ba/ gtad bzlog byas pa bshig pa rnams dang / bar mar gshed po las rgyal4༷༷ phreng mar zhal dbye'i thod pa'ogiX 'on kyang brubs khung 'og ma gnyis dpangs sor brgyad tsam dang / brub khung steng ma rgyar sor mo nyi shu tsam btang na 'gal ba med cing lag len bde'o// der ma zad mun smag bsdu ba sa stegs kyi 'og dong gru gsum thur du shus par mnan pa bshad do// mchod rten gyi bar thog so so'i dbus bug pa zur gsum du phugs par srog shing gri mda' thal bar gtor zhing / cha tshad 'di la gri mda' tshad ldan gyi steng la mkha' lding skyon te char khebs rtse nas btang bas seng khri'i smad du slobs tsam dang gnod sbyin rwa thod kyi 'bor lo bca' tshe mchod rten la nyi zla'i tog sogs ma byas par bya khyung tsam bkod pa'i skabs mda' stong phyogs nas sor bzhi lnga tsam mkha' lding nang du tshud par bya'o// 'jam dpal tshe bdag lcags 'dra'i stobs chen mchod rten gyi thig rtsa dang / rgyan bkod
༄tshi/ /kyi zin bris gsal bar bkod pa gnad gyi sgron ma ithi/ guphya/ pad rtsa ltar dkar 'od ldan ma rig gshed/ /'gyur med zab don zla ba 'di shar tshe/ /rgya mtsho'i pha mthar gnas pa'i bdud tshogs kun/ /thar byed drag po'i gar gyis srid gsum gnon/ mya/na mo mañdzu shrī ye/ 'di 'jam dpal tshe bdag lcags 'dra'i stobs chen mchod rten la nye bar mkho ba'i rdzas thems spra khrid las dang por mchod rten gyi thig gi skabs rtsa drag po'i srad bu kha dog lnga ldan thig cha la dur sol thal chen khrag sna dang bsres pa/ las sbyor gyi skabs rang srung gi rdzas cu gang mu zi btsan dug gla rtsi shu dag nag po ste byug rdzas lnga/ yang gong gi sman lnga dang / pu shud kyi sgro gla ba'i mche ba rnams lus la 'degs bgegs bskrad sogs spyi mthun rdzas/ gu gul rgya tshil/ mu zi bong tshil ra khrag mkhal khrag mdze khrag yungs dkar nag skye tshe gri lcags brdar phye rnams mchod rten nag po'i rdzas la rten 'brel 'grub pa'i rgyu lha khang dang mchod rten byin can gyi sa/ dgra'i lha lnga zil gyis gnon pa'i rgyur phung shul mi bsad g.yul bkye rnam pa dang ro bsregs pas sa rdo sol ba/ dur khrod gnyan po'i sa/ ngag mnan phyir gri khrag dug khrag grog mkhar gyi sa/ rang gshed du dbab phyir/ gro zhun tshe zhes pa gnam lcags brdar phye/ ra dug re lcag pa/ a phre( gan te spu nag dug sna khrag sna/ bstan pa dang
bsra phyir shog 'dag sa spyin/ mtshe'i khu ba rnams so// brubs khung dang rtsang sogs kyi rdzas spyi mthun/ 'khor lo'i rdzas la/ dang po mun smag bsdu ba'i 'khor lo'i rdzas la bri gzhi dug shog ling ga gsum la dri ma drug gang rnyed/ sdig pa gsum gyi nag po la dug sna/ dmar po khrag sna/ sngon po la gri lcags kyi phye byugs4༷༷ lcags sdig nas bshad pa'i gtad bzlog la/ bri gzhi ro ras/ dug thekhog rgya shog rnams gang rung byugs rdzas dug khrag khyad par sbrul gyi khrag klu gnas nges pa'i chu/ khyad par gyi thun rdzas / dug khrag ngar blud pa/ gri rkang gi gzar bu'i brab/ lcags sdig nas bshad pa'i byas pa bshig pa la/'bri gzhi gong 'dra la thog mar byugs rdzas/ dug khrag sbrul sha/ zha nye'i rdo rnams chu mig gnyan po'i chu la sbyar/ smyug bur byugs rdzas gri rus phye ma/ gshed po las rgyal spyi mthun 'chi bdag zhal dbye'i thod pa sbram po ma rnyed par skya yol tsam la brten tshe mon nam rabs chad wo mo'i bhan dha kha sbyar gyi wo thod la gshin rje'i gzungs ri mor bris shing lte bar thun bug rdol/ stong srog 'khor lo'i thun rdzas/ dug sna/ mi rta khyi phag bzhi'i khrag/ lcags zangs rdo phye gsum/ skye tshe/ shang tshe/ yungs dkar nag rnams rur bsags/ sgron drug ling ga'i byug rdzas la pha rol po'i dri chen/ dri chu/ mchil snabs gnyis/ skra shad dang gos
༄tshi/ /dum gnyis/ rkang rjes kyis sa rnams/ khang zhing gi sa ste dri ma drug sogs spyi mthun gang rnyed/ thun gyi rdzas/ slob ma dam nyams la/ gu gul/ mngal khrag dug sna rnams bon po'i lha chags la/bong khrag mdze khrag ris khrag gu gul/ khyi lud rnams/ urmo mkhan nang 'gras la spyi mthun/ btsad po bsad pa la/ gri lcags brdar phye dang dug sna/ dam tshig gcig pa'i sngags pa la/ dme khrag rim khrag sdig pa'i khrag sbal pa'i khrag rnams/ dam 'dres spyi'i spun la/ dur khrod kyi sa khrims 'chal dang / glang gi khrag mdze khrag rnams te/ de thams cad kyang sngags kyis ngar btags pa'i yungs dkar nag dang bsres nas brab/ mtha' bsdud kyi mnan snod/ btsad po la spyang thod/ gzhan rnams la mon nam rabs chad gyi thod pa/ ma rnyed na spyi 'gre'o// rdzas dmigs gsal med pa kun gyi drag sngags dang spel tshig rnams la dug khrag dang pha rol po'i ming yig sogs la dri ma drug gis byug /thun phur gyi rgyu gri lcags/ thun thag tshon skud sna lnga la ro skra bsres pa/ bzhig par bya khyung so brdar gyi 'bor lo'i e ring sogs la dri bzang dang spu gri spel tshig bcas pa dug khrag byugs/ dmigs gsal med pa'i las sbyor gyi thun rdzas yang gsang blun la brten nas bsad pa ltar bsags gi skabs su babs shing / de ltar na yungs nag / dug
sna gzi ra nag po/ til nag skye tshe/ shangs tshe mi khrag ra khrag/ khyi khrag phag khrag lcags phye zangs phye rnams/ bye brag lha lnga rang gshed du 'bebs pa'i rdzas/ pho lhar nyungs nag dang / za ra srog ltar/skye tshe dang / shangs tshe/ mo lhar ra khyi bong gsum gyi khrag zhang lhar lcags zangs phye/ yul lhar gu gul dang rdo phye/ yang lha dbye'i rdzas la/ rta bon pa gu gul/ mdze pho'i lham 'bog yugs sa'i zhabs ma/ mu zi khyi lud rnams te/ rdzas de rnams sgrub khang nang du btang bar mi bya'o// de'i steng lha lnga so so'i skyabs rtags byung na lha dbye'i rdzas gong gsal thog khyad par gyi rdzas dang sngags drag sngags gzhan du bshad pa ltar mchog go de rnams ni drag rdzas gtso che ba'i bskor ro/ yang mchod rten gyi lha tshogs rnams la so so'i sngags dang / gnas gsum du yig 'bru gsum dri bzang dang / chos sman gyi byugs bre yan chad du de bzhin gshegs ba'i ring bsrel dang sel med byin rten sna tshogs sogs spyi mthun no/ /'jam dpal tshe bdag lcags 'dra'i stobs chen mchod rten la mkho ba'i khyad par gyi rdzas thems 'ga' zhig zin bris su bsdebs pa gnad kyi sgron ma i thi/ guphya/ pad 'byung bla ma mchog dang yang dbang gi thugs kyi nying khu 'gyur med 'di sgrub na/ /gsang sngags rten 'brel gnad du che ba'i phyir/ /rdzas thems rgya mtsho'i snying po'i yang brgyud
༄tsho/ /sdebs / na mo mañdzu shrī ye/ 'dir 'jam dpal tshe bdag lcags 'dra'i stobs chen mchod rten ji ltar bya ba'i cho ga'i pra khrid la/ bsnyen sgrub las rung gi sngags pas gdug pa'i dus gnad dang rjes su 'brel ba las sbyor gyi 'khor lo thams cad la ling khrus dang 'brel ba'i sbyangs ba spyi ltar byas rjes las gzhung sngon du 'gro bas tshogs tha ma dang 'brel bar bskul/ gser skyems/ gzu dpang / brub khung bskyed chog dgug gzhug mon pa'i bskul/ bla 'gugs lha dbye/ thun brab rnams gtor bzlog skabs bzhin las khyad par mun smag bsdu ba'i thun sngags ni/ e myags ya rngub mug shag ka dun ra tri ra khrag srog la yam yam tri ling dgra bo'i snying la shag rbad/ e ka ya ma srog la hur thums gzir mnan dgra bo'i snying la shag rbad/ nag po na ga be ta srog la dza dza4༷༷ dṛ hur thums dgra bo'i snying la rbad/ ces ci mang bzlas la khrag dug yungs dkar gyis 'khor lo 'og ma'i ling ga la brab/ de rjes 'khor lo gong ma bkab pa sogs chas su bcug la/ hūm̐X nyon mongs las kyi ru tra 'di/ /ma rig mun pa'i smag rum du/ /dug gsum stobs kyis gnon mdzad pa/ /'chi ba'i bdag po tshe dang srog /gsang ba gshed kyi lha khyod kyi/ /rang gshed nag po'i las mdzod cig e baX raX yaX khaX shig tsitta rngubs/ che ge mo sas stib mes tshig chus bskur/ rlung
yen kha ri ba ltag na ri rtsi stibs/ kha g.yen dgra bo mā ra ya nan/ zhes mnan la bro brdung ngo / smin slob zhag sbrel gyi tshe ji tsam 'os pa dang / spyi tsam du nub dang po'i bya ba'o// lcags sdig nas bshad pa'i gtad bzlog la/ las gzhung bsrang ba sogs gong bzhin las khyad par thun sngags ni nyin mo'i dus bdag nyid zil gnon tu gsal ba'i spyi bo'i bya khyung las 'od zer 'phros 'khor lo gnyis la phog phyi nang gi rtsibs gnyis kyi 'khor lo 'og ma g.yon du 'khor ba'i bar du dmigs bya rnams mar 'dur 'dur bcom klu bdud pho mo'i zhal du gsol4༷༷ gzhan yang 'bor lo la bkod pa'i pho sngags drag tu bzla zhing thun gyis brab mtshan mo sngar bzhin las khyad par bdag nyid zil gnon du gsal ba'i thugs ga'i rusbal las 'od zer spro ba dang 'khor lo go ldog tu bskor zhing 'khor lo bkod pa'i mo sngags bzla zhing brab lcags sdig gi byas pa bzhig la ma gzhan bdag nyid zil gnon du gsal ba'i snying kha'i phyag rdor gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar nag 'phros/ tshe bdag pho mo la phog pas rgyud bskul/ 'khor lo'i sdig pa bzhi'i lus kyi yig 'bru bzhi las 'od zer 'phros/ e myags 'bru brgyad la phog de'i 'od zer gyi dregs pa sde brgyad bkug der sprul pa yang sprul dang bcas pa rnams dang / pho mo 'khor lo gnyis g.yas g.yon du 'khor ba'i bar la byad ma
༄tsho/ /rdul du brlag par bsam la/ e ka he dun sogs sku sngags ya ma ra tsa sogs nyin bzhi/ e myags sogs gsung sngags sbrel ba'i mthar badzra kro dha zhes pa nas/ sarba sha tun stum bha ya nan/ zhes pa'i bar 'khor lo'i sngags rnams drag tu bzla zhing bdud bzhi slong ba'i dmigs gnad dang sbyar te thun gyis brab/ de ltar gtad bzlog dang byas pa bshig pa gnyis so sor zhag re sogs ci nus sgrub la mnan pa'i tshe/hūm̐X lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la/ zhes pa nas rang gshed dbab pa'i phrin las mdzod/ ces pa'i bar brjod rjes bro brdung ngo // gshed po las rgyal la'ang / gzhan sngar bzhin las khyad par thun sngags ni/ 'khor lo'i phyi'i gshon rje'i gzugs mngon sum lta bur gyur pa'i lto nang du dmigs bya thar med du tshud pa la/ bdud bzhi sdig pa bzhi'i rnam pas g.yeng zhing rdul du brlag par bsam la/ ya ma rasmo rakta zhes sogs 'khor lo bkod pa'i dregs pa'i sngags rnams mang du bzlas la thun gyis brabs mthar mnan pa'i tshe/ hūm̐X lnga brgya dus kyi sogs gong ltar ro// de nas skabs 'dir 'chi bdag zhal dbye'i nang gi 'khor lo sogs la 'gugs 'dren lha dbye rnams sngon du 'gro bas lag len ltar bar bcas rnams tshul bzhin du 'grigs/ de nas mchod rten gyi stod smad bar gsum gyi cha rnams pa dum bur bkod pa la lha so so'i bzhugs gsol gyi
smreng rnams brjod bzhin du bkod nas gcig tu bsgrigs kyang rnam pa gsal mod/ 'on kyang lag len bde ba'i phyir lha'i rten rnams stegs bu khebs ldan gyi khar bzhugs tshul dang mthun par bkod pa la/ sbyang khrus sngon du 'gro bas las byang ltar lhar bskyed bstim mchod bstod rnams byas rjes mchod rten gyi bcas ldogs par bsgrigs la gnas su bkod pa'i gyer byang gi lha tshogs rnams bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūṃX rnal 'byor chos la dgra byung gi rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ram mda' bzlog /gzu dang dpang du dkon mchog bzhugs/ /dkon mchog gsum gyis byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes chos 'khor gyi gzugs rnams gzhug /de nas lha rnams la rim bzhin/ hūṃX klu 'bum gnyan khri phyogs skyong ma he'i steng / /thabs dang shes rab nyi zla'i gdan stengs su/ /nag po chen po dug chen 'khyil 'dra'i sku/ /dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol / e dun ka yam/ sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan/ hūm̐X chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas/ /drag po e yi gzhal yas nas/ /srog bdud gzhin rje chen po ni/ /nag po dug chen 'khyil 'dra'i sku/ /dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad/ /phyag drug mtshon chas dgra bgegs sgrol/ /sku la dur khrod rgyan dang ldan/ /khro rgyal thams cad zil gyis gnon/ /dregs pa lha srin rdul du brlog/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i gshed ma mdzod/ /
༄༅/ /e myags ya rngubs mugs shag ka dun/ dgra bo'i tsitta la hur thums dza4༷༷ /srog la dun rmugs breng shag rbad/ ces srog shing zil gnon du bsam mo/ hūm̐X srin po ya rā dza'i sku/ /smug nag be con tsakra bsnams dam nyams dgra bo'i gshed ma mdzod/ /ya ma ra dza sa do me ya dgra bo'i srog la dun rmugs rbad/ /gzhin rje myos byed 'bar ba'i sku/ /ser nag be con 'khor lo bsnams/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i gshed ma mdzod/ /ya me do ru ṇa yo da ya dgra po'i srog la kham shag rbad/ bdud po ār ya ma ru'i sku/ dmar nag beza dam nyams: ya da yo ni ra ya kṣe ya dgra po'i srog la breng shag rbad/ /gnod sbyin ral pa tshar dgu'i sku/ ljang nagacu dam nyams: yakṣe yakṣa ni mā ra ya dgra bo'i srog la yam shag rbad/ hūm̐X dung gi mon pa seng ge'i mgo/ /lcags kyi mon pa stag gi mgo /bse yi mon pa dred kyi mgo /gser gyi mon pa khyung gi mgo /sprul pa las kyi srog gshed bzhi'i/ /dam nyams: ka li dun ting tsitta ro myags rbad ha la ha la dun ting tsitta ro myags rbad/ rakta dun ting tsitta ro myags rbad/ garma bha ki dun ting ro myags rbad/hūṃX he le khyab pa shar gyi bdud/ nag po 'dzum med lho yi bdud/ /so 'dar 'khrig pa nub kyi bdud/ /ral pa spyir bcing byang gi bdud/ /las kyi bdud po chen po bzhi/ dam nyams: ru tra ru thum bha ti srog la
thur thur mā ra ya hūṃX/ lcags mkhar 'bar ba bcu gnyis la/ /'chi bdag bdud kyi bdud chen po/ /'jigs byed chen po 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /gdug pa dug gi kha rlangs can/ /'bar ba gtum po tshogs kyi bdag spyan gsum ldog pa'i gdangs mig bsgyur/ /zhal bgrad 'bar ba'i mche ba gtsigs/ /lce spyang chu ni khrag gis slan/ /so rno lag pa khrag gis dmar/ /zangs gri zhags pa nag po dang / /gdug pa'i mtshon cha mang po 'dzin/ /snying rje med par gsod byed pa/ /rngams shing gtum pa'i tshogs bcas kyi/ /dam nyamasazo kriṣṭha dza ma ri dgra bo'i tsitta breng shag rbad/ hūm̐X srog bdag dkar po snying 'byin dang / /ma hā ka la 'jigs pa'i sku/ /bdud po yab rje nag po dang / /gnod sbyin sku mchog dmar po bzhi/ /drag po las kyi sgo bzhi nas/ /dam nyams: tri tsa pa la a shug me dgra bo'i srog la thum ril rbad bhyo:༷༷ mā ra ya rbad nan ma hā ka la ya thun rbad bhyo:༷༷ mā ra ya rbad bhyo:༷༷ zhes bskul lo/ mchod rten rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga ni/ e myags 'bru brgyad kyi mthar rten 'brel snying po btags pa nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas la/ bden stobs brjod pa sngon du 'gro bas bden pa chen po'i byin gyis rlobs kyis bka' bden pa 'grub par gyur cig ces me tog dor zhing phyag dang bskor ba lan gsum gsum bya'o// rgyas par spro na/ kun mkhyen rgyal
