༄tshi/ /mchog lnga pa chen pos mdzad pa'i mchod rten bcas chog gi rab gnas byin rlabs nyi ma'i gzi 'bar bzhin shes par bya'o// mchod rten gsar du bzhengs pa yin na sgrub pa'i cho ga ni mchod gtor sogs yo byad thams cad 'tshogs par 'du byas la/ 'og tu las sbyor gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar bskyed bstim mchod bstod sogs dang 'brel bar drag por bzla ba'i dmigs gnad dang sbyar te/ e ring bye chung gcig tu bsnyen par gsung pa ni gong ma dag gi phyag bzhes so// las sbyor gyi cho ga ji ltar bsgrub tshul dngos la thun drug dang thun bzhi gang rung du bsnyen pa las/ nyin zhag re re bzhin gyi thun thog ma'i 'gor skyabs mchog bla ma dam pas mdzad pa'i las byang rdo rje'i me phreng bzhin bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas mchod rten la dmigs te/ ayo ayo ayo/ ayo nyid stong pa zhes pa nas/ rang bzhin gnas par dran par bya/ mi 'gyur chos sku bdag nyid las/ /sprul pa'i gzugs sku cir snang yang / /kun rdzob bha ga gsang ba'i dbyings/ /rang byung mchod rten chen por grub/ /byang chub mchog chos rang bzhin can/ /mtshan nyid kun tshang bum pa'i dbus klu 'bum gnyan khri sa bdag stong / zhes pa nas/ sku la khro rgyal bcu po rdzogs/ /gtso bo'i g.yas g.yon rgyab gsum du/ /sku sprul 'chi bdag bye ba sogs/ zhes pa nas/ tshe bdag mgo dgu pa/
de 'og bang rim dang po'i nang / gshedapo ya ma ra dang / zhes pa nas/ tshar dgu bzhi/ de 'og bang rim gsum po la/ steng nas rim bzhin mon pa bzhi/ bdud bzhi 'chi bdag bcu gnyis rnams/ /rang rang yum dang bcas pa'o/ /gdan khri'i phyogs kyi sgo bzhi rtswa /shar nas rim bzhin rgyal po dang / /mgon po bdud dang gnod sbyin bzhi/ /gzhan yang de dag phyi rol na/ /pho gshed mo gshed la sogs pa'i/ /sha za zhing gang ma mo'i tshogs/ /sprul pa yang sprul bsam mi khyab/ /de ltar de dag thams cad kun zhes pa nas/ mchod pa rdzogs pa'i bar las byang rdo rje'i me phreng bzhin byas rjes khyad par bzlas pa'i tshe/ spyang mo drug dang / smyi sgos ldebs tshul sogs skabs dang sbyar zhing / spyi tsam du lha srin stobs gzhom dregs pa dbang sdud kyi dmigs gnad ni/ lha'i sku dang thugs ga'i yig 'bru dang sngags kyi 'od zer 'phros pas yul gang la bya ba rang dbang med par gzir nas srog gi ngo bo nang na yod pa'i rnam shes kyi yig 'bru re/ hur thum dza/ zhes pas rang dbang med par 'phrog thugs ga'i rus sbal rngams pa'i khyams nang e dang ka la bsdus par bsam zhing / sku gsung thugs sngags/ e ring gi mthar/ gzir ba g.yu spyang btags pa ci rigs bzlas rjes bstod pa bya ba ni/ hūṃX chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas/ /chos sku mi 'gyur rdo rje'i bdag nyid
༄tsho/ /las / zhes pa nas/ bdag la byin rlabs bkra shis stsal du gsol lo/ zhes pa'i bar bsu dhā ras mdzad pa'i tshe bdag nag po'i mchod rten gyi bstod pa bzhin dang / e chos dbyings skye ba med pa las/zhes sogs las byang bzhin bstod nas thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūṃX yongs rdzogs bum pa'i pho brang nas/ zhes pa nas/ mi mthun rkyen ngan thams cad zhi bar mdzod/ ces pa'i bar mchod rten bstod pa'i nang bzhin btang rjes/ thun gtor la rakta sbran te 'og bcas kyi 'khor ling rnams dang lhan cig tu dmigs bya 'gugs gzhug bya/ bdud rtsi bran la byin gyis brlabs/ a kro bcu bdun pa'i mthar gtor sngags btags pa gsum gyis phul mthar/ dmar chen gtor zor sogs kyi thebs phyogs su 'phang ngo / thun rjes ma rnams la mchod bstod byin rlabs dang bdag bskyed gsal 'debs tsam sngon 'gros mchod rten bskyed chog man chad sngar ltar byed/ khyad par thun tha ma'i mthar tshogs mchod/ bam skong / chos skyong spyi sgos kyi gtor 'bul sogs rjes chog rnams nyin re bzhin du bya ste/ de ltar zhag bdun gcig bdun gnyis la sogs sgrub pa dngos gzhi'i yun skabs dang sbyar nas ñtsu rigs su sgrub par bya'o// de nas nyin re bzhin thun dang po mgor las byang gi sngon 'gro rnams song rjes bdag mdun 'jug pa gcig pa'i dbang du mchod rten
bskyed chog nas thugs dam bskul pa'i bar sngar bzhin byas rjes/ gser skyems dang gzu dpang sngon 'gros/ e ring gi sprul pa spro/ dmigs byar bskyed dgug pho nya spro ba rnams nan tan yid ches par byas la e myag 'bru brgyad kyi mthar/ dgra bo'i bla sha re ma ti zhes sogs bla 'gugs kyi sngags la chig sgril dang / e myags kyi mthar / che ge mo a garsha ya hūṃX dza dza4༷༷ de bzhin du a yusnyo na a kārsha ya hūṃX dza dza4༷༷ tri ya ma ni āXgar sha ya hūṃX dzaXdzaX ru pa skan a garsha ya hūṃX dza dza4༷༷ zhes srog tshe yi gzugs 'gug pa'i sngags rnams btags de brgya tsam re bzla/ de nas lha dbye'i bskul 'jam dpal dregs 'joms bzhin btang rjes lcags sdig ltar e myags kyi mthar che ge mo de ba ka pa ye e dza la dza la ra dza e ra dza phye a shag shag ya ma phye ma spu ta spu ta phus phus/ lang lang seng seng phus phus che ge mo lha dang phyes/ srog lha dang phye/ zhes ji tsam nus pa re bzlas mthar bsad pa ni/ e ya/ thod pa kha sbyor las kyi gshon rje ni/ 'jigs rung gtum drag 'bar ba'i lto nang du/ dmigs bya mgon med skyabs bral tshud pa las/ /las gshon dregs pa'i dmag tshogs skar ltar 'khrugs/ /'khor lo'i rtsibs mtshon gdug pa'i tshwa tshwa 'phro/ /sbal sdig gzugs sogs mi bsrun rnam 'gyur can/ /kun kyang dgra bo'i gshed du char 'phros nas/ rang gshed 'bebs shing
༄tshi/ /'gugs 'chings sdom myos gsod/ /khyad par rang rgyud rtsa ba'i 'bor lo ni/ /dmigs bya'i snying gar ya yig dbus su ma/ de dbus rnam shes ngo bo 'bru gcig po/ rtsa bzhi'i dngas ma zhe sdang sdig pa bzhi'i/ /mchu la e dun ka sogs dmar ser mtshon/ /ru 'dzing e myags 'bru brgyad rtsa brgyad kyi/ /dwangs ma'i snying por gnas pas bzas pa po'i/ /chos kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa brgyad gzung ba gang / /lha tshogs thugs ka nas spros sngags 'od kyi/ /bskul bas sdig pa'i rwa yis rtsa 'dabs brgyad/ /dum bur bcad de 'byung bzhi rim bzhin du/ /bsdu mthar rnam shes dwangs ma 'od dkar po'i/ /rnam pas zil gnon thugs srog dwangs mar thim/ /dmigs bya'i gzugs phung gshin rje'i dmag tshogs kyis/ /rjes med zos te gzugs phung brlag par bsam/ /e myags 'bru brgyad kyi mthar/ dgra po'i srog la dṛ hur thums dza/ rtsa khrag tsitta thums ril raX shag rbadaX dgra bgegs kyi tsitta breng shag dzaX srog la hur thum dza rbadagiX ces brgya rtsa sogs bzla zhing thun la sngags te4༷༷ hūṃXltoX khrag 'thung 'jam dpal gshen rje yigiX pho nyar sngags pa thun gyi bdagagiX dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i las la yugiX sna tshogs drag po'i thun gyi rdzas4༷༷ glog ltar 'khyug cing thog ltar 'bebs4༷༷ dgra bgegs lus sems 'ben la yugiX zhes sogs thun bskul sngon du 'gro bas
nyin kyi thun gzhan rnams la dkar po snying 'byin lcags kyus snying nas bzung ste brgyal du smyo ru bcug par gyur bar bsam zhing gong gi sngags sham du/ e dgra bgegs kyi srog la thum ril rbad bhyo:༷༷ zhes shar sgo nas de bzhin du/ mgon pos nags zhags pas btab nas bzung te rgyal du bcug par bsam zhing / a mu ka thums khrag shig tsitta myong rbad bhyo/ zhes btags te lho sgo nas/ yab rje nag po lcags sgrogs dang khram shig thogs nas dgra bgegs khram la btab par bsam zhing / a mu ka tsa la dun rmug rbad bhyo/ zhes btags te nub sgo nas/ sku mchog dmar po zhags pa dang dril bu thogs nas dgra bo'i rtsa rus bcad par bsam zhing / a mu ka ya ma khrag la mug ti rbad bhyo/ zhes btags te byang sgo nas thun rdegs/ srod dang tho rang gi thun gnyis la gong gi thun bskul rjes su bsad sngags kyi mthar sgo bzhi'i thun sngags sbrel ba'i mjug tu sngags pa snying du sod/ tsitta gtubs rbad long / srog tsitta myags myags mā ra ya tsitta la thun bhyo:༷༷ zhes shar sgo nas bso/ phyogs bzhi ka nas thun brdeg go /gang ltar yang thun gtor 'bul zhing mthar zor du 'phang pa sogs sngar ltar dang / thun rjes ma rnams la bdag bskyed gsal 'debs tsam sngon 'gros thugs dam bskul ba man chad dkyus bzhin byas pas chog go /de ltar zhag bdun sogs ci rigs par
༄tshi/ /sgrub pas khugs rtags byung byung ba dang cho ga'i gtong tshul sngar ltar las nyin zhag gcig gnyis tsam gyi bar lha dbye'i sngags la chig sgril byed/ gal te lhas skyobs pa'i rtags che na/ 'og gi ling ga rnams phyir 'don zhing sgrub khang gi nub byang gi phyogs nas gzhan du khyer te rdzas kyi bdug pa sogs khyad par thun gtor gyi tshe dgug gzhugs byin rlabs gtor bsngo rnams song rjes bdud bzhi slong phyir dregs pa bskul pa ni / hūm̐X zhe sdang me ltar 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /sku mdog sngo nag ral pa mun ltar gtibs/ /sa yi rang bzhin smyi gtsug rtsa la gtibs4༷༷ dam nyams bsgral phyir tshangs pa'i gtsug thag chodagiX dwangs ma bsdus la klad khrag zho ltar 'phyos/ 'dod chags khrag mtsho dmar po'i nang shed na4༷༷ khrag mdog dmar po bse yi ral pa can4༷༷ chu yi rang bzhin sdig pa bgrad pa'i tshul4༷༷ dam nyams bsgral phyir mgrin pa'i rtsa chod la4༷༷ dwangs ma bsdus la khrag ltar skyug tu chugagiX nga rgyal keng rus 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas4༷༷ sku mdog dud ka rngams pa'i zhal gdangs shing ltoX 'jigs pa'i tshul gyis lus kyis rtsa mdud 'joms4༷༷ dam nyams bsgral phyir lte ba'i rtsa chod la4༷༷ dwangs ma bsdus la lus sems bral bar gyis4༷༷ gti mug dug mtsho khol ba'i nang shed na4༷༷ srog bdag nag po ma rung ral pa can4༷༷ mche ba gtsigs shing dug gsum khong du
'joms4༷༷ skye 'gro srid pa gsum gyi tshe srog bdudagiX rlung gi rang bzhin dkar nag mtshams na gnas4༷༷ dam nyams bsgral phyir srog gi rtsa chen la4༷༷ dwangs ma bsdus la tshe srog 'du byed bskumagiX gzhan yang 'chi bdag 'khor na gnas pa yigiX las kyi gnod sbyin mon mo nag mo bdun4༷༷ lcags kyu 'bar bas dgra snying khyer la phre(gagiX mon pa gsod byed me dang 'khor lo bsnams4༷༷ gnam lcags mda' dang gdug pa'i khram bam thogs4༷༷ khyi mo dmar mo don snying bla la khyeraltoX bya nag bdun ni khong nas tsitta 'byin4༷༷ dug sbrul bdun ni khong nas dug mda' brdeg rus sbal bdun ni dgra bo'i tshe srog bsdudagiX sdig pa bdun ni dgra bo'i srog dbugs len4༷༷ dus la bab bo dam tshig 'di longs la4༷༷ dam nyams ru tra 'di la rang gshed phobaltoX ces bskul rjes dmar chen gtor zor sogs sngar ltar 'phang ltoX 'dir ni las sbyor spyi khyab tsam gyi dbang du byas pa stegiX gzhan du bsad sngags dang sbrel bar sgron drug so so'i dmigs gnad dang bstun te sngags bzla tshul sogs ni rtsa ba'i gzhung sogs gzhan du shes par bya'o// rtags mthong nas mthar las la sbyar ba ni 'og bcas rnams g.yo 'gul med par bzhag thogs par bcas kyi 'og 'degs dang / steng gcod ma gtogs 'khor ling rnams phyir phyung / mchog phag gnyis dang rlang rkyang smyi 'gre zhig zur du bcas pa tshab tu
༄tshi/ /'jug phyir bton pa'i 'khor ling rnams brub khung lta bur btsug pa la gtor bzlog nang bzhin bskul nas mtshon chas bsgral ba'i bar dkyus ltar byas rjes mnan bsreg gang rung gis mtha' bsdud/ 'on kyang las drug so so'i dmigs gsal dang 'brel tshe mnan pa'i sa gnad sogs bye brag tu dgos pa'i gnad kyang shes par bya/ gal te las sbyor 'di nyid gang la bya ba'i yul dmigs gsal med par rgyun gyi bsrung bzlog tsam du bca' bar 'dod tshe bsad rtags ci rigs gtan la 'bebs tshe nas rjes chog rnams spyi mthun las mtha' bsdud kyi las sbyor byed mi dgos la/ dus dus su sgrub pa kha gso zhing las kyi sbyor ba'ang ci rigs su bya ba gnad yin/ 'jam dpal tshe bdag lcags 'dra'i stobs chen mchod rten la nye bar mkho ba'i cho ga'i pra khrid gsal bar bkod pa gnad kyi sgron ma au thi/ pad rtsa dang mtshungs rnam dag gzhung gi don/ma 'khrul gsal byed snying po 'gyur med dngos/ /grub chen sngags 'chang rgya mtsho'i snying nor bcud/ /'di ko grub brnyes byin rlabs mthu las byung / /na mo mañdzu shlau ye/ 'dir 'jam dpal tshe bdag lcags 'dra'i stobs chen mchod rten la nye bar mkho ba'i zab mo'i gnad yig 'ga' zhig sdebs pa mchod rten sgrub pa'i skabs nam mkha'i mthongs su sbyor ba'i stobs bshig pa stong srog 'khor lo sgos sgrub tu byed na/ thog ma kho
nar stong srog 'khor lo zur pa zhig bcas pa la/ bdag bskyed sngon 'gros bskul dang dgug bstim sogs sgyi 'gre las khyad par gyi dmigs gnad ni 'khor lo srid pa'i khyams khang chen por grub pa'i dbus kyi ling ga gzas po dngos su gsal ba las yig 'bru rnams zil gnon gyi lha tshogs dregs pa'i dpung dang bcas pas gzir bar bsam zhing / e ring gi mthar gzir spyang btags pa ci nus bzlas rjes/ ayo ayo ayo/ a spro te ka ya manta ka ye/ hriṣṭi a pa ye/ ya manta ka bi tri ga ka li kro ta/ a ne u ne du ne/ bya tsa ye/ du ru ye/ tsitta ye/ ha la ye/ ya ma kri ta/ ya ma kro ta manta/ ya ma rakta/ ya ma byi sha/ hu ti mornya hri tsa ya a mu ka/ tsitta breng shag myags thun bhyo:༷༷ thums ril khrag la myogs bhyo:༷༷ dunting hri shag hal yam bhyo:༷༷ dgra bo'i snying khrag tshal myags rbad/ srog la ma ra ya rbad/ ni sha ku ru ni rbadagiX ni hur long breng breng dun dun / hur thums dza tsitta ya rbad/ zhes thun sngags kyang drag tu bzlas la khyad par gyi thun rdzas kyis brab/ de ltar zhag dgu la sogs pa ci rigs su sgrub rjes dbus gru gsum gyi liṅga bris pa phyogs gzhan du mnan pa'am/ mun smag bsdu ba'i 'bor lo dang lhan cig mnan kyang rung / gang ltar yang 'bor lo de mchod rten sgrub pa'i skabs bum pa'i steng zil gnon gyi dbu thog tu bla gre ltar 'gram par bya'o/ 'khor lo
༄tsho/ /'di bri bar bya ba'i spyang mo yang spyang gzir kho na ste/ des na bar bcas kyi stong srog 'khor lo dang ma 'dres par/ spyi dang khyab par gyi gnad shes pa gal che'o// yang las dmigs gsal dang sbrel tshe sgos srog sdebs na dgra sdebs dang 'dre ldebs gnyis kyi dang po ni/ 'khor lo bri ba dang sngags bzla ba gnyis ka la mtshungs par/ e ring gi rakta mon to'i mthar so so'i spu gri brdeg pa ste/ dper na slob ma dam nyams dang 'gras na/ rakta manti'i mthar/ che ge mo'i srog la hur thums ma ra ya tsitta la rbad/ ces dang bon po lha chags la che ge mo'i srog la :giX dza4༷༷ thums mugs ma ra ya rbadagiX ces pa lta bu'o// gnyis pa ni/'khor lo dngos su ma bcas kyang rung / srog gong ltar sdebs pa ste/ dper na rgyal po dang dam sri sdom pa la/ rakta manti'i sham du/ ra tsa ru tri a mu ka myags thums ril/ trig nan sbur ya nan/ tsa tu hur thums dza kham shag ro myags mug ti rbad ya/ de bzhin du gshin rje gnod pa gong gi ra tsa ༄ zla'i tshab tu/ ya ma zhes dang / tsa tu'i tshab tu ya zhes bsgyur bas mtshon te dmigs gnad sogs zhib par lha srin ming srog 'phrog pa'i ting 'dzin yig chung bzhin shes par bya'o// yang tshul bzhin sgrub kyang ma 'grub na 'khor ba'i rgya gling du srid pa'i ri 'gyel ba ni sbog ba'i cho ga ste/ las gang byed kyang rtags med dam dus las 'gyang na
sngags bzlas pa'i skabs nyin mo'i dus/ e myags 'bru brgyad kyi mthar dgra bo'i srog la dṛ khung thums dza/ rtsa khrag snying la thums ril ram shag rbad/ e raX yaX khaX bri sha ku ru ma ra ya rbad/ ces yungs dkar la bzlas shing brabs/ mchog 'bor gyi gzugs dang dregs pa rnams kyi dgra bo'i snying khrag rngubs par bsam mo/ mtshan mo'i dus/ e myags 'bru brgyad kyi mthar dgra bo'i tsitta breng shag dza/ srog la hur thums rbad raX yaX khaX e ka ya ma bri sha ku ༄ ༄rdzog la ma ra ya rbad/ zhes yungs nag la bzlas shing brabs/ phag mo gsar 'khor gyi gzugs dang dregs pa rnams kyi dgra bo'i snying khrag rngubs par bsam mo// gal te des kyang ma 'grub na rgyud dang man ngag gi gnad don bzhin sngar gyi sngags nyid bzlog dkrugs su bzlas pas 'grub par gsung ste/ 'di ni zhag gsum tsam las mang du mi rung ngo / da rung rtags ma byung na gshed po las rgyal gyi 'bor lo zhig zur du bcas pa'i sngags rnams lto dkrugs su bri zhing/ dkrugs tshul e myags 'bru brgyad la dper mtshon na/ e ya shag myags dun rngubs ka mugs4༷༷ zhes pa lta bu'i mtshon dregs pa'i srog yig rnams kyang gcod gzer gyi spu gri dang sdeb pa sogs man ngag gi gnad rnams shes pas las la sbyar bar bya'o// gzhan yang las dmigs gsal gyi skabs pha rol po'i bla srog 'gyu ba'i dus dang bla
༄༅/ /rtags / de mthun gyi gnyen po sprod tshul sogs kyang drag sngags spyi'i 'gros bzhin shes dgos so// mnan gtad kyi las khyad par ba la gces pa rus sbal gyi pra khrid ni/ chu mig lta bu la mtshon na/ de nyid snying gar byas nas mgo gang ltad steng du byas pa'i snying ga nas yar rnal 'byor pa'i 'dom gang gzhal ba kha/ de nas khru phyed na sna/ de nas khru phyed gzhal ba nas g.yas g.yon so sor khru re'i sar mig gnyis/de nas g.yas g.yon du gru spyod re na rna ba gnyis mig nas gyen du khru gang gzhal bas mgo kha nas yar mgo phyogs su 'dom do dang tshangs thig nas g.yas g.yon du 'dom re na mchan khung gnyis/ snying kha nas mar rkang phyogs su 'dom gang na lte ba/ de'i g.yas g.yon du 'dom gang na lto g.yas dang lto g.yon/ lto ba nas mar 'dom gang na mjug ma/ de'i g.yas g.yon du khru re gzhal ba na gsang g.yas dang g.yon/ mjug ma nas g.yas g.yon du 'dom re'i sa na rkang pa gnyis yod do/ 'di ni rtsa ru sbal khra bo'i pra khrid bzhin la rdo rje gtsug lag sogs kyi kha skong ste man ngag gi gnad dang ldan pa bris pa yin la/ gang gtad par bya ba'i dmigs bya'i lo khams dang rus khams/ nad kyi 'debs tshul sogs zhib par pra khrid nyid las shes so// de la mgo gtad phyogs ni/ hor zla bcu gcig par nub/ bcu gnyis par lho/ dang po shar/ gnyis
par byang / gsum par lho/ bzhi par shar/ lnga par nub/ drug par lho/ bdun par shar/ brgyad par byang / dgu par lho/ bcu par shar du'o// de yang rgyun du kha nub dang / nyin gung mtshan gung gan rkyal du gnas pas g.yas g.yon gyi gnad ma nor ba gal che/ rnal 'byor pa'i kha lta phyogs ni drag sngags smyi mthun no// yang gong 'og tu ma 'dus pa'i 'khor lo gzhan dag gis bstan tshul tsam lde mig tu bkod pa ni rgyud kyi le'u brgyad pa nas gsung pa'i 'byung ba khram thog chen mo mnan pa'i 'khor lo'i khongs su bsdu/ pad lugs sbyin bsreg nas bshad pa'i sbyin sreg sbyor ba'i 'khor lo thab dkyil gyi khongs su bsdu/ padma'i man ngag las byung ba gcod pa nam mkha'i 'khor lo gshed po'i lto bar bris pa sbyin sreg dus thabs kyi steng me lces mi slebs pa'i phar 'gram du rgyud kyi le'u bdun pa dang padma'i man ngag sogs nas bstan pa'i ngag mnan du na bdun pa mnan pa'i khongs su bsdu/ bzhig pa gnod sbyin mdze thod dang mnan pa dug sbrul ra can gnyis ljags 'drar gzhung gi zin po sngon chad ma mthong kyang 'di dang 'dra min lcags sdig nas bshad cing gang ltar yang byas pa bshig pa dang mnan pa'i khongs su bsdu ba las mchog phag gi 'khor lo lugs gcig tsakra zhirta'i man ngag nas bshad/ 'khor lo gsang ba'i pra khrid dam bsad pa snying thun sgron ma nas
༄༅/ /bshad pa'i gsang ba tsitta la brten nas bsad pa'i 'khor lo sbal sdig kha sbyor bsad 'khor gyi sdebs su 'gro padma'i man ngag rtsa ba nas bshad pa'i gshed po'i 'khor lo kha sbyor 'khor ba'i rgya gling du srid pa'i ri bsgyel ba'i khongs su bsdu/ 'byung bzhi bskul ba'i las mtha' las byung ba rtsa ba'i lha bzhi'i 'khor lo 'byung ba so so'i las mtha' bzlog bsad kyi khongs su bsdu/ ur mo sbyor ba bzhi pa las byung ba rnon po nang gcod kyi 'khor lo mnan gtad khongs su bsdu ste/ des mtshon pa'i las phran rnams rkyang par sgrub pa dang / sdebs tshul sogs man ngag dpe chung go bstun te shes par bya'o// yang drag po'i zor las dang rjes su 'brel bar rwa zor gyi thebs rtags tshul ni/ mi rta khyi gsum bsad pa'i g.yag rgod kyi rwa g.yas pa'i ru rtse g.yas dang gug phyogs phyi bstan gyi dbang du byas pa'i phyi'i steng du khro po'i mig kha phyir blta ba'i rnam pa dang rtser me ri rtsa bar sbrul gzugs rnams bkod pa las 'phang pa'i tshe rwa'i rtsa rtse gnyis ka thebs phyogs dang / mig steng du gtad na thebs chen/ gong 'dra las mig 'og tu rgyud na gan thebs ru rtse thebs phyogs dang rtsa ba rang la bstan cing mig steng du gtad na brdung thebs nang ma/ de las mig sar gtad na brdung thebs phyi ma ste snga ma snga ma mchog go de bzhi las phyin ci log tu gyur pa'i bzlog bzhi dang rwa'i rtsa rtse gnyis gar sar
zug na lkugs pa/ rtsa rtse nam mkhar bstan cing sgang tshugs na sgang pa zhes bya ste de rnams la bskyar/ 'on kyang sgang lkugs gnyis po'i rtse mo dgra phyogs su bstan na rgya 'dra'i zor thebs zhes te 'di dag la yang rgyud nas bskyar bar gsungs kyang phyag len la thebs dbang du byas bskyar bar mi mdzad do/ 'jam dpal tshe bdag lcags 'dra'i stobs chen zab mo'i man ngag 'ga' zhig ldebs pa gnad gyi sgron ma i thi/ padma'i rigs sogs rigs rnams kun gyi gtso/ 'gyur med sku mchog 'jam dpal dpa' bo'i tshul/ yongs bzhes khro rgyal rgya mtsho spyi gzugs 'di/ grub na 'dod don lhun grub spyi gzugs yin/ na mo mañdzu shlau ye/'dir 'jam dpal tshe bdag lcags 'dra'i man ngag dang rjes su 'brel bar gnam lcags udma'i sbyor ba lag tu blang ba'i pra khrid la/ dang po rdzas bca' ba ni/ mgo phur 'dzoms pa bdud kyi nyi ma'am/ nyi nag sogs drag po'i dus dang 'brel bar shog bu bskum khru gang pa gnyis byas pa la lte bar bzas po'i ling ga mtshan nyid tshang ba'i snying gar dṛ yig dzaXkha sbyor gyi bar du ldebs pa'i mthar dgra kro che ke mo ma ra ya rbad sod/srog chod dbugs long / snying phyung / mā ra ya sod/ dgra bo'i lus ngag yid gsum aṅku sha dza dza4༷༷ zhes bri gnad yig spyi dang 'dra/ ling ga'i phyi zlum bskor gyi nang sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar/ yul 'di zhes pa'i
༄7/ /bdag po ming rus 'di zhes pa la chos skyong srung ma lha srin sde brgyad 'go ba'i lha lnga rnams bdud du phob cig gshed du phob cig ma ra ya sod/ myur du sod cig de'i phyir rdo rje'i g.yas g.yon gyi rwa brgyad la e myags 'bru brgyad/ de'i phyi zlum skor gyi nang rwa bar gyi stong bzhi la dgra bo che ge mo ma ra ya rbad sod nan/ zhes pa tshar re/ de'i phyi rtsibs nyi shu pa phyi ru mu khyud bcas pa'i wo 'khor gyi rtsibs la/ dgra hur thums/ a mu/ srog la thums/ ril rbad/ rtsa khrag tsitta/ phyungs/ breng / shag hur thums/ dza dza4༷༷ zhes dza gnyis gcig tu 'dril ba'i 'bru re/ phyi rim mu khyud la/ dgra kro ghargha mṛ dza dza bhanta bhanta stum bha ya nan a mu ga'i 〈snag la breng shag rtsa khrag snying thums ril nag po rakta snying la thums ril hur thums sarba nan/ nag po nan/ nag po rakta srog la hur thums rbad/ nag po rakta rtsa la breng shag rbad/ nag po rakta snying khrag tshal pa shaX long rbad/ dgra bo dam nyams che ge mo lo zlar ma bzhag myur mgyogs sgrol zhig phung du chug cig dgra bo thams cad ma ra ya sod cig ces bri/ mo 'khor gyi rtsibs la/ dṛ srog la hur thums / a mu ka/ srog la/ rbad thums/ ril rbad/ rtsa khrag tsitta/ phyung rbad/ zhes 'bru re/ de'i phyi'i mu khyud la a mu ga'i srog la breng shag rtsa khrag snying thums ril nag po rakta snying la thums nan rbad nag
po rakta rtsa la breng shag rbad/ nag po rakta snying khrag tshal pa sha long garbha dṛ dza bhanta bhanta stum bha ya nan ma ra ya nan/ dgra bo che ge mo'i srog chod snying phyung dbugs long lus sems phrol dus mtha' btul/ lo dang zla bar ma bzhag zhag dang za mar ma 'gyangs par myur mgyogs sod cig sgrol cig zhes bri/ pho 'khor gyi phyi la sdig pa nag po'i gzugs mgo stod phyogs ling ga dang mtshungs pa dang / mo 'khor gyi phyi la sbal pa dmar po dbus kyi ling ga'i 'jug phyogs su mgo bstan pa de gnyis ka gan rkyal du byas pa'i pho 'khor gyi phyi la sku gsung thugs sngags kyi mthar dza dza/ a mu sarba sha truX srog rtsa hur thums rbad sod rtsa khrag snying la thums ril rbad sod/ rakta sarba tsitta phyungs snying la breng shag rbad sod/ dgra bo che ge mo'i srog rtsa mṛ hur thums dza dza4༷༷ mā ra ya rbad sod/ e yam bam sum lam e myags ya rngubs mug shag ka dun ma hā de ba ya ma ra dza ma ma ru ma hā ka la dha zhi ma e ka dza ṭi ru tra dunting shu la tsa ra dza pa na na kro dhi shwa ri yakṣa yaklo pa sha mi kki de wa a titta ka rakta raklo mun mun pa badzra sa dhu tri haX shaX tri du tri tri badzra du tri raX ma bam ril ging ka ra yam tri la se la tig na 'dre rum tri pa shaX lam̐ bi na ya ga dgra bo ge mo mṛ tri tsitta dkrugs srog la breng shag mā ra ya rbad sod bstan bshog dam nyams dgra bo che ge mo 'di lo dang zla bar ma bzhag zhag dang za mar las myur
༄༅/ /mgyogs sgrol las kyi gshin rje dang gza' bdud ra hu la 'khor dregs pa'i lha srin sde brgyad kyi dgra bo che ge mo 'di khram la thob cig srog chod cig snying phyungs/ dbugs long / mgo dang yan lag chod cig lus srog phrol/ dgra bo'i dus myur du bsdus mā ra ya rbad sod/ zhes bri/ mo 'khor gyi phyi la/ sku gsung thugs kyi sngags mthar dza dza4༷༷ bstan bshig dgra bo a mu ka srog la breng shag rbad sod tsakra snying la ram nan raklo rakta snying la thums ril rbad sod/ snying la breng shag rbad sod/ snying khrag tshal pa garbha mṛ dza4༷༷ dgra bo che ge mo'i tsitta phyungs snying la 'dus mā ra ya rbad sod/ e yaX baX suX e myags ya rngubs mug shag ka dun ma hā de wa/ zhes pa nas/ srog breng shag mā ra ya rbad sod kyi bar sngar ltar gyi rjes su las kyi gshin rje dang dregs pa'i lha srin sde brgyad klu bdud nag po mgo dgu gza' bdud yul lha khyod rnams kyi dgra bo 'di'i srog chod dbugs long snying phyungs lus srog khram la thob zhags pas chings byad du chug sho rde khye 'khor dkrugs tshang bshog lo dang zla bar ma 'gyang par zhag dang za ma las myur mgyogs sgrol cigdgra bo 'di'i bdud dang gshed du phob/ zhes bri'o// pho mo'i 'khor lo 'di gnyis kyi bri tshul dpe chung dang mthun par bkod pa ste/ rdo rje urmo gnam sa lto ba dkrugs pa'i man ngag tu bri tshul mi 'dra bar gsung pa
bzhin bris kyang legs/ gang ltar yang pho 'khor gyi yi ge thams cad ling ga'i mgo phyogs nas mgo phyir bstan dang / mo 'khor gyi yi ge thams cad rkang phyogs nas mgo nang bstan du bri ba gnad yin cing pho 'khor la dug sna dang mo 'khor la gri khrag gis byug go pho 'khor gyi rgyab phyogs su gshon rje'i khram byang dpe chung ltar bris pa'i sdig pa'i mgo phyogs nas hūṃX phe ma sha ka du nā ga ra dza tri ling sha ka du ni ya mā ra dza sa ga na ga du ni dung dung du du ne du nai du ne shing khram khram bstan pa bshog pa'i dgra bo 'di 'chi bdag gi khram la thob cig bdud kyi zhags pas bcings/ sa bdag gi byad du chug btsan gyi shwa dhe khrom/ lha srin sde brgyad kyis dgra bo myur du sod/ gza' bdud ra hu la 'khor lha chen brgyad klu chen brgyad gza' chen brgyad las kyi gshin rje la sogs pa khyed rnams kyi bstan pa bzhig pa'i dgra bo myur du sod/ gza' bdud rwa hu la/ sgrol cig lo dang zla ba zhag dang za ma las ma 'gyangs par myur du sgrol cig dam nyams dgra po 'di myur mgyogs su sgrol cig ri po chen po 'di ma zad bar du zo zhig rgya mtsho chen po 'di ma zad bar du 'thung zhigdgra bo 'di rnams myur mgyogs su med par brlag par gyis lhag rlung gi gtor mes bsreg chus khyer cig yig mgo phyi bstan no// mo 'khor gyi rgyab dngos su khram byang dpe chung ltar gyi mthar rus sbal gyi mgo
༄tsho/ /phyogs nas shlau ma ra ya dung dung ka du ka ni dung dung du nai du nai dung lhag khram khram/ dgra kro dam nyams bstan bshig che ge mo 'di khram la las kyi gshin rje lha srin sde brgyad klu bdud mgo dgu khyed rnams kyis dgra bo khram la thob cig lo dang zla bar ma 'gyangs par myur du sgrol gza' bdud ra hu la 'khor gza' brgyad klu brgyad snang srid kyi lha srin sde brgyad klu bdud mgo dgu pa sa bdag klu gnyan khyod rnams la zas skal du dgra 'di rnams gtad pa yin pas myur mgyogs sgrol la sod cig ri bo chen po 'di ma zad bar du zo zhig rgya mtsho chen po 'di ma zad bar du 'thung zhig dgra bo che ke mo 'di pho rgyud rtsad nas chod cig mo rgyud mngal nas skam med par gyis shig dgra bo mi nor zas gsum rtsa ba thams cad rlung la bskur cig ces yig mgo nang bstan no/ /'khor lo de gnyis rabs chad kyi rang 'thag gi rgyab ngos su ya khebs la pho 'khor dang / ma khebs la mo 'bor/ rdo ngos su 'khor lo sbyar te khram byang phyir bstan nas brlan sdig pa'i rang yul la bstan te sbyor/ rang 'thag la dug sna dang khrag sna/ khyad par mdze khrag rnams kyis byugs/dur rdos sgyed bu gsum ri rab du bsam pa'i steng du bzhag nas e ring gi mthar bshig pa g.yu spyang btags pa ṇi chung ngu bsnyen pas nus ldan du sgrub pa phyag len yin/ las sbyor gyi tshe ling ga bca' ba ni/ dug
shog la gri khrag khyi ra phag gsum gyi khrag mdze khrag rnams kyi gzas po'i ling ga mtshan nyid tshangs bar bris pa'i lto bar dmod byang sogs gnad yig spyi mthun du bkodagiX khyad par rus sbal mgo thur bstan bris/de steng ban dgra yin na lte phyir phyung pas brang khebs par bcas pa'i dbus su sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar ya'i khog par ma yig bris pa'i ma'i khog nang du mṛ yig dza stems kyi mthar ban dgra che ge mo'i lus ngag yid gsum aX gu sha dza dza/ ma'i phyi ya'i khog nang bstan dgra dam nyams dgra bo 'di rnams las kyi gshin rje'i zhal du thob/ khram la thob/ srung ma rang gshed du thob cig mgo phyi bstan no// rdo rje'i dbus ra dang g.yas g.yon gyi rwa bar du rwa'i mjug nas brtsam ste dbus rwar mgo bstan pa'i tshul gyis dbus rwar bskor thabs su sa ma ya garbha nag po dṛ dzaXhri dmar rnyu dmar/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i rwa bzhi'i bar stongs la rnyu rtsa phyogs nas nang bstan du/ dgra bo a mu ka snying du na na dza ti nan snying gzer sbur nan/ kā ya waka tsitta nan dgra bo che ge mo'i lus ngag yid gsum lha dang bcas pa bhi tang stum bha nan dza sti stum bha ya nan mṛ dza khas yen yan nan dgra bo 'di rnams stum bha ya nan/ zhes pa cha bsgos nas yig phreng gang shong du bri ba ni khyad par ro// gang ltar yang ling ga'i phyi'i mgo nas bzung yig mgo phyi bstan du pho sngags dang nang bstan du mo
༄༅/ /sngags kyi g.yas g.yon du bskor te gnyis ga'i mjug tu dmod byang bri/ dgug gzhug lha dbye byas la mtha' nas dbus su lkaṃ lpags bstums pa bzhin rim gyi ltab ste dril la sngo mar skud pa dang khyi bal dang ra bal nag pos bcings te rang 'thag gi lte bar khung du bcug de steng rang 'thag gi lte ba btsug yang shog bu tshal pa mang du byas pa la dgra'i ming rus bris pa'i gri rus/ rta rus/ spyang khri'i brun rnams med na khyi brun dgra'i zag rdzas gang rnyed dang lhan cig dum bur dril ba yang brub khung ngam lcags slang lta bu'i nang du bkod/ de nas bdag gi rnal 'byor sngon du 'gro bas/ gser skyems/ gzu dpang / dgug gzhug lha dbye rnams yid ches par byas rjes/ yos khung du gong gi ming rus dril ba nas blugs/ bdag nyid zil gnon du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ rang 'thag gshin rje wo mo gnyis rnams pa zhe sdang lcags sdig nag po dang / 'dod chags khrag gi sbal pa dmar po gsal ba la phog phan tshun rjes su chags pa'i bar gzas pos bkag pas de nyid cher khros te gdug pa'i sprul pa dpag med spros pa kho rang gi lha srung dang bcas pas gzas po thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin ru bcom par bsams la pha rol pos mtshan mo byas pa'i sbyor ba nyin mo bshig pa ni/ e myags kyi mthar a mu ka sarba sha chun srog rtsa hur thums rbad sod/
rtsa khrag snying la thums ril rbad sod/ rakta rbad tsitta phyung / snying la breng shag rbad sod/ che ge mo srog rtsa mṛ hur thums ma ra ya rbad sod/ e yaX baX saX raX/ zhes nyin mo byas pa'i sbyor ba mtshan mo bshig pa ni/ e myags mthar a mu ka srog la breng shag rbad sod/ rtsa khrag snying la ram ma nag mo rakta snying la thum ril rbad sod/ srog la thums ril rbad sod/ snying la breng shag rbad sodagiX rtsa khrag tshal pa galhe'u dza/ che ge mo'i tsitta snying la 'dus/ mā ra ya rbad sodagiX e yaX baX saX raX/ zhes mtshan gyi mo sngags dang bskor sngags brgya rtsa re bzlas mthar sngar bzhin bskor/ de la bskor sngags ni/ e myags 'bru brgyad kyi mthar sngar bzhin bskoraltoX de la bskor sngags ni/ e myags 'bru brgyad kyi mthar/ a mu ka sarba rtsa sbur srog nan/ snyig gzer breng shag sa ma ya rbadagiX sarba sha truX stum bha ya nan/ thums ril trig nan/ e mṛ tri hur thums dza4༷༷shag yam byas pa rnams phyir lhag shigagiX rbad bhyo bhyo che ge mo'i tshe dang bsod nams mthu dang nus pa khar rje za dbang mi nor zas gsum e thums ril rbad byas pa rnams phyir shig shig rlag rlag zhes pa'o// de ltar thun drug tu bskor zhing / khyad par gyi dus gnad ni/ phyi ltar bshog pa bdud nyi dang nyi nag sogs kyi dus dang 'brel bar nyin mo'i byas pa bshog pa'i mtshan sngags nyi shu dgu'i nyi ma dmar thag chod pa la bskor
༄tsho/ /mtshan mo'i byas pa bshog pa'i nyin sngags nyi zla'i tho rangs nas nam langs su nye ba'i skar ma gyes tsam la bskor nang ltar bshig pa lo zad zla zad kyi nyi shu dgu la gong bzhin skoraltoX gsang ba ltar bshig pa nyi zla gzas zin pa'i skabs su bskor/ sngags mi bzla bar phro gcod dus mdzes pho'i mchog phur ram med na grir shi ba'i mchog phur la yugs sa'i skra shad dam med na ro skra btags pa'i sne rang phur btags shing phur bu yos khung du btab nas 'jog thun 'jog khar thun gtor sogs spyi ltar byas na legs/ dgra bo'i ming byang rang 'thag gi phyir thon pa dang nang rtags 'byung ba dus mnyam gsung / 'on kyang las dmigs gsal dang 'brel bar sgrub pa yin na rtags mthong ba dang lte khung gi ling ga phyung pa'i tshab tu spyi ling gsar pa zhig gzhug gong gi ling ga mnan bsreg gang rung gi mtha' sdud bya/ des ni pha rol po thal ba'i rdul du brlag ste rnam shes mi shig pa'i ngo bo 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i dgongs klong du rdzogs par gdon mi za'o// rang 'thag la brten pa'i gnam lcags udma'i las sbyor gyi pra khrid gsal bar bkod pa gnad kyi sgron ma i thi/ pad rtsa'i rjes 'gro sems kyi rtsis/ nyer zin ma dag las min 'gyur med don/ /rgyal bstan rgya mtsho'i dpal du nyer babs na/ /rang gzhan gnyis ka 'tshings pa'i mchog gcig lags/ /'dir
smras pa/ phyag rgya zil gnon yang gsang nges ba'i bcud/ /gnas kyi man ngag zab don sgron me 'dis/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i 'od zer 'phreng / /spros tshe dge legs rgya mtsho'i bdud rtsi thob/ /lag len gzhung gi sgril thabs rtsa ba ston/ /'khor lo'i bris yig dpe chung sdebs pa gces/ /thig rgyan gnad sgron ji bzhin mchod rten bca'/ /rdzas them nges pa rnyed pas ma 'dres gces/ /cho ga'i gnad don tshig gi 'doms pa bzhin/ /ma 'khrugs phrin las sbyor ba dus su khyer/ /zab gnad lhan thabs tshul gyis gang dgos su/ /man ngag sdebs tshul 'khrul med lag tu blangs/ /gnam lcags utna'i sbyor ba snga ma dang / /lhan cig sbyar bas rno myur thog dang 'dra/ /man ngag 'di bdun gcig tu nyams blangs na/ /drag po'i las kun thogs med lhun gyis grub/ /de phyir ma 'khrugs ma gab zab mo'i tshul/ /yi ger bkod 'dir bka' srung dam can tshogs/ /ma mnyes bka' yi chad pa ma mdzad par/ /dam ldan rnal 'byor 'dod don ma lus sgrub/ /cho ga'i bya ba tsam la mkhas pa zhes/ /rtags min lha sngags ting 'dzin rol mo la/ /'byams klas grub brnyes zam mi chad byon pa'i/ /man ngag brjod par 'phangs nas khrigs su ldebs/ /'on kyang bde gshegs bstan pa rin chen la/ /gcig tu gzhol min gdug can 'gro ba'i lam/ /'di thob smyon pas
༄༅/ /ral gri rnyed dang mtshungs/ /de phyir gsang zhing sba ba gnad du che/ /gzhan yang cung zad kun rtog mtho ma'i rjes/ /nyer 'tshe'i las la drag po'i 'khrul 'khor spyod/ /de dag 'di mthong rang gzhan gnyis ka phung / /mthu ldan dam can bka' yi bya ra mdzod/ /'dis thob bsod nams dus gsum gshin rje'i spungs/ /mthar byed rdo rje'i mtshon cha nyid gyur nas/ /rang byung mi 'gyur sku gsum dbyer med chos/ /'jam dpal rdo rje'i go 'phang mngon byed shog ces 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gyis gnon pa lcags 'dra'i man ngag dang rjes su 'brel bar stobs chen dang rjes su 'brel bar stobs chen mchod rten gtso gyur gyi lag len las kyi sbyor ba gsal byed gnad kyi sgron ma bdun pa zhes bya ba 'di yang mthing la myos kyi rigs las dge slong rig sngags 'chang ba padma 'gyur med rgya mtsho 'jigs med dpa' bo'i sdes rang lo so gcig pa gdong ngan gyi lo khrums stod zla ba'i nag phyogs kyi gral tshes dge bar rdzogs par sbyar ba dge legs su gyur cig/ bkra shis dge'o//
༄༅/ man ngag sgron ma bdun pa las/ phag mo gsang ba'i 'khor lo'i dpe'u ris bzhugs so/ /
